Start here从这里开始

ENThis edition explains all 25 main cards and 32 additional topics from the reviewed guide. Each lesson uses three steps: build the idea, follow the mechanism, then work through an example. Examples and analogies are teaching aids. Source anchors connect the explanations to the supplied slides and transcripts.

中文本版为复核版的25张主卡和32条补充知识全部配上讲解。每项按三步展开：建立直觉、跟着机制理解、再看例子。例子与类比用于帮助学习；来源定位对应你提供的课件与字幕。

ENScope and format: Weeks 1–7 plus Week 8 Parts One and Two, physical PDF p5–29; 25 single-answer MCQs, 60 minutes, closed book. Read in Chinese first when needed, then match the English terms. The 25-question mock remains the reviewed practice paper, with 17 concepts and 8 short calculations.

中文范围和形式：Week1–7加Week8前两章，实际PDF p5–29；25道单选，60分钟，闭卷。需要时先读中文理解，再对应英文。25题模拟沿用已复核卷，含17道概念和8道短计算。

ENLesson IDs C01–C25 match the previous main cards; B01–B32 match the additional concepts. They are now arranged in a learning sequence. Integer LOD is taught beside calibration, and grating resolution beside spectroscopy, even though those topics were revisited in later lectures.

中文C01–C25对应原主卡，B01–B32对应原补充概念。本版按学习顺序排列：整数LOD紧接校准，光栅分辨紧接光谱；它们虽在后续课堂重讲，但放在相关基础旁更容易理解。

EN2026-10-12 coverage update: the eight original PDFs have been read again page by page. All 57 existing lessons and their recall statements remain. 52 short S lessons now explain missing distinctions and conditions beside the relevant topic, with 39 original slide figures and bilingual reading guidance. Study the whole chapter, not just the statement that gives a sample answer.

中文2026-10-12补漏更新：重新逐页核对八份原PDF，保留57项原讲解及其重点摘要；在对应知识章旁增加52个S补充小节，讲清缺漏的区别和条件，并加入39张原课件图及中英文读图说明。复习整章知识，不只记得到样题答案的那一句。

ENFor each concept, ask what it measures, how the signal is generated, which conditions the statement assumes, and how it differs from similar methods. A true option also needs a reason. Lower-priority derivations are kept at the level needed to recognize their concepts; the scope still ends before Week 8 Human–Machine Interface.

中文每个概念都问：它测什么、信号怎样产生、这句话依赖什么条件、与相似方法有什么区别。正确选项也要能说出理由。较低优先级的推导保留到能辨认概念的层次；范围仍止于Week8 Human–Machine Interface之前。

ENVisual update: 48 figures now sit beside their concepts: 39 original slide crops and 9 teaching diagrams, including 32 newly added pictures. Read the bilingual guidance below each figure. In the HTML, use Zoom to inspect labels, then Actual size if necessary. The classmate PDF informs the visual layout; the reviewed course scope and content remain the basis.

中文图文更新：共48张图紧跟对应知识点，其中39张原课件截图、9张教学示意，本次新增32张。每张新图下方都有中英文读图说明。HTML可点“放大”检查标签，再选“原始大小”。同学PDF用于参考图文排版；知识内容和考试范围仍以已复核的课程资料为依据。

ENReading colours: blue builds the concept, purple follows the mechanism, green explains examples or recall, and amber marks wording and conditions. P1/P2/P3 separately indicate review priority. Original slide figures retain their own colours; interpret their axes, legends and arrows using the nearby reading guide.

中文阅读颜色：蓝色建立概念，紫色追踪机制，绿色看例子与记忆要点，橙黄色提示题目措辞和条件。P1/P2/P3另行表示复习优先级。原课件截图保留原有配色，需结合旁边读图说明判断坐标、图例和箭头的含义。

EN2026-10-13 reading order: begin each week with its concept map, then read the key points at the start of each lesson before following the explanation and example. The existing topics and figures remain. Comparison with the supplied classmate notes adds short missing explanations and clarifies conditions; the reference is study material, while the slides and classroom evidence determine course scope.

中文2026-10-13阅读顺序：每周先看知识框架，再读每节开头的分点必会知识，随后理解机制与例子。原有知识项和配图保留。对照同学资料后，补上少量缺漏说明并讲清适用条件；参考资料用于学习，课程范围仍依据原课件和课堂证据。

Study priorities and route重点标记与复习路线

ENP1: master first and explain each statement; P2: important foundations that connect or qualify P1; P3: supporting details to consult after the first pass. These levels are study recommendations, not probabilities or a guarantee of the real questions.

中文P1：先掌握，能解释陈述；P2：重要基础，用来连接P1及理解条件；P3：辅助细节，第一轮后按需查。等级是复习建议，不是出题概率或真题保证。

ENEvidence tags are separate: Quiz stated, teacher emphasis, repeated explanation, worked example, sample quiz and final-only emphasis. “Important” alone is not a Quiz promise. Example tags identify practice in the slides/class; they do not invent a separate homework assignment.

中文依据标签分别为：Quiz明确提及、课堂强调、反复讲解、例题练习、样卷涉及、仅期末强调。“重要”本身不等于Quiz保证。例题标签指课件或课堂练习，不凭空认定为独立课后作业。

ENA mixed lesson has a specific review target: focus on that part first. A sample question marks all its relevant option concepts. Its extra derivations or device details can still be P2/P3. Open “Evidence” below a heading in the HTML to see the review target, transcript references and the lecturer’s short quote when available.

中文混合小节有具体学习抓手，先学该部分；样卷标记覆盖相关选项的概念，额外推导或器件细节仍可为P2/P3。HTML中展开标题下的“依据”，可看学习抓手、字幕位置及可核对的老师短引语。

P1: 44 · P2: 53 · P3: 12

First-pass study group第一轮学习组 P1 locationsP1位置 What to do要会什么
Measurement and LOD测量性能与检测限 C02, C03, B03 Distinguish slope, selectivity and LOD; use the linear range and integer-count rule.区分斜率、选择性与LOD；会选线性区、计算及整数计数处理。
Photon energy and absorption光子与吸收 C04, S105 Match wavelength, energy and photon count; calculate absorbance, transmission and ε.对应波长、能量、光子数；会算吸光度、透过率与ε。
Fluorescence荧光 C05, C06, S110, S111 Explain intensity versus color, source/filter roles and Φ, τ, radiative rate.解释强度与颜色、光源及滤光片作用；区分Φ、τ与辐射速率。
Raman and scattering拉曼与散射 C07, B08 Distinguish elastic/inelastic signals and Stokes/anti-Stokes; read cm⁻¹.区分弹性/非弹性与Stokes/anti-Stokes；会读cm⁻¹及位移。
Grating resolution光栅分辨 C08 Use R=mN and distinguish groove density, illuminated width and diffraction order.会用R=mN，区分刻线密度、照明宽度与衍射级次。
Label-free, fibre and resonance无标记、光纤与共振 C09, C10, C11, B10, S115, S116, S117 Recognize cavities, SPR and Raman; explain TIR, evanescent sensing and spatial arrangements.辨认共振腔、SPR与Raman；解释全反射、倏逝场及光纤传感布置。
ART and LSPR抗原快检与LSPR C12 Separate antibody recognition from gold-particle color generation and check the control line.区分抗体识别与金颗粒显色，并会判断控制线。
Microscopy and resolution显微成像与分辨 C13, C14, B14, B15, B17 Compare NA rather than magnification alone; distinguish confocal and two-photon mechanisms.比较NA而非只看倍率；区分共聚焦与双光子机制。
OCT and light detectorsOCT与光探测器 C15, C16, S404 Explain reflectivity-based OCT and CCD/CMOS/PMT roles; separate depth and lateral resolution.理解OCT反射读出与CCD/CMOS/PMT；分清轴向、横向分辨。
Ultrasound and photoacoustics超声与光声 B18, S501 Trace transmit/receive and piezoelectric conversion; distinguish echo depth from a photoacoustic source path.会追踪发射接收与压电转换；区分回波深度与光声源传播路径。
Electrochemical readouts电化学读出 C18, C19, S603 Match voltage/current/impedance readouts, electrode roles and GOx reaction-current relations.对应电位/电流/阻抗模式、电极分工与GOx反应—电流关系。
Bioelectricity生物电基础 C20, C21, B27, S707 Know sources of biopotentials, resting/spike phases and basic charge/voltage/current units.理解生物电来源、静息及尖峰阶段，记基础电荷、电压、电流单位。
ECG, EEG and watches心电、脑电与手表 C22, S705, S706 Identify wave sources and time intervals; estimate frequency and separate watch PPG from EEG/EMG.辨认波形来源与时间；估频率，区分手表PPG与EEG/EMG。
Patch clamp and MEA膜片钳与多电极阵列 C23, S801 Recognize pipette versus array, intracellular/extracellular signals and throughput differences.辨认吸管与阵列、胞内与胞外，以及通量差别。
Amplification and filters放大与滤波 C24, C25 Separate gain, input/output impedance and common-mode rejection; recognize four filter curves.区分增益、输入输出阻抗与共模抑制；会认四种滤波曲线。

ENSuggested order: read the prerequisites you need, complete the P1 groups, use P2 to explain unfamiliar options, then take the 25-question mock in English. Return to P3 when a concept or a diagram still blocks understanding. Keep the full guide for checking; a P3 label does not mean a whole field is excluded.

中文建议顺序：先补自己缺的先修基础，完成P1学习组；用P2解释不熟悉的选项，再用纯英文做25题。概念或图仍不懂时回查P3。完整资料仍供查阅；P3不等于整个领域已被排除。

Foundations before the course concepts先补足理解所需的基础

F01 · What connects these eight weeks?这八周到底在学什么？

ENThe course repeatedly asks one question: how can an invisible biological event become a number we can read? A molecule binds, a cell fires, or light interacts with tissue. An instrument changes that event into a measurable signal. Analysis then connects the signal to the quantity we want.

中文这门课反复讨论一个问题：看不见的生物事件，怎样变成能读出的数字？比如分子发生结合、细胞发出电活动、光与组织相互作用。仪器把事件变成可测信号，再用分析把信号与想知道的量联系起来。

ENThink in four questions: What is the target? What physical event changes? What does the detector measure? How do we interpret the result? For a glucose meter, the target is glucose, a chemical reaction occurs, the electrode measures current, and calibration turns that current into a glucose estimate.

中文每个方法都问四件事：目标是什么？哪种物理事件发生变化？探测器实际测什么？怎样解释结果？血糖仪的目标是葡萄糖，发生的是化学反应，电极实际测电流，校准关系再把电流转换为葡萄糖估计值。

ENRead the foundations first. Then read each topic’s three paragraphs: basic idea, mechanism, and example. Use Chinese mode when a concept is new; use bilingual mode to match terms; finally use English-only mode to practise recognition. The older 32-page guide is useful after understanding, for quick revision.

中文先读本基础章，再读各主题的三段：基本意思、机制和例子。第一次学可切换中文模式，随后用中英对照对应术语，最后用纯英文练识别。理解之后，原32页版本适合做快速复习。

F02 · Atoms, molecules, electrons and ions原子、分子、电子和离子

ENAn atom is a small building block of matter. Atoms joined together form a molecule: H₂O is a water molecule, while H₂O₂ is hydrogen peroxide, a different substance. An electron carries negative electric charge. An ion is an atom or group of atoms with net charge, such as Na⁺ or K⁺.

中文Atom原子是物质的基本构成单位之一。多个原子结合形成molecule分子：H₂O是水，H₂O₂是过氧化氢，是不同物质。Electron电子带负电；ion离子是具有净电荷的原子或原子团，例如Na⁺、K⁺。

ENA chemical reaction rearranges substances. An enzyme is a biological catalyst: it speeds a particular reaction without being consumed in the overall catalytic cycle. An antibody is a recognition protein that can bind a matching antigen. Binding and reaction are different events; a sensor can use either to obtain information.

中文Chemical reaction化学反应改变物质的组成。Enzyme酶是生物催化剂，能加快特定反应，在整个催化循环中不被消耗。Antibody抗体是能结合相匹配antigen抗原的识别蛋白。Binding结合与reaction反应不是同一事件，传感器可利用其中任何一种获取信息。

ENConcentration means amount per volume. A mole is an amount containing about 6.022×10²³ entities; it is not a unit of mass. A solution at 1 mM contains 0.001 mol per litre. The same concentration can correspond to different masses for different molecules because their molar masses differ.

中文Concentration浓度表示单位体积中的量。Mole摩尔是物质的量单位，每摩尔约含6.022×10²³个实体，不是质量单位。1 mM溶液含0.001 mol/L。不同分子的摩尔质量不同，因此相同摩尔浓度不一定对应相同质量。

F03 · Units without panic不慌张地看单位

ENPrefixes change scale: milli (m)=10⁻³, micro (μ)=10⁻⁶, nano (n)=10⁻⁹, pico (p)=10⁻¹², kilo (k)=10³ and mega (M)=10⁶. Therefore 1 mV=0.001 V, 1 μA=0.000001 A, 1 kΩ=1000 Ω, 1 MΩ=10⁶ Ω and 1 pF=10⁻¹² F. Always convert a value together with its unit; changing only the number changes the physical meaning.

中文单位前缀改变数量级：milli（m，毫）=10⁻³，micro（μ，微）=10⁻⁶，nano（n，纳）=10⁻⁹，pico（p，皮）=10⁻¹²，kilo（k，千）=10³，mega（M，兆）=10⁶。所以1 mV=0.001 V，1 μA=0.000001 A，1 kΩ=1000 Ω，1 MΩ=10⁶ Ω，1 pF=10⁻¹² F。数值与单位必须一起转换，只改数字会改变物理意义。

ENWatch the context of m: in 2 m it means metres; in mV it means milli; in y=mC+b it is a symbol for slope. Likewise C can mean concentration, capacitance, or the unit coulomb. MΩ uses the mega prefix, but 1 M for concentration means 1 mol/L. A symbol’s meaning comes from its definition, not just its letter.

中文注意m的上下文：2 m中的m是米，mV中的m是毫，y=mC+b中的m是斜率符号。同样，C可能表示浓度、电容或库仑单位。MΩ中的M是兆前缀，而浓度1 M表示1 mol/L。字母含义要看定义，不能只凭字母判断。

ENUseful conversions: 1 cm=10⁷ nm; 1 s=10³ ms=10⁶ μs. In an echo-depth question, 40 μs is 40×10⁻⁶ s. In a wavelength question, 600 nm is 6×10⁻⁷ m. Write the conversion before substitution to avoid thousand-fold or million-fold errors.

中文常用换算：1 cm=10⁷ nm；1 s=10³ ms=10⁶ μs。回波题的40 μs应写成40×10⁻⁶ s；波长题的600 nm应写成6×10⁻⁷ m。先写换算再代入，避免相差千倍或百万倍。

F04 · Signal, noise and calibration信号、噪声与校准

ENA signal is the measured change carrying information, such as current, wavelength or voltage. Noise is unwanted variation in that measurement. A blank sample contains no target but can still give a nonzero, fluctuating reading. Therefore “I see some output” does not prove that the target is present.

中文Signal信号是携带信息的测量变化，例如电流、波长或电压。Noise噪声是测量中的无用波动。Blank空白样品不含目标，但读数仍可能不为零、也可能波动。所以“有输出”不能直接证明“有目标”。

ENCalibration means measuring known target amounts to learn the response. A straight calibration line y=mC+b says: output y equals slope m times concentration C, plus baseline b. The slope tells how much output changes per unit concentration. The standard deviation σ summarizes how widely repeated blank readings fluctuate.

中文Calibration校准是先测已知目标量，建立响应关系。直线y=mC+b表示：输出y=斜率m×浓度C+基线b。Slope斜率说明每单位浓度带来多少输出变化。Standard deviation标准差σ概括重复空白读数的波动程度。

ENImagine a signal increase of 1 unit. It is easy to see if blank readings fluctuate by only 0.1 unit, but difficult if they fluctuate by 5 units. This is the intuition behind detection limits. A steep response helps only when noise is considered too; this comparison is not about whether a device can identify the correct molecule.

中文想象信号增加1单位：空白只波动0.1单位时，很容易看出来；空白波动5单位时，就很难判断。这就是检测限的直观含义。响应斜率大有帮助，但必须一起考虑噪声；这件事与设备能否认对分子是两个不同问题。

F05 · Light, wavelength, frequency and spectra光、波长、频率与光谱

ENLight is electromagnetic radiation. Wavelength λ is the distance between neighbouring wave crests. Frequency f is the number of oscillations per second, measured in hertz (Hz). In vacuum, c=λf, where c is light speed. A longer wavelength therefore means a lower frequency.

中文光是电磁辐射。Wavelength波长λ是相邻波峰之间的距离；frequency频率f是每秒振动次数，单位hertz赫兹（Hz）。真空中c=λf，c为光速。因此波长越长，频率越低。

ENA photon is a small packet, or quantum, of light energy. Its energy is E=hf=hc/λ. A longer-wavelength photon has less energy, even if a beam contains many such photons and has high total power. Power is energy per second: 1 watt (W)=1 joule (J)/s. Photon energy and total beam power are different quantities, just as one coin’s value differs from the value of a whole bag of coins.

中文Photon光子是一小份光能，即光量子，能量E=hf=hc/λ。长波长光子的单个能量较低，即使光束含很多光子、总功率很大也如此。Power功率是每秒的能量：1 watt（W，瓦）=1 joule（J，焦耳）/s。单个光子能量与整束光的功率不同，类似一枚硬币面值与整袋硬币总值不同。

ENA spectrum plots measured optical strength against wavelength, frequency or wavenumber. A peak shows where a signal is strong; a dip can show where transmission is reduced. Check the horizontal axis before comparing “left” and “right”: moving right in wavelength means lower photon energy, but moving right in frequency means higher energy.

中文Spectrum光谱将测得的光强画在波长、频率或波数坐标上。Peak峰表示信号强的位置；dip凹谷可能表示透射减少的位置。比较左右前先读横轴：在波长轴向右意味着单光子能量更低，在频率轴向右却意味着能量更高。

F06 · Voltage, current, resistance and impedance / 电压、电流、电阻与阻抗

ENVoltage is an electric potential difference: energy difference per unit charge, measured in volts. Current is charge passing per second, measured in amperes. In a water analogy, voltage resembles a pressure difference and current resembles flow rate. The analogy explains their roles; electrical charge is not literally water.

中文Voltage电压是电势差，即单位电荷对应的能量差，单位伏特。Current电流是每秒通过的电荷量，单位安培。用水流类比时，电压像压力差，电流像流量。类比帮助理解作用，但电荷并不是真正的水。

ENResistance R limits current: for an ideal resistor, V=IR. A capacitor stores separated charge, with Q=CV; capacitance C is measured in farads (F). An inductor stores energy in a magnetic field. DC current keeps its direction, although its magnitude may vary; AC current reverses direction, usually periodically. Their AC opposition is described by impedance Z, which includes size and phase, not just resistance.

中文Resistance电阻R限制电流；理想电阻满足V=IR。Capacitor电容器储存分离电荷，Q=CV；capacitance电容C的单位是farad（F，法拉）。Inductor电感器把能量储存在磁场中。DC直流保持方向，大小可以变化；AC交流方向交替反转，通常周期变化。交流中的阻碍用impedance阻抗Z描述，包含大小与相位，不只是电阻。

ENA voltmeter measures between two points; one voltage value needs a reference. A measuring instrument can draw current and change the source it is measuring: this is loading. High input impedance draws less current and helps preserve a weak biological voltage. Amplifier gain is a separate ratio, output voltage divided by input voltage.

中文电压表测两个点之间的差；一个电压值需要参照。测量仪器可能取走电流、改变被测信号，这叫loading加载。高输入阻抗取电流较少，有助于保留微弱生物电压。Amplifier gain放大器增益则是另一个比值：输出电压除以输入电压。

F07 · Resolution, magnification, contrast and pixels / 分辨率、放大倍率、对比度与像素

ENResolution is the ability to distinguish nearby features. Magnification makes an image look bigger. Enlarging a blurry photograph produces a bigger blur; it does not recover missing detail. In microscopy, a smaller minimum separable distance means better spatial resolution. In spectroscopy, a smaller separable wavelength gap means better spectral resolution.

中文Resolution分辨率是区分邻近细节的能力；magnification放大倍率是把图像变大。放大模糊照片只会得到更大的模糊，不会找回丢失细节。显微中最小可分辨距离越小，空间分辨越好；光谱中最小可分辨波长间隔越小，光谱分辨越好。

ENContrast is the difference between an object and its surroundings. You may have sufficient resolution but still fail to see a feature with almost no contrast. A pixel is one sampled position in a digital image; bit depth controls how many intensity levels can be stored. Pixel count, bit depth, contrast and optical resolution describe different things.

中文Contrast对比度是目标与周围的差别。即使分辨能力够，目标与背景几乎一样时也可能看不见。Pixel像素是数字图像中的一个采样位置；bit depth位深决定能存多少强度等级。像素数、位深、对比度和光学分辨率是不同概念。

ENWhen a question says “higher resolution”, translate it into “can separate closer features”. When it says “larger resolution distance”, it may mean a worse separation limit. Always identify the quantity being compared. A label such as 100× describes magnification; NA describes the objective’s light-collection angle and medium.

中文题目说higher resolution时，理解为“能区分更近的细节”。若说larger resolution distance，则可能是最小间距更大、分辨更差。必须看比较的物理量。100×表示倍率；NA描述物镜的收光角和介质。

F08 · How to read three common graphs三种常见图怎么读

ENFor a calibration graph, identify x and y, then choose two points within the linear region. Slope is vertical change divided by horizontal change, not simply the height of one point. If output starts to saturate, the last points are not suitable for the straight-line slope used in the LOD calculation.

中文校准图先认x、y，再在线性区选两个点。斜率是纵向变化除以横向变化，不是某一个点的高度。若输出开始饱和，末端点就不适合计算LOD所用的直线斜率。

ENFor a resonance spectrum, distinguish peak position, peak height and linewidth. A peak moving sideways is a wavelength or frequency shift; a peak getting taller is an intensity change. Full width at half maximum (FWHM) is the horizontal width measured at half the peak height above baseline. These changes carry different information.

中文共振光谱要区分峰位置、峰高和线宽。峰横向移动是波长/频率位移；峰变高是强度变化。FWHM半高全宽是在高出基线的峰高一半处测得的横向宽度。这些变化携带不同信息。

ENFor a time trace, one cycle goes from one repeating feature to the next equivalent feature. Period T is time per cycle; f=1/T. Eight cycles in 0.2 s give 40 Hz. Counting eight peaks from the first to the eighth gives only seven peak-to-peak intervals, so use the actual interval rather than blindly dividing by eight.

中文时间波形中，一个周期从某个特征到下一个相同特征。Period周期T是每轮时间，f=1/T。0.2 s内八个完整周期对应40 Hz。若是从第一个峰到第八个峰，则只有七个峰间隔；要按实际完整间隔计算，不能机械除以八。

Week 1 learning block: Biosensors and measurement quality / 第1学习组：生物传感器与测量质量

Week 1 concept map / 第1周知识框架

ENChapter logic: A biosensor recognizes a target, converts its event into a signal, and uses calibration to judge identity and amount.

中文本章主线：生物传感器先识别目标，再把事件变成信号，最后用校准判断是什么、多少及能否检出。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Analyte · bioreceptor · transducer 分析物·生物受体·换能器 Target, recognition and signal conversion are separate roles. 被测目标、识别与信号转换是三个不同角色。 Details / 详解
Biorecognition 生物识别 Antibodies bind; enzymes catalyse; complementary nucleic acids hybridize. 抗体结合，酶催化，互补核酸杂交。 Details / 详解
Optical · electrochemical · mechanical 光学·电化学·机械 Classify the transducer by the measured physical change. 按测到的物理变化判断换能类别。 Details / 详解
Sensitivity · selectivity 灵敏度·选择性 Sensitivity is calibration slope; selectivity concerns interferents. 灵敏度是校准斜率，选择性针对干扰物。 Details / 详解
Limit of detection, LOD 检测限 LOD=3σ/|m| combines blank noise with linear calibration slope. LOD=3σ/|m|同时考虑空白噪声与线性校准斜率。 Details / 详解
Linearity · response time · reproducibility 线性度·响应时间·再现性 These describe range, speed and consistency; they do not alone establish accuracy. 分别描述范围、速度和一致性，不能单独证明准确。 Details / 详解
POCT · microfluidics 即时检测·微流控 POCT describes test location; microfluidics organizes small-volume sample handling. POCT描述检测地点，微流控组织少量液体处理。 Details / 详解
Minimum integer count 最小整数数量 Round upward only when a minimum integer count must reach a continuous threshold. 仅当最小整数数量必须达到连续阈值时，向上取整。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX101 Calibration sensitivity and concentration LOD, FX102 Hall voltage.

中文本章公式定位：FX101 校准灵敏度与浓度检出限；FX102 霍尔电压。

C01 · [P2] Sensor, transducer and biosensor / 传感器、换能器与生物传感器

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Match recognition, transduction and readout to their roles.学习抓手：分清识别、换能、读出各负责什么。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W1 PDF p14–20, p39–42; T1-0020–0021; T1-0033–0034; T2-0003–0009

“The keyword is another. From one form to another form.”

跨周反复定义；“If I ask you to draw”是教学假设，不是Quiz必考承诺。

ENKey points
  • A sensor responds to a physical or chemical input.
  • A transducer converts a recognition event or another input into a measurable signal.
  • A biosensor combines a biological recognition element with a transducer;
  • the recognition element gives specificity, while the transducer produces the readout.
中文必会知识点
  • Sensor响应物理或化学输入；
  • transducer把识别事件或其他输入转为可测信号。
  • Biosensor由生物识别元件与换能器组成：识别元件赋予特异性，换能器产生读出信号。

ENStart from zero: A sensor helps us measure something that our eyes cannot reliably count, such as glucose in a drop of blood. The analyte is the thing we want to measure. A biosensor uses a biological recognition element, called a bioreceptor, to interact with that target. Recognition alone is not yet a number on a screen.

中文从零理解：传感器帮助我们测量肉眼无法可靠数清的东西，例如一滴血中的葡萄糖。Analyte（分析物）就是我们想测的目标。Biosensor（生物传感器）用一个生物识别元件，即bioreceptor（生物受体），与目标相互作用。但发生了识别，还不等于屏幕上已经有数值。

ENFollow the mechanism: Think of an antibody as a selective catcher and the transducer as a translator. First, the catcher binds its target. Next, that event changes light, electrical current, or another measurable property. Finally, electronics convert the change into a result. The catcher analogy only describes selective binding; an antibody does not consciously identify a substance.

中文跟着机制走：可以把antibody（抗体）想成有选择性的捕捉器，把transducer（换能器）想成翻译器。第一步，捕捉器结合目标；第二步，这个事件引起光、电流或其他可测性质的变化；最后，电子系统把变化转换成结果。捕捉器类比只帮助理解选择性结合，抗体并不会有意识地识别物质。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a glucose sensor uses an enzyme to help react with glucose and an electrode to produce an electrical reading. Glucose is the analyte; the enzyme is the recognition element; the electrode belongs to the transduction system. In a question, ask three separate questions: What is measured? What recognizes it? What produces the signal?

中文用例子理解：教学例子：葡萄糖传感器用enzyme（酶）帮助葡萄糖发生反应，再用electrode（电极）产生电读数。葡萄糖是分析物，酶是识别元件，电极属于换能系统。做题时分开问三个问题：测的是什么？谁识别它？谁把识别变成信号？

ENExam wording: Do not confuse the analyte (the target being measured), the bioreceptor (what recognizes it), and the transducer (what converts recognition into a signal).

中文英文读题抓手：不要混淆analyte（被测目标）、bioreceptor（识别目标的元件）和transducer（把识别转成信号的元件）。

Source / 来源：W1 PDF p13–20; W1 PDF p39–42; W2 PDF p6–12 | T1-0017–0021, T1-0033–0034, T2-0004–0009

B01 · [P2] Biorecognition and sensor families生物识别与传感器类别

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Identify the biological recognition element and the measured signal.学习抓手：看到抗体/酶/核酸时，认出识别对象和输出信号。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W1 PDF p25–31, p39–49; T1-0025–0027; T1-0033–0042; T2-0003–0009

“This additional layer is to ensure that your sensor will only capture, or you can say only detect the target you want.”

要会生物识别和光/电/机械读出对应；不是逐个背应用器件。

ENKey points
  • Antibodies bind antigens;
  • enzymes catalyse reactions;
  • complementary nucleic acids hybridize.
  • Recognition supplies selectivity, while the transducer supplies readout.
  • Optical sensors read light, electrochemical sensors read electrical changes, and mechanical sensors can read mass-induced displacement or frequency shifts.
  • AI interprets measured data;
  • it does not replace the physical sensing step.
中文必会知识点
  • Antibody抗体结合抗原；
  • enzyme酶催化反应；
  • 互补核酸通过hybridization杂交识别。
  • 识别环节提供选择性，换能器提供读出。
  • 光学传感测光，电化学传感测电变化，机械传感可测质量引起的位移或频移。
  • AI分析测得的数据，不能替代实际感测。

ENStart from zero: Different targets need different recognition tools. An antibody binds a matching molecular feature; an enzyme helps a particular chemical reaction occur faster; a nucleic-acid strand binds a sufficiently complementary sequence. Catalysis means speeding a reaction without being consumed overall. Hybridization means complementary strands pairing. These words describe recognition processes, not whether the final reading is optical, electrical, or mechanical.

中文从零理解：不同目标需要不同识别工具。Antibody（抗体）结合匹配的分子特征，enzyme（酶）帮助某类化学反应更快发生，nucleic-acid strand（核酸链）与足够互补的序列结合。Catalysis（催化）指加快反应，而自身不被总体消耗；hybridization（杂交）指互补链配对。这些词描述识别过程，并没有决定最终读数是光学、电学还是机械。

ENFollow the mechanism: After recognition, a transducer needs to turn the event into a measurable change. Optical systems may measure color or light intensity. Electrochemical systems may measure current or potential. Mechanical systems may respond when added molecules change mass or motion. Think of different doorbells announcing the same visitor. The biological recognition is the visitor check; the transducer is the announcement mechanism, so they can be combined in different ways.

中文跟着机制走：识别之后，换能器需要把这个事件变成可测变化。光学系统可以测颜色或光强，电化学系统可以测电流或电位，机械系统可以响应分子附加后造成的质量或运动变化。可以类比不同门铃都能报告同一位访客：生物识别像核查访客，换能器像发出通知的装置，所以两者可以有不同组合。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: an antibody-coated surface can be read optically or electrically. The antibody alone does not determine the sensor family. Ask what physical quantity is measured. AI can help classify or interpret the measured data, but it still needs data from a physical measurement. In a question, do not treat an analysis algorithm as a replacement for sampling, recognition, and signal generation.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：涂有抗体的表面可以用光学方法读出，也可以用电学方法读出。仅有抗体并不能确定传感器类别，要看测的物理量是什么。AI可以帮助分类或解释测量数据，但仍需要来自实际测量的数据。做题时，不能把分析算法当成采样、识别和信号产生的替代品。

Source / 来源：W1 PDF p1–3; W1 PDF p21–31; W1 PDF p39–42; W1 PDF p43–44; W1 PDF p45–49; W1 PDF p50–57; W1 PDF p68–79 | T1-0001–0004, T1-0022–0027, T1-0033–0052, T1-0065–0072

S101 · [P3] Recognize sensor families from their input / 从输入辨认传感器类别

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Supporting concept辅助理解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize each sensor family by input and avoid mixing SONAR, RADAR and LiDAR.学习抓手：按输入认传感器类别，辨清声/无线电/光测距即可。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W1 PDF p20–30; T1-0022–0027

用于分类词汇辨认；不要求逐个器件深入工作细节。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: T1-0022

“I'll go through it very fastly. It's just an example.”

明确说快速概览例子；不能把应用页数当Quiz权重。

ENA sensor family describes what it senses: magnetic field, chemicals, sound, temperature, electric quantities, mechanical quantities, or light. A magnetic Hall sensor produces a transverse Hall voltage related to magnetic field; with other factors fixed, V_H is proportional to B. A thermal sensor can infer temperature from another changing property, such as resistance. Measuring an electrical output does not automatically make the original stimulus electrical.

中文传感器类别描述它感受什么：磁场、化学物、声音、温度、电量、机械量或光。磁性Hall sensor（霍尔传感器）产生与磁场有关的横向Hall voltage（霍尔电压）；其他条件固定时，V_H与B成正比。Thermal sensor（温度传感器）可通过电阻等随温度改变的性质间接测温。最后输出电信号，并不表示最初感受的输入一定是电量。

ENSONAR uses sound; RADAR uses electromagnetic radio waves; LiDAR uses laser light. In an ideal reflected time-of-flight measurement, distance is wave speed times round-trip delay divided by two. Pressure is force per area, whereas a force sensor measures force. A gas sensor reports gas composition or amount through an optical or electrical response; it is a biosensor only when it includes the relevant biological recognition element.

中文SONAR（声呐）用声音；RADAR（雷达）用无线电电磁波；LiDAR（激光雷达）用激光。在理想反射飞行时间测量中，距离=波速×往返延时÷2。Pressure（压力）是单位面积上的力，force sensor（力传感器）测的是力。Gas sensor（气体传感器）以光或电响应报告气体成分或含量；有相应生物识别元件时，才能按生物传感器定义归类。

Source / 来源：Week 1 PDF p20–30; T1-0022–0027

S102 · [P3] Static and dynamic microcantilever sensing / 微悬臂梁的静态与动态传感

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize static deflection versus dynamic resonant-frequency change.学习抓手：认得微悬臂梁的静态弯曲与动态频移两种读出。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W1 PDF p47; T1-0041–0042

课堂作为其他传感器的短例子；没有专门Quiz或详细计算强调。

ENA microcantilever is a tiny beam fixed at one end and free at the other. In static-mode sensing, molecular binding can change surface stress and bend the beam; the readout is deflection. In dynamic-mode sensing, the beam vibrates and a change in attached mass or mechanical properties can shift its resonance frequency. Deflection and frequency are different measured quantities.

中文Microcantilever（微悬臂梁）是一端固定、另一端自由的小梁。Static mode（静态模式）中，分子结合可以改变表面应力，使小梁弯曲，读出deflection（偏转量）。Dynamic mode（动态模式）中，小梁振动，附加质量或机械性质变化可以改变resonance frequency（共振频率）。偏转与频率是两种不同的被测量。

ENUnder a simple fixed-stiffness oscillator model, adding mass lowers the resonance frequency. If binding also changes stiffness or stress, the shift needs the appropriate model. The receptor still supplies target recognition: a frequency shift alone does not identify a particular virus, and mechanical sensing is not automatically selective.

中文在刚度固定的简单振子模型下，增加质量会降低共振频率。如果结合还改变刚度或应力，就需要相应模型判断位移方向。受体仍负责识别目标：仅凭频移，不能认定某一种病毒存在；机械传感也不会自动具有选择性。

Source / 来源：Week 1 PDF p47; T1-0041–0042

B03 · [P1] POCT, microfluidics and the sensing workflow / 现场检测、微流控与检测流程

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q9样卷Q9Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: First explain microfluidic integration/automation in sample Q9 C; POCT comparisons remain P2 foundations.学习抓手：先会样卷Q9 C的微流控集成/自动化优势；POCT比较仍按P2基础理解。

Sample Q9 C: microfluidic integration样卷Q9 C：微流控集成: Sample quiz PDF p2 Q9 C; W1 PDF p65–66

正确选项同样要会解释。只将微流控的集成与自动化优势放入P1，不表示整页POCT/佩戴形式/封装细节都升为P1。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W1 PDF p33–36; T1-0028–0031

以PCR/ART比较检测位置和速度；课堂历史百分比不是通用性能常数。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W1 PDF p65–66; W6 PDF p26–27

微流控/集成用于解释检测流程；不要求记产品参数。

ENKey points
  • Point-of-care testing (POCT) brings testing near the patient;
  • centralized testing sends samples to a laboratory.
  • Sampling → recognition → transduction → analysis is the basic workflow.
  • Microfluidic biochips manipulate small fluid volumes and support integration and automation;
  • wearable devices support repeated or continuous monitoring.
  • Portability alone does not guarantee better analytical performance.
中文必会知识点
  • Point-of-care testing（POCT，即时/现场检测）把检测带到患者附近；
  • centralized testing把样品送到中心实验室。
  • 基本流程为采样→识别→换能→分析。
  • Microfluidic biochip微流控芯片操控少量液体，便于集成与自动化；
  • wearable可穿戴设备支持重复或连续监测。
  • 便携本身不保证分析性能更好。

ENStart from zero: Point-of-care testing, POCT, means testing near the person receiving care, such as a bedside test. Centralized testing sends the sample to a laboratory. A microfluidic chip handles liquid in very small channels and can organize several steps on one device. A wearable stays on the body to collect repeated or continuous information. These terms describe location, fluid handling, or monitoring format, rather than one universal detection mechanism.

中文从零理解：Point-of-care testing（POCT，即时检测）指在接受照护的人附近检测，例如床旁检测；centralized testing（中心化检测）则把样品送到实验室。Microfluidic chip（微流控芯片）在极小通道中处理液体，能把几个步骤安排在一个器件上。Wearable（可穿戴设备）佩戴在身上，收集重复或连续信息。这些词分别描述检测位置、液体处理或监测形式，并不代表某一种统一检测机制。

ENFollow the mechanism: Follow the complete route: collect the sample, bring it to the recognition region, generate a measurable change, and interpret the reading. A chip is like a miniature plumbing system, with channels routing small fluid volumes to different stations. That analogy explains transport, not automatic selectivity. The chip still needs suitable recognition and readout components; making channels smaller does not itself prove a lower detection limit.

中文跟着机制走：沿完整路线理解：收集样品，把它送到识别区域，产生可测变化，再解释读数。芯片像一个微型管道系统，用通道把少量液体送往不同工作站。这个类比解释运输，并不代表芯片自动拥有选择性。它仍需要合适的识别与读出元件，把通道做小本身不能证明检测限更低。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a portable cartridge accepts a drop of blood, separates fluid, mixes reagents, and reads a signal. It combines microfluidics with sensing and can support POCT. Portability may reduce travel and waiting, but analytical quality must still be checked. A smartwatch provides ongoing measurements, while a single rapid-test strip usually provides one result.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：便携检测盒接收一滴血，分离液体、混合试剂，再读取信号。它把微流控与传感结合起来，可以支持POCT。便携可能减少运输和等待，但分析质量仍要检查。智能手表提供持续测量，单次快检试纸通常提供一次结果。

Source / 来源：W1 PDF p32–36; W1 PDF p63–66; W6 p3–12; Sample quiz p2 Q8–9; W4 p35–38, p73–86; W3 p25–32 | T1-0028–0031, T1-0059–0061, T6-0001–0010, T7-0055–0057

S103 · [P3] Electronic noses and sensing-to-action systems / 电子鼻与从感测到行动的系统

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Supporting concept辅助理解Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Trace gas pattern sensing, wireless readout and a sensing–stimulation loop.学习抓手：看懂电子鼻分类、无线读出和感测—刺激闭环的流程。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W1 PDF p69–75; T1-0065–0070

系统和视频应用例子；产业重要性不等于本次Quiz权重。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: T1-0068–0069

电信号易与无线芯片集成被重复解释，会一句理由即可。

ENAn electronic nose exposes a group of chemical sensors to volatile compounds and reads their response pattern. A computer extracts features and classifies the pattern, much as a combination of responses distinguishes an aroma. It measures chemical information, not sound or EEG. Electronic readout is convenient for integrating processing and wireless communication such as Bluetooth; this advantage concerns system integration, not a guarantee of greater selectivity.

中文Electronic nose（电子鼻）让一组化学传感器接触volatile compounds（挥发性化合物），读取它们的响应模式。电脑提取特征并分类，依靠一组响应区分气味。它测化学信息，不是声音或EEG。电读出便于集成处理与Bluetooth（蓝牙）等无线通信；这属于系统集成优势，不保证选择性一定更高。

ENA monitoring system records and reports a signal. A closed-loop system also uses the measured signal to decide an action, then measures the result again. The illustrated implantable example links neural recording, processing and stimulation. Recording is sensing; stimulation or drug delivery is an action by an actuator. A wearable describes where a device is worn, while implantable means it is placed inside the body.

中文Monitoring（监测）系统记录并报告信号；closed-loop（闭环）系统还利用测得的信号决定行动，再重新测量行动结果。课件的植入示例连接神经记录、处理和刺激。Recording（记录）是感测，stimulation（刺激）或drug delivery（给药）是actuator（执行器）的行动。Wearable描述佩戴形式，implantable描述器件放在身体内部。

Source / 来源：Week 1 PDF p69–75; T1-0065–0070

C02 · [P1] Sensitivity, selectivity and limit of detection / 灵敏度、选择性与检测限

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Teacher emphasis课堂强调Sample Q10, Q12样卷Q10、Q12
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Find the linear slope, distinguish selectivity, and calculate LOD=3σ/|m|.学习抓手：会在线性区求斜率、区分选择性，并用3σ/|m|求LOD。

Explicit Quiz emphasis老师明确提到Quiz: W1 PDF p58–62; T1-0053–0058

“This slide is very important because you'll definitely see these type of question on your quiz and final exam.”

明确说Quiz会出现此类题；σ会提供。原p62/样题Q12的电流与电流密度单位问题仍需留意。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: T1-0053; T1-0059–0061

“Now you must know to define the performance of a sensor, which is specifity, sensitivity and limit of detection.”

ASR中的specifity在本课此处对应selectivity；三个性能不能混用。

Sample quiz Q10 (linear slope and LOD)样卷Q10 (linear slope and LOD): Sample quiz Q10 (linear slope and LOD)

只取题目指定的线性区。

Sample quiz Q12 (LOD)样卷Q12 (LOD): Sample quiz Q12 (LOD)

按斜率和背景标准差计算；标出原题单位不一致。

ENKey points
  • For a linear calibration y=mC+b, sensitivity is the slope m.
  • Selectivity means discriminating the target from interfering species.
  • Under the course convention, LOD=3σ/|m|, where σ is the standard deviation of the background response.
  • Holding the other factor fixed, a larger absolute slope or smaller background noise lowers the LOD.
中文必会知识点
  • 线性校准y=mC+b中，灵敏度是斜率m。
  • 选择性是区分目标与干扰物的能力。
  • 本课程采用LOD=3σ/|m|，σ是背景响应的标准差。
  • 在另一因素固定时，斜率绝对值更大或背景噪声更小，才会降低检测限。

ENStart from zero: A calibration curve connects a known target concentration to a measured output. Its slope tells us how much the output changes when concentration increases by one unit; this is sensitivity. Selectivity asks a different question: does another substance also produce a response? The limit of detection, or LOD, asks how small a target amount we can distinguish from background.

中文从零理解：Calibration curve（校准曲线）把已知的目标浓度与测得的输出联系起来。它的slope（斜率）告诉我们浓度增加一个单位时，输出变化多少，这叫sensitivity（灵敏度）。Selectivity（选择性）问的是另一件事：其他物质会不会也引起响应？Limit of detection，即LOD（检测限），则问多小的目标量还能与背景区分。

ENFollow the mechanism: Even a blank sample can give slightly different readings each time. These unwanted fluctuations are noise. Imagine hearing a quiet voice in a noisy room: a louder voice helps, but so does a quieter room. Similarly, LOD=3σ/|m| combines background variation σ with calibration slope m. A steep slope alone does not prove a low LOD.

中文跟着机制走：即使是blank sample（空白样品），每次读数也可能稍有不同，这种不需要的波动叫noise（噪声）。想象在嘈杂房间里听很轻的说话声：声音更大有帮助，房间更安静也有帮助。同样，LOD=3σ/|m|同时考虑背景波动σ和校准斜率m。只知道斜率陡，不能证明检测限低。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: let m=10 output units per mM and σ=2 output units. Then LOD=6/10=0.6 mM. If a second sensor has the same slope but twice the noise, its LOD becomes 1.2 mM. For a comparison question, look for both slope and noise. Lower LOD means smaller amounts can be detected; it does not guarantee selectivity.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：设m=10输出单位/mM，σ=2输出单位，则LOD=6/10=0.6 mM。若另一传感器斜率相同，但噪声加倍，LOD就变为1.2 mM。比较题要同时寻找斜率和噪声。检测限更低，表示能检测更少的量，并不自动保证选择性。

ENClarify the concept: Matrix effect means that other components of the sample affect the measured response. A calibration slope obtained in pure water need not match the slope in groundwater or another complex sample. Compare sensors and calculate LOD using a calibration and noise estimate appropriate to the sample conditions. A high slope is sensitivity; distinguishing the target from interferents is selectivity.

中文把概念讲清：Matrix effect（基质效应）指样品中其他成分影响测量响应。纯水中的校准斜率不一定适用于地下水或其他复杂样品。比较传感器和计算LOD时，应使用与样品条件匹配的校准及噪声估计。斜率大属于灵敏度；区分目标与干扰物属于选择性。

Source / 来源：Week 1 PDF p64 original image: perchlorate response differs between reagent water and groundwater; T1-0053–0061

ENExam wording: Use the linear region rather than a saturated endpoint. A low LOD means better detection capability. Diagnostic sensitivity TP/(TP+FN) is a different meaning of sensitivity; do not substitute it for calibration slope.

中文英文读题抓手：用线性区计算，不能把饱和点纳入斜率。LOD越小，检测能力越好。诊断学sensitivity=TP/(TP+FN)是另一个含义，不能代替校准斜率。

Source / 来源：W1 PDF p58–61; W1 PDF p60–62; W6 p49 | T1-0053–0058, T6-0050–0053

ENRead the figure: Read concentration on the horizontal axis and response on the vertical axis. The orange slope is sensitivity; the blue bracket is the range where one constant slope is useful. The green noise band explains why a small response may be indistinguishable from the blank. With the course criterion LOD = 3σ/m, a steeper slope or smaller blank noise lowers LOD; the saturated section cannot use the same linear calibration.

中文读图：横轴是浓度，纵轴是响应。橙线斜率表示Sensitivity（灵敏度）；蓝括号内才适合用同一个固定斜率校准。绿色Noise（噪声）带说明：信号太小时可能与空白分不清。按本课LOD = 3σ/m判据，斜率更大或空白噪声更小都会降低LOD；进入Saturation（饱和）段后不能沿用原来的线性校准。

Source / 来源：Week 1 PDF p61; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B02 · [P2] Performance beyond sensitivity灵敏度之外的性能指标

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Supporting concept辅助理解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish linearity, response time and reproducibility from sensitivity and LOD.学习抓手：认出线性度、响应时间、再现性，别把它们当灵敏度或LOD。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W1 PDF p58–66; T1-0054–0061

三大指标的P1内容先学C02；这里补充其他性能词汇。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: W1 PDF p65–66; T1-0061

“This slide is not important. This slide is just to show in the end how we can package the entire sensor into a product.”

仅降低就近整机封装页的优先级，不排除selectivity等性能。

ENKey points
  • Linearity describes how closely output follows a straight calibration line.
  • Response time describes how quickly output approaches its final value (95% in these slides).
  • Reproducibility describes agreement across repeated measurements.
  • Selectivity concerns interferents;
  • sensitivity is calibration slope;
  • LOD combines slope with noise.
  • None of these terms alone means overall accuracy.
中文必会知识点
  • Linearity线性度描述输出接近直线校准关系的程度；
  • response time响应时间描述接近最终值的速度（课件取95%）；
  • reproducibility再现性描述重复测量的一致程度。
  • Selectivity选择性针对干扰物；
  • sensitivity灵敏度是校准斜率；
  • LOD兼顾斜率与噪声。
  • 任何一个指标都不单独等于整体准确性。

ENStart from zero: A useful sensor needs more than a large output. Linearity asks whether equal concentration increases give approximately equal output increases over a stated range. Response time asks how quickly the reading settles after the target changes. Reproducibility asks how well repeated measurements agree under stated conditions. These describe the shape, speed, and consistency of measurement, so none can be substituted for another.

中文从零理解：有用的传感器不只需要输出大。Linearity（线性度）问的是：在规定范围内，浓度每次等量增加，输出是否也近似等量增加？Response time（响应时间）问目标改变后读数多久稳定？Reproducibility（再现性）问规定条件下重复测量是否一致？它们分别描述测量关系的形状、速度和一致性，不能互相代替。

ENFollow the mechanism: Think of a bathroom scale. It might repeatedly show the same wrong weight: good consistency, poor accuracy. It might be accurate after a long wait: reasonable accuracy, slow response. For the course's 95% response-time definition, the clock stops when output reaches 95% of its final change, not necessarily when all fluctuation disappears. A biosensor's delays also involve molecular transport and reactions.

中文跟着机制走：想象一台体重秤：它可能每次都显示同一个错误体重，说明一致性好，但准确性差；也可能等很久后才显示正确值，说明准确性尚可，但响应慢。课程的95%响应时间定义，是输出达到最终变化的95%时停止计时，而不是必须等所有波动完全消失。生物传感器的延迟还涉及分子传输与反应。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a reading starts at 0 and finally reaches 100 units. The 95% response point is 95 units. If a graph bends toward a plateau, use its straight region for calibration rather than assuming constant sensitivity everywhere. When asked which sensor is better, inspect the task: continuous monitoring may favor speed, while detecting tiny amounts also needs low noise and an appropriate slope.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：读数从0开始，最终到100单位，95%响应点就是95单位。如果图线弯曲并趋向平台，校准时应使用直线区域，不要假设所有位置的灵敏度都相同。问哪种传感器更好时，要看任务：连续监测可能更重视速度，而检测极少量还需要低噪声和合适的斜率。

Source / 来源：W1 PDF p58–61; W1 PDF p60–62; W1 PDF p63–66 | T1-0053–0061

C03 · [P1] Integer detection threshold: corrected sample Q10 / 整数检测阈值：修正样题Q10

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q10样卷Q10Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Use the linear region and round an integer detection threshold upward.学习抓手：先用线性区得连续LOD，再对整数目标取达到阈值的最小整数。

Sample quiz Q10 (A–D)样卷Q10 (A–D): Sample quiz Q10 (A–D)

课堂明确给4.2个病毒模型阈值，并否定4、选5。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: T7-0057–0060

“Many students will choose four. Because it seems to be rounded off closest to four, but it's wrong.”

只针对不可分割的整数计数；连续浓度结果不一律向上取整。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: Sample quiz p2 Q10; T7-0057–0060

这是样卷课堂讲解，不是独立课后作业。

ENKey points
  • In the sample graph, the linear interval is 20–80 viruses: m=(700−100)/(80−20)=10 pF/virus.
  • With σ=14 pF, LOD=4.2 viruses.
  • The lecturer explicitly rejects 4 and chooses the minimum integer count that reaches the threshold: 5, option B.
中文必会知识点
  • 样题图线性区为20–80个病毒：m=(700−100)/(80−20)=10 pF/virus。
  • σ=14 pF时，LOD=4.2个病毒。
  • 老师明确否定4，并选择达到阈值的最小整数数量：5，对应B。

ENStart from zero: The sample question measures a number of viruses, so the final answer must be a whole number. However, the LOD formula first gives a continuous threshold. A threshold of 4.2 viruses means the required signal corresponds to more than four viruses under the stated model. Four is below that threshold, even though it is numerically closer than five.

中文从零理解：样题测的是病毒个数，所以最后答案必须是整数。但是LOD公式先算出来的是连续阈值。4.2个病毒表示：在题目采用的模型下，需要的信号对应超过4个病毒。4虽然在数值上比5更接近4.2，但仍低于检测阈值。

ENFollow the mechanism: Use only the straight part of the graph to calculate slope. Here, output rises from 100 to 700 pF while virus count rises from 20 to 80, giving m=600/60=10 pF per virus. With background standard deviation σ=14 pF, the required output change is 3σ=42 pF. Divide that change by the slope: 42/10=4.2 viruses.

中文跟着机制走：先只用图中的直线部分求斜率。输出从100增加到700 pF时，病毒数从20增加到80，因此m=600/60=10 pF/个病毒。背景标准差σ=14 pF，需要达到的输出变化为3σ=42 pF。再用这个变化除以斜率，得到42/10=4.2个病毒。

ENTry an example: A helpful analogy is needing at least 4.2 units of money: four whole coins cannot pay the bill; five can. This is rounding upward to meet a minimum, not rounding to the nearest integer. Keep 0.42 μM as 0.42 μM when concentration is continuous. The sample uses the slope as a model near the threshold; experimental validation would require checking that assumption.

中文用例子理解：可以类比成需要至少4.2单位的钱：4枚整硬币不够，5枚才够。这是为了达到最低要求而向上取整，不是四舍五入到最近整数。如果测的是连续浓度，0.42 μM就保留0.42 μM。样题把该斜率作为阈值附近的模型使用，真实实验还需要检查这个假设是否成立。

ENExam wording: The previous guide incorrectly used the nearest option, A=4. This edition corrects it to B=5. Round up only when the question asks for a minimum detectable integer count; a concentration LOD such as 0.42 μM stays continuous.

中文英文读题抓手：旧版错误地选了最近选项A=4，本版改为B=5。只有题目要求“最小可检测整数数量”时才向上取整；0.42 μM这样的浓度检测限仍保留连续数值。

Source / 来源：Sample quiz p2 Q10; W1 p59–62 | T7-0057–0060

Week 2 learning block: Light and optical signals / 第2学习组：光与光学信号

Week 2 concept map / 第2周知识框架

ENChapter logic: Match a light source to the sample, follow how light interacts with it, and distinguish the measured optical quantities.

中文本章主线：先让光源匹配样品，再追踪光怎样作用，最后区分实际测得的光学量。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Ray · wave · photon 光线·波·光子 Paths, interference and energy exchange call for different light models. 路径、干涉与能量交换使用不同光模型。 Details / 详解
Photon energy · photon rate 光子能量·光子速率 E=hc/λ describes one photon; P/E gives photons per second. E=hc/λ描述一个光子，P/E得到每秒光子数。 Details / 详解
Coherence · noise · power 相干性·噪声·功率 Select suitable phase stability, noise and power; brighter is not automatically better. 相位稳定、噪声和功率须合适，越亮不一定越好。 Details / 详解
Absorption · scattering · attenuation 吸收·散射·衰减 Direct-beam attenuation can contain both absorption and redirection losses. 直达光衰减可同时包含吸收与改变方向造成的损失。 Details / 详解
Absorbance · transmittance 吸光度·透射率 A=−log₁₀T=εCL; compare at the same wavelength and matching units. A=−log₁₀T=εCL；同波长比较，并匹配单位。 Details / 详解
Pulse oximetry 脉搏血氧测量 Two wavelengths and the pulsatile component help estimate arterial saturation. 两波长与脉动分量帮助估计动脉血氧饱和度。 Details / 详解
Fluorescence · filters · Φ · τ 荧光·滤光片·产率·寿命 Match excitation and emission bands; Φ is emitted/absorbed and kᵣ=Φ/τ. 匹配激发/发射波段；Φ=发射/吸收，kᵣ=Φ/τ。 Details / 详解
Raman · Rayleigh · spectral resolution 拉曼·瑞利·光谱分辨 Raman exchanges vibration energy; Rayleigh is elastic; grating R=mN separates wavelengths. 拉曼交换振动能，瑞利为弹性；光栅R=mN描述分开波长的能力。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX103 Optical wave, frequency, wavelength and phase, FX104 Photon energy, total energy and photon rate, FX105 Photon momentum, FX106 Energy fractions: reflection, absorption and transmission, FX107 Direct-beam attenuation and characteristic distances, FX108 Beer–Lambert: transmission and two logarithm conventions, FX109 Two-wavelength hemoglobin mixture, FX110 Oxygen saturation and total hemoglobin, FX111 Pulse-oximeter example: ratio of ratios, FX112 Raman shift and absolute wavenumber, FX113 Fluorescence lifetime and exponential decay, FX114 Quantum yield, radiative and nonradiative rates, FX115 Molecular fluorescence brightness, FX116 Grating resolving power and illuminated grooves.

中文本章公式定位：FX103 光波、频率、波长与相位；FX104 单光子能量、总能量与光子率；FX105 光子动量；FX106 反射、吸收与透射能量比例；FX107 直达光衰减与特征距离；FX108 Beer–Lambert：透过率与两种对数约定；FX109 双波长血红蛋白混合关系；FX110 血氧饱和度与总血红蛋白；FX111 血氧仪例题：比值之比；FX112 拉曼位移与绝对波数；FX113 荧光寿命与指数衰减；FX114 量子产率、辐射与非辐射速率；FX115 分子荧光亮度指标；FX116 光栅分辨本领与受照刻线数。

B04 · [P2] Light models, sources and coherence光的模型、光源与相干性

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Choose ray, wave or photon models and compare laser/LED coherence, power and noise.学习抓手：知道三种光模型解决什么问题，并比较激光/LED的相干性、功率与噪声。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p14–28; T2-0014–0015; T2-0019–0027

“In summary, coherence, noise and output power.”

光子能量短算的最高优先内容单列S105；光源技术比较无明确Quiz承诺。

ENKey points
  • Rays describe paths, waves explain interference/diffraction, and photons describe energy exchange.
  • Lasers commonly offer narrower spectra and greater coherence than LEDs or lamps;
  • CW means continuous-wave, while pulsed means time-separated emission.
  • Coherence is a stable phase relationship.
  • Source power and noise affect usable signal;
  • more power is not always better because saturation or photodamage can occur.
中文必会知识点
  • Ray光线模型描述路径，wave波模型解释干涉/衍射，photon光子模型描述能量交换。
  • 激光通常比LED或灯具具有更窄光谱和更高相干性；
  • CW为连续波，pulsed为脉冲发射。
  • Coherence相干性指稳定相位关系。
  • 光源功率与噪声影响有效信号；
  • 功率过大可能饱和或光损伤，并非越大越好。

ENStart from zero: Light can be described in several useful ways. Rays trace where light travels and help explain lenses. Waves have repeating peaks and help explain interference, where waves combine, and diffraction, where light spreads around openings. Photons describe small packets of energy exchanged with matter. These are models for different questions, not three unrelated substances. Choose the model that explains the measured effect.

中文从零理解：光可以用几种有用模型描述。Ray（光线）追踪传播路径，帮助解释透镜；wave（波）有重复的波峰，帮助解释波相加的interference（干涉）以及光绕开口扩展的diffraction（衍射）；photon（光子）描述与物质交换的一小份能量。这是针对不同问题的模型，不是三种互不相关的物质，要选择能解释被测效应的模型。

ENFollow the mechanism: Coherence means a sufficiently stable relationship between wave phases. Phase tells us where a wave is within its repeating cycle. Compare people stepping together: their steps have a predictable relationship. Light waves have no intention, but a stable phase relationship makes interference predictable. Lasers commonly have narrower wavelength ranges and greater coherence than LEDs or lamps. This is a typical comparison, not a guarantee for every device.

中文跟着机制走：Coherence（相干性）表示波的相位之间有足够稳定的关系。Phase（相位）告诉我们一个波处于重复周期中的哪个位置。可以类比步伐整齐的人，他们的动作之间存在可预测关系；光波没有意识，但稳定相位关系使干涉更可预测。激光通常比LED或灯具具有更窄的波长范围和更高相干性，但并不是每个器件都绝对如此。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: interference sensing needs suitable coherence, while fluorescence excitation needs an appropriate wavelength and enough power. CW, continuous wave, means sustained emission; pulsed means emission separated in time. More power may increase a useful signal, but can also cause saturation or damage. In questions, separate wavelength, timing, coherence, and power rather than calling all of them simply 'stronger light'.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：干涉传感需要合适的相干性，荧光激发则需要合适波长和足够功率。CW，即continuous wave（连续波），表示持续发光；pulsed（脉冲）表示发光在时间上分开。功率提高可能增强有用信号，也可能造成饱和或损伤。做题时，把波长、时间方式、相干性和功率分开，不要全部理解成“光更强”。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p13–22; W2 PDF p21–28 | T2-0010–0027

S104 · [P2] Wave terminology, coherence and source noise / 波的术语、相干性与光源噪声

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate wavelength, phase/coherence and intensity noise; compare source tradeoffs.学习抓手：分清波长、相位/相干性、强度噪声，知道光源选择有取舍。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p17, p23–28; T2-0019–0027

“These are the three important aspects that people usually look for in terms of a light source when they build a biosensor.”

technical aspects指coherence/noise/power；非明确Quiz承诺。

ENFor the wave E(z,t)=E₀ cos(ωt−kz), E₀ is field amplitude, ω=2πf is angular frequency, and k=2π/λ is angular wavenumber. Raman spectra commonly use the different wavenumber convention ν_tilde=1/λ. Phase specifies position within an oscillation; polarization describes electric-field orientation, not propagation direction. Keep this k separate from a fluorescence rate constant also called k.

中文波动表达式E(z,t)=E₀ cos(ωt−kz)中，E₀是场振幅，ω=2πf是angular frequency（角频率），k=2π/λ是角波数。拉曼图常用另一种波数约定ν_tilde=1/λ。Phase（相位）说明振荡位置；polarization（偏振）描述电场方向，不是传播方向。这里的k也不同于同样可能叫k的荧光速率常数。

ENSpatial coherence concerns the phase relationship between different positions across a light field. Temporal coherence concerns how long a predictable phase relationship persists over time; a narrower spectrum commonly gives a longer coherence time. They are independent aspects: the slide shows a superluminescent diode, SLD, with relatively high spatial coherence and low temporal coherence. Coherence is not simply equal brightness everywhere.

中文Spatial coherence（空间相干）关注光场不同空间位置之间的相位关系；temporal coherence（时间相干）关注相位关系随时间能保持多久，较窄光谱通常对应更长相干时间。两者是不同方面：课件中的SLD（superluminescent diode，超辐射发光二极管）具有相对较高的空间相干和较低的时间相干。相干不等于所有位置亮度都相同。

ENIntensity noise changes signal height; wavelength or frequency noise moves its spectral position. The slides distinguish quantum noise, including spontaneous-emission contributions, from technical noise caused by pump/current fluctuations, temperature or vibration. A source should have suitable coherence, sufficiently low noise and adequate power. More power does not by itself correct wavelength drift or prevent sample saturation. RIN stands for relative intensity noise: it characterizes intensity fluctuations relative to the source’s average optical power, not the mean power alone.

中文Intensity noise（强度噪声）改变信号高度；wavelength/frequency noise（波长/频率噪声）改变光谱位置。课件区分quantum noise（量子噪声，包括自发辐射贡献）与technical noise（技术噪声，由泵浦/电流波动、温度或振动造成）。光源需要合适相干性、足够低噪声和适当功率；增大功率本身不能纠正波长漂移，也不能避免样品饱和。 RIN是relative intensity noise（相对强度噪声），表征相对于光源平均光功率的强度波动，不是平均功率本身。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p17, p23–28; T2-0010–0012, T2-0019–0027

S105 · [P1] Single-photon energy versus photon rate / 单光子能量与光子数量速率

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Use E=hc/λ for one photon and Ṅ=P/E for photon rate.学习抓手：单光子能量用hc/λ，光子速率用P/E；别把功率当单光子能量。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p19–20; T2-0014–0015

“Keep in mind that the third model is the most important one. We will continue to use this down the road.”

明确强调光子模型，能量与光子数是后续荧光/双光子的基础。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p80–81; T2-0101–0104

有光子数课堂题；简短关系优先，功率/面积/吸收率长综合题后读。

Final-exam emphasis仅期末考试强调: T2-0104

“This is a very typical exam type question.”

长综合示例为期末式exam type；不承诺Quiz复制同样长题。

ENOne photon has energy E=hc/λ. For N photons of the same wavelength, total energy is NE. Power P is energy per second, so photon arrival rate is N_dot=P/E=Pλ/(hc), with units photons/s. Convert watts to J/s and wavelength to metres when using SI h and c. The useful shortcut is E(eV)=1240/λ(nm); 1.24 is the coefficient when wavelength is in micrometres. A photon also has momentum: in vacuum p=h/λ. Longer wavelength gives smaller momentum per photon; transferring photon momentum to matter produces radiation pressure.

中文单个光子的能量E=hc/λ。同一波长的N个光子，总能量为NE。Power P（功率）是每秒能量，因此光子到达速率N_dot=P/E=Pλ/(hc)，单位photons/s。用SI单位h、c时，把瓦看作J/s，波长换成米。常用简式为E(eV)=1240/λ(nm)；波长用微米时，系数才是1.24。 光子也有momentum（动量），真空中p=h/λ；波长越长，单光子动量越小。光把动量传给物体时可产生radiation pressure（辐射压力）。

ENAt 410 nm, E is about 4.84×10⁻¹⁹ J; 10 nW therefore corresponds to about 2.07×10¹⁰ incident photons/s. At fixed power, longer-wavelength photons have less individual energy, so more photons arrive each second. Incident, absorbed and detected photon counts are different: absorption probability, quantum yield and detector efficiency can reduce the count at later stages.

中文410 nm时，E约为4.84×10⁻¹⁹ J；10 nW因此对应约2.07×10¹⁰个入射光子/秒。功率固定时，长波长光子的单个能量较少，所以每秒光子数较多。Incident（入射）、absorbed（吸收）和detected（检测）光子数不同：吸收概率、量子产率和探测效率可能使后续阶段的数量减少。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p19–20, p80–81; T2-0013–0015

ENClarify the concept: In the particle model, a photon in vacuum also carries momentum p=h/λ. Absorption or reflection can transfer momentum to an object, so light can exert pressure. At the same vacuum wavelength, single-photon energy E=hc/λ and momentum p=h/λ are different quantities; P/E gives photons per second, not momentum.

中文把概念讲清：粒子模型中，真空中的光子还携带momentum（动量）p=h/λ。吸收或反射可以向物体传递动量，所以光能施加压力。同一真空波长下，单光子能量E=hc/λ与动量p=h/λ是不同量；P/E得到每秒光子数，不是动量。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p19 (explicit Photon momentum and light pressure); T2-0013–0015

B05 · [P2] Absorption, scattering and penetration吸收、散射与穿透

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate absorption from scattering and explain attenuation and NIR penetration.学习抓手：分清吸收与散射，解释直达光衰减和近红外相对深穿透。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W2 PDF p29–33, p44–46; T2-0028–0036; T2-0052–0055; T4-0004–0006

基础机制跨周复习；近红外有利于穿透并不代表零损耗。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: W2 PDF p32–33; T2-0036

“You don't need to memorize these are constant.”

只是不背各材料系数表；系数含义、长度和衰减方向仍要理解。

ENKey points
  • Absorption transfers optical energy to matter;
  • scattering redirects light.
  • Ballistic attenuation can include both: μt=μa+μs.
  • Rayleigh and Mie scattering are elastic;
  • their regimes depend on particle size relative to wavelength.
  • Raman scattering is inelastic.
  • Tissue penetration depends on both absorption and scattering;
  • the near-infrared window is useful, but not loss-free.
中文必会知识点
  • Absorption吸收把光能传给物质；
  • scattering散射改变光的传播方向。
  • 直达光衰减可同时包含两者：μt=μa+μs。
  • Rayleigh瑞利与Mie米氏散射都是弹性散射，其适用情形取决于颗粒相对波长的尺寸；
  • Raman拉曼为非弹性。
  • 组织穿透取决于吸收与散射；
  • 近红外窗口有利于穿透，但并非没有损耗。

ENStart from zero: If less light arrives straight behind tissue, it does not follow that all missing light was absorbed. Absorption transfers light energy to material. Scattering redirects light, so some can leave sideways or backward instead of reaching the straight-through detector. Ballistic light means light that follows the original path without scattering. Its attenuation can include both absorption and scattering: μt=μa+μs.

中文从零理解：如果组织正后方收到的光减少了，并不表示所有少掉的光都被吸收了。Absorption（吸收）把光能传给材料；scattering（散射）改变方向，因此部分光会向侧面或后方离开，无法到达直透探测器。Ballistic light（直达光）指没有被散射、沿原路径传播的光。其衰减可以同时包括吸收和散射：μt=μa+μs。

ENFollow the mechanism: Imagine a hallway: some people stop inside rooms, while others turn into side passages. Both reduce the number reaching the far end, but for different reasons. Here μa describes absorption loss per distance and μs scattering loss per distance. Rayleigh and Mie are elastic scattering regimes, meaning photon energy is unchanged; particle size relative to wavelength matters. Raman differs because it exchanges energy with molecular vibrations.

中文跟着机制走：想象一条走廊：有些人停进了房间，另一些人拐进了岔路，两者都会减少到达末端的人数，但原因不同。这里μa描述单位距离的吸收损失，μs描述单位距离的散射损失。瑞利和米氏属于elastic scattering（弹性散射）情形，表示光子能量不变，颗粒尺寸与波长的相对大小很重要。拉曼不同，因为它与分子振动交换能量。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a cloudy suspension can strongly reduce a narrow transmitted beam even without strong absorption. A tissue's useful imaging depth therefore depends on scattering as well as absorption. A near-infrared window offers favorable losses for some tissues, not zero losses. If a question equates all attenuation with absorption, check whether scattering is being ignored. Scattered photons need not be destroyed.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：浑浊悬液即使吸收不强，也可能显著削弱一束狭窄的透射光。组织的有效成像深度因此既依赖散射，也依赖吸收。Near-infrared window（近红外窗口）对某些组织具有较有利的损耗，并不代表无损耗。如果题目把所有attenuation（衰减）都等同于吸收，要检查是否忽略了散射。散射光子并不一定被消灭。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p29–33; W2 PDF p44–46; W2 PDF p55–62; W2 PDF p61–64 | T2-0028–0036, T2-0052–0055, T2-0070–0082

S106 · [P2] Attenuation coefficients and characteristic distances / 衰减系数与特征距离

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Interpret μa+μs, inverse-length units and longer-path attenuation.学习抓手：会解释μa+μs、长度倒数单位、光程更长衰减更强。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W2 PDF p30–33; T2-0034–0036

老师反复解释长度与吸收/散射系数共同决定强度。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: T2-0036

“Different material, different sample has different coefficient, which will be given you.”

不背材料系数表；不是不要理解衰减公式。

ENFor the directly transmitted, unscattered component in a uniform sample, I(L)=I₀ exp[−(μ_a+μ_s)L]. The coefficients have units of inverse length, such as cm⁻¹; multiplying a coefficient by L gives a dimensionless exponent. Increasing either coefficient or path length reduces this direct component. This model does not describe every multiply scattered photon collected by every detector.

中文均匀样品中，直接透过、未经散射的光分量满足I(L)=I₀ exp[−(μ_a+μ_s)L]。系数单位是长度的倒数，例如cm⁻¹；系数乘光程L后，指数无量纲。增大任一系数或光程，都会减少该直达分量。这个模型并不代表每种探测器收集到的全部多次散射光。

ENThe slide interprets 1/μ_a and 1/μ_s as characteristic mean distances for absorption and scattering, respectively. For total direct-beam attenuation, 1/μ_t is the distance at which I/I₀ falls to 1/e. It is a scale of exponential decay, not a sharp border after which all light disappears. In R+A+T=1, A denotes an absorbed fraction; it is not the logarithmic absorbance A of Beer–Lambert notation.

中文课件把1/μ_a和1/μ_s分别解释为吸收与散射的特征平均距离。对直达光总衰减，1/μ_t是I/I₀降到1/e的距离，这是指数衰减尺度，不是“过了这条边界光全没了”。在R+A+T=1中，A代表吸收比例；它不是Beer–Lambert记号里取对数的absorbance A（吸光度）。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p30–33; T2-0034–0036

C04 · [P1] Absorbance and Beer–Lambert law吸光度与比尔—朗伯定律

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q11样卷Q11Worked example例题练习Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Convert T to absorbance and solve A=εCL with matching units and wavelength.学习抓手：会由T求A，再用A=εCL短算；单位、前后比较波长必须一致。

Sample quiz Q11 (A–D)样卷Q11 (A–D): Sample quiz Q11 (A–D)

ε=A/(CL)，不是把A当百分数或漏乘光程。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p41–43; T2-0048–0051

课堂/课件Example：换光程、15%透过率求ε；并非另有课后作业承诺。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p36–40; T2-0045–0047

“It should be fair that the comparison of your intensity before and after is under the same wave then.”

ASR wave then指wavelength；这是有效比较的关键条件。

ENKey points
  • Absorbance is A=−log₁₀(I/I₀)=εCL.
  • Transmittance is T=I/I₀, so A=−log₁₀T.
  • If C is in mol/L and L in cm, ε must be in L mol⁻¹ cm⁻¹.
  • A=1 means 10% transmitted light;
  • A=2 means 1%.
中文必会知识点
  • 吸光度A=−log₁₀(I/I₀)=εCL；
  • 透射率T=I/I₀，所以A=−log₁₀T。
  • 若C用mol/L、L用cm，ε必须用L mol⁻¹ cm⁻¹。
  • A=1代表透过10%，A=2代表透过1%。

ENStart from zero: Shine light through a solution and compare the light before and after it. I₀ is the incoming intensity and I is the transmitted intensity. Transmittance T=I/I₀ is the fraction that gets through. Absorbance A=−log₁₀T expresses that loss on a logarithmic scale. Therefore, absorbance is not simply the percentage of light absorbed; the two quantities use different scales.

中文从零理解：让光穿过一杯溶液，比较进入前和穿出后的光强。I₀是入射光强，I是透射光强。Transmittance（透射率）T=I/I₀表示有多大比例的光穿过去。Absorbance（吸光度）A=−log₁₀T用对数尺度表示这种损失。因此，吸光度不是直接的吸收百分比，两者使用不同的尺度。

ENFollow the mechanism: Beer–Lambert law says A=εCL under its measurement assumptions. C is concentration, L is the distance through the sample, and ε describes how strongly the substance absorbs at the chosen wavelength. More absorbing molecules or a longer path give light more opportunities to be absorbed. Think of walking through a longer crowd, although molecules absorb light rather than physically blocking it like people.

中文跟着机制走：在相应测量假设下，比尔—朗伯定律为A=εCL。C是浓度，L是光在样品中经过的距离，ε表示物质在所选波长处的吸收能力。吸收分子更多，或者路径更长，都使光有更多机会被吸收。可以类比走过更长的人群，但分子是在吸收光，并非像人一样直接挡住光。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: T=0.1 gives A=1. Doubling concentration or path length doubles A to 2, so T becomes 0.01, not zero. This multiplication of transmission losses is why the logarithm is useful. Match units: concentration in mol/L and path in cm require ε in L mol⁻¹ cm⁻¹. Strong scattering or unsuitable concentrations can invalidate the simple absorption model.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：T=0.1时，A=1。浓度或光程加倍，A就加倍到2，于是T变为0.01，而不是零。透射损失之间这种相乘关系，正是对数方便的原因。单位要匹配：浓度用mol/L、光程用cm时，ε应为L mol⁻¹ cm⁻¹。强散射或不合适的浓度可能使简单吸收模型不再适用。

ENClarify the concept: Beer–Lambert uses A=−log₁₀T=εCL. The equivalent natural-exponential form is T=exp(−ε′CL), with ε′=ln(10)ε≈2.303ε. The two coefficients are not numerically identical. For the slide example A₁=0.35 at L₁=2 cm, changing only the path to L₂=4.5 cm gives A₂=0.35×4.5/2=0.7875≈0.79; keep intermediate precision before rounding.

中文把概念讲清：Beer–Lambert形式为A=−log₁₀T=εCL。等价的自然指数形式是T=exp(−ε′CL)，其中ε′=ln(10)ε≈2.303ε，两个系数数值不同。课件例子L₁=2 cm、A₁=0.35，若仅把光程改为L₂=4.5 cm，则A₂=0.35×4.5/2=0.7875≈0.79；中间计算不要提前取整。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p38 and p41–42; numerical check 0.35×4.5/2=0.7875; T2-0041–0051

ENExam wording: The lecturer names A=εCL as a short equation to remember for the closed-book Quiz. Absorbance is dimensionless and is not the same as an absorbed fraction or a current.

中文英文读题抓手：老师明确举A=εCL为闭卷Quiz应记忆的短公式。Absorbance无量纲，不等于吸收比例，也不是电流。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p36–40; W2 PDF p41–43; Sample quiz p2 Q11; Sample quiz p3 Q12; W2 p37–43; W1 p61–62 | T2-0041–0051, T7-0060–0061

S107 · [P2] Wavelength selection, blanks and absorption spectra / 波长选择、空白与吸收光谱

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Read an absorption spectrum, choose a matched wavelength and understand the blank.学习抓手：会读吸收光谱、选匹配波长，解释为什么需要空白。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p34–40; T2-0045–0047

“You cannot compare under a different wave then.”

wave then为wavelength；与C04一起防止比较不同波长。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p41–43; T2-0048–0051

例题和双光路示例说明blank/样品；最高优先计算在C04。

ENA monochromator selects a narrow wavelength band: an entrance slit admits light, a dispersive element separates wavelengths, and an exit slit selects the band sent through the sample. A detector then measures transmitted light. A grating separates wavelengths; a photodetector measures light; a sample holder supplies the optical path. These components have different jobs.

中文Monochromator（单色器）选择较窄波段：entrance slit（入射狭缝）让光进入，dispersive element（色散元件）分开波长，exit slit（出射狭缝）选出送往样品的波段，再由探测器测透射光。Grating（光栅）分波长，photodetector（光探测器）测光，sample holder（样品池）提供光程，这些元件的功能不同。

ENCompare I and I₀ at the same wavelength. A blank/reference containing the solvent and relevant background provides a baseline so their contribution is not mistaken for target absorption; a buffer is not universally transparent at every wavelength. The coefficient ε depends on wavelength. At fixed wavelength and path length, increasing concentration raises absorbance in the valid linear range; different wavelengths can have different ε and peak heights.

中文I与I₀必须在相同波长下比较。含溶剂及相应背景的blank/reference（空白/参照）提供基线，避免把背景贡献误认成目标吸收；不能断言所有buffer（缓冲液）在每个波长都透明。ε随波长变化。波长和光程固定、且处于有效线性范围时，浓度越高吸光度越大；不同波长处的ε和峰高可以不同。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p34–43; T2-0037–0051

ENClarify the concept: Typical spectroscopy associations in the slide are: X-rays—core-electron transitions; UV–visible—valence-electron transitions; infrared—molecular vibrations; microwaves—molecular rotations; radiofrequency—electron or nuclear spins. Use these to identify the kind of interaction being studied; they are typical associations, not exclusive statements that each band has only one possible interaction.

中文把概念讲清：课件中的典型光谱对应为：X-rays X射线——内层电子跃迁；UV–visible紫外/可见——价电子跃迁；infrared红外——分子振动；microwaves微波——分子转动；radiofrequency射频——电子或核自旋。可据此辨认研究的相互作用；这些是典型对应，不代表每个波段只有唯一作用。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p35 original spectroscopy diagram; T2-0037–0040 explains different spectroscopy methods

ENRead the figure: The horizontal axis is wavelength, not concentration; the vertical axis is absorbance A, not transmitted intensity. Near the absorption peak, this sample gives a larger signal than at the spectral tail. For the same analyte, path length and wavelength, Beer–Lambert predicts A ∝ C in its valid range. Selecting λmax can improve sensitivity, but interference and usable absorbance range still matter; compare with a matched blank.

中文读图：横轴是Wavelength（波长），不是浓度；纵轴是Absorbance A（吸光度），不是透射光强。该样品在吸收峰附近的信号比光谱尾部大。同一物质、光程和波长下，在Beer–Lambert定律适用范围内有A ∝ C。选λmax可提高灵敏度，但仍需考虑干扰和可测吸光度范围，并扣除匹配的Blank（空白）影响。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p39; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B06 · [P2] Pulse oximetry / 脉搏血氧测量

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain why two wavelengths distinguish Hb from HbO₂ and isolate arterial pulsation.学习抓手：解释两波长为何能区分Hb/HbO₂，及脉动分量为何有用。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p47–54; T2-0061–0069

“This is the most important part you need to understand, and this is also the working principle of a post oximeter.”

强调对象是两波长、不同吸收，不是长公式背诵。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p52–54; T2-0065–0067

会读峰谷和题给系数、代题给式即可；没有找到独立课后任务标记。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: T2-0063; T2-0065

“You don't need to memorize this. This is just to show how it is really calculated.”

降低推导/整条氧饱和度公式记忆，不能解读为整个血氧概念不考。

ENKey points
  • Two wavelengths exploit different absorption by oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin;
  • the pulsatile component helps isolate the arterial contribution.
  • Know oxygenated versus deoxygenated hemoglobin and differential absorption.
  • This estimates oxygen saturation, not simply the total amount of blood.
  • The long saturation equation is lower priority under the lecturer’s instruction.
中文必会知识点
  • 两个波长利用oxyhemoglobin氧合血红蛋白与deoxyhemoglobin脱氧血红蛋白的吸收差异；
  • pulsatile脉动分量帮助分离动脉贡献。
  • 要认得氧合/脱氧及差异吸收。
  • 估计量是oxygen saturation血氧饱和度，不是简单的总血量。
  • 按老师说明，长的饱和度方程降低优先级。

ENStart from zero: Hemoglobin is the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells. Oxyhemoglobin carries oxygen; deoxyhemoglobin has released it. Oxygen saturation describes the fraction of available hemoglobin binding sites occupied by oxygen. A pulse oximeter estimates this from light, commonly using red and infrared wavelengths. It is not simply counting blood cells, measuring total blood volume, or reading heart rate alone.

中文从零理解：Hemoglobin（血红蛋白）是红细胞中携带氧的蛋白质。Oxyhemoglobin（氧合血红蛋白）携带氧，deoxyhemoglobin（脱氧血红蛋白）已经释放氧。Oxygen saturation（血氧饱和度）描述可用血红蛋白结合位点中，有多大比例被氧占据。Pulse oximeter（脉搏血氧仪）通常用红光与红外光估计这个比例，并非简单数血细胞、测总血量或只测心率。

ENFollow the mechanism: The two hemoglobin forms absorb the two wavelengths differently. The device compares their changing optical signals. During each heartbeat, arterial blood volume changes, creating a pulsatile component above a relatively steady background from other tissue and blood. Focusing on this component helps isolate the arterial contribution. Think of noticing a flashing light against a steady lamp; measured time-varying signals help, without removing every background effect.

中文跟着机制走：两种血红蛋白对两个波长的吸收不同，仪器比较相应的光信号变化。每次心跳时，动脉血量改变，在其他组织和血液形成的相对稳定背景上产生pulsatile component（脉动分量）。关注这一分量，有助于分离动脉的贡献。可以类比在常亮灯旁识别闪烁灯；测得的时间变化信号有帮助，但不能消除所有背景影响。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: if only one wavelength were measured, a weaker signal could reflect several causes, including more blood or different oxygenation. Two wavelengths and the pulse-related component provide more information for the calibrated estimate. When recognizing the method, look for differential hemoglobin absorption plus pulsation. You do not need the long saturation equation to understand why both wavelengths and a time-dependent signal are useful.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：如果只测一个波长，信号变弱可能来自不同原因，包括血量更多或氧合状态不同。两个波长加上与脉搏相关的分量，为校准后的估计提供更多信息。辨认该方法时，寻找“血红蛋白差异吸收＋脉动”。不背长的饱和度方程，也能理解为什么两个波长和随时间变化的信号都有用。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p47–54 | T2-0056–0069

S108 · [P2] Pulse-oximeter geometry and absorption directions / 血氧仪布置与吸收方向

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Read red/IR absorption directions and distinguish transmission from reflection geometry.学习抓手：读红光/近红外吸收方向，分清透射式和反射式布置。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p44–54; T2-0061–0069

“This is the most important part you need to understand, and this is also the working principle of a post oximeter.”

强调的是两物质在两波长吸收不同，不是医学阈值或长公式。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p52–54; T2-0065–0067

需会从图读峰谷和题给系数；不能把一个示例方向扩大到所有波长。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: T2-0063

“You don't need to memorize this. This is just to show how it is really calculated.”

只降低详细求解式的记忆优先级。

ENIn transmissive oximetry, source and detector are on opposite sides, as in a finger clip. In reflectance oximetry, they are on the same side and the detector collects returned light, useful for sites such as the wrist. Both exploit wavelength-dependent hemoglobin absorption; reflectance mode does not mean that absorption is irrelevant.

中文Transmissive oximetry（透射式血氧测量）中，光源和探测器在两侧，例如指夹；reflectance oximetry（反射式）中，两者位于同一侧，探测器收集返回光，可用于手腕等位置。两种布置都利用血红蛋白随波长变化的吸收；反射式并不意味着吸收没有作用。

ENFor the common red/infrared comparison near 660/940 nm, deoxyhemoglobin absorbs red light more strongly than oxyhemoglobin, while the taught infrared comparison reverses that tendency. The pulse-related components at both wavelengths are compared to estimate arterial saturation. Oxygen saturation is C_ox/(C_ox+C_de); total hemoglobin is C_ox+C_de. Saturation and total concentration are distinct.

中文对常用约660/940 nm的红光/红外比较，deoxyhemoglobin（脱氧血红蛋白）对红光的吸收强于oxyhemoglobin（氧合血红蛋白），课件中的红外比较趋势相反。比较两个波长与脉搏有关的分量，以估计动脉血氧。血氧饱和度为C_ox/(C_ox+C_de)，总血红蛋白浓度为C_ox+C_de；饱和度与总浓度是不同量。

ENThe near-infrared tissue window reflects a favorable balance of absorption and scattering. It does not provide unlimited penetration: scattering blurs spatial detail, and strong water absorption at other infrared wavelengths can increase loss. The long pulse-oximetry equation is lower priority; ratios and logarithms of intensity ratios are dimensionless, even though the slide solution prints nm beside them.

中文Near-infrared tissue window（组织近红外窗口）来自较有利的吸收/散射组合，不意味着无限穿透：散射模糊空间细节，其他红外波段的强水吸收还会增加损耗。长的血氧方程优先级较低；光强比以及光强比的对数均无量纲，不能沿用课件答案旁错误标出的nm。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p44–54; T2-0052–0069

ENClarify the concept: At an isosbestic wavelength, the two hemoglobin forms have equal extinction coefficients: in the ideal two-component model, absorption then depends on their total concentration rather than their oxygenation ratio.

中文把概念讲清：Isosbestic wavelength（等吸收点）处两种血红蛋白消光系数相同；理想两组分模型中，该处吸收取决于两者总浓度，而不是氧合比例。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p44–46, p49–52; p46 original hemoglobin absorption curves; T2-0052–0069

ENRead the figure: At 660 nm, follow the dashed line upward: deoxyhemoglobin (Hgb) absorbs more than oxyhemoglobin (HgbO₂). Near the infrared marker, their ordering reverses. Two wavelengths therefore help distinguish their contributions. This original plot marks 920 nm; the typical pulse-oximeter pair described on p52 is 660/940 nm. These curves show absorption coefficients, whereas actual pulse oximetry uses the pulsatile signal and calibration rather than reading saturation directly from one curve.

中文读图：沿660 nm虚线向上看：脱氧血红蛋白Hgb的吸收高于氧合血红蛋白HgbO₂；到红外标线附近，大小关系相反，所以两个波长有助于区分两者贡献。原图标的是920 nm；课件p52所讲典型血氧仪组合是660/940 nm。图展示的是吸收系数；实际Pulse oximetry（脉搏血氧测量）使用脉动信号和校准，不能凭一条曲线直接读出血氧饱和度。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p46; original slide figure / 原课件截图

C05 · [P1] Fluorescence and Stokes shift荧光与斯托克斯位移

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q1样卷Q1Repeated explanation反复讲解Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain Stokes shift and identify valid fluorescence source, filter and readout statements.学习抓手：会解释Stokes shift，并判断荧光光源、滤光片、读出各选项。

Sample quiz Q1 (A–D)样卷Q1 (A–D): Sample quiz Q1 (A–D)

A强度/颜色、B二向色镜、C光源匹配、D双光子低能量都要会判断。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W2 PDF p69–79; T2-0088–0100; T7-0050–0051

激发→弛豫→发射和三种分光部件反复讲；不只背D错误。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p79–81; T2-0099–0104

读溶剂相关吸收/发射峰及激发波长；长光子数综合题属期末式示例。

ENKey points
  • Fluorescence follows absorption and relaxation in an excited state.
  • The usual Stokes shift gives a longer emission wavelength and lower photon energy than excitation.
  • An excitation filter selects excitation light;
  • an emission filter and dichroic mirror help separate fluorescence from the excitation beam.
中文必会知识点
  • 荧光经历吸收及激发态弛豫。
  • 通常的Stokes shift使发射波长比激发波长更长、光子能量更低。
  • Excitation filter选择激发光，emission filter与dichroic mirror帮助分离荧光和激发光。

ENStart from zero: A photon is a small packet of light energy. In fluorescence, a molecule absorbs a photon and temporarily gains energy. It can then release a new photon as it returns to a lower-energy state. Excitation names the incoming light that starts the process; emission names the light produced afterward. They are different stages, rather than the same beam simply bouncing back.

中文从零理解：Photon（光子）可以理解为一小份光能。在fluorescence（荧光）中，分子吸收一个光子，暂时获得较高能量；随后返回较低能量状态时，可以释放一个新光子。Excitation（激发）指启动过程的入射光，emission（发射）指随后产生的光。这是两个不同阶段，并非同一束光只是反弹回来。

ENFollow the mechanism: Usually, some energy is lost to molecular motion before emission. The emitted photon therefore has less energy. Because photon energy is inversely related to wavelength, less energy means a longer wavelength: the usual Stokes shift. A staircase analogy helps: the molecule first goes up, steps down a little without shining, and then comes down while emitting light. The levels are not literal physical stairs.

中文跟着机制走：通常，分子在发光之前会把一部分能量传给分子运动。因此，发射光子的能量较低。由于光子能量与波长成反比，能量较低就意味着波长更长，这就是通常的Stokes shift（斯托克斯位移）。可以类比成先上楼，不发光地往下走一小段，再边发光边下楼；但能级并不是真正的物理楼梯。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: blue excitation can produce green emission. An emission filter helps block strong excitation light so the weaker fluorescence can be seen. In an incorrect-statement question, check whether longer wavelength has wrongly been called higher energy. Fluorescence may come from an added dye or naturally fluorescent material. Thus, the fluorescence mechanism itself does not always require an artificial label.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：蓝光激发可以产生绿光发射。Emission filter（发射滤光片）帮助挡住较强的激发光，让较弱的荧光能被看到。遇到“错误陈述”题，要检查是否把长波长误写成了高能量。荧光既可以来自添加的染料，也可以来自天然会发荧光的材料，所以荧光机制本身不总需要人工标记。

ENExam wording: If a question asks for the wrong statement, check the direction of wavelength and energy carefully. Two-photon excitation combines two lower-energy photons; it does not mean two individually higher-energy photons.

中文英文读题抓手：若题目问wrong statement，先核对波长与能量的方向。Two-photon excitation是两个低能光子共同激发，不是两个各自更高能的光子。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p69–76; W2 PDF p77–79; Sample quiz p1 Q1–3; W2 p73–78; W3 p39–50; W4 p54–61 | T2-0088–0100, T7-0051–0053

S110 · [P1] Fluorescence microscope: source, filters and dichroic cutoff / 荧光显微镜：光源、滤光片与二向色镜截止

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q1样卷Q1Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain Q1 B/C: match excitation light and separate excitation/emission with filters.学习抓手：解释Q1 B/C为什么对：光源匹配激发带，滤光片/二向色镜分离两波段。

Sample quiz Q1 (B, C (plus D contrast))样卷Q1 (B, C (plus D contrast)): Sample quiz Q1 (B, C (plus D contrast))

要考虑实际吸收/发射带宽；光源可以是匹配的灯、LED或激光。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W2 PDF p70, p77–78; T2-0097–0099

“You need a excitation filter, corresponding to your absorption peak one.”

课堂逐个说明excitation filter、emission filter和dichroic mirror，不只讲错误选项。

ENA fluorescence microscope needs a light source capable of exciting the fluorophore: its output must overlap a usable absorption/excitation band and provide sufficient light. This source can be a suitable lamp, LED or laser; it need not always be a laser. A source at a wavelength the dye cannot absorb will not produce the expected fluorescence merely because it is bright.

中文荧光显微镜需要能激发该fluorophore（荧光团）的光源：输出波段必须与可用的吸收/激发带重合，并提供足够光。合适的灯、LED或laser（激光）均可，不要求一定用激光。染料不能吸收的波长，即使看起来很亮，也不能因此产生预期荧光。

ENIn the usual epi-fluorescence filter cube, the excitation filter passes the desired excitation band. The dichroic mirror reflects that shorter-wavelength excitation toward the objective and sample, but transmits the longer-wavelength fluorescence toward the detector. The emission filter then passes the desired emission band and rejects remaining excitation/background. A dichroic mirror sorts wavelengths by reflection versus transmission; it is not just an ordinary mirror reflecting every color equally.

中文常见epi-fluorescence（落射荧光）滤光组件中，excitation filter（激发滤光片）通过所需激发带；dichroic mirror（二向色镜）把较短波长激发光反射到物镜与样品，却让较长波长荧光透向探测器；emission filter（发射滤光片）再通过所需发射带，抑制残余激发光和背景。二向色镜按波长区分反射与透射，不是对所有颜色都同样反射的普通镜子。

ENFor a simple separated-band example with excitation near 480 nm and emission near 530 nm, a suitable cutoff/transition between them allows the mirror to reflect excitation and transmit emission. This is why sample option B is reasonable. Real absorption and emission are bands, so filter choice considers their widths, overlap and transition region, not merely two exact numbers. B and C explain optical design; D is wrong because two-photon excitation uses two individually lower-energy photons, and higher spatial resolution is not automatic.

中文简单例子：激发约480 nm、发射约530 nm，合适的cutoff/transition（截止/过渡位置）选在两者之间，便可让二向色镜反射激发、透过发射，所以样题B合理。真实吸收/发射是波段，选滤光片时还要看宽度、重叠和过渡区，不能只看两个精确数字。B、C说明光学设计；D错误在于双光子用两个各自能量较低的光子共同激发，而且空间分辨率更高并非自动成立。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p70, p77–78; Week 1 PDF p88; T2-0097–0100; Sample quiz p1 Q1 B/C
