ENRead the figure: Trace source → excitation filter → dichroic reflection → sample, then emission → dichroic transmission → emission filter → detector. On the right, the mirror transition lies between selected excitation and emission bands.

中文读图：沿光源→激发滤光片→二向色镜反射→样品追光路，再看荧光→二向色镜透射→发射滤光片→探测器；右图的镜面过渡区位于所选激发/发射波段之间。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p77; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S111 · [P1] Fluorescence readouts: intensity, color, ratio and lifetime / 荧光读出：强度、颜色、比值与寿命

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q1样卷Q1Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain Q1 A: fluorescence can report intensity or colour; distinguish ratio/lifetime readouts.学习抓手：解释Q1 A：可用强度或颜色变化读出；比值/寿命是另外的读出方式。

Sample quiz Q1 (A)样卷Q1 (A): Sample quiz Q1 (A)

“可以这样测”不等于每个荧光器件必须变色。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W1 PDF p50–51; W2 PDF p79, p89–92; W3 PDF p8–12; T2-0009; T2-0099–0101

样卷优先焦点是intensity/color；比值和寿命读出先认词义即可。

ENFluorescence intensity means how much emission is detected: a sensor may turn on, turn off, become brighter or become dimmer. Color/wavelength readout instead tracks where the emission spectrum is located or how different color channels are distributed. These can change independently. A greener-looking image does not necessarily contain more total photons, and a brighter signal need not have a shifted emission peak.

中文Fluorescence intensity（荧光强度）指检测到多少发射光：传感器可turn on（亮起）、turn off（熄灭）、变亮或变暗。Color/wavelength（颜色/波长）读出关注发射光谱的位置，或不同颜色通道的分布。两者可独立改变：图像更绿，不一定总光子数更多；信号更亮，也不一定发射峰移动。

ENA fluorescence array has many sensing spots or channels. Responses across the array can be expressed as intensity changes, color changes, or a pattern of both, depending on the probe design. This explains why sample option A is correct as a statement of possible readouts. It does not mean every fluorescence sensor must change color, or that all spots identify targets without recognition chemistry and calibration.

中文Fluorescence array（荧光阵列）包含多个传感点或通道。根据探针设计，阵列响应可以表现为强度变化、颜色变化，或两者的组合模式，因此样题A作为“可采用的读出方式”是正确的。它不意味着每一种荧光传感器都必须变色，也不意味着无需识别化学和校准就能让所有点识别目标。

ENA ratiometric probe compares two measured channels, for example I₁/I₂, instead of using one intensity alone; the ratio can reduce some shared intensity variations when the reference channel behaves suitably. Lifetime readout measures decay after excitation rather than just total brightness. For a spectrum, read the wavelength of the emission peak to identify emitted color; the excitation color is not the emitted color.

中文Ratiometric probe（比率型探针）比较两个测得的通道，例如I₁/I₂，而非只用单一强度；参照通道性质合适时，该比值可降低部分共同强度波动。Lifetime readout（寿命读出）测激发之后的衰减，而非只看总亮度。读光谱时，用发射峰波长判断发出的颜色；激发光颜色不等于发射颜色。

Source / 来源：Week 1 PDF p50–51; Week 2 PDF p79, p89–92; Week 3 PDF p8–12; T2-0009, T2-0099–0101; Sample quiz p1 Q1 A

ENRead the figure: The left diagram compares intensity variation, wavelength variation and lifetime variation. Look for peak height, peak position and decay with time respectively; these are different observables, not three names for one quantity.

中文读图：左图对比强度、波长、寿命变化：分别观察峰高、峰位置和随时间衰减，是不同观测量，不能只记一种“变亮”。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p91; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B07 · [P2] Luminescence and state transitions发光类别与能级跃迁

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish fluorescence, phosphorescence and chemical/biological luminescence.学习抓手：分清荧光、磷光、化学发光、生物发光及辐射/非辐射过程。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W2 PDF p69–76; T2-0088–0096

能级术语用于看懂荧光；无需把完整自旋/量子推导当P1背诵。

ENKey points
  • Fluorescence usually emits from S1 to S0;
  • phosphorescence involves a triplet state and is generally slower.
  • Internal conversion is nonradiative relaxation between states of the same spin multiplicity;
  • intersystem crossing changes multiplicity.
  • Chemiluminescence uses chemical excitation, and bioluminescence is biological chemiluminescence.
  • An emission peak need not have the same wavelength as absorption.
中文必会知识点
  • Fluorescence荧光通常由S1到S0发射；
  • phosphorescence磷光涉及三重态，通常更慢。
  • Internal conversion内转换是在相同自旋多重度能态间的非辐射弛豫；
  • intersystem crossing系间窜越改变多重度。
  • Chemiluminescence化学发光由化学反应激发，bioluminescence生物发光属于生物化学发光。
  • 发射峰不必与吸收峰波长相同。

ENStart from zero: Luminescence means light produced through an excited-state process rather than simply because an object is hot. The energy can come from absorbed light, giving photoluminescence, or from a chemical reaction, giving chemiluminescence. Bioluminescence is chemical light production in a biological system. Fluorescence and phosphorescence are forms of photoluminescence distinguished by the states and transitions involved, not just by the visible color.

中文从零理解：Luminescence（发光）指通过激发态过程产生光，而不是单纯因为物体很热。能量可以来自吸收光，这叫photoluminescence（光致发光）；也可以来自化学反应，这叫chemiluminescence（化学发光）。Bioluminescence（生物发光）是生物系统中的化学发光。荧光与磷光属于光致发光，其区别在涉及的状态和跃迁，并不只是可见颜色不同。

ENFollow the mechanism: An energy-level diagram labels S0 as the ground singlet state, S1 as a higher singlet state, and T1 as a triplet state. Singlet and triplet describe quantum spin arrangements, not the number of emitted photons. Fluorescence commonly returns from S1 to S0. Phosphorescence involves a triplet route that is usually slower. Internal conversion loses energy without light within one multiplicity; intersystem crossing changes multiplicity.

中文跟着机制走：能级图中，S0是基态单重态，S1是较高的单重态，T1是三重态。Singlet（单重态）和triplet（三重态）描述量子自旋安排，并不是发射了几个光子。荧光通常从S1回到S0，磷光涉及通常更慢的三重态路线。Internal conversion（内转换）在同一多重度内不发光地损失能量，intersystem crossing（系间窜越）则改变多重度。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: glow remaining after excitation stops may suggest a slower phosphorescent route, but identify the actual mechanism rather than assuming every afterglow is phosphorescence. A chemical glow needs chemical energy instead of an excitation lamp. In diagrams, arrows downward do not all mean light emission: some indicate nonradiative relaxation. Follow how energy enters, where it moves, and which step actually releases a photon.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：停止激发后还持续发光，可能提示较慢的磷光路线，但应看实际机制，不能认定所有余辉都是磷光。化学发光需要化学能，而不是激发灯。在图中，向下箭头不都代表发光，有些表示非辐射弛豫。沿着能量从哪里进入、往哪里转移、哪一步真正释放光子来读图。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p69–76; W2 PDF p77–79; W2 PDF p82–88 | T2-0088–0100, T2-0105–0107

ENRead the figure: Blue upward arrows mean absorption; orange downward arrows from S₁ to S₀ mean fluorescence. Before emission, some excitation energy can be lost without producing a photon, explaining the usual lower-energy, longer-wavelength fluorescence. Intersystem crossing transfers population to a triplet state T₁; purple T₁→S₀ emission is phosphorescence. Black return paths produce no emitted photon. The vertical axis is energy: an upward arrow is not a longer wavelength.

中文读图：蓝色向上箭头表示Absorption（吸收）；从S₁回到S₀的橙色箭头表示Fluorescence（荧光）。发光前可先无光子地损失部分能量，所以普通荧光的光子能量较低、波长较长。Intersystem crossing（系间窜越）把激发态人口转到三重态T₁；紫色T₁→S₀发光是Phosphorescence（磷光）。黑色返回路径不发射光子。纵轴是能量，不能把向上箭头理解为波长变长。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p74; original slide figure / 原课件截图

C06 · [P1] Quantum yield, lifetime and radiative rate / 量子产率、寿命与辐射速率

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q6样卷Q6Worked example例题练习Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Use Φ=emitted/absorbed photons and kᵣ=Φ/τ; distinguish lifetime from half-life.学习抓手：会用Φ=发射/吸收光子数、kᵣ=Φ/τ，分清寿命与半衰期。

Sample quiz Q6 (A–D)样卷Q6 (A–D): Sample quiz Q6 (A–D)

80%要写0.80，kᵣ=0.80/8.0=0.10 ns⁻¹。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p82–88; T2-0105–0107; T7-0054

课堂做亮度和速率短式题；以课件公式为准，口述half及乘法存在不一致。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: T2-0107

“These are the two important property where people talk about if flocen is good or if a flocen is not good.”

两属性为lifetime和quantum yield；跳过相似Example 8不代表排除模型。

ENKey points
  • Quantum yield Φ is emitted photons divided by absorbed photons.
  • With total non-radiative rate kₙᵣ, τ=1/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ), Φ=kᵣτ and kᵣ=Φ/τ.
  • Fluorescence brightness also depends on absorption, commonly through εΦ in the course examples.
中文必会知识点
  • 量子产率Φ是发射光子数除以吸收光子数。
  • 非辐射总速率为kₙᵣ时，τ=1/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ)、Φ=kᵣτ、kᵣ=Φ/τ。
  • 本课程示例中亮度还受吸收影响，常用εΦ表示。

ENStart from zero: An excited molecule has more than one way to lose energy. It can emit a photon, a radiative route, or lose energy without light, a nonradiative route. Quantum yield Φ is the fraction of absorbed photons that lead to emitted photons. Lifetime τ describes how quickly a population of excited molecules decays; it is not how long the dye remains usable in a bottle.

中文从零理解：被激发的分子有不止一种释放能量的方法：可以发出光子，这是radiative（辐射）途径；也可以不发光地损失能量，这是nonradiative（非辐射）途径。Quantum yield Φ（量子产率）表示吸收的光子中，有多大比例最终对应发射光子。Lifetime τ（寿命）描述一群激发态分子衰减得多快，并不是染料在瓶子里能保存多久。

ENFollow the mechanism: Imagine two exits from a room: a light-producing exit and a dark exit. Their rates, kᵣ and kₙᵣ, add because both empty the excited population. Hence τ=1/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ), and Φ=kᵣ/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ)=kᵣτ. Faster total escape shortens lifetime. The analogy describes competing probabilities; a molecule does not choose an exit deliberately. The rates have units of inverse time, such as s⁻¹.

中文跟着机制走：想象一个房间有两个出口：一个出去会发光，另一个出去不会发光。它们的速率kᵣ与kₙᵣ相加，因为两条路都会减少激发态分子。所以τ=1/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ)，而Φ=kᵣ/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ)=kᵣτ。总离开速率越快，寿命越短。这个类比描述相互竞争的概率，分子不会有意识地选择出口。速率单位是时间的倒数，例如s⁻¹。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: 100 photons arrive, 20 are absorbed, and 12 are emitted. Φ=12/20=0.60, not 12/100. If τ=12 ns, kᵣ=0.60/12=0.05 ns⁻¹=5×10⁷ s⁻¹. Lifetime is the time to reach 1/e of the initial population in this model, not the half-life. Brightness also depends on how many photons are absorbed, so yield alone does not determine total brightness.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：100个光子入射，20个被吸收，12个被发射，Φ=12/20=0.60，而不是12/100。如果τ=12 ns，则kᵣ=0.60/12=0.05 ns⁻¹=5×10⁷ s⁻¹。这个模型中的寿命，是激发态群体降到初始值1/e所需的时间，不是半衰期。亮度还取决于吸收了多少光子，所以只知道产率还不能确定总亮度。

ENExam wording: Do not use all incident photons as the denominator unless all are absorbed. Lifetime is an exponential 1/e decay time, not automatically a half-life. Convert ns and s consistently.

中文英文读题抓手：除非入射光子全部被吸收，否则分母不能用全部入射光子。Lifetime是指数衰减至1/e的时间，并非直接等于半衰期。ns与s必须统一。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p82–88; Sample quiz p1 Q6; Sample quiz p2 Q7; W2 p82–88 | T2-0105–0107, T7-0054–0055

ENRead the figure: From S₁, the molecule may emit through kᵣ or leave without fluorescence through k₁ and k₂; these competing routes together set its fluorescence lifetime. On the right, a short excitation pulse is followed by a fast or slow emission decay. In the single-exponential model, I(t)=I₀e⁻ᵗ/τ and τ=1/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ), with kₙᵣ=k₁+k₂ here. Longer τ means slower decay; at τ the intensity is I₀/e, not I₀/2. A long lifetime alone does not prove a high quantum yield.

中文读图：分子离开S₁时，可以经kᵣ发荧光，也可以经k₁、k₂不发荧光地离开；这些竞争路径共同决定荧光寿命。右图的短激发脉冲之后，荧光有快、慢两种衰减。在单指数模型下，I(t)=I₀e⁻ᵗ/τ，τ=1/(kᵣ+kₙᵣ)，本图kₙᵣ=k₁+k₂。τ较大表示衰减较慢；t=τ时剩I₀/e，不是I₀/2。仅凭寿命长，不能断言量子产率高。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p82; original slide figure / 原课件截图

ENRead the figure: This is a made-up counting example. Of 100 incoming photons, only 20 are absorbed; 12 of those events produce fluorescence and 8 relax without light. Thus Φ = 12/20 = 0.60. The ratio 12/100 also includes losses before absorption and is not the fluorescence quantum yield.

中文读图：这是便于理解的假设数字。100个入射光子中只有20个被吸收；其中12次产生荧光，8次不发光而弛豫。因此Φ = 12/20 = 0.60。12/100还混入吸收前的损失，不是Fluorescence quantum yield（荧光量子产率）。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p82–88; original teaching schematic / 自绘教学示意，非实验数据

S112 · [P2] Environment, quenching and fluorescence brightness / 环境、猝灭与荧光亮度

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Worked example例题练习Sample Q6样卷Q6
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain brightness εΦ and distinguish quenching from photobleaching.学习抓手：知道亮度还取决于吸收ε，分清猝灭与光漂白。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p79, p82–86; T2-0099–0100; T2-0105–0107

课堂比较谱峰/量子产率及亮度；固定吸收条件时才能只按Φ比较。

Sample quiz Q6 (rate relationship)样卷Q6 (rate relationship): Sample quiz Q6 (rate relationship)

P1计算kᵣ=Φ/τ先学C06；此节环境、猝灭的扩展没有单独Quiz承诺。

ENA dye’s fluorescence can depend on solvent and local environment. The slide compares spectra in two solvents, so one dye need not have an identical emission peak in every condition. Concentration-dependent self-quenching is one reason that adding dye does not always increase intensity proportionally. Quenching reduces fluorescence through competing processes; photobleaching refers to light-induced chemical damage or loss of the fluorophore. Both can dim a signal, but they are not the same mechanism. Control concentration, solvent, excitation and detection conditions when comparing samples.

中文染料荧光可受solvent（溶剂）和局部环境影响。课件比较两种溶剂中的光谱，同一染料不一定总有相同发射峰。与浓度有关的self-quenching（自猝灭）是“加更多染料不一定按比例更亮”的原因之一。Quenching（猝灭）通过竞争过程降低荧光；photobleaching（光漂白）指光引起荧光团化学损伤或损失，两者都可使信号变暗，但不是同一机制。比较样品时，要控制浓度、溶剂、激发和检测条件。

ENIn the simple competing-rate model, if k_nr increases while k_r is fixed, τ=1/(k_r+k_nr) and Φ=k_r/(k_r+k_nr) both decrease. For Φ=0.80 and τ=8 ns, k_r=0.10 ns⁻¹; the total rate is 0.125 ns⁻¹ and k_nr=0.025 ns⁻¹. Quantum yield, radiative rate, total decay rate and measured brightness are related but different quantities. Brightness εΦ applies to a specified excitation wavelength and comparable conditions.

中文简单竞争速率模型中，若k_r固定而k_nr增大，τ=1/(k_r+k_nr)与Φ=k_r/(k_r+k_nr)都会减小。Φ=0.80、τ=8 ns时，k_r=0.10 ns⁻¹；总速率为0.125 ns⁻¹，k_nr=0.025 ns⁻¹。量子产率、辐射速率、总衰减速率和测得亮度互相关联，但并非同一个量。Brightness εΦ应对应指定激发波长及可比条件。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p79, p82–86; Week 3 PDF p8; T2-0099–0100, T2-0105–0107

C07 · [P1] Raman, Rayleigh, Stokes and anti-Stokes / 拉曼、瑞利、斯托克斯与反斯托克斯

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q2样卷Q2Repeated explanation反复讲解Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Compare Rayleigh/Raman and the energy/wavelength directions of Stokes/anti-Stokes.学习抓手：会比较瑞利/拉曼，判断Stokes/anti-Stokes的能量与波长方向。

Sample quiz Q2 (E)样卷Q2 (E): Sample quiz Q2 (E)

Raman是振动相关非弹性散射，不是题目问的光学共振器。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W2 PDF p55–68; T2-0070–0087; T4-0004–0007; T7-0052

概念跨周复习；拉曼过程不能误写成荧光吸收后延时发射。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: T2-0080

“Please differentiate the difference between these two.”

就近指散射时能量/频率保持或变化的区别。

ENKey points
  • Rayleigh scattering is elastic: scattered photon energy is unchanged.
  • Raman scattering is inelastic and reports molecular vibrations.
  • Stokes Raman light has lower energy and longer wavelength;
  • anti-Stokes has higher energy and shorter wavelength.
  • Raman shift is usually expressed in cm⁻¹.
中文必会知识点
  • Rayleigh scattering是弹性散射，光子能量不变。
  • Raman scattering是非弹性散射，反映分子振动。
  • Stokes Raman能量更低、波长更长；
  • anti-Stokes能量更高、波长更短。
  • 拉曼位移常用cm⁻¹。

ENStart from zero: Scattering means light leaves in a changed direction after interacting with matter. In Rayleigh scattering, the outgoing photon keeps its energy; this is called elastic scattering. In Raman scattering, the photon exchanges energy with a molecular vibration, so its energy changes. Molecules have different vibration patterns, making a Raman spectrum useful as a chemical fingerprint rather than just a brightness measurement.

中文从零理解：Scattering（散射）表示光与物质作用后，改变了离开的方向。在Rayleigh scattering（瑞利散射）中，出射光子的能量不变，这叫elastic（弹性）散射。在Raman scattering（拉曼散射）中，光子与分子振动交换能量，所以能量发生变化。不同分子有不同振动模式，因此拉曼光谱可以作为化学指纹，而不只是测亮度。

ENFollow the mechanism: For Stokes Raman scattering, the photon gives some energy to a vibration and leaves with lower energy and longer wavelength. For anti-Stokes scattering, a vibration already carrying energy gives some to the photon, which leaves with higher energy and shorter wavelength. Think of an energy trade between light and vibration. This differs from fluorescence, which involves absorption and subsequent emission from an excited electronic state.

中文跟着机制走：在Stokes Raman（斯托克斯拉曼）中，光子把一部分能量给了振动，离开时能量更低、波长更长。在anti-Stokes（反斯托克斯）中，原本已经带有能量的振动把部分能量给光子，使它离开时能量更高、波长更短。可以理解为光与振动之间的能量交换。这与荧光不同：荧光涉及吸收，以及随后从电子激发态发光。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: use one laser and observe an unchanged-energy peak plus shifted peaks. The unchanged peak is Rayleigh; shifted vibrational peaks are Raman. Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) uses nearby metal nanostructures to strengthen these Raman signals. Recognize the measured signal: vibrational shifts mean Raman, whereas a changed resonance position means resonance sensing. Plasmonic enhancement does not make SERS an optical-cavity measurement.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：用一束激光照射，观察到一个能量不变的峰和一些偏移峰。能量不变的峰是瑞利，振动产生的偏移峰是拉曼。Surface-enhanced Raman scattering（SERS，表面增强拉曼散射）利用附近的金属纳米结构增强这些拉曼信号。辨认被测信号：振动位移提示拉曼，共振位置变化提示共振传感。等离激元增强并不把SERS变成光学腔测量。

ENExam wording: Fluorescence and Raman are different mechanisms. In the sample resonator question, Raman is the clearest non-resonance-sensing option. SERS means surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy; the metal nanostructure enhances the Raman signal.

中文英文读题抓手：荧光和拉曼机制不同。样题的共振器辨析中，Raman是最明确的非共振传感选项。SERS是surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy，金属纳米结构增强拉曼信号。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p55–62; W2 PDF p65–68; W3 p88–94 | T2-0070–0078, T2-0083–0087, T4-0007–0013

S109 · [P2] Why Raman is different from fluorescence / 拉曼为什么不同于荧光

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain a virtual-state vibration exchange versus a real excited-state fluorescence process.学习抓手：分清拉曼振动能交换与荧光真实激发态后发射过程。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W2 PDF p58–62, p94; T2-0079–0082; T4-0004–0007; T7-0052

该比较支撑P1 C07；虚能级图细节在理解能量方向后再看。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: T2-0081

“I'm not going to talk about the history of Raman, you can search for it if you're interested.”

只降级历史和名字来源，不降级能量交换。

ENFluorescence absorbs light into a real electronic excited state and then emits after an excited-state interval. The usual Raman diagram instead uses a virtual intermediate state: scattered light exchanges energy with molecular vibration without populating that real fluorescence state. Thus Raman does not require the laser to match an allowed electronic absorption transition in the same way. It is not simply delayed fluorescent light.

中文荧光先吸收光、进入真实电子激发态，经过激发态停留后再发光。常见拉曼图使用virtual intermediate state（虚中间态）：散射光与分子振动交换能量，而不是占据那个真实荧光激发态。因此，拉曼不需要像荧光那样，让激光匹配允许的电子吸收跃迁；它不是“延迟出来的荧光”。

ENPolarizability describes how an electric field distorts a molecule’s electron distribution. A vibration is Raman-active when it changes polarizability. Bonding and molecular environment determine vibration frequencies, producing a fingerprint. Raman is normally much weaker than Rayleigh scattering; an instrument must separate the strong unshifted light from weak shifted lines. Rayleigh and Mie are elastic scattering regimes, whereas Stokes and anti-Stokes Raman exchange vibration energy.

中文Polarizability（极化率）描述电场使分子电子分布变形的程度。振动能改变极化率时，该振动具有Raman-active（拉曼活性）。化学键和分子环境决定振动频率，形成指纹。拉曼通常远弱于瑞利，仪器要把很强的无位移光与弱的位移谱线分开。瑞利、米氏是弹性散射情形，斯托克斯及反斯托克斯拉曼则交换振动能量。

Source / 来源：Week 2 PDF p58–62, p94; Week 3 PDF p89–90; T2-0070–0082

B08 · [P1] Raman shift and spectral axes拉曼位移与光谱坐标

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Convert nm to Raman shift in cm⁻¹ and reverse the conversion.学习抓手：会在nm与拉曼位移cm⁻¹间换算，认清绝对波长和位移坐标。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W2 PDF p65–68; T2-0083–0087

“You need to be very familiar with the exchanges between this box and this box.”

明确要求熟悉两种坐标换算；未明确承诺Quiz必考。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W2 PDF p66; T2-0086–0087

1000→1080 nm例题约741 cm⁻¹；反向换算也应会。

Final-exam emphasis仅期末考试强调: T2-0085

H常数/公式不提供与cheat sheet的回答针对final exam，不据此推断本次Quiz提供政策。

ENKey points
  • Wavelength (nm), frequency (Hz) and wavenumber (cm⁻¹) are different axes.
  • For Stokes scattering, Δν̃=10⁷(1/λexc−1/λS) cm⁻¹ when both wavelengths are in nm.
  • A 1000 nm excitation and 1080 nm Stokes line give about 741 cm⁻¹.
  • Anti-Stokes photons have higher energy than excitation;
  • Stokes photons have lower energy.
中文必会知识点
  • Wavelength波长（nm）、frequency频率（Hz）、wavenumber波数（cm⁻¹）是不同坐标。
  • 两波长均用nm时，斯托克斯位移Δν̃=10⁷(1/λexc−1/λS)，单位cm⁻¹。
  • 1000 nm激发、1080 nm斯托克斯线对应约741 cm⁻¹。
  • Anti-Stokes反斯托克斯光子能量高于激发，Stokes斯托克斯光子能量低于激发。

ENStart from zero: A spectrum can use wavelength, frequency, or wavenumber on its horizontal axis. Wavelength is the distance between repeating wave features. Frequency counts oscillations per second. Wavenumber is inverse wavelength; cm⁻¹ means reciprocal centimeters, not centimeters. These axes describe related properties, but their numbers cannot be subtracted as if they were the same unit. Raman shift measures a difference in wavenumber from the excitation light.

中文从零理解：光谱横轴可以用wavelength（波长）、frequency（频率）或wavenumber（波数）。波长是波上重复特征之间的距离；频率是每秒振荡次数；波数是波长的倒数，cm⁻¹表示厘米的倒数，并不是厘米。这些坐标描述相关性质，但不能把不同单位的数值当成同一个单位相减。Raman shift（拉曼位移）测的是相对激发光的波数差。

ENFollow the mechanism: Because 1 nm equals 10⁻⁷ cm, a wavelength written in nm has wavenumber 10⁷/λ in cm⁻¹. For Stokes scattering, subtract the emitted wavenumber from the excitation wavenumber: Δν̃=10⁷(1/λexc−1/λS). Here λexc is excitation wavelength and λS the Stokes wavelength, both in nm. The symbol ν̃ represents wavenumber, not ordinary frequency. Taking reciprocals is essential before subtracting.

中文跟着机制走：因为1 nm=10⁻⁷ cm，所以波长λ用nm表示时，波数为10⁷/λ，单位cm⁻¹。斯托克斯散射中，用激发波数减去发射波数：Δν̃=10⁷(1/λexc−1/λS)。λexc是激发波长，λS是斯托克斯波长，两者都用nm。ν̃表示波数，不是普通频率。必须先取倒数，再相减。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: 1000 nm excitation has wavenumber 10000 cm⁻¹; 1080 nm emission has about 9259 cm⁻¹. The Stokes shift is about 741 cm⁻¹, not 80 cm⁻¹. The number 80 is the wavelength difference in nm. A longer Stokes wavelength means lower photon energy. For anti-Stokes light the direction reverses; check the question's sign convention if a signed shift is requested.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：1000 nm激发的波数为10000 cm⁻¹，1080 nm发射的波数约为9259 cm⁻¹，所以斯托克斯位移约741 cm⁻¹，而不是80 cm⁻¹。80是以nm表示的波长差。斯托克斯波长更长，表示光子能量更低。反斯托克斯方向相反，如果题目要求带符号的位移，要检查其符号约定。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p34–35; W2 PDF p55–62; W2 PDF p65–68 | T2-0037–0040, T2-0070–0078, T2-0083–0087

C08 · [P1] Grating density and spectral resolution / 光栅刻线密度与光谱分辨率

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Sample Q7样卷Q7Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Apply R=λ/Δλ=mN and compare groove density under fixed conditions.学习抓手：会用R=λ/Δλ=mN，并在条件固定时比较光栅刻线密度。

Explicit Quiz emphasis老师明确提到Quiz: T5-0061–0063

“These two are very important. You will see these two questions again on your quiz.”

“两题”分别是显微镜NA与300/1200光栅密度比较；相同受照宽度/级次等条件要写明。

Sample quiz Q7 (A–D)样卷Q7 (A–D): Sample quiz Q7 (A–D)

题给二级衍射，N=50/2=25；600/50=12 nm是Δλ而非刻线数。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: T7-0054–0055; W2 PDF p35 (structure only)

W2 p35只提供光谱仪结构背景，不能声称给出的W2课件有300/1200比较图。

ENKey points
  • For the same illuminated width and diffraction order, a higher groove density illuminates more grooves N.
  • Resolving power R=λ/Δλ=mN increases, and the minimum resolvable wavelength difference Δλ decreases.
  • Thus 1200 lines/mm resolves more closely spaced lines than 300 lines/mm under these assumptions.
中文必会知识点
  • 在受照宽度与衍射级次相同的条件下，刻线密度更高使受照刻线数N增加。
  • 分辨本领R=λ/Δλ=mN增大，最小可分辨波长差Δλ减小。
  • 因此在这些假设下，1200 lines/mm比300 lines/mm能分开更接近的谱线。

ENStart from zero: White light contains many wavelengths. A diffraction grating is a surface with many regularly spaced grooves that sends different wavelengths toward different directions. This lets a spectrometer separate colors and measure a spectrum. Spectral resolution asks whether two nearby wavelengths can be seen as two distinct lines. It is different from microscope resolution, which asks whether two nearby objects can be separated in space.

中文从零理解：白光含有许多波长。Diffraction grating（衍射光栅）表面有大量规律排列的刻线，能把不同波长送向不同方向，因此光谱仪可以分开颜色、测量光谱。Spectral resolution（光谱分辨率）问的是两个接近的波长能否显示为两条不同谱线。它不同于显微镜的分辨率，后者问的是空间中两个接近物体能否分开。

ENFollow the mechanism: Each illuminated groove contributes a wave. Their combined interference makes wavelength-selective bright directions; more contributing grooves can make those features sharper. The ideal relation is R=λ/Δλ=mN: λ is the measured wavelength, Δλ the smallest separable difference, m the diffraction order, and N the illuminated groove count. Grooves outside the light beam do not count. Here m does not mean calibration slope.

中文跟着机制走：每条受到照明的刻线都贡献一个波，它们相互干涉，在特定方向形成对应波长的亮光。参与的刻线更多，可以使这些特征更尖锐。理想关系为R=λ/Δλ=mN：λ是被测波长，Δλ是最小可分开的波长差，m是衍射级次，N是受照刻线数。光束外的刻线不计入N。这里m不是校准斜率。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a 5 mm illuminated width covers 1500 grooves at 300 lines/mm, but 6000 grooves at 1200 lines/mm. With the same order, the second grating has four times the ideal resolving power and one-quarter the minimum Δλ. Thus larger R and smaller Δλ both mean better separation. Real spectrometers also depend on slit width and detector sampling, so preserve the comparison assumptions.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：受照宽度为5 mm时，300 lines/mm覆盖1500条刻线，1200 lines/mm覆盖6000条。在级次相同的条件下，第二块光栅的理想分辨本领是4倍，最小Δλ是四分之一。因此，R更大和Δλ更小都表示分得更清。真实光谱仪还受到狭缝宽度与探测器采样的影响，所以要保留比较条件。

ENExam wording: The lecturer explicitly revisits this comparison as a Quiz item. Higher resolving power and smaller Δλ both describe better resolution. The 300/1200 example is anchored to the Week 5 oral review, not an invented Week 2 slide page.

中文英文读题抓手：老师明确说会在Quiz再问该比较。R更大与Δλ更小都表示分辨率更好。300/1200示例依据Week5口头回顾，不虚标为Week2某页原图。

Source / 来源：W2 p35 (spectrometer structure background; no 300/1200 comparison on supplied slides); Sample quiz p1 Q6; Sample quiz p2 Q7; W2 p82–88 | T5-0061–0063, T7-0054–0055

Week 3 learning block: Labels, fibres and resonance / 第3学习组：标记、光纤与共振

Week 3 concept map / 第3周知识框架

ENChapter logic: Follow how unlabelled binding changes a guided or resonant optical response, while separating recognition from the readout.

中文本章主线：追踪无报告标签的结合怎样改变导光或共振响应，并始终区分识别与读出。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Labelled · label-free 有标记·无标记 An added reporter defines labelled sensing; label-free does not mean no light or no receptor. 添加报告物是有标记；无标记不等于不用光或不用受体。 Details / 详解
Quantum dots · flow cytometry 量子点·流式细胞术 Dot size can tune color within a material family; flow cytometry reads individual passing events. 同材料系列量子点尺寸可调颜色；流式逐个读取经过的事件。 Details / 详解
Total internal reflection · fibre NA 全内反射·光纤NA TIR needs high-to-low index and an angle above critical; acceptance and internal angles differ. TIR要求高到低折射率及超过临界角；接受角不同于内部角。 Details / 详解
Evanescent field 倏逝场 A rapidly decaying external field lets nearby molecules affect a guided optical signal. 外侧迅速衰减的场使附近分子影响导光信号。 Details / 详解
Modes · sensing arrangement 模式·传感布置 Mode count is a field property; point, multiplexed and distributed describe measurement positions. 模式数是场性质；点式、复用、分布式描述测量位置。 Details / 详解
Optical resonators · SPR · LSPR 光学共振器·SPR·LSPR Identify circulating/standing optical patterns versus metal collective-electron resonance. 辨认循环/驻波光场与金属集体电子共振。 Details / 详解
Sλ · FWHM · Q · FOM 位移灵敏度·线宽·Q·FOM Compare shift with width in consistent units; index sensitivity alone does not establish selectivity. 位移和线宽要统一单位；折射率灵敏度本身不证明选择性。 Details / 详解
ART · SERS 抗原快检·表面增强拉曼 ART uses antibody capture and gold-particle color; SERS enhances molecular vibration fingerprints. ART以抗体捕获并用金颗粒显色；SERS增强分子振动指纹。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX117 Label-free spectral sensitivity and index LOD, FX118 Snell refraction and critical angle, FX119 Fibre numerical aperture and acceptance half-angle, FX120 Evanescent intensity and field-amplitude decay, FX121 Evanescent penetration-depth convention (support), FX122 WGM resonance and small fractional changes, FX123 Two-mirror cavity resonance (support), FX124 FWHM, Q and unit-consistent FOM, FX125 Weak Raman signals and reported SERS enhancement.

中文本章公式定位：FX117 无标记光谱灵敏度与折射率检出限；FX118 斯涅尔折射与临界角；FX119 光纤数值孔径与接受半角；FX120 倏逝强度与场幅衰减；FX121 倏逝穿透深度约定（辅助）；FX122 WGM 共振与小幅相对变化；FX123 双镜腔共振（辅助）；FX124 半高宽、Q 与单位一致的 FOM；FX125 微弱拉曼信号与所报 SERS 增强量级。

C09 · [P1] Labelled versus label-free optical sensing / 有标记与无标记光学传感

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q3样卷Q3Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish an added fluorescent reporter from intrinsic absorption/index/resonance readout.学习抓手：区分外加荧光标签与内在吸收、折射率、共振位移读出。

Sample quiz Q3 (A–E)样卷Q3 (A–E): Sample quiz Q3 (A–E)

不仅知道A是预期例外，也要能解释B/C/D/E为何可用于无标记。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W3 PDF p13–18; T3-0021–0029

“This slide is very, very important.”

限定为本课共振型无标记的参考谱→折射率改变→位移主线；不是所有无标记传感只测峰位。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: T3-0016–0029; T3-0108; T4-0001–0002; T7-0052–0053

跨周重复；保留自发荧光和无标记仍可用抗体的边界。

ENKey points
  • Labelled sensing attaches a reporter such as a fluorescent dye.
  • Label-free sensing detects an intrinsic change such as absorption, refractive index, or resonance shift without adding that reporter.
  • In the sample classification, fluorescence intensity is treated as a labelled method.
中文必会知识点
  • 有标记传感添加荧光染料等报告物。
  • 无标记传感不添加这种报告物，而测量吸收、折射率或共振位移等内在变化。
  • 样题分类把fluorescence intensity视为有标记方法。

ENStart from zero: Many biological targets do not produce an easily visible signal by themselves. A label is an added reporter, such as a fluorescent dye attached to an antibody. It helps reveal where the target is or how much is present. Labelled sensing reads that reporter. Label-free sensing instead reads a property change caused by the target without adding that kind of reporter.

中文从零理解：许多生物目标本身不会产生容易看见的信号。Label（标记）是一种额外添加的报告物，例如连接在抗体上的荧光染料，帮助显示目标在哪里或有多少。Labelled sensing（有标记传感）读取这个报告物；label-free sensing（无标记传感）则不添加这种报告物，而读取目标引起的性质变化。

ENFollow the mechanism: Imagine locating a guest by a colored badge versus noticing their weight on a floor sensor. The badge is a reporter; the weight is an intrinsic effect. In an optical label-free sensor, surface binding can change refractive index, meaning how light propagates through the local material. A light source measures that change. Thus label-free does not mean light-free, antibody-free, or surface-free.

中文跟着机制走：可以类比为靠彩色胸牌找到客人，与靠地板传感器感受到客人的重量。胸牌相当于报告物，重量则是客人本身造成的作用。在光学无标记传感器中，表面结合可以改变refractive index（折射率），即光在局部材料中传播的性质。光源负责测量这个变化，所以label-free并不等于不用光、不用抗体或不用表面。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: adding a fluorescent antibody and measuring its glow is labelled sensing. Measuring a resonance shift after unlabelled molecules bind can be label-free sensing. First identify whether a separate reporter was added, then identify the measured signal. Some substances naturally fluoresce, called autofluorescence, so do not claim all fluorescence is labelled. The sample classification concerns its taught dye-based fluorescence example.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：添加荧光抗体并测量它的发光，属于有标记传感；未标记分子结合后测共振位移，可以属于无标记传感。先判断是否添加了独立报告物，再判断测的信号。有些物质天然会发荧光，叫autofluorescence（自发荧光），因此不能说所有荧光都属于有标记。样题分类针对的是课程所讲的染料荧光例子。

ENExam wording: Label-free does not mean no illumination, no biological recognition, or no sensor surface. Autofluorescence exists, so the course classification should not be turned into an absolute claim about every fluorescence measurement.

中文英文读题抓手：Label-free不等于不照光、不需生物识别或不需传感界面。自发荧光确实存在，因此不能把课程分类扩大为所有荧光测量的绝对规律。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p13–18 | T3-0016–0020

S117 · [P1] Label-free changes and the signal actually measured / 无标记变化与真正测得的信号

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q3样卷Q3Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain why absorption, index, wavelength and frequency can all support label-free sensing.学习抓手：逐个说明吸收、折射率、波长、频率为何可用于无标记。

Sample quiz Q3 (A–E)样卷Q3 (A–E): Sample quiz Q3 (A–E)

全选项覆盖：外加荧光报告物与内在性质及其读出坐标不同。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W3 PDF p15–18; T3-0021–0029

“This slide is very, very important.”

强调课堂共振型参考谱主线；固定波长强度读出也可无标记，自发荧光例外保留。

ENLabel-free optical sensing may detect direct absorption, refractive-index change, or a shift of resonance wavelength/frequency caused by the target. The index change is a property change; wavelength/frequency shift is one possible instrument readout of that change. At fixed medium convention, a shift toward longer wavelength corresponds to lower frequency. A sensor can also monitor intensity at a selected point on the shifting response curve.

中文无标记光学传感可检测目标的直接吸收、折射率变化，或由目标引起的共振波长/频率移动。折射率变化是性质改变，波长/频率位移是仪器对该改变的一种读出。介质约定固定时，波长变长对应频率变低。传感器也可在响应曲线选定位置监测强度，观察曲线移动。

ENIn sample Q3, B absorption, C refractive index, D wavelength and E frequency can therefore be related to label-free principles. A fluorescence intensity refers to the taught added-dye reporter and is the intended exception. This classification does not say that every intensity measurement is labelled, or that autofluorescence is impossible. “No label” means no added reporter of that kind, not no light, no excitation, or no antibody receptor.

中文因此样题Q3中，B吸收、C折射率、D波长、E频率，都可与无标记原则有关。A荧光强度针对课程所讲的外加染料报告物，是题目预期的例外。这个分类不表示所有强度测量都是有标记，也不否认自发荧光。“无标记”是没有添加这一类报告物，不是不用光、不激发或不用抗体受体。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p15–18; T3-0016–0029; Sample quiz p1 Q3

B09 · [P2] Quantum dots and flow cytometry量子点与流式细胞术

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize quantum-dot size-dependent colour and FSC/SSC/fluorescence channels.学习抓手：会认量子点尺寸影响颜色，以及FSC/SSC/荧光分别看什么。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W3 PDF p5–12; T3-0003–0015

量子点承接上周标记；流式视频完整说明逐细胞测量。无明确Quiz必考声明。

ENKey points
  • Quantum dots are semiconductor fluorescent labels with size-dependent emission;
  • larger dots commonly emit at longer wavelengths within the same material family.
  • Flow cytometry measures cells/particles passing a detection region: forward scatter (FSC) mainly indicates size, side scatter (SSC) internal complexity/granularity, and fluorescence label-associated molecular information.
  • A scatter plot separates populations;
  • it is not a tissue image.
中文必会知识点
  • Quantum dot量子点是半导体荧光标记，发射随尺寸变化；
  • 同材料系列中，较大颗粒通常发射更长波长。
  • Flow cytometry流式细胞术测量流经检测区的细胞/颗粒：FSC前向散射主要反映大小，SSC侧向散射反映内部复杂度/颗粒度，荧光反映标记所对应的分子信息。
  • 散点图用于区分群体，不是组织图像。

ENStart from zero: A quantum dot is a very small semiconductor particle that can fluoresce. Confinement at this size changes the available electronic energies, so particle size can affect emitted color. Within a comparable material family, larger dots commonly emit longer wavelengths. Flow cytometry is a separate method: it passes cells or particles through a detection region and measures each event, often using light scattering and fluorescence.

中文从零理解：Quantum dot（量子点）是可以发荧光的极小半导体颗粒。这种尺寸下的约束改变可用电子能量，因此颗粒大小可以影响发射颜色。同一个可比材料系列中，较大的量子点通常发射更长波长。Flow cytometry（流式细胞术）是另一种方法：让细胞或颗粒通过检测区域，逐个测量事件，常用光散射和荧光。

ENFollow the mechanism: Imagine cells passing a checkpoint one by one. Forward scatter, FSC, mainly provides information related to size. Side scatter, SSC, relates to internal complexity or granularity. Fluorescent labels can indicate particular molecules. Optical setup and cell properties also affect these signals; FSC is not a perfect ruler and SSC is not a complete picture of the cell interior.

中文跟着机制走：想象细胞一个接一个经过检查点。Forward scatter（FSC，前向散射）主要提供与大小有关的信息；side scatter（SSC，侧向散射）与内部复杂度或颗粒度有关；荧光标记可以提示某些分子。光学配置和细胞性质也影响这些信号：FSC不是完美的尺，SSC也不是细胞内部的完整照片。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a scatter plot places each measured cell according to its FSC and SSC values; clusters can suggest different populations. Adding a fluorescent antibody supplies another measurement for the matching target. This plot is not a tissue image showing neighboring cell positions. If asked which signal reports labelled molecular information, choose fluorescence; if asked which mainly relates to size, choose FSC, with the stated approximation.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：散点图根据每个细胞的FSC与SSC数值放置点，点群可以提示不同细胞群体。加入荧光抗体，又提供一个针对匹配目标的测量量。这个图不是显示邻近细胞位置的组织图像。若问哪个信号反映带标记的分子信息，选荧光；若问哪个主要与大小有关，按上述近似选FSC。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p89–95; W3 PDF p5–9; W3 PDF p10–12 | T2-0108–0111, T3-0003–0015

S113 · [P3] Quantum dots compared with molecular dyes / 量子点与分子染料的比较

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize the size–emission trend of quantum dots and compare labels qualitatively.学习抓手：认得同材料量子点变大通常发射变红，定性比较染料即可。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W3 PDF p6–9; T3-0003–0007

课堂标记应用介绍；不要求背某种材料的尺寸、寿命或优胜数值。

ENWithin a comparable quantum-dot material family, smaller dots have a larger band gap and tend to emit shorter-wavelength light; larger dots tend to emit longer wavelengths. Different sizes can supply different emission colors. Many dot colors can be excited by one suitable shorter-wavelength source whose photon energy is sufficient for their absorption bands, simplifying multicolor detection. This does not mean any source excites every dot.

中文同一个可比量子点材料系列中，较小颗粒有较大band gap（带隙），倾向发射较短波长；较大颗粒倾向发射较长波长。不同尺寸可提供不同发射颜色。能量足够、且波段匹配的一种较短波長光源可激发多种量子点颜色，简化multicolor detection（多色检测），但不是任何光源都能激发所有量子点。

ENThe course comparison presents quantum dots as potentially brighter and more photostable than its molecular-dye examples, with more distinguishable color channels. Photostability means maintaining performance under illumination; it is not the same as excited-state lifetime. Such advantages can help reproducibility and multiplexing, but actual yield and stability depend on material and conditions: do not memorize the example percentages as universal values for every dye or quantum dot.

中文课程比较表把量子点描述为相对其分子染料示例可能更亮、更photostable（耐光照稳定），并能提供更多可区分颜色通道。Photostability指光照下维持性能，不是激发态寿命。这些优势有助于再现性和多通道检测，但实际产率与稳定性取决于材料、条件，不能把表中示例百分比当成所有染料或量子点的普遍值。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p6–9; T3-0003–0007

ENRead the figure: Align each dot along the bottom with its bandgap above. For the same semiconductor family, a smaller nanocrystal generally has a larger bandgap and emits a higher-energy, shorter-wavelength photon; a larger one shifts toward longer wavelengths. The arrows point left toward increasing wavelength and size in this original figure, so check the axis direction. The core–shell drawing shows structure, not two separate colors that must both be emitted.

中文读图：把底部每个小球与上方带隙对应起来看。同一半导体材料体系中，纳米晶越小，Bandgap（带隙）通常越大，发出的光子能量更高、波长更短；越大则趋向较长波长。原图波长和尺寸轴向左增加，读图时别把方向看反。左下Core–shell（核–壳）图表示结构，不表示必定同时发出两种颜色。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p7; original slide figure / 原课件截图

C10 · [P1] Optical fibers and total internal reflection / 光纤与全内反射

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Sample Q9样卷Q9
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Check core/cladding indices and the two requirements for total internal reflection.学习抓手：会判断纤芯/包层折射率和全内反射的两个条件。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W3 PDF p19–24; T3-0030–0038

“This is very, very important. This is the foundation of how a fiber works.”

强调光纤导光基础，不是明确说某道Quiz必考。

Sample quiz Q9 (A, D, E)样卷Q9 (A, D, E): Sample quiz Q9 (A, D, E)

整组光纤相关概念还包括近界面倏逝场及点/复用/分布式，见S115/S116。

ENKey points
  • A conventional guiding fiber has a higher-index core and lower-index cladding.
  • Total internal reflection requires light travelling from higher to lower refractive index and an incidence angle above the critical angle.
  • Point sensing measures locally;
  • multiplexed sensing uses several sites;
  • distributed sensing reads along the fiber.
中文必会知识点
  • 常规导光光纤的纤芯折射率高于包层。
  • 全内反射要求光从高折射率介质到低折射率介质，且入射角大于临界角。
  • Point sensing在局部测量；
  • multiplexed sensing有多个位置；
  • distributed sensing沿光纤分布测量。

ENStart from zero: An optical fibre carries light along a thin core surrounded by cladding. Refractive index describes a material's effect on light propagation; a larger index means a lower phase speed than in vacuum. In a conventional guiding fibre, the core has the higher index. The boundary can keep suitable light inside through total internal reflection, allowing it to travel around gentle bends.

中文从零理解：Optical fibre（光纤）让光沿细小的core（纤芯）传播，外面包着cladding（包层）。Refractive index（折射率）描述材料对光传播的影响，折射率更大表示光的相速度比真空更低。常规导光光纤的纤芯折射率较高。边界可以通过total internal reflection（全内反射）把符合条件的光留在内部，使光能经过适度弯曲的路径。

ENFollow the mechanism: Total internal reflection needs two conditions: light approaches the boundary from the higher-index side, and its incidence angle exceeds the critical angle. The incidence angle is measured from the normal, a line perpendicular to the surface. Think of repeated boundary reflections guiding a beam, but remember the wave field is not perfectly confined: an evanescent field extends a short distance outside and decays rapidly.

中文跟着机制走：全内反射需要两个条件：光从较高折射率一侧来到边界，而且入射角超过临界角。入射角从normal（法线，即垂直表面的线）开始测量。可以先想象光通过反复的边界反射被引导，但波的场并非完全关在里面：evanescent field（倏逝场）会向外延伸一小段，并迅速衰减。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: molecules near an exposed sensing section can interact with the evanescent field and change the optical signal. A question saying that all external fields vanish under total internal reflection is therefore wrong. Point sensing measures one location; multiplexed sensing reads several separate sites; distributed sensing provides information along the fibre. These describe where measurements occur, not whether the target is biologically specific.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：靠近暴露传感段的分子，可以与倏逝场相互作用，改变光信号。因此，“全内反射时外部所有场都消失”是错误的。Point sensing（点式传感）测一个位置，multiplexed（复用）测多个分开的位点，distributed（分布式）沿光纤提供信息。这些术语描述测量位置，并不描述目标是否有生物特异性。

ENExam wording: An evanescent field outside the guiding region can interact with the surrounding sample. Total internal reflection does not mean the electromagnetic field is exactly zero outside the core.

中文英文读题抓手：导光区域外的evanescent field可与周围样品相互作用。全内反射并不表示纤芯外电磁场严格为零。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p19–24; W3 PDF p23–28; W3 PDF p31–38 | T3-0030–0045, T3-0052–0057

S114 · [P2] Snell’s law, critical angle and fibre acceptance / 斯涅尔定律、临界角与光纤接受角

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Calculate a critical angle or fibre NA and distinguish internal from acceptance angle.学习抓手：会临界角/光纤NA短算，分清界面入射角和外部接受角。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W3 PDF p20–24; T3-0030–0038

“This is very, very important. This is the foundation of how a fiber works.”

最高优先的TIR条件在C10；本节补公式和角度约定。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W1 PDF p86

W1所展示为全学期的期末样题，不是W1课后作业；不因此把长题当Quiz形式。

Final-exam emphasis仅期末考试强调: T2-0001

老师明确W1展示的past exam questions需学完整学期再答。

ENSnell’s law is n₁ sinθ₁=n₂ sinθ₂; angles are measured from the normal. Entering a higher-index medium bends a ray toward the normal; entering a lower-index medium bends it away. For n₁>n₂, the critical angle satisfies sinθ_c=n₂/n₁. At θ_c the ideal transmitted ray is tangent to the interface; angles above it give total internal reflection. With n₁=1.6 and n₂=1.38, θ_c is about 59.6°.

中文Snell’s law（斯涅尔定律）为n₁ sinθ₁=n₂ sinθ₂，角度从法线测量。进入较高折射率介质，光线向法线弯折；进入较低折射率介质，远离法线。n₁>n₂时，临界角满足sinθ_c=n₂/n₁。θ_c处理想透射光沿界面；超过它发生全内反射。n₁=1.6、n₂=1.38时，θ_c约59.6°。

ENThe fibre’s external acceptance angle is different from the internal incidence angle at the core–cladding wall. For an ideal step-index fibre, NA=n₀ sinθ_accept=√(n_core²−n_cladding²), where θ_accept is the maximum accepted half-angle and n₀ the outside index. A larger NA accepts a wider cone. Use the right indices and angle definition; the refractive index of a lens is not automatically the index to insert in a fibre formula.

中文光纤外部的acceptance angle（接受角）不同于光线在纤芯—包层壁面的内部入射角。理想阶跃折射率光纤满足NA=n₀ sinθ_accept=√(n_core²−n_cladding²)，θ_accept是最大接受半角，n₀是外部介质折射率。NA更大，能接受的光锥更宽。要使用正确折射率与角度定义，不能自动把透镜折射率代入光纤公式。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p20–24; Week 1 PDF p86; T3-0030–0041

ENRead the figure: The marked entry angle is an external acceptance half-angle. The internal reflection angle at the core–cladding boundary is measured from that boundary’s normal; do not interchange the two. The equation printed on this slide assumes entry from air (n₀≈1); in general NA=n₀ sinθ_accept.

中文读图：图中入纤角是外部接受半角；纤芯—包层壁面内部反射角从该壁面的法线测量，两个角不能互换。 原图NA=sinθ默认从空气入射（n₀≈1）；一般应写NA=n₀ sinθ_accept。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p23; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S115 · [P1] Evanescent sensing is confined near an interface / 倏逝传感局限在界面附近

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q9样卷Q9Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain why an evanescent field senses molecules near the interface rather than far away.学习抓手：解释倏逝场为什么只对靠近界面的分子敏感，远处场会衰减。

Sample quiz Q9 (A)样卷Q9 (A): Sample quiz Q9 (A)

近界面场及其空间范围是正确选项涉及的概念。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W3 PDF p25–29; T3-0042–0050

近场→结合改变折射率→光谱响应的链条；不要背ASR错误距离。

ENAn evanescent field extends into the lower-index side of a totally reflecting interface and decays rapidly away from it. In the slide’s intensity model, I(d)/I(0)=exp(−d/L₀). At one intensity decay length L₀, intensity is about 37% of its boundary value; at two it is about 14%. Amplitude and intensity decay lengths use different conventions, so use the definition printed with the equation.

中文Evanescent field（倏逝场）延伸进入全反射界面较低折射率的一侧，并随离界面距离迅速衰减。课件强度模型为I(d)/I(0)=exp(−d/L₀)。离界面一个强度衰减长度L₀时，强度约为界面值37%；两个时约14%。场振幅与强度的衰减长度定义不同，应以方程所注明的定义为准。

ENPenetration depends on wavelength, refractive-index contrast and incidence angle. The sensor is especially sensitive to molecules within this nearby field, which is why immobilized receptors at the surface are useful. It is not uniformly sensitive to an entire thick sample. A strong near-boundary field in sample Q9 A refers to this surface interaction; it does not mean all evanescent fields are automatically amplified or that light propagates deeply through the outside medium.

中文Penetration depth（穿透深度）与波长、两介质折射率差及入射角有关。传感器特别感受附近场范围内的分子，因此把受体固定在表面有用；它并非对整个厚样品同样敏感。样题Q9 A的“界面附近强场”指这种近表面相互作用，不意味着所有倏逝场自动被放大，或光会在外部介质深处持续传播。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p25–29; T3-0042–0050

ENClarify the concept: The wave description of total internal reflection also gives a small lateral displacement of a finite reflected beam relative to the ideal ray reflection point: the Goos–Hänchen shift. The slide uses this with the evanescent-field diagram to show why a purely geometric picture is incomplete. Keep the near-interface exponential decay and its dependence on wavelength, indices and angle; do not confuse a lateral beam shift with penetration depth normal to the interface.

中文把概念讲清：全内反射的波动描述还给出有限宽反射光束相对理想光线反射点的小横向位移，叫Goos–Hänchen shift（古斯—汉欣位移）。课件配合倏逝场图说明纯几何图像不完整。仍以界面附近指数衰减及其波长、折射率、角度依赖为主；横向光束位移不同于垂直界面的穿透深度。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p25–27 explicitly labels Goos–Haenchen shift; current S115 supplies decay and convention; recognition-level addition only

ENRead the figure: The light remains guided, but its evanescent field extends into the adjoining sample. Surface antibodies place bound targets within this short sensing region. Read the distance axis below: intensity decreases exponentially with distance from the interface. The slide writes exp(−d/L₀); interpret this as normalized intensity I(d)/I₀. Thus targets close to the surface affect the signal more strongly; total internal reflection does not mean zero field outside the guide.

中文读图：光仍被波导导引，但Evanescent field（倏逝场）会伸进邻近样品。表面抗体把结合的目标带到这段很薄的感应区。看下方距离轴：离开界面越远，光强越弱，呈指数衰减。课件写exp(−d/L₀)，应理解为归一化光强I(d)/I₀。因此靠近表面的目标影响更大；Total internal reflection（全内反射）不表示波导外完全没有场。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p27; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B10 · [P1] Fibre modes and cavity recognition光纤模式与共振腔辨识

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q2, Q9样卷Q2、Q9Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Identify Fabry–Pérot/WGM/photonic-crystal resonators and point/multiplexed/distributed sensing.学习抓手：会认FP/WGM/光子晶体共振器，分清点式、复用与分布式。

Sample quiz Q2 (A, C, D)样卷Q2 (A, C, D): Sample quiz Q2 (A, C, D)

两反射面、边界循环、周期折射率结构都要认得。

Sample quiz Q9 (D, E)样卷Q9 (D, E): Sample quiz Q9 (D, E)

按课堂示例判断，再保留通用复用定义不强制目标不同的边界。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W3 PDF p24, p31–38, p48–50; T3-0052–0057; T3-0079–0083

“students usually get confused between multiplex and distributed.”

老师专门指出易混点；模式细节见S116，可在判断概念后再读。

ENKey points
  • A mode is an allowed field pattern;
  • single-mode and multimode fibres differ in supported patterns.
  • Evanescent fields decay outside the guiding region and enable surface sensing.
  • Fabry–Pérot cavities use facing reflectors;
  • whispering-gallery modes circulate near a boundary;
  • photonic-crystal cavities confine light using a structured refractive-index arrangement.
  • Multiplexing uses distinct sensing sites;
  • distributed sensing samples along the fibre.
中文必会知识点
  • Mode模式是允许存在的场分布；
  • single-mode单模与multimode多模光纤支持的模式数不同。
  • Evanescent field倏逝场在导光区域外衰减，可用于表面传感。
  • Fabry–Pérot腔使用相对反射面；
  • whispering-gallery mode回音壁模式沿边界循环；
  • 光子晶体腔利用结构化折射率分布约束光。
  • Multiplexed在多个离散位点检测；
  • distributed沿光纤分布检测。

ENStart from zero: A mode is an allowed pattern of the light field in a structure. A single-mode fibre supports one guided spatial pattern at the operating wavelength; a multimode fibre supports several. This does not mean single-mode light contains only one photon. A cavity confines light so selected patterns can persist and resonate. Its geometry helps determine the allowed patterns, much as an instrument's shape influences its supported notes.

中文从零理解：Mode（模式）是光场在结构中允许存在的分布。Single-mode fibre（单模光纤）在工作波长处支持一个导光空间模式，multimode fibre（多模光纤）支持多个，并不是说单模光里只有一个光子。Cavity（腔）约束光，让选定模式可以持续并共振。几何形状帮助决定允许模式，类似乐器形状影响可支持的音调。

ENFollow the mechanism: A Fabry–Pérot cavity uses facing reflectors, letting light travel back and forth. A whispering-gallery mode circulates near a boundary, resembling sound traveling around a round gallery. A photonic-crystal cavity uses a structured refractive-index arrangement to confine light. These are recognition aids, not exact mechanical pictures: all involve electromagnetic field patterns. An evanescent field outside a guiding boundary can sample nearby molecules without requiring them to enter the whole cavity.

中文跟着机制走：Fabry–Pérot（法布里—珀罗）腔使用相对的反射面，使光往返传播；whispering-gallery mode（回音壁模式）沿边界循环，类似声音沿圆形回廊传播；photonic-crystal cavity（光子晶体腔）利用结构化折射率排列约束光。这些只是辨认辅助，不是严格的机械图像，三者都涉及电磁场模式。导光边界外的倏逝场可以感受附近分子，不要求分子进入整个腔。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: identify facing mirrors, a circular rim, or a patterned lattice before naming the cavity. For fibre sensing, distinguish several separate sensing locations, multiplexed sensing, from information continuously resolved along a length, distributed sensing. Neither describes the number of optical modes. Mode describes a field pattern; sensing arrangement describes where information is obtained.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：先寻找相对镜面、圆形边缘或图案化晶格，再判断腔类型。光纤传感中，多个分开的传感位置属于复用传感，沿长度连续分辨信息属于分布式传感；两者都不是光学模式数。模式描述场分布，传感安排描述从哪里获得信息。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p19–24; W3 PDF p23–28; W3 PDF p30; W3 PDF p31–38; W3 PDF p31–39; W3 PDF p39–45; W3 PDF p48–50 | T3-0030–0045, T3-0051–0072, T3-0079–0083

S116 · [P1] Modes, dispersion and spatial sensing arrangements / 模式、色散与空间传感安排

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q9样卷Q9Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain Q9 D/E: discrete multiplexed channels versus location-resolved distributed sensing.学习抓手：解释Q9 D/E：离散复用通道与沿位置分辨的分布式检测不同。

Sample quiz Q9 (D, E)样卷Q9 (D, E): Sample quiz Q9 (D, E)

按课堂多位点/多目标与沿线温度示例判断；通用定义不强制复用目标不同。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W3 PDF p31–38; T3-0052–0057

“students usually get confused between multiplex and distributed.”

模态/模式色散在本节是辅助；P1先分清空间测量安排。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: W3 PDF p30; T3-0051

“Later this part is not that important, but just to share with you, that there are different setups to build to set up a fiber sensor.”

只就近降低传输/反射装置搭建细节，不排除后续复用/分布式。

ENDifferent modes can travel with different delays. A multimode fibre can collect more light but a pulse may spread in time because its modes arrive at different times: modal dispersion. Single-mode operation avoids this particular source of spreading; it does not eliminate every loss or every kind of dispersion. Mode count describes field patterns, not target count or number of sensors.

中文不同模式可具有不同传播延时。Multimode fibre（多模光纤）能收集较多光，但不同模式抵达时间不同，脉冲可能在时间上展宽，这叫modal dispersion（模式色散）。单模操作避免这一类展宽，并不消除所有损耗或所有色散。模式数描述场分布，不是目标数或传感器数量。

ENPoint sensing reads locally. Multiplexed sensing separately reads several localized sites/channels along one fibre; the taught example assigns different targets to different sites. Distributed sensing resolves a measurand along the fibre, such as temperature at many positions. Thus sample Q9 D/E fit the classroom examples. In the general definition, multiplexed sites may measure the same target, and distributed systems can have multiple parameters; do not turn the examples into universal restrictions.

中文Point sensing（点式）在局部读出。Multiplexed sensing（复用）分别读取一根光纤上的多个离散位点/通道，课程例子在不同位点安排不同目标。Distributed sensing（分布式）沿光纤分辨某一被测量，例如各位置温度。因此样题Q9 D/E符合课堂示例。通用定义中，复用位点也可测同一目标，分布式系统也可包含多参数，不能把示例扩大成普遍限制。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p24, p30–38; T3-0051–0058; Sample quiz p2 Q9 D/E

C11 · [P1] Resonators, SPR and LSPR / 共振器、表面等离激元与局域表面等离激元

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q2样卷Q2Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain resonance at selected frequencies and distinguish SPR from nanoparticle LSPR.学习抓手：知道共振只增强特定频率，分清金属界面SPR和纳米颗粒LSPR。

Sample quiz Q2 (A–E)样卷Q2 (A–E): Sample quiz Q2 (A–E)

按课程广义光学共振传感分类逐项判断；SPR不等同普通双镜封闭腔。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W3 PDF p39–45; T3-0069–0072

“But the most important thing is resonator is used to amplify the signal only at particular frequencies that can fulfill this condition.”

被动共振器增加相互作用和内部场，不创造光能。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W3 PDF p51–75; T3-0084–0105; T4-0001–0003; T7-0051–0052

SPR/LSPR基本机制反复比较。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: W3 PDF p59–63; T3-0097

“As a reference, you don't need to put it on your exam sheet. It will not be tested.”

就近是详细SPR传播/耦合说明，exam sheet最明确是期末语境；不能排除SPR/LSPR基础。

ENKey points
  • Optical resonators enhance repeated light–sample interaction.
  • SPR is a light-coupled collective electron oscillation at a metal interface;
  • LSPR is localized around metal nanoparticles or nanostructures.
  • Surface binding can shift a resonance because the surrounding refractive index changes.
中文必会知识点
  • 光学共振器增强光与样品反复相互作用。
  • SPR是金属界面上与光耦合的集体电子振荡；
  • LSPR局域于金属纳米颗粒或纳米结构。
  • 表面结合改变周围折射率，因此可能引起共振位移。

ENStart from zero: Resonance means a system responds especially strongly at certain frequencies. A playground swing is easier to drive when pushes match its timing. An optical resonator similarly favors particular light frequencies, although its mechanism involves electromagnetic waves rather than a swinging mass. Repeated light interaction with a sensing region can make small changes easier to observe through shifts of a resonance peak.

中文从零理解：Resonance（共振）表示一个系统在某些频率处响应特别强。推秋千时，如果推的节奏配合秋千的运动节奏，就比较容易越荡越高。光学共振器也会特别响应某些光频率，但它涉及电磁波，而不是摆动的物体。光在传感区域反复作用，可以让很小的变化通过共振峰位移变得更容易观察。

ENFollow the mechanism: In SPR, light drives many mobile electrons in a metal to oscillate together at an interface. In LSPR, this collective response is localized around a nanoparticle or nanostructure. Nearby molecules change the optical environment, often represented by refractive index, and can shift the response peak. A metal plasmonic surface is not automatically a closed cavity with two mirrors; the course groups these mechanisms broadly as resonance sensing.

中文跟着机制走：在SPR（表面等离激元共振）中，光驱动金属中许多可移动电子在界面处一起振荡。在LSPR（局域表面等离激元共振）中，这种集体响应局域在纳米颗粒或纳米结构周围。附近的分子改变光学环境，常用折射率描述，因而可能改变响应峰的位置。金属等离激元表面并不自动等于由两面镜子组成的闭合腔，课程把这些机制广义归入共振传感。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a sensor peak moves after protein binds to its surface. This suggests resonance-shift readout; recognition chemistry still determines which protein binds. Identify SPR by its metal interface and LSPR by localized metal structures. Do not decide selectivity from a large peak shift alone: unrelated changes in temperature or surrounding solution can also move a resonance.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：蛋白质结合传感器表面后，峰的位置发生移动，这提示采用共振位移读出；至于哪种蛋白质会结合，仍由识别化学决定。看到金属界面想到SPR，看到局域金属结构想到LSPR。不能只凭位移大就认定选择性好：温度或周围溶液的其他变化也可能移动共振峰。

ENExam wording: The course uses a broad resonance-sensing classification. Do not equate every SPR structure with a closed Fabry–Perot cavity. For this Quiz, identify mechanism and shift direction before studying long resonance derivations.

中文英文读题抓手：课程采用广义“共振传感”分类，但不能把所有SPR结构等同于闭合Fabry–Perot腔。这次Quiz优先辨识机制与位移，再考虑长共振公式。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p39–45; W3 PDF p51–60; W3 PDF p64–75 | T3-0062–0072, T3-0084–0093, T3-0099–0105

S118 · [P2] Resonance shifts from index and geometry / 折射率与几何造成的共振位移

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Final emphasis仅期末强调Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Relate a resonance shift to refractive index or geometry and read bulk-index calibration.学习抓手：知道共振可因折射率或尺寸变化而移位，会读体折射率校准。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W3 PDF p41–50; T3-0062–0083

P1器件分类先学B10/C11；本节解释λ=2πRn_eff/m及校准含义。

Final-exam emphasis仅期末考试强调: W3 PDF p47–50; T3-0077–0078

“As you can see, on the final exam, it can look like this.”

展示图计算明确是final exam，不提升为Quiz必考。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: T3-0076

“Don't bother too much by this part.”

就近是温度/尺寸延伸；仍保留尺寸能使峰移的概念，长温度推导次要。

ENCavity resonators such as Fabry–Pérot and WGM recirculate light so a sample can interact with the field repeatedly, rather than only during one pass. For the illustrated WGM model, λ_r=2πRn_eff/m for a fixed mode order m. Small changes give Δλ_r/λ_r≈ΔR/R+Δn_eff/n_eff. With radius and mode fixed, a larger effective index shifts this resonance to longer wavelength. A size change can also shift it, so a shift is not proof of binding by itself.

中文Fabry–Pérot、WGM等cavity resonator（腔型共振器）使光循环，让样品反复与场作用，而不是只经过一次。课件WGM模型在模式级次m固定时，λ_r=2πRn_eff/m。微小变化满足Δλ_r/λ_r≈ΔR/R+Δn_eff/n_eff。半径、模式固定时，有效折射率更大，会使该共振移向较长波长；尺寸变化也会造成位移，因此位移本身不是结合的充分证据。

ENBulk refractive-index calibration uses liquids with known indices and measures the resulting shifts to obtain Δλ/Δn. It characterizes the optical device’s index response, not its ability to distinguish one biomolecule from another. Two facing reflectors identify a Fabry–Pérot cavity, a circulating rim mode identifies WGM, and a periodic index structure identifies a photonic-crystal resonator. Raman scattering reports vibrational energy exchange rather than this resonance-recycling mechanism.

中文Bulk refractive-index calibration（体折射率校准）用折射率已知的液体，测对应位移，求Δλ/Δn。它表征光学器件的折射率响应，不是区分不同生物分子的能力。两面相对反射面提示Fabry–Pérot腔，沿边界循环的模式提示WGM，周期性折射率结构提示光子晶体共振器。拉曼报告振动能交换，不是这种循环光的共振机制。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p41–50; T3-0062–0083

S119 · [P2] SPR coupling, localized plasmons and EOT / SPR耦合、局域等离激元与EOT

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize prism/grating coupling and read SPR/LSPR/EOT spectrum axes.学习抓手：认得SPR的棱镜/光栅耦合，并读清反射/消光/透射纵轴。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: W3 PDF p54–68, p81; T3-0098–0103; T4-0001–0003

SPR/LSPR基本区别已列P1 C11；EOT与耦合方法是这一节扩展。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: W3 PDF p59–63; T3-0097

“This is some detailed explanation.”

详细传播常数推导低优先；不排除棱镜/光栅方法和峰/谷读图。

ENA propagating surface plasmon couples an electromagnetic field with collective conduction-electron motion at a metal–dielectric interface. Exciting it requires appropriate coupling; a prism or grating can provide a suitable coupling condition. It is not enough to shine any beam onto any metal and assume an SPR signal. In LSPR the response is localized around a small metal structure; its excitation arrangement is often simpler, but wavelength, structure and polarization can still matter.

中文传播型surface plasmon（表面等离激元）把电磁场与金属—介质界面的导电电子集体运动耦合。激发它需要合适coupling（耦合），棱镜或光栅可提供相应条件；不能任意光束照任意金属，就假定出现SPR信号。LSPR的响应局域在小金属结构周围，激发布置通常更简单，但波长、结构和偏振仍可能有影响。

ENExtraordinary optical transmission, EOT, refers here to resonantly enhanced transmission through patterned small holes in a metal film. Its spectrum can change when the nearby refractive index changes. Read the plotted observable: traditional SPR often shows a reflectivity dip, LSPR an extinction peak, and EOT a transmission feature. A resonance may appear as a peak or a dip depending on what the detector measures; neither appearance alone identifies the biosensor family.

中文这里的Extraordinary optical transmission（EOT，异常光透射）指金属膜图案化小孔中的共振增强透射，附近折射率改变可使其光谱变化。要读纵轴：传统SPR常显示reflectivity（反射率）凹谷，LSPR显示extinction（消光）峰，EOT显示透射特征。同一类共振因被测量不同，可以表现为峰或谷；仅靠“峰还是谷”不能确定生物传感器类型。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p54–68, p81; T3-0084–0103

ENRead the figure: Read both axes: SPR plots reflection against angle here, LSPR extinction against wavelength, EOT transmission against wavelength. A target-induced resonance change may move a dip or a peak depending on the observable.

中文读图：先看两条坐标轴：此图SPR为反射对角度，LSPR为消光对波长，EOT为透射对波长。目标引起共振变化时，根据被测量不同，移动的可以是谷，也可以是峰。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p81; original slide figure / 原课件截图

ENRead the figure: Follow the red incident beam through the prism to the thin metal film. At the resonance condition, energy couples to electron oscillations along the metal–sample interface, so reflected intensity decreases and the detector sees a dip. Binding changes the nearby refractive index and shifts the angle or wavelength where this dip occurs. For conventional propagating SPR, coupling and p/TM polarization matter; simply shining any light onto gold does not guarantee resonance.

中文读图：沿红色入射光追踪：光经过棱镜到达薄金属膜。在Resonance（共振）条件下，能量耦合到金属–样品界面的电子振荡，反射光减少，探测器读到一个Dip（谷值）。结合改变附近折射率，会移动谷值对应的角度或波长。传统传播型SPR需要合适耦合条件及p/TM偏振；不是任意光照到金上都会产生共振。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p59; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S120 · [P3] SPR imaging and fixed-wavelength intensity readout / SPR成像与固定波长强度读出

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Supporting concept辅助理解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain fixed-point intensity changes and distinguish a camera from a spectrometer.学习抓手：知道固定工作点强度可随共振移动而变化，相机不直接告诉波长。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W3 PDF p81–86; T3-0111–0115

SPR成像/AI研究应用例子；没有独立Quiz或短计算重点提示。

Lower-priority detail老师降低细节优先级: T3-0111–0112

“I would not want you to memorize this.”

仅就近指旧θ扫描配置，不能据此排除所有SPR成像概念。

ENSPR imaging illuminates many spots and measures their reflectivity changes in parallel, commonly at a fixed angle and wavelength. If binding shifts a resonance curve, the intensity at that fixed operating point can change. Thus sensing a resonance shift does not always require scanning and measuring the full spectrum in every measurement. The array improves throughput and can support multiplexing when its sites have appropriate recognition elements.

中文SPR imaging（SPR成像）照明多个传感点、并行测它们的反射率变化，常在固定角度和波长工作。结合使共振曲线移动时，固定工作点处的强度也会变化。因此，感测共振位移不要求每次都扫描完整光谱。阵列能提高throughput（通量），各位点有相应识别元件时，还能支持复用检测。

ENA camera records spatial intensity values; a spectrometer resolves optical strength across wavelength. Converting a camera pattern into an estimated wavelength shift or concentration requires calibration or a validated model. A dark or bright spot does not directly supply its wavelength. Machine learning can help map patterns to biological information, but the measurement and calibration still have to establish what the pattern means.

中文Camera（相机）记录空间强度数值，spectrometer（光谱仪）按波长分辨光学强度。把相机图案转换为估计波长位移或浓度，需要校准或验证过的模型。暗点或亮点本身不能直接告诉你波长。机器学习可以帮助把图案映射为生物信息，但仍需测量与校准确定图案的含义。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p81–86; T3-0111–0115

B11 · [P2] Sensitivity, linewidth, Q and FOM / 灵敏度、线宽、Q值与品质指标

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Final emphasis仅期末强调Repeated explanation反复讲解Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Read FWHM and calculate index sensitivity, Q and FOM with consistent coordinates.学习抓手：会读FWHM并短算折射率灵敏度、Q、FOM，坐标和单位要一致。

Final-exam emphasis仅期末考试强调: W3 PDF p77–80; T3-0109–0110

“You will definitely see a question on final exam, asking this, and then divide it over your forward at half maxima.”

这条确定考试强调明确针对final exam，不标成Quiz必考。

Repeated explanation课堂反复讲解: T3-0026; T3-0046–0050; T3-0077–0078; T3-0108–0110; T4-0002

基础S=Δλ/Δn和窄峰意义反复讲；短式仍适合概念/简单计算复习。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W3 PDF p47–50; T3-0077–0078

课堂实际校准图；长综合图题次于读斜率、线宽和单位。

ENKey points
  • Bulk refractive-index sensitivity Sλ=Δλ/Δn has units nm/RIU.
  • It describes index response, not biochemical selectivity.
  • Resonance linewidth is often FWHM (full width at half maximum);
  • Q=f0/δf, equivalently λ0/δλ for a narrow resonance.
  • FOMλ=Sλ/δλ compares sensitivity with linewidth.
  • Keep the same spectral coordinate and units;
  • narrower lines alone do not determine LOD.
中文必会知识点
  • 体折射率灵敏度Sλ=Δλ/Δn，单位nm/RIU，描述折射率响应而非生化选择性。
  • 共振线宽常用FWHM半高全宽；
  • Q=f0/δf，窄共振下等价于λ0/δλ。
  • FOMλ=Sλ/δλ同时考虑灵敏度与线宽。
  • 分子分母必须使用相同光谱坐标与匹配单位；
  • 线更窄也不能单独确定LOD。

ENStart from zero: A resonance peak has a position and a width. Sensitivity tells us how far the position moves when the measured quantity changes. Linewidth describes how broad the peak is. FWHM, full width at half maximum, is the distance between two points at half the peak height above its baseline. A tall peak can still be broad, so height alone is not sharpness.

中文从零理解：共振峰同时有位置和宽度。Sensitivity（灵敏度）告诉我们被测量变化时，峰位置移动多少；linewidth（线宽）描述峰有多宽。FWHM，即full width at half maximum（半高全宽），是峰高相对基线的一半处左右两点之间的距离。峰高也可能很宽，因此高度本身不是尖锐程度。

ENFollow the mechanism: For refractive-index sensing, Sλ=Δλ/Δn: peak shift Δλ divided by index change Δn, in nm/RIU. RIU means refractive-index unit. Quality factor Q compares the resonance position with its width; a narrow peak at the same position gives larger Q. FOMλ=Sλ/δλ compares sensitivity with linewidth δλ. Think of a moving pointer with a blurred edge, but actual uncertainty also depends on noise and how the peak is fitted.

中文跟着机制走：折射率传感中，Sλ=Δλ/Δn，等于峰位移Δλ除以折射率变化Δn，单位nm/RIU。RIU是refractive-index unit（折射率单位）。Quality factor Q（品质因数）比较共振位置与宽度：位置相同时，峰越窄，Q越大。FOMλ=Sλ/δλ把灵敏度与线宽δλ放在一起比较。可以类比边缘模糊的移动指针，但真实不确定性还取决于噪声和峰的拟合方法。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: a 2 nm shift for Δn=0.01 gives Sλ=200 nm/RIU. If linewidth is 4 nm, FOMλ=50 RIU⁻¹. Do not divide this wavelength sensitivity by a width in Hz; convert to one coordinate first. High Q or high FOM does not alone establish LOD or biochemical selectivity. A resonance can respond strongly to any index change, including an unwanted background change.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：Δn=0.01引起2 nm位移，则Sλ=200 nm/RIU；若线宽4 nm，FOMλ=50 RIU⁻¹。不能把这个波长灵敏度直接除以Hz单位的宽度，先统一坐标。Q高或FOM高，都不能单独证明检测限低或生化选择性好。共振可以强烈响应任何折射率变化，包括不需要的背景变化。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p15–18; W3 PDF p25–29; W3 PDF p46–50; W3 PDF p77–80; W3 PDF p81–87 | T3-0021–0029, T3-0046–0050, T3-0073–0078, T3-0107–0114

ENRead the figure: For FWHM, first find half the peak height, then measure the horizontal separation of the two intersections; it is neither the full base width nor half the center frequency. Compare the two lower spectra: a narrow peak makes the same wavelength shift easier to distinguish. Q=f₀/Δf compares center frequency with linewidth; FOM compares sensitivity with linewidth. Match the units: frequency sensitivity needs Δf, wavelength sensitivity needs Δλ. A tall peak alone does not prove high Q or FOM.

中文读图：求FWHM（半高全宽）时，先找峰高的一半，再量左右交点的横向距离；它不是整个底宽，也不是中心频率的一半。比较下方光谱：同样的波长移动，窄峰更容易分辨。Q=f₀/Δf比较中心频率与线宽；FOM比较灵敏度与线宽。必须匹配单位：频率灵敏度配Δf，波长灵敏度配Δλ。峰很高，不等于Q或FOM就很高。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p80; original slide figure / 原课件截图

C12 · [P1] Antigen rapid test (ART): gold nanoparticle LSPR / 抗原快速检测：金纳米颗粒LSPR

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate antibody–antigen recognition from gold-nanoparticle LSPR colour in ART.学习抓手：ART识别靠抗体—抗原，红色读出靠金纳米颗粒LSPR；控制线判有效性。

Explicit Quiz emphasis老师明确提到Quiz: W3 PDF p76; T3-0106; T7-0048–0050

“I actually asked this question to student every year on the quiz. What is the working principle of ART?”

直接指ART原理；正确是课程金纳米颗粒比色示例的LSPR，不是荧光。

Worked example课堂/课件例题: W1 PDF p67; W3 PDF p76; T1-0062–0064; T7-0048–0050

W7课堂Quiz型问题再次问ART，控制线属于理解检测流程的基础。

ENKey points
  • The lecturer explicitly says the ART principle is a recurring Quiz question.
  • In the taught colorimetric rapid-test example, gold nanoparticles produce the visible optical response through LSPR;
  • antibody–antigen recognition controls their localization at the test line.
  • The control line checks assay operation;
  • a missing control line makes the test invalid.
中文必会知识点
  • 老师明确说ART原理是反复出现的Quiz问题。
  • 课程的比色快检示例中，金纳米颗粒通过LSPR产生可见光学响应，抗体—抗原识别控制其在检测线处的聚集或定位。
  • Control line控制线用于检查检测运行；
  • 缺少控制线时结果无效。

ENStart from zero: An antigen is a molecular target that an antibody can recognize. In the taught antigen rapid test, antibodies supply the recognition and gold nanoparticles supply a visible reporter. These are separate jobs. A test line appears when the appropriate labelled material is captured there. The gold is not simply a decorative color, and the antibody is not itself an electronic detector.

中文从零理解：Antigen（抗原）是抗体可以识别的分子目标。在课程讲的antigen rapid test（抗原快速检测，ART）中，抗体负责识别，金纳米颗粒负责提供可见报告信号，这是两个不同工作。当相应的带标记材料被捕获在检测线处，就能形成可见线。金颗粒并非只是装饰颜色，抗体本身也不是电子探测器。

ENFollow the mechanism: The liquid travels along the strip by capillary action, the movement of liquid through small spaces without a pump. Target antigen can associate with labelled antibodies and be captured at the test line. Many gold nanoparticles together create a visible optical response associated with LSPR. Their electrons interact collectively with light. Think of gathering colored markers at one location; actual capture is molecular binding, not deliberate placement.

中文跟着机制走：液体通过capillary action（毛细作用）沿试纸移动，也就是液体在细小空间内无需泵就能流动。目标抗原可以与带标记抗体结合，并被检测线捕获。大量金纳米颗粒聚在一起，形成与LSPR有关的可见光学响应，其电子会与光发生集体作用。可以类比把彩色标记集中到一个位置，但真实捕获是分子结合，并非人为放置。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: if a question asks the recognition mechanism, answer antibody–antigen binding; if it asks the gold nanoparticle optical principle, answer LSPR. Do not replace one with the other. This colorimetric ART example is different from PCR, which amplifies nucleic acids, and from ordinary fluorescent reporting. Match the requested step to its mechanism. A control line checks assay operation; a missing control line makes the result invalid, even if a test line appears.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：如果问识别机制，答抗体—抗原结合；如果问金纳米颗粒的光学原理，答LSPR，两者不能互换。这个比色ART例子不同于扩增核酸的PCR，也不同于普通荧光报告。把题目问的步骤与相应机制对应起来。 Control line（控制线）检查检测是否正常运行；即使出现测试线，缺少控制线时结果仍无效。

ENExam wording: Separate recognition from readout: antibody binding supplies specificity, while the gold nanoparticles supply the optical signal. Do not answer PCR, electrical membrane potential, or ordinary fluorescence excitation for this taught example.

中文英文读题抓手：区分识别与读出：抗体结合赋予特异性，金纳米颗粒提供光学信号。该课程示例不能答成PCR、细胞膜电位或普通荧光激发。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p76; W7 p52–55 (context; classroom question diagram); W3 p76–79; W1 PDF p67 | T1-0062–0064, T3-0106, T7-0047–0050

ENRead the figure: Fluid moves along the strip by capillary action. Antibodies provide selective recognition; accumulated gold labels provide a visible colour signal through their optical properties. For the illustrated common assay pattern, C+T means positive, C alone means negative, and no C means invalid. Read within the assay-specific time window and follow its instructions.

中文读图：液体靠Capillary action（毛细作用）沿试纸流动。Antibody（抗体）负责选择性识别；聚集的Gold labels（金标签）利用自身光学性质显色。图示常见判读模式为C＋T阳性、仅C阴性、无C则无效。具体检测须按该试剂说明和规定时间判读。

Source / 来源：Week 1 PDF p67; Week 3 PDF p76; original teaching schematic / 自绘教学示意，非实验数据

B12 · [P2] LSPR tuning and SERS局域等离激元调谐与表面增强拉曼

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Sample Q2样卷Q2
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain nanoparticle hot spots, SERS enhancement and Raman molecular fingerprints.学习抓手：解释纳米颗粒热点为何增强拉曼，区分SERS指纹与LSPR峰移。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W3 PDF p88–94; T4-0006–0013

“This is a important slide to describe what is a service enhanced Raman.”

Week3课件内容实际在Week4续讲；ASR service enhanced Raman为surface-enhanced Raman。

Sample quiz Q2 (E (Raman contrast))样卷Q2 (E (Raman contrast)): Sample quiz Q2 (E (Raman contrast))

样卷直接问普通Raman为何不是共振器；SERS是后续增强机制，不等同该E选项。

ENKey points
  • Nanoparticle material, size, shape and surrounding refractive index affect LSPR.
  • SERS means surface-enhanced Raman scattering: metal nanostructures create strong local fields, especially at hot spots, and greatly enhance nearby Raman signals.
  • Recognize a Raman molecular fingerprint versus an LSPR resonance shift.
  • SERS was continued in Week 4;
  • its deferral in Week 3 did not remove it from scope.
中文必会知识点
  • 纳米颗粒材料、尺寸、形状和周围折射率影响LSPR。
  • SERS为surface-enhanced Raman scattering表面增强拉曼散射：金属纳米结构产生强局域场，尤其在hot spot热点处，显著增强附近拉曼信号。
  • 区分拉曼分子指纹与LSPR共振位移。
  • SERS在Week4续讲，Week3推迟讲解不表示不考。

ENStart from zero: LSPR is the light-driven collective electron response localized around a metal nanostructure. Its preferred wavelengths depend on the material, size, shape, and surrounding optical environment. Thus changing a sphere into a rod can change its spectrum even without adding an analyte. A measured resonance shift needs a controlled comparison, because geometry and environment both influence the signal.

中文从零理解：LSPR是光驱动的集体电子响应，局域在金属纳米结构周围。它特别响应的波长取决于材料、尺寸、形状和周围光学环境。因此，即使没有添加分析物，把球形颗粒改成棒形也能改变光谱。测得共振位移时需要受控比较，因为几何和环境都影响信号。

ENFollow the mechanism: SERS strengthens normally weak Raman scattering from molecules near suitable metal structures. Structures can concentrate the local electromagnetic field, especially in gaps called hot spots. The stronger field makes nearby Raman signals easier to detect. Imagine a locally intensified light zone; the molecules still contribute their vibration-related spectrum. The analogy does not mean the whole sample becomes equally bright, or that every molecule automatically reaches a hot spot.

中文跟着机制走：SERS增强位于合适金属结构附近的分子原本很弱的拉曼散射。结构可以集中局部电磁场，尤其是在叫hot spots（热点）的间隙中，使附近的拉曼信号更容易检测。可以想象一个局部光场增强区域，分子仍然贡献与自身振动有关的光谱。这个类比不表示整个样品均匀变亮，也不表示每个分子都会自动来到热点。

ENTry an example: Teaching example: tracking a metal resonance peak moving with the surroundings is LSPR-based resonance readout. Looking for a molecule's shifted vibrational lines, made stronger near metal, is SERS readout. Both may use plasmonic structures but answer different measurement questions. For identification, ask what is plotted: the metal resonance position or a Raman fingerprint. Enhancement does not remove the need for suitable recognition, controls, and interpretation.

中文用例子理解：教学例子：跟踪金属共振峰随着周围环境移动，是基于LSPR的共振读出；寻找分子的振动位移谱线，并用附近金属增强它们，是SERS读出。两者都可能用等离激元结构，但回答不同的测量问题。辨认时看图里画的是什么：金属共振位置，还是拉曼指纹？增强并不会取消合适识别、对照和解释的需求。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p64–75; W3 PDF p88–95; W3 p60–94; W3 p88–94 | T3-0099–0105, T3-0115–0116, T4-0001–0014

S121 · [P2] SERS enhancement and molecular fingerprints / SERS增强与分子指纹

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate metal-field enhancement from molecular Raman fingerprints; recognize two enhancement paths.学习抓手：分清金属场增强与分子拉曼指纹，认得电磁/化学两条增强路径。

Teacher emphasis课堂明确强调: W3 PDF p88–94; T4-0006–0013

“This is a important slide to describe what is a service enhanced Raman.”

W3最后宣布下周续讲，实际详细机制在W4；巨大增强倍数是示例而非所有基底保证。

Supporting course concept课内辅助概念: W3 PDF p89–90

化学增强和电磁增强区别来自课件图；无需背具体研究疾病或增强倍数。

ENSERS means surface-enhanced Raman scattering. The metal structure supplies enhancement while the molecule supplies vibration-related Raman lines. The slide distinguishes electromagnetic enhancement from an intensified near field and chemical enhancement involving molecule–surface interactions. Molecules must be suitably close to the enhancing structure; the entire sample does not receive one uniform enhancement factor.

中文SERS为surface-enhanced Raman scattering（表面增强拉曼散射）。金属结构提供增强，分子提供与振动有关的拉曼谱线。课件区分局域场增强造成的electromagnetic enhancement（电磁增强），以及涉及分子—表面相互作用的chemical enhancement（化学增强）。分子要足够接近增强结构，不能认为整个样品都具有相同增强倍数。

ENFor chemical identification, compare the pattern of Raman-shift positions and intensities: this is a molecular fingerprint. The illustrated applications use spectral patterns and analysis to distinguish sample groups. A larger SERS peak alone is not a unique identifier, and the very large enhancement factors shown are examples, not a guaranteed value for every substrate. LSPR-based index sensing follows a metal resonance feature; SERS follows enhanced molecular vibration lines.

中文化学识别时，要比较拉曼位移位置与强度组成的模式，这叫molecular fingerprint（分子指纹）。图示应用用光谱模式和分析区分样品群体。单一SERS峰更大，不等于唯一识别目标；课件展示的巨大增强倍数属于示例，不保证每个基底都达到。基于LSPR的折射率传感跟踪金属共振特征，SERS跟踪增强后的分子振动谱线。

Source / 来源：Week 3 PDF p88–94; T3-0116 (announces continuation next week)

Week 4 learning block: Microscopes and optical imaging / 第4学习组：显微镜与光学成像

Week 4 concept map / 第4周知识框架

ENChapter logic: Follow light from image formation and contrast to depth selection, detection and spectral information.

中文本章主线：沿着光的流程，理解成像与对比如何产生，再看怎样选深度、检测光和获取光谱信息。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Imaging modalities 成像模态 Identify the input energy and detected signal; projection X-ray and reconstructed CT slices differ. 先辨输入能量与检测信号，区分投影X射线与重建CT切片。 Details / 详解
NA, resolution and sampling NA、分辨率与采样 d≈0.61λ/NA: larger NA or shorter λ improves lateral separation; pixels must sample the magnified detail. d≈0.61λ/NA：大NA或短λ改善横向间距；像素须充分采样放大后的细节。 Details / 详解
Optical contrast 光学对比 Brightfield, darkfield, phase contrast and fluorescence use different sources of image contrast. 明场、暗场、相衬与荧光使用不同对比来源。 Details / 详解
Confocal versus two-photon 共聚焦与双光子 Confocal rejects light at detection; two-photon localizes excitation (F∝I² before saturation). 共聚焦在检测端拒光；双光子限制激发位置（未饱和时F∝I²）。 Details / 详解
OCT mechanism OCT机制 Sample return + reference light → interference → depth-reflectivity information. 样品返回光+参考光→干涉→深度反射信息。 Details / 详解
Three depth concepts 三种深度概念 OCT axial separation follows source bandwidth; lateral detail follows focusing; focused range is another quantity. OCT轴向间距由光源带宽控制，横向细节依赖聚焦，可聚焦范围是另一量。 Details / 详解
Optical detectors 光探测器 Photodiode/PMT convert light to current; CCD shifts charge, while CMOS uses pixel-associated circuits. 光电二极管/PMT把光转电流；CCD移电荷，CMOS用像素相关电路。 Details / 详解
Hyperspectral cube 高光谱立方 Each position has a spectrum: axes are x,y,λ; scan method determines what is acquired per step. 每个位置有光谱，坐标是x,y,λ；扫描方式决定一步记录什么。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX401 Thin lens and magnification, FX402 Objective numerical aperture, FX403 Rayleigh separation and Airy radius/diameter, FX404 Detector sampling and magnification, FX405 Two-photon intensity law, FX406 Michelson path, phase and intensity, FX407 OCT coherence-limited axial resolution, FX408 Object-side depth of field with detector term, FX409 Hyperspectral cube data counts.

中文本章公式定位：FX401 薄透镜与放大率；FX402 物镜数值孔径；FX403 瑞利间距与艾里斑半径／直径；FX404 探测器采样与倍率；FX405 双光子强度关系；FX406 迈克尔逊光程、相位与强度；FX407 OCT相干长度限制的轴向分辨率；FX408 含探测器项的物方景深；FX409 高光谱立方的数据数目。

B13 · [P2] Imaging modality identification成像技术辨识

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Identify each modality’s input energy, detected signal and resolution–depth trade-off.学习抓手：认出各成像方式的输入能量、检测信号，以及分辨率与穿透深度的取舍。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0015–0021; Week 4 PDF p4–11

“There's no perfect image to all. Every image modality has its own strength depending on what your application is.”

该句为课堂技术取舍说明，不是Quiz题目承诺；不必背表中每个示例数值。

ENKey points
  • X-ray imaging measures transmission attenuation;
  • CT reconstructs many X-ray projections.
  • MRI uses magnetic fields and radiofrequency excitation;
  • PET means positron emission tomography and uses a radioactive tracer.
  • Ultrasound uses sound;
  • optical imaging uses light.
  • X-rays/CT and PET involve ionizing radiation.
  • Compare contrast mechanism, penetration and resolution rather than assuming one method is best for every task.
中文必会知识点
  • X-ray成像测透射衰减；
  • CT由多个X射线投影重建。
  • MRI磁共振使用磁场及射频激发；
  • PET为positron emission tomography正电子发射断层，使用放射性示踪剂。
  • Ultrasound超声用声，optical imaging光学成像用光。
  • X射线/CT和PET涉及电离辐射。
  • 比较对比机制、穿透与分辨率，不能认定某技术对所有任务都最好。

ENStart from zero: Imaging means making a map of where signals come from. Contrast means that two regions give distinguishable signals, so one can be seen against the other. Different imaging methods use different physical signals. A bright region can therefore mean different things in different images. Before comparing pictures, ask what energy is sent in, what is detected, and what tissue property changes that signal.

中文从零理解：Imaging（成像）就是把信号来自哪里画成图。Contrast（对比）表示两个区域的信号可以区分，才能看出彼此。不同技术使用不同物理信号，所以不同图像中的“亮”可能表示不同含义。比较图像之前，先问：送入什么能量？检测什么信号？组织的哪种性质改变了信号？

ENFollow the mechanism: X-ray imaging measures photons passing through tissue; CT combines many viewing angles to reconstruct slices. MRI uses a strong magnetic field: certain atomic nuclei act like tiny magnets. A radiofrequency (RF) pulse, an oscillating electromagnetic field, disturbs their magnetic state; their subsequent response provides a signal whose relaxation depends on tissue. PET uses a radioactive tracer that releases positrons, particles like electrons but positively charged. A positron meeting an electron produces two gamma photons; detecting pairs helps locate the tracer. Ultrasound uses returning sound; optical imaging uses light. NIH/NIBIB: MRI, NIH/NIBIB: PET.
