中文跟着机制走：X-ray（X射线）成像检测穿过组织的光子；CT合并多个观察角度的信息，重建切片。MRI使用强磁场：某些原子核像微小磁体。Radiofrequency（RF，射频）脉冲是一种振荡电磁场，会扰动它们的磁状态；之后的响应形成信号，其弛豫与组织有关。PET使用放射性示踪剂，释放positron（正电子），即类似电子但带正电的粒子。正电子与电子相遇会产生两个伽马光子；检测成对光子有助于定位示踪剂。超声使用返回的声波；光学成像使用光。NIH/NIBIB：MRI、NIH/NIBIB：PET。

ENTry an example: Ionizing radiation has enough energy to remove electrons from atoms. X-rays, CT, and PET involve ionizing radiation; ordinary diagnostic ultrasound and MRI use different, nonionizing mechanisms. This classification does not mean every nonionizing method is automatically suitable in every circumstance. In English questions, match projection and attenuation to X-rays, magnetic field and RF to MRI, radioactive tracer to PET, and echo to ultrasound. Judge resolution, depth, and contrast separately.

中文用例子理解：Ionizing radiation（电离辐射）有足够能量把电子从原子中移走。X射线、CT和PET涉及电离辐射；常规诊断超声与MRI采用其他非电离机制。这种分类不表示任何非电离技术都自动适用于任何情况。英文辨认：projection与attenuation对应X射线；magnetic field与RF对应MRI；radioactive tracer对应PET；echo对应超声。分辨率、成像深度及对比机制应分别比较。

Source / 来源：W4 p3–12; W5 p53–58; W5 p64–69 | T4-0015–0021, T5-0073–0080, T5-0088–0095

B14 · [P1] Optical biopsy, endoscopy and virtual staining / 光学活检、内窥镜与虚拟染色

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain optical biopsy and distinguish virtual staining from physically adding dye.学习抓手：能解释光学活检，并区分虚拟染色与真正添加染料。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T4-0024; Week 4 PDF p18–20

“So Optical biopsy is quite important because it's non invasive.”

“很重要”针对光学活检的流程和价值；研究案例不代表所有情况下免取样确诊。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: T4-0085–0087; Week 4 PDF p65–70

内窥镜／光纤探头是应用背景，先识别用途，不背仪器品牌和具体器官照片。

ENKey points
  • Optical biopsy seeks tissue information through optical imaging, reducing tissue removal in the taught examples.
  • Endoscopy brings illumination and detection to internal sites, often with fibre delivery.
  • Virtual staining computationally makes an image resemble a stained tissue image;
  • it does not physically add a dye.
  • Recognize the workflow without assuming every optical method replaces histopathology.
中文必会知识点
  • Optical biopsy光学活检通过光学成像获取组织信息，在课程示例中减少取组织操作。
  • Endoscopy内窥镜把照明与检测带到体内，常用光纤传输。
  • Virtual staining虚拟染色用计算产生类似染色组织的图像，并未实际添加染料。
  • 要认得流程，不应推断所有光学方法都能替代组织病理。

ENStart from zero: A conventional tissue biopsy removes a sample for examination. Optical biopsy tries to obtain useful tissue information through optical measurements, sometimes reducing the need to remove tissue in the taught applications. The word biopsy here describes the diagnostic purpose, not a requirement that light cuts tissue out. Different optical methods reveal different information, so an optical image does not automatically provide every answer that laboratory pathology provides.

中文从零理解：常规tissue biopsy（组织活检）是取出样品进行检查。Optical biopsy（光学活检）尝试通过光学测量取得组织信息，在课程应用中有时可减少取组织操作。这里的biopsy强调检查目的，不表示光必须把组织切出来。不同光学方法显示不同信息，因此光学图像不会自动提供实验室病理检查的全部答案。

ENFollow the mechanism: Endoscopy brings illumination and observation to an internal location using an instrument. Fibres can deliver light or return information through a narrow path, somewhat like extending the instrument's reach. Conventional staining physically adds dyes to make structures easier to distinguish. Virtual staining instead uses computation to produce a staining-like image from measured input. The tissue is not physically dyed by the computer.

中文跟着机制走：Endoscopy（内窥镜检查）用仪器把照明与观察带到体内。光纤可沿狭窄路径输送光或返回信息，好比延长仪器的观察范围。常规staining（染色）实际加入染料，让结构更容易区分；virtual staining（虚拟染色）则根据测得的输入，用计算生成类似染色效果的图像，电脑并没有实际给组织加染料。

ENTry an example: Imagine a grayscale tissue image converted into a colored image resembling a familiar stain. This can help interpretation, but its colors are calculated from the input and model; they are not directly measured dye signals. Exam clues are internal access for endoscopy, optical tissue assessment for optical biopsy, and computational transformation for virtual staining. Distinguish image acquisition from display and interpretation.

中文用例子理解：想象一张灰度组织图被转换成类似熟悉染色效果的彩色图：这可能方便阅读，但颜色来自输入和模型的计算，不是新测得的染料信号。英文辨认：internal access提示内窥镜；optical tissue assessment提示光学活检；computational transformation提示虚拟染色。要区分图像如何acquired（采集），与它如何displayed（显示）或interpreted（解释）。

Source / 来源：W4 p13–20; W4 p65–70; W4 p106–112 | T4-0022–0025, T4-0085–0087, T4-0115–0120

C13 · [P1] Numerical aperture and microscope resolution / 数值孔径与显微分辨率

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Teacher emphasis课堂强调Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Compare objectives by NA at fixed wavelength; use d≈0.61λ/NA and separate magnification from resolution.学习抓手：同波长比较物镜看NA；会用d≈0.61λ/NA，并分清倍率与分辨率。

Explicit Quiz statement老师明确提到Quiz: T5-0059–0063; Week 4 PDF p27–30

“So you'll see these two questions again on your quiz.”

两题中的第一题为物镜比较；相同波长条件下最大NA对应最小可分辨间距。第二题光栅密度见C08。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T4-0034–0038; Week 4 PDF p29–34

反复强调高分辨能力对应较小d，倍率增加不自动提升分辨能力。

Explicit final-exam statement老师明确提到期末: T4-0030; Week 4 PDF p27–30

“So I can definitely tell you, this will be on the final exam.”

这句单独指期末；本Quiz的依据另见T5，不把两种声明混为一个。

ENKey points
  • Numerical aperture is NA=n sinθ.
  • At a fixed wavelength, the diffraction-limited lateral separation scales as d≈0.61λ/NA.
  • Larger NA or shorter wavelength gives a smaller resolvable separation.
  • Magnification alone does not guarantee improved resolving ability.
中文必会知识点
  • 数值孔径NA=n sinθ。
  • 波长固定时，衍射极限横向最小间距约d≈0.61λ/NA。
  • NA更大或波长更短，使可分辨间距更小。
  • 只有放大倍率增加，并不保证分辨能力提高。

ENStart from zero: Resolution means telling two nearby objects apart. Magnification means making their image larger. Imagine enlarging a blurry phone photograph: the blur becomes bigger, but hidden detail does not appear. A microscope therefore needs both suitable magnification and good resolving ability. In this chapter, lateral resolution concerns separation across the image, rather than separation along its depth.

中文从零理解：Resolution（分辨率）是把两个靠近的物体区分开的能力；magnification（放大倍率）是把图像变大的程度。想象放大一张模糊的手机照片：模糊区域更大了，但原本看不清的细节不会凭空出现。因此显微镜既需要合适倍率，也需要好的分辨能力。本章的lateral resolution（横向分辨率）指图像平面内的区分能力，而不是沿深度方向。

ENFollow the mechanism: An objective lens collects a cone of light. Numerical aperture, NA=n sinθ, describes this collection ability: n is the surrounding medium's refractive index, and θ is the cone's half-angle. Collecting a wider cone helps capture fine detail. Because light spreads through diffraction, even a tiny point makes a small blurred spot. Larger NA makes that spot smaller at the same wavelength.

中文跟着机制走：物镜收集的是一束锥形范围内的光。Numerical aperture（数值孔径）NA=n sinθ描述收光能力：n是物镜前介质的折射率，θ是光锥的半角。收集角度更大，有助于保留细小信息。由于diffraction（衍射），光会扩散，因此极小的点也会形成一小团模糊光斑；波长相同时，NA更大会使这个光斑更小。

ENTry an example: For the course's Rayleigh criterion, minimum separation d≈0.61λ/NA. With λ=500 nm and NA=0.5, d≈610 nm; raising NA to 1.0 gives about 305 nm. The smaller distance means better resolution. In English questions, higher resolving ability and smaller resolvable separation point to the same improvement. Compare NA while holding wavelength and the criterion fixed; choosing the largest magnification alone is insufficient.

中文用例子理解：按本课程的Rayleigh criterion（瑞利判据），最小可分辨间距d≈0.61λ/NA。λ=500 nm、NA=0.5时，d约610 nm；NA提高到1.0时，d约305 nm。这个距离越小，分辨能力越好。英文题中的higher resolving ability（更强分辨能力）与smaller resolvable separation（更小可分辨间距）表示同一种改善。比较NA时应固定波长和判据；仅选放大倍率最大的物镜不够。

ENExam wording: The objective-lens comparison is explicitly named again for the Quiz in Week 5. If NA doubles with the same wavelength and criterion, d halves. “Higher resolution” means a smaller minimum distinguishable distance.

中文英文读题抓手：Week5明确说Quiz会再问物镜比较。波长与判据相同、NA加倍时，d减半。“Higher resolution”表示最小可分辨距离更小。

Source / 来源：W4 p27–30; W4 p29–34; W4 p29–30 | T4-0030–0038, T5-0059–0061

ENRead the figure: Find the dotted optical axis and angle α: α is the half-angle of the light cone, not its full opening angle. In NA = n sin α, n is the refractive index between specimen and objective. A larger NA collects a wider cone and gives a smaller diffraction-limited separation d at the same wavelength; magnification is a separate property.

中文读图：找虚线光轴与α：α是收光锥的半角，不是整个张角。NA = n sin α中的n是样品与物镜之间介质的折射率。同一波长下，更大NA收集更宽的光锥，使衍射限制的最小可分辨距离d更小；放大倍率是另一项性质。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p31; original slide figure / 原课件截图

ENRead the figure: Keep wavelength at 550 nm and magnification at 20×. Using d ≈ 0.61λ/NA gives about 0.839 μm for NA 0.4 and 0.419 μm for NA 0.8. A 0.60 μm separation exceeds the second threshold but not the first. The drawn spots illustrate the distinction; they are not calculated point-spread functions.

中文读图：固定波长550 nm、放大倍率20×。按d ≈ 0.61λ/NA，NA为0.4时约0.839 μm，为0.8时约0.419 μm。间隔0.60 μm超过第二个分辨阈值，却未超过第一个。图中点像只用于示意，没有用真实Point-spread function（点扩散函数）计算。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p27–34; original teaching schematic / 自绘教学示意，非实验数据

B15 · [P1] NA, Airy disk and detector samplingNA、艾里斑与探测器采样

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know NA=n sinθ, the cone half-angle, and Rayleigh separation versus Airy-disk diameter.学习抓手：会认NA=n sinθ的介质折射率与半角，并分清瑞利间距与艾里斑直径。

Explicit Quiz statement老师明确提到Quiz: T5-0059; T5-0060; Week 4 PDF p27–30

“magnification power doesn't change the resolution.”

T5-0059承诺两道课堂题会在Quiz再见；这句解释其中物镜比较题，相同波长条件下重点看NA。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0031–0038; Week 4 PDF p27–34

NA的n为样品与物镜之间的介质折射率，θ为半角；像素采样见S403。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T4-0028; Week 4 PDF p26

“It's not required if you know this or not.”

局部指薄透镜公式，不能据此把后续NA／分辨率一起排除。

ENKey points
  • In NA=n sinθ, θ is the collection cone half-angle;
  • immersion increases n.
  • Rayleigh separation ≈0.61λ/NA is different from Airy-disk diameter ≈1.22λ/NA.
  • Pixels must sample optical features sufficiently after magnification.
  • More pixels cannot restore detail absent from the optical image.
  • The thin-lens relation 1/f=1/u+1/v uses the stated lens sign convention.
中文必会知识点
  • NA=n sinθ中，θ为收集锥半角；
  • 浸液可提高n。
  • Rayleigh最小分辨间距约0.61λ/NA，与Airy-disk艾里斑直径约1.22λ/NA不同。
  • 放大后的光学细节需要充分像素采样；
  • 增加像素无法恢复光学成像中本来缺失的细节。
  • 薄透镜式1/f=1/u+1/v需配合题目规定的符号约定。

ENStart from zero: Even a point source makes a small diffraction pattern through a circular lens opening. Its central bright region is called the Airy disk. The disk diameter describes the size of one point's pattern; the Rayleigh separation describes how far apart two points must be to distinguish them under that criterion. They answer different questions, so their numerical factors must not be exchanged.

中文从零理解：点光源经过圆形透镜孔径，也会形成一个小衍射图样，其中中央亮区叫Airy disk（艾里斑）。光斑直径描述“一个点的图样有多大”；Rayleigh separation（瑞利分辨间距）描述按该判据“两个点至少相隔多远才能分开”。两者回答不同问题，因此公式中的数字系数不能互换。

ENFollow the mechanism: NA depends on the collection angle and medium: a suitable immersion liquid can increase the refractive index n. The optics first form an image, then detector pixels sample it at discrete positions. Imagine recording a melody with too few time samples: information can be missed. Spatial undersampling similarly misses image detail. More detector pixels help only if useful optical detail reaches them; they cannot undo optical blur.

中文跟着机制走：NA取决于收光角度及介质；合适浸液可提高折射率n。先由光学系统形成图像，再由探测器像素在离散位置采样。可以类比录音乐时采样点过少会漏掉信息；空间采样不足也会遗漏图像细节。更多像素只有在有用光学细节到达探测器时才有帮助，无法消除光学系统已经造成的模糊。

ENTry an example: Remember the approximate factors: Rayleigh separation 0.61λ/NA, Airy diameter 1.22λ/NA. Magnification changes detector image size and affects sampling. In 1/f=1/u+1/v, f is focal length, u object distance, and v image distance. Use the stated sign convention; for positive distances of a real object and real image, u=v=20 cm gives f=10 cm. This lens example concerns image formation, not diffraction resolution.

中文用例子理解：记住近似系数：瑞利间距为0.61λ/NA，艾里斑直径为1.22λ/NA。倍率改变呈现在探测器上的图像尺寸，因此影响采样。薄透镜式1/f=1/u+1/v中，f是焦距、u是物距、v是像距；要遵循题目规定的符号约定。若实物和实像的距离均取正值，u=v=20 cm，则f=10 cm。这个透镜例子讨论成像位置，不是在计算衍射分辨率。

Source / 来源：W4 p21–26; W4 p27–30; W4 p29–34; W4 p31–34 | T4-0026–0038, T4-0045–0047

S401 · [P2] Image formation, refraction and reflection / 成像、折射与反射

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Supporting concept辅助理解Sample Q8样卷Q8Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know n changes speed/wavelength, not frequency; distinguish reflection, refraction and absorption.学习抓手：知道n改变光速／波长而频率不变，分清反射、折射与吸收。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: T4-0026–0029; Week 4 PDF p16, 21–26, 92–94

用来理解透镜、OCT和界面选项；不把所有光学反射式变为本Quiz必考。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p2 Q8 C; Week 4 PDF p75–86

速度与折射率有关，但不是Q8所问层亮度的直接主要来源。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T4-0028; Week 4 PDF p26

“It's not required if you know this or not.”

只降低薄透镜求像距这一处的优先级，基础词义仍保留。

ENAn imaging system needs an optical element to collect or focus light, a detector to convert the light pattern into a signal, and processing to form or display an image. A lens bends rays by refraction. Focal length is the lens-to-focus distance for parallel incoming rays; it is not the distance between two objects that can be resolved. For a thin lens with real object and image distances taken as positive, the magnification magnitude is |M|=v/u.

中文成像系统需要收集或聚焦光的光学部件、把光分布转成信号的探测器，以及形成或显示图像的处理环节。透镜通过refraction（折射）改变光线方向。Focal length（焦距）是平行入射光聚焦时透镜到焦点的距离，不是两个物体的最小可分辨间距。薄透镜实物、实像距离均取正时，放大倍率大小|M|=v/u。

ENIn a medium of refractive index n, light speed is c/n and wavelength is λ₀/n; its frequency stays the same across a stationary interface. Reflection returns light to the original medium; refraction changes its direction in the new medium. Specular reflection gives a mirror-like direction, whereas diffuse reflection spreads light into many directions. Absorption removes energy from the light; light that is not reflected is not necessarily all absorbed, because transmission and scattering are also possible. Polarimetry measures optical polarization, the direction/state of electric-field oscillation explained in S104; spectroscopy instead measures wavelength-dependent signals. Optical polarization differs from electrode polarization in electrochemistry.

中文折射率为n的介质中，光速为c/n、波长为λ₀/n；光经过静止界面时频率不变。Reflection（反射）使光回到原介质；refraction使光进入另一介质后改变方向。Specular reflection（镜面反射）方向集中，diffuse reflection（漫反射）向许多方向分散。Absorption（吸收）把能量从光中取走；未被反射的光不一定全部被吸收，也可能透射或散射。 Polarimetry（偏振测量）测光的偏振，即S104解释的电场振动方向/状态；spectroscopy（光谱学）测随波长变化的信号。光的偏振不同于电化学电极polarization（极化）。

ENFor a simple, nonabsorbing interface at normal incidence, intensity reflectance is R=[(n₂−n₁)/(n₂+n₁)]². It is the refractive-index mismatch that matters under this model. Do not turn the slide’s glass-versus-water example into a universal rule that any material with a larger n must always reflect more at every angle.

中文简单非吸收界面、垂直入射时，强度反射率R=[(n₂−n₁)/(n₂+n₁)]²。在这个模型中关键是折射率失配。不能把课件玻璃与水的例子推广为“任何折射率更大的材料，在任何角度都一定反射更多”。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p16, p21–26, 92–94; T4-0026–0029

S403 · [P2] Match detector pixels to optical detail / 让探测器像素匹配光学细节

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Convert detector pitch to object-space pitch Δx/M; sampling cannot restore missing optical detail.学习抓手：会把像素间距换到物面Δx/M；采样不能恢复光学上已丢失的细节。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0045–0047; Week 4 PDF p32–34

“Resolution is still defined by this Delta D value.”

三像素是课堂建议，课件实践范围约2.3–3；不能理解为增加倍率就使光学d变小。

ENIf the detector pixel pitch is Δx and magnification is M, its object-space sampling pitch is Δx/M. The course recommends about 2.3–3 detector pixels across the magnified Rayleigh separation: M d/Δx≈2.3–3. Thus the same camera can under-sample at low magnification even when the objective itself resolves the detail.

中文探测器像素间距为Δx、倍率为M时，折算到物体上的采样间距是Δx/M。课程建议放大后的瑞利间距内约有2.3–3个像素，即M d/Δx≈2.3–3。因此，同一相机在低倍率下可能采样不足，即使物镜本身能够分辨该细节。

ENFor example, d=0.5 μm, M=20 and detector pitch Δx=5 μm give M d/Δx=2: only two pixels span that separation. At M=30, the ratio becomes 3. This improves recording of existing optical detail; it does not make d smaller. Distinguish detector pixel size, object-space pixel size, magnification and optical resolution.

中文例如d=0.5 μm、M=20、探测器间距Δx=5 μm时，M d/Δx=2，只有两个像素覆盖这个间距。M=30时比例变为3。这改善了已有光学细节的记录，并没有使d变小。要分清探测器像素尺寸、折算到物体的像素尺寸、倍率与光学分辨率。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p32–34; T4-0045–0047

C14 · [P1] Confocal and two-photon microscopy共聚焦与双光子显微镜

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q1样卷Q1Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Compare confocal pinhole rejection with focal two-photon excitation; each photon has lower energy.学习抓手：分清共聚焦靠针孔挡离焦光，双光子靠焦点局域激发；每个光子能量更低。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p1 Q1 D; Week 4 PDF p47–61; T7-0051

Q1 D错误涉及两个较低能量光子及“对比改善≠保证更高衍射分辨率”；不是只背D字母。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0062–0069; Week 4 PDF p47–61

课堂连续比较宽场、共聚焦及双光子切片机制。高峰值脉冲与漂白取舍见S407，先掌握基本区别。

ENKey points
  • A confocal pinhole suppresses out-of-focus light and enables optical sectioning.
  • Two-photon excitation is nonlinear and largely confined to the focus;
  • two longer-wavelength photons together supply the excitation energy.
  • These mechanisms improve contrast and sectioning in different ways.
中文必会知识点
  • 共聚焦pinhole抑制离焦光，实现光学切片。
  • 双光子激发具有非线性，主要限制在焦点；
  • 两个长波长光子共同提供激发能量。
  • 两种机制以不同方式改善对比度与切片能力。

ENStart from zero: When viewing thick tissue, light from above and below the chosen focus can cover the wanted detail with background. Optical sectioning means selecting a thin depth layer without physically cutting the tissue. Think of trying to read one transparent page while other pages overlap it. Confocal and two-photon microscopes solve this depth problem through different parts of the imaging process.

中文从零理解：观察较厚组织时，焦点上方和下方的光会成为背景，盖住想看的细节。Optical sectioning（光学切片）就是不实际切开组织，却选择某一薄层深度来成像。可以想象几张透明纸叠在一起，你只想看清其中一张。Confocal（共聚焦）和two-photon（双光子）显微镜在成像流程的不同环节解决这个深度问题。

ENFollow the mechanism: Confocal microscopy illuminates a focused spot and places a small pinhole before the detector. Properly focused return light passes through; much out-of-focus light is blocked. Scanning builds an image. Two-photon microscopy instead needs two photons to supply excitation energy together. This event becomes much more likely where light is most concentrated, so fluorescence is mainly generated near the focus rather than throughout the illuminated path.

中文跟着机制走：共聚焦用聚焦光点照明，并在探测器前放置很小的pinhole（针孔）。来自正确焦点的返回光可以通过，许多离焦光被挡住；逐点扫描后得到图像。双光子则需要两个光子共同提供激发能量；光越集中，这种事件越容易发生，所以荧光主要在焦点附近产生，而不是沿整个照明路径都大量产生。

ENTry an example: The exam distinction is detection-side rejection versus excitation-side localization. A pinhole is the signature of confocal imaging; nonlinear, localized excitation is the signature of two-photon imaging. Under the simple unsaturated model, two-photon fluorescence is proportional to I², where I is light intensity: doubling I gives four times the signal. Longer excitation wavelengths can help tissue penetration, but do not automatically improve diffraction-limited spatial resolution.

中文用例子理解：考试要区分：共聚焦是在检测端排除不想要的光，双光子是在激发端限制发光位置。看到pinhole应想到共聚焦；看到nonlinear（非线性）和localized excitation（局域激发）应想到双光子。在简单、未饱和模型下，双光子荧光与I²成正比，I是光强：光强加倍，信号变为四倍。更长激发波长可能有利于组织穿透，但不会自动提高衍射极限空间分辨率。

ENExam wording: Do not call a pinhole the cause of two-photon excitation. The usual two-photon wavelength advantage concerns penetration and localized excitation; it does not erase the dependence of diffraction resolution on wavelength and NA.

中文英文读题抓手：不要把pinhole说成双光子激发的原因。双光子的常见优势是穿透与局域激发，并不取消衍射分辨率对波长和NA的依赖。

Source / 来源：W4 p47–61; Sample quiz p1 Q1–3; W2 p73–78; W3 p39–50; W4 p54–61 | T4-0062–0069, T7-0051–0053

ENRead the figure: Trace illumination from Point Source to Sample, then the returning light toward Pinhole and Detector. Light from the selected focal plane passes the pinhole; light from another plane is rejected. This suppresses background rather than physically cutting the tissue. A point measurement must be scanned to form an image, and changing focus gives different depth slices.

中文读图：从Point Source光源跟到Sample样品，再看返回光走向Pinhole针孔和Detector探测器。选定焦平面的光通过针孔，其他平面的光被挡掉。它抑制背景，并没有真的切开组织。一次测一点，需要扫描形成图像；改变焦点位置可得到不同深度的切片。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p51; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S402 · [P2] Brightfield, darkfield, phase contrast and PSF / 明场、暗场、相衬与点扩散函数

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Sample Q1样卷Q1
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Identify brightfield, darkfield and phase contrast by the light collected; understand PSF and display colours.学习抓手：按收集的光辨认明场、暗场与相衬；理解PSF及伪彩色。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0056–0065; Week 4 PDF p40–46, 51–53

主要是模式与荧光通道的课堂讲解；照片中的细胞名和研究作者不必逐个背。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p1 Q1 A; Week 4 PDF p42–46

多通道信号能表现亮度／颜色变化；此处提供背景，荧光阵列重点解释见S110。

ENBrightfield microscopy mainly uses transmitted light: absorbing or scattering structures appear darker against a bright background. Darkfield excludes the direct illumination beam and collects scattered light, so scattering objects can look bright on a dark background. Phase contrast turns phase delays caused by optical-path differences into intensity differences, helping reveal transparent cells without relying on fluorescent labels.

中文Brightfield microscopy（明场显微）主要看透射光：吸收或散射结构在亮背景上较暗。Darkfield（暗场）挡掉直达照明光，收集散射光，因此散射物可在暗背景上发亮。Phase contrast（相衬）把光程差造成的相位延迟转成亮度差，帮助观察透明细胞，并不依赖荧光标记。

ENFluorescence contrast instead comes from emitted light after excitation. Different labels and detection channels can highlight different structures and show co-localization, meaning that signals appear at the same spatial location. Display colors may be assigned by the software: a red, green or blue region in a pseudo-colored image need not be the sample’s natural color. A suitable fluorescent probe can report a molecule’s presence or ion binding. The slide also lists diffusion coefficient, a quantity describing how rapidly molecules spread by random motion; it is not intensity or color itself and needs an appropriate fluorescence measurement/model.

中文荧光对比来自激发后的发射光。不同标记和检测通道可突出不同结构，也可显示co-localization（共定位），即不同信号出现在同一空间位置。显示颜色可由软件指定：pseudo-colored（伪彩色）图中的红、绿、蓝不一定是样品的天然颜色。 合适荧光探针可报告分子是否存在或是否结合离子。课件还列出diffusion coefficient（扩散系数），描述分子随机运动扩散的快慢；它本身不是光强或颜色，需用相应荧光测量与模型推断。

ENThe point spread function, PSF, is the image produced by an ideal tiny point source. It describes how the imaging system spreads that point into a spot, sideways and along depth. A sharper-looking image and stronger contrast do not by themselves prove a smaller PSF or better diffraction resolution. In confocal imaging, the pinhole suppresses out-of-focus contributions; stacking optical sections gives a 3D data set.

中文Point spread function（PSF，点扩散函数）是理想极小点光源经系统形成的图像，描述一个点在横向和深度方向被扩散成多大的光斑。看起来更锐利、对比更强，不自动证明PSF更小或衍射分辨率更好。共聚焦针孔抑制离焦贡献；把不同深度的光学切片叠起来，可得到三维数据。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p40–46, 51–53; T4-0056–0065

ENClarify the concept: In the axial-response plot, scan the reflector through focus along z: a narrower I(z) response means a thinner selected optical layer. The smaller pinhole curves are narrower in the shown comparison. Closing the pinhole also rejects useful light, so it is not a free improvement without a signal trade-off. Compare curve width for section thickness; the plot’s similar peak heights do not establish identical collected photon counts.

中文把概念讲清：轴向响应图让反射面沿z经过焦点：I(z)响应越窄，选出的光学层越薄。图示比较中，小针孔曲线更窄；缩小针孔也挡掉有用光，因此不是没有信号代价的改善。用曲线宽度判断切片厚度，不要因图中峰值看起来接近就认为收集光子数相同。

Source / 来源：README §4.3 Confocal; Week 4 PDF p53 diagram, re-rendered peer_original_formula_contact.png; T4-0062–0065

ENRead the figure: Compare the image backgrounds and the slide labels. Ask whether contrast comes from transmitted intensity, scattered light or converted phase differences.

中文读图：对照图像背景与原图标签，问对比来自透射强度、散射光，还是相位差转亮度差。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p40; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S407 · [P2] Two-photon requirements and practical advantages / 双光子激发条件与实际优势

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Sample Q1样卷Q1
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain focal high peak intensity and reduced out-of-focus damage; advantages do not guarantee zero damage.学习抓手：理解焦点高峰值光强与焦外损伤减少；优势不等于零损伤。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0066–0069; Week 4 PDF p56–61

两个低能光子、较长波长与局域激发在课堂重复讲；插入视频旁白不能当老师考试承诺。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p1 Q1 D; Week 4 PDF p56–61

样卷核心是“每个光子能量更低”，先看C14；本节补为什么需要聚焦／脉冲，以及漂白与热损伤边界。

ENTwo-photon absorption is rare unless photons are concentrated strongly in space and time. A tightly focused pulsed laser supplies high peak intensity, so simultaneous two-photon excitation is much more likely near the focus. Because the excitation itself selects that small volume, a confocal detection pinhole is not required by this principle. This differs from illuminating a larger volume and then rejecting unwanted light at the detector.

中文双光子吸收只有在光子于空间和时间上高度集中时才较容易发生。紧密聚焦的pulsed laser（脉冲激光）提供高峰值光强，使两个光子联合激发主要出现在焦点附近。因为激发本身已选择这一小体积，该原理不需要共聚焦那种检测针孔；这不同于先照亮更大体积，再在探测器前挡掉不需要的光。

ENLonger-wavelength excitation and localized fluorescence generation support deeper imaging in scattering tissue and reduce out-of-focus photobleaching and photodamage. Emitted photons scattered on their way out can still be collected because excitation was localized. These are advantages in contrast, collection and penetration, not a promise of zero damage or universally higher diffraction resolution: bright infrared excitation can still heat tissue, and wavelength and NA still matter.

中文更长波长激发及局域产生荧光，有助于较深散射组织成像，也减少焦外photobleaching（光漂白）和photodamage（光损伤）。因为激发位置局域，发射光在返回途中被散射后仍可被收集。这些是对比、收光和穿透方面的优势，不保证零损伤或普遍更高衍射分辨率：强红外激发仍可造成组织加热，波长与NA仍然重要。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p56–61; T4-0066–0081

ENRead the figure: Compare the upward arrows: one blue excitation photon or two lower-energy red photons jointly excite the fluorophore; green arrows represent emission. On the lower wavelength axis, right means longer wavelength. The two-photon excitation wavelength can exceed the emission wavelength because two photons supply the energy together. Do not apply the usual single-photon Stokes ordering to each individual two-photon excitation photon.

中文读图：比较向上的箭头：一个蓝色激发光子，或两个能量较低的红色光子共同激发荧光体；绿色向下箭头表示发射。下方波长轴向右是波长更长。双光子激发波长可以长于发射波长，因为能量由两个光子共同提供；不能把通常的单光子Stokes顺序直接套到每个双光子激发光子上。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p55; original slide figure / 原课件截图

C15 · [P1] OCT: low-coherence interference and reflectivity / OCT：低相干干涉与反射率

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q8样卷Q8Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: OCT uses sample/reference interference to recover depth; layer intensity mainly reflects returned light.学习抓手：OCT用样品／参考光干涉定位深度；层亮度主要来自返回光的反射／后向散射。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p2 Q8 A–D; T7-0055–0056; Week 4 PDF p71–86

“Remember that OCT is a reflection signal.”

题目主要对比答案为反射率；不能把TIR、光速差或吸收替代主机制。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0088–0098; T4-0105–0106; Week 4 PDF p71–86

重复讲两臂合束、反射与深度剖面；长干涉推导、OCT-A研究应用不随核心一并升级为必背。

ENKey points
  • Optical coherence tomography combines light returning from a sample with a reference beam.
  • Low-coherence interference localizes returning signals in depth.
  • Layer brightness represents back-reflection/back-scattering under the course description;
  • it is not simply a temperature or fluorescence map.
中文必会知识点
  • 光学相干断层成像把样品返回光与参考光合并。
  • 低相干干涉把返回信号定位到不同深度。
  • 按课程描述，层状亮度反映后向反射或散射，而不是简单的温度图或荧光图。

ENStart from zero: Optical coherence tomography, OCT, builds depth pictures from light returned by tissue. Different layers return different amounts of light, so the picture can show boundaries beneath the surface. Its common grayscale brightness represents the detected return signal, not simply temperature or fluorescence. The practical difficulty is that light travels too quickly for ordinary electronics to time these tiny travel differences directly.

中文从零理解：Optical coherence tomography（OCT，光学相干断层成像）用组织返回的光构建深度图像。不同层返回的光量不同，因此能显示表面下面的层界；常见灰度图的亮度对应检测到的返回信号，不直接等于温度或荧光。实际困难是光传播太快，普通电子设备不能直接计时这些极小的传播时间差。

ENFollow the mechanism: OCT splits light into a sample arm and a reference arm, then recombines their returning beams. Interference means overlapping light waves reinforce or weaken each other according to their relative phase. With a broad-band, low-coherence source, useful interference is linked to closely matched optical paths. The reference supplies a comparison for identifying return depth; in modern systems this information can also be recovered from a measured interference spectrum.

中文跟着机制走：OCT先把光分到sample arm（样品臂）和reference arm（参考臂），再把返回的两束光合并。Interference（干涉）是光波叠加时按相对相位互相增强或减弱。使用宽带、低相干光源时，有效干涉与光程接近匹配有关。参考臂提供定位返回深度的比较基准；现代系统也可以从测得的干涉光谱中恢复深度信息。

ENTry an example: A useful analogy is comparing an unknown path with a known ruler: the reference is essential, but OCT uses wave interference rather than a physical ruler. In a diagram, look for beam splitting, two arms, and recombination. In a question about OCT contrast, choose back-reflection or back-scattering. Avoid calling OCT ordinary electronic time-of-flight measurement, ultrasound echoes, or a fluorescent-label measurement.

中文用例子理解：可以类比用已知尺子比较未知距离：参考基准很重要，但OCT实际用的是光波干涉，而不是实体尺子。图中应寻找分光、两个光臂以及返回光合并。题目问OCT的成像对比时，选back-reflection（后向反射）或back-scattering（后向散射）。不要把它理解为普通电子计时的飞行时间测量、超声回波或荧光标记测量。

ENExam wording: Identify the reference arm, sample arm and interference signal. The long Michelson intensity derivation is lower priority because of the global short-calculation guidance; there is no separate explicit oral exclusion of all OCT equations.

中文英文读题抓手：要识别reference arm、sample arm和interference signal。依据本次短计算的总要求，Michelson长强度推导降低优先级；没有单独找到“所有OCT公式均不考”的明确声明。

Source / 来源：W4 p71–79; W4 p85–90; Sample quiz p2 Q8–9; W4 p35–38, p73–86; W3 p25–32 | T4-0088–0098, T4-0105–0108, T7-0055–0057

ENRead the figure: Use the labelled arrows to match the anatomical layers on the left with bands in the OCT image on the right. Across the image is lateral position; top-to-bottom separates depths. These display colors encode the strength of returning/scattered light, not the tissue's natural color or a fluorescent stain. Layer separation depends on axial resolution; the figure does not supply a calibrated scale for measuring thickness.

中文读图：用标注箭头把左侧组织层与右侧OCT条带对应起来。横向是在组织表面不同位置，纵向把不同深度分开。显示颜色编码返回/散射光强，既不是组织天然颜色，也不是荧光染色。能否分开两层取决于轴向分辨率；本图没有可用于测厚度的标定尺度。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p86; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S405 · [P2] OCT interference, resolution and angiography / OCT干涉、分辨率与血管成像

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Sample Q8样卷Q8Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Read the two arms and bandwidth trend; the long interference derivation and OCT-A are secondary.学习抓手：会读两臂及带宽趋势即可；长干涉推导与OCT-A放后面。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T4-0100–0104; Week 4 PDF p81–83

“This Delta and that is the bandwidth of your light.”

ASR“Delta and”对应Δλ；其含义是光源带宽。核心三参数先见B17，轴向短式可第二轮练习。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p2 Q8 A–D; Week 4 PDF p85–86

伪彩色和反射主机制相关；优先答案机制已在C15。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: T4-0089–0098; T4-0106–0108; Week 4 PDF p75–87

未发现老师排除整个OCT；这里只策略性降低长代数推导与血管成像扩展的优先级。

ENIn the slide’s single-wavelength Michelson example, moving one mirror by L changes the round-trip path by 2L, so the phase difference changes by 4πL/λ. The detected intensity contains a phase-dependent interference term; it is not merely the sum of two unrelated brightness readings. Constructive interference strengthens the signal and destructive interference weakens it. The long derivation is secondary; identify the splitter, sample arm, reference arm and recombination.

中文课件单波长Michelson示例中，一面镜子移动L，往返光程改变2L，因此相位差改变4πL/λ。检测强度含随相位变化的干涉项，不只是两次互不相关亮度读数相加。Constructive interference（相长干涉）增强信号，destructive interference（相消干涉）减弱信号。长推导次要，先辨认分光器、样品臂、参考臂与重新合束。

ENFor the course’s Gaussian-source approximation in air, λ₀ is the central wavelength and Δλ is the intensity spectrum’s FWHM (full width at half maximum); axial separation Δz≈(2 ln2/π)λ₀²/Δλ≈0.44λ₀²/Δλ. Use matching wavelength units: λ₀=800 nm and bandwidth Δλ=100 nm give about 2816 nm=2.8 μm. At fixed λ₀, doubling bandwidth halves Δz. This is a depth-resolution relation; changing NA mainly changes lateral focusing and the useful focus range. Physical depth in tissue additionally depends on refractive index.

中文这里λ₀是中心波长，Δλ为强度光谱的FWHM（半高全宽），不是任意波段两端之差。课程高斯光源近似下，空气中的轴向间距Δz≈(2 ln2/π)λ₀²/Δλ≈0.44λ₀²/Δλ。波长单位必须统一：λ₀=800 nm、带宽Δλ=100 nm时，约为2816 nm=2.8 μm。λ₀固定时，带宽加倍使Δz减半。这是深度方向分辨关系；改变NA主要改变横向聚焦及可用聚焦范围。组织中的实际深度还受折射率影响。

ENAn OCT cross-section commonly uses lateral position x and depth z. In the taught display, stronger returning signals receive brighter or red/white display colors, while weak returns receive dark colors. The color is a signal map, not the natural color of each eye layer. Refractive-index inhomogeneity creates reflection/backscatter contrast; absorption along the path can weaken returns but is not the primary answer to sample Q8.

中文OCT剖面常以横向位置x和深度z为坐标。课程显示中，较强返回信号用更亮或红/白色表示，弱返回用暗色。颜色是信号映射，不是眼各层的天然颜色。折射率不均匀产生反射/后向散射对比；沿途吸收可削弱返回光，但它不是样题Q8所问的主要对比答案。

ENOCT angiography, OCT-A, uses changes associated with moving red blood cells to map microvasculature. The example avoids injected vascular dye. It is a flow-related extension of OCT, not fluorescent labeling of every vessel. Structural OCT asks where tissue layers are; OCT-A adds information about where blood-cell motion is detected.

中文OCT angiography（OCT-A，OCT血管成像）利用运动红细胞相关的变化绘制微血管，课件示例不需要注射血管染料。它是OCT的血流相关扩展，不是给每根血管加荧光标签。结构OCT回答组织层在哪里；OCT-A补充哪里检测到血细胞运动。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p75–87; T4-0089–0106

ENClarify the concept: Spectral/Fourier-domain OCT records the interference spectrum as the sample return combines with the reference. Fourier processing converts the spectral fringe structure into a depth-reflectivity profile, often called an A-scan. Moving laterally and combining depth profiles gives a cross-section. Thus the raw measured horizontal coordinate can be wavelength, while the reconstructed coordinate is depth; neither is a fluorescence emission spectrum used as a label.

中文把概念讲清：Spectral/Fourier-domain OCT（谱域/傅里叶域OCT）记录样品返回光与参考光形成的干涉光谱。傅里叶处理把光谱条纹结构变为深度反射曲线，常叫A-scan；横向移动并合并深度曲线得到剖面。因此原始测量横轴可为波长，重建后坐标却是深度；这不是把荧光发射光谱当作标记来测。

Source / 来源：README §4.4 Fourier-domain OCT; Week 4 PDF p79–80; T4-0096–0098

ENRead the figure: Identify the beam splitter, fixed mirror, movable mirror, and detector in this Michelson demonstration. Light travels to each mirror and back; mirror displacement L changes the round-trip path by 2L. Interference compares the returning fields, not two independent light counts.

中文读图：在Michelson演示图中找出beam splitter分光器、固定镜、可动镜与detector探测器。光走到镜面再返回，镜移动L使往返光程改变2L；干涉比较的是两束返回光场，不是两份独立光强。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p76; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B16 · [P2] Photodiode and photomultiplier tube光电二极管与光电倍增管

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish photodiode electron–hole generation from PMT dynode electron multiplication.学习抓手：分清光电二极管的电子—空穴对与PMT倍增极的电子级联。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0047–0055; Week 4 PDF p35–38

老师逐一比较点探测器与CCD／CMOS阵列。PMT口述存在“曲面镜／消除噪声”错误，正文已纠正为电子倍增且仍有噪声。

ENKey points
  • A photodiode converts absorbed photons into electron–hole pairs and photocurrent.
  • A PMT emits photoelectrons from a photocathode, then multiplies electrons at successive dynodes.
  • This internal gain helps detect weak light;
  • it does not remove all noise.
  • A point detector usually requires scanning for an image, whereas CCD/CMOS arrays provide many spatial detector elements.
中文必会知识点
  • Photodiode光电二极管将吸收光子转换为电子—空穴对及光电流。
  • PMT光电倍增管由photocathode光阴极发出光电子，再在dynode倍增极逐级倍增电子。
  • 内部增益帮助检测弱光，不等于消除所有噪声。
  • 点探测器通常需扫描才能成像；
  • CCD/CMOS阵列提供许多空间探测单元。

ENStart from zero: A light detector turns arriving light into an electrical signal. A photodiode is a semiconductor device: suitable absorbed photons create electron–hole pairs, which can be separated and collected as photocurrent. An electron carries negative charge; a hole represents a missing electron that behaves as a positive carrier. The current tells us about the detected light under the detector's calibrated response.

中文从零理解：光探测器把到达的光转换成电信号。Photodiode（光电二极管）是半导体器件：合适光子被吸收后产生electron–hole pairs（电子—空穴对），它们被分离、收集，形成photocurrent（光电流）。电子携带负电荷；空穴代表缺失电子的位置，表现为正电荷载流子。在探测器已校准的响应关系下，电流反映被检测的光。

ENFollow the mechanism: A photomultiplier tube, PMT, first releases photoelectrons from a photocathode. An electric field accelerates them toward successive dynodes. Each impact can release several secondary electrons, producing a cascade before collection at the anode. Think of a branching count that grows at each stage. These stages multiply electrons; they are not tiny mirrors repeatedly reflecting and multiplying light. A PMT requires an appropriate high-voltage supply.

中文跟着机制走：Photomultiplier tube（PMT，光电倍增管）先由photocathode（光阴极）发出光电子，电场把它们加速到连续的dynodes（倍增极）。每次撞击可释放多个二次电子，逐级级联，最后在阳极收集。可以类比每一级分支后数量增加；这里倍增的是电子，不是小镜子反复反射并倍增光。PMT需要合适的高压供电。

ENTry an example: For illustration, one initial electron multiplied by four at each of three stages gives 4³=64 electrons; real gains depend on device and conditions. Internal gain helps weak signals become measurable, but noise remains. A single detector reports light at one measurement location, so scanning is usually needed to build an image. English clues are electron–hole pairs for photodiodes and photocathode, dynodes, and secondary emission for PMTs.

中文用例子理解：简化举例：一个初始电子经过三级，每级都倍增四倍，则最终为4³=64个电子；实际增益取决于器件及工作条件。内部增益让弱信号更容易测到，但噪声仍存在。单个探测器报告一个测量位置的光，通常需要扫描才能形成图像。英文辨认：electron–hole pairs对应光电二极管；photocathode、dynodes、secondary emission（二次发射）对应PMT。

Source / 来源：W4 p35–38 | T4-0048–0055

C16 · [P1] CCD, CMOS and hyperspectral imagingCCD、CMOS与高光谱成像

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q9样卷Q9Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish CCD charge-transfer readout from CMOS pixel circuitry; know HSI adds a wavelength axis.学习抓手：先分清CCD电荷转移与CMOS像素电路；再认出高光谱的第三轴是波长。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p2 Q9 B; Week 4 PDF p35–38; T7-0056–0057

Q9 B把CMOS像素内转换／放大结构写给CCD；课堂没有明确说最终字母，B是依课件机制判断的参考。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0048–0055; T4-0109–0114; Week 4 PDF p35–38, 99–104

CCD／CMOS比较优先；HSI每像素光谱和x,y,λ是重要基础，技术采集实现见S406辅助。

ENKey points
  • A CCD accumulates photocharge and transfers it through a charge-transfer readout structure.
  • CMOS commonly uses pixel-associated circuitry for readout or amplification.
  • Hyperspectral imaging records a spectrum at each spatial location, producing a spatial–spectral data cube.
中文必会知识点
  • CCD累积光生电荷，并通过电荷转移结构读出；
  • CMOS通常通过像素相关电路读出或放大。
  • Hyperspectral imaging在每个空间位置记录光谱，形成空间—光谱数据立方。

ENStart from zero: A camera must turn a pattern of light into numbers. A pixel is one small detector element that samples a position in the image. Light produces electrical charge in these elements. Reading all the elements gives a digital image. CCD and CMOS are two detector-array technologies; they differ mainly in how the electrical information is collected and read.

中文从零理解：相机需要把光的分布转换成数字。Pixel（像素）是对图像某个位置采样的小探测单元；光在这些单元内产生电荷，读出所有单元的信息就得到数字图像。CCD和CMOS是两种探测器阵列技术，主要区别在电信息如何收集和读出。

ENFollow the mechanism: In a CCD, collected charge is transferred through a readout structure, like passing measured packets along a line. CMOS commonly has circuitry associated with pixels for local conversion or readout, like giving positions their own reading stations. These analogies explain architecture only: neither guarantees perfect noise performance. Both still need illumination, optics, and suitable electronics to produce a useful image.

中文跟着机制走：CCD把收集的电荷通过读出结构转移，可类比为沿队列传递已经装好的测量包。CMOS通常有与像素相关的电路，完成局部转换或读出，可类比为不同位置设有自己的读取站。这些比喻只帮助理解结构，不保证哪种技术噪声永远更小。两者都需要照明、成像光学系统及合适电路才能形成有用图像。

ENTry an example: Hyperspectral imaging adds a wavelength dimension: each position has a spectrum, meaning signal versus wavelength. The result is a cube indexed by x, y, and λ, not a physical cube inside the camera. A line-scan system records one spatial line and its spectra, then moves to collect the next line. English clues are charge transfer for CCD, pixel-associated circuitry for CMOS, and spectrum at each pixel for hyperspectral imaging.

中文用例子理解：Hyperspectral imaging（高光谱成像）增加了波长维度：每个位置都有一条spectrum（光谱），即信号随波长的变化。结果用x、y、λ三个坐标组成data cube（数据立方），并非相机里有一个实体立方体。Line-scan（线扫描）一次记录一条空间线及其光谱，再移动采集下一条。英文辨认：charge transfer对应CCD，pixel-associated circuitry对应CMOS，spectrum at each pixel对应高光谱。

ENExam wording: A line-scan instrument records one spatial line plus its spectra at a time; scanning the other spatial axis builds the cube. For sample Q9, B remains a reasoned reference answer; the oral review does not give an unambiguous final letter.

中文英文读题抓手：Line-scan一次记录一条空间线及其光谱，再沿另一空间轴扫描形成数据立方。样题Q9仍把B作为推导参考答案，但口头回顾没有给出明确的最终字母。

Source / 来源：W4 p35–38; W4 p91–104; Sample quiz p2 Q8–9; W4 p35–38, p73–86; W3 p25–32 | T4-0048–0055, T4-0109–0113, T7-0055–0057

ENRead the figure: In the upper sequence, follow the arrows: charge packets move down the CCD array, then through the serial register to an output. In the lower CMOS example, each pixel has local conversion circuitry and the row/column circuits select readout. The shown per-pixel ADC is one digital-pixel implementation; it is not a requirement for every CMOS sensor. Both begin with photons generating charge.

中文读图：上方按箭头看：CCD中的电荷包先沿阵列下移，再通过串行寄存器送到输出。下方CMOS示例在像素附近放转换电路，并用行列电路选择读出。图中的每像素ADC属于一种数字像素实现，并非所有CMOS都必须如此。两者最初都是光子产生电荷。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p36; original slide figure / 原课件截图

ENRead the figure: Photodiodes produce photocurrent. PMTs multiply electrons at dynodes, rather than repeatedly reflecting light. CCDs transfer charge packets for readout. CMOS sensors use pixel-associated circuitry, but analogue-to-digital conversion can be shared at column or other levels; do not generalize one schematic to every CMOS architecture.

中文读图：Photodiode（光电二极管）产生光电流。PMT在Dynode（打拿极）处倍增电子，不是让光反复反射。CCD转移电荷包再读出。CMOS使用像素相关电路，但Analog-to-digital conversion（模数转换）可以按列或以其他层级共用；不能把单张结构图推广成所有CMOS的必然结构。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p35–38; Sample Quiz Q9 option B; original teaching schematic / 自绘教学示意，非实验数据

S404 · [P1] Detector architecture and practical trade-offs / 探测器结构与实际取舍

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q9样卷Q9Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Correct the CCD/CMOS per-pixel-circuit swap; treat speed, noise and cost as device trends.学习抓手：能识别CCD／CMOS像素电路被对调；速度、噪声、成本只按器件趋势理解。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p2 Q9 B; Week 4 PDF p36–38

器件结构直接对应样卷选项；参考答案B依课件推断，课堂最终字母未明确确认。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0052–0055; Week 4 PDF p36–38

架构比较比绝对性能排名优先；不背“所有CCD一定比所有CMOS好”。

ENIn the course comparison, CCD charge is shifted toward output nodes for conversion and digitization. CMOS uses pixel-associated circuitry and often parallel readout; selected pixels can be addressed. ADC means analog-to-digital converter: it turns an analog voltage into a numerical value. Neither CCD nor CMOS removes the need for optical focusing.

中文按课程比较，CCD把电荷移向输出节点进行转换和数字化；CMOS使用像素相关电路，常可并行读出，也可选择部分像素读取。ADC是analog-to-digital converter（模数转换器），把模拟电压转成数字数值。CCD和CMOS都仍需要光学聚焦。

ENThe slides associate CCD with sensitive, low-noise scientific imaging, and CMOS with faster readout, lower power/cost and on-chip integration. Treat these as architecture trends in the course examples, not absolute rankings for every modern device. A photodiode has no PMT-style dynode multiplication; a PMT has high internal gain but still has noise and a wavelength-dependent response.

中文课件把CCD与灵敏、低噪声的科学成像联系起来，把CMOS与更快读出、较低功耗/成本及片上集成联系起来。这些是课程示例中的结构趋势，不是所有现代器件的绝对排名。光电二极管没有PMT那种倍增极级联；PMT内部增益高，但仍有噪声，其响应也随波长变化。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p35–38; T4-0048–0055

B17 · [P1] Sectioning, OCT resolution and hyperspectral data / 切片、OCT分辨率与高光谱数据

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Sample Q8样卷Q8Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate OCT axial resolution, lateral resolution and object-side depth of field (called depth of focus in slide p83); broader bandwidth improves axial resolution at fixed central wavelength.学习抓手：分清OCT轴向分辨率、横向分辨率与物侧景深（原课件p83称焦深）；固定中心波长时带宽增大改善轴向分辨。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T4-0100–0104; Week 4 PDF p80–83

“These are parameters are important for OCT.”

原字幕语法按原文保留；强调三个不同参数，不要求死背有疑误的焦深完整式。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p2 Q8; Week 4 PDF p85–86

OCT反射对比相关，具体答案与干涉定位先看C15。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T4-0114; Week 4 PDF p105

“You don't really need to memorize it.”

仅指HSI采集技术，不排除每像素光谱的核心定义。

ENKey points
  • Widefield collects out-of-focus background;
  • confocal rejects it;
  • two-photon excitation is localized (fluorescence ∝I² before saturation).
  • OCT axial resolution depends on coherence length: broader bandwidth improves it at fixed central wavelength.
  • Lateral resolution depends on focusing/NA;
  • at fixed wavelength, higher NA reduces object-side depth of field, the usable focused specimen range, not layer separation.
  • Slide p83 calls this depth of focus, although standard terminology reserves depth of focus for image space.
  • Hyperspectral imaging records many narrow bands at each position, not just RGB.
中文必会知识点
  • Widefield宽场会收集离焦背景，共聚焦抑制它，双光子采用局域激发（未饱和时荧光∝I²）。
  • OCT轴向分辨率取决于相干长度：中心波长固定时，带宽越宽、轴向分辨越好。
  • 横向分辨率依赖聚焦/NA；
  • 固定波长时，NA越大、物侧景深越小。
  • Depth of field景深是样品保持清晰的深度范围，不是可分辨层间距；
  • 原课件p83称它depth of focus，但标准术语的depth of focus焦深指像侧范围。
  • 高光谱在每个位置记录许多窄谱带，不只是RGB。

ENStart from zero: Separate layer selection, resolution and focus range. Optical sectioning selects a layer; axial resolution separates structures along depth, while lateral resolution separates them sideways. Depth of field is the object-side specimen thickness that stays acceptably sharp. Depth of focus is the image-side tolerance for the image plane. Slide p83 labels its object-side range 'depth of focus'; recognize the slide's wording, but keep the standard meanings separate.

中文从零理解：分清选层、分辨和聚焦范围：Optical sectioning光学切片选择成像层；axial resolution轴向分辨率区分深度方向的结构，lateral resolution横向分辨率区分左右结构。Depth of field景深是样品侧保持清晰的厚度；depth of focus焦深是像侧允许像面移动的范围。原课件p83把物侧范围写成depth of focus；要认得课件用词，同时分清标准含义。

ENFollow the mechanism: Widefield imaging collects substantial out-of-focus background. Confocal imaging rejects much of it with a pinhole; two-photon imaging mainly creates fluorescence at the focus, with signal proportional to I² before saturation. In OCT, axial separation is governed by source coherence length: broader optical bandwidth improves axial resolution at fixed central wavelength. Lateral resolution instead depends on focusing and NA. Higher NA improves lateral detail but reduces object-side depth of field at fixed wavelength; it does not automatically improve OCT axial resolution.

中文跟着机制走：Widefield（宽场）会收集较多离焦背景；共聚焦用针孔抑制许多背景；双光子主要在焦点产生荧光，未饱和时信号与I²成正比。OCT的轴向区分由光源相干长度控制：中心波长固定时，光谱带宽越宽，轴向分辨越好。横向分辨则取决于聚焦与NA。NA提高可改善横向细节，在固定波长时却减小物侧景深；并不会自动改善OCT轴向分辨率。

ENTry an example: Hyperspectral imaging answers a different question: what spectrum comes from each location? RGB uses a few broad color channels; hyperspectral data use many narrow wavelength bands. Imagine a small map in which every square contains a wavelength-versus-signal graph. This can help distinguish materials with different spectra, but collecting more bands does not itself sharpen spatial detail. Exam examples: wider OCT source bandwidth improves axial resolution; greater NA affects lateral resolution and focus range; x, y, λ identifies a hyperspectral cube.

中文用例子理解：高光谱回答另一个问题：每个位置的光谱是什么？RGB只有少数宽颜色通道，高光谱记录许多窄波长带。可以想象一张小地图，每个格子里都放着一条“波长—信号”曲线，这有助于区分光谱不同的材料；但增加谱带不会自动让空间细节更清楚。英文题例：更宽OCT光源带宽改善轴向分辨率；更大NA影响横向分辨率及聚焦范围；x、y、λ指高光谱数据立方。

Source / 来源：Nikon MicroscopyU: depth of field and depth of focus; Week 4 PDF p83

Source / 来源：W4 p39–46; W4 p47–61; W4 p71–79; W4 p80–82; W4 p83; W4 p91–104; W4 p105 | T4-0056–0069, T4-0088–0104, T4-0109–0114

S406 · [P3] Hyperspectral acquisition and material identification / 高光谱采集与物质辨识

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Lower priority降低优先级Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognise point/line/wavelength/snapshot acquisition; keep the x,y,λ definition in C16/B17.学习抓手：粗辨点／线／波长／快照采集即可；x,y,λ核心定义仍看C16/B17。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T4-0114; Week 4 PDF p105

“You don't really need to memorize it. So this is more technical.”

范围是如何生成HSI的技术实现，不是HSI所有概念都不用学。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T4-0111–0114; Week 4 PDF p99–104

每像素光谱的定义仍重要；本节四种实现图可作理解参考。

ENA spectrometer measures signal versus wavelength at a location; hyperspectral imaging adds spatial locations. Its cube has axes x, y and λ, so the third axis is spectral, not anatomical depth z. Reflectance HSI, Raman HSI and fluorescence HSI use different light–matter signals, even though all can provide a spectrum at each position.

中文Spectrometer（光谱仪）测某个位置的信号随波长如何变化；hyperspectral imaging（高光谱成像）再加上空间位置。数据立方坐标为x、y、λ，第三轴是光谱，不是解剖深度z。Reflectance HSI（反射高光谱）、Raman HSI（拉曼高光谱）和fluorescence HSI（荧光高光谱）使用不同光—物质信号，但都可在各位置提供光谱。

ENRead the four acquisition diagrams by asking what is recorded at once. Point scan records one location’s spectrum; line scan records a spatial line and its spectra, then scans the other spatial axis. Wavelength scan records a 2D image at one band, then changes bands. Snapshot acquisition attempts to collect the spatial–spectral information in one exposure. Line scan does not obtain the entire surface cube in one step.

中文四种采集图先问“一次记录什么”：point scan（点扫描）记录一个位置的光谱；line scan（线扫描）记录一条空间线及其光谱，再扫另一空间轴。Wavelength scan（波长扫描）一次记录一个谱带的二维图，再改变谱带；snapshot（快照）尝试一次曝光采集空间—光谱信息。线扫描并不是一步就取得整个表面的完整数据立方。

ENDifferent materials can have different spectral signatures even when an RGB image looks similar. Classification compares these signatures; many spectral bands can therefore help identify tissue or materials. A pixel can contain more than one material, giving a mixed spectrum. More wavelength bands do not automatically improve spatial resolution, and a spectrum-based classification still requires suitable reference data or a trained model.

中文不同材料即使RGB图看起来相似，也可具有不同spectral signatures（光谱特征）。分类比较这些特征，因此许多谱带可帮助辨识组织或材料。一个像素也可能混有多种材料，形成mixed spectrum（混合光谱）。增加谱带不会自动提高空间分辨率；基于光谱的分类仍需要合适参考数据或训练过的模型。

Source / 来源：Week 4 PDF p95–110; T4-0109–0119

Week 5 learning block: Ultrasound, photoacoustics and image analysis / 第5学习组：超声、光声与图像分析

Week 5 concept map / 第5周知识框架

ENChapter logic: Compare what enters tissue and what returns, then turn measured signals into images and diagnostic decisions.

中文本章主线：比较送入组织和返回的信号，再理解测量怎样形成图像及诊断判断。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Piezoelectric transducer 压电换能器 Voltage→deformation transmits sound; pressure→charge receives it. 电压→形变用于发声，压力→电荷用于接收。 Details / 详解
Acoustic impedance and reflection 声阻抗与反射 Z=ρc; impedance mismatch creates echoes, and high frequency usually trades depth for detail. Z=ρc；失配形成回波，高频通常以穿透深度换更细细节。 Details / 详解
Echo versus photoacoustic timing 回波与光声计时 Echo depth uses ct/2 for the round trip; a stated one-way photoacoustic route uses ct. 回波按往返ct/2，明确单程的光声声路按ct。 Details / 详解
Photoacoustic contrast 光声对比 Absorbed pulsed light→heating/expansion→sound; multiple wavelengths can reveal different absorbers. 脉冲光吸收→升温/膨胀→声音，多波长可区分不同吸光物。 Details / 详解
X-ray and CT X射线与CT I/I₀=exp(−ΣμᵢLᵢ) for stated uniform layers; CT combines angular projections into slices. 题设均匀多层I/I₀=exp(−ΣμᵢLᵢ)，CT合并角度投影重建切片。 Details / 详解
Digital-image representation 数字图像表达 Sampling discretizes position; b-bit quantization gives 2ᵇ intensity levels. 采样离散化位置，b位量化给2ᵇ个强度等级。 Details / 详解
Processing and analysis 处理与分析 Clean the image, segment regions, measure features, then classify, estimate values or track objects. 整理图像、分割区域、测特征，再分类、估数值或跟踪。 Details / 详解
Diagnostic metrics 诊断指标 TP/TN/FP/FN compare predictions with truth; ROC plots TPR against FPR as threshold changes. TP/TN/FP/FN对比预测和真值；ROC在变阈值时画TPR对FPR。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX410 Acoustic wave, wavelength and frequency, FX411 Echo depth versus one-way photoacoustic path, FX412 Acoustic impedance and pressure/intensity, FX413 Acoustic reflection and normal-incidence optical analogue, FX414 Exponential pressure and intensity attenuation, FX415 dB loss and exponential-coefficient conversion, FX416 Frequency-dependent ultrasound path loss, FX417 Ultrasound pulse length and slide half-depth heuristic, FX418 X-ray single- and multilayer attenuation, FX419 Signed transmission-image contrast, FX420 Photoelectric threshold and absorption trend, FX421 Bit depth, storage and spatial sampling, FX422 Convolution and averaging kernels, FX423 Diagnostic sensitivity, specificity and ROC.

中文本章公式定位：FX410 声波、波长与频率；FX411 回波深度与光声单程声路；FX412 声阻抗与压力／强度；FX413 声反射与正入射光学类比；FX414 压力与强度的指数衰减；FX415 dB损耗与指数系数换算；FX416 频率相关的超声路径损耗；FX417 超声脉冲长度与课件半深度经验式；FX418 X射线单层与分层衰减；FX419 透射图像的带符号对比度；FX420 光电阈值与吸收趋势；FX421 位深、存储与空间采样；FX422 卷积与均值核；FX423 诊断敏感度、特异度与ROC。

B18 · [P1] Piezoelectric transmission, echoes and attenuation / 压电发射、回波与衰减

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know direct/inverse piezoelectric conversion, impedance mismatch and total echo-path attenuation.学习抓手：会认正／逆压电、声阻抗失配，以及回波衰减要算总路程。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T5-0022; Week 5 PDF p19–23

“This is very, very important. This reflection is the key value that what ultrasound is measuring.”

重点在界面失配产生返回信号，不必背每种组织的Z表。

Slide / classroom worked example课件／课堂例题: T5-0030–0032; Week 5 PDF p24–25

“It should be 20 Cm.”

课堂例子深度10cm对应回波总路程20cm；这不是已确认的课后作业要求。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T5-0019; Week 5 PDF p19–21

“I will definitely be provided for any questions.”

这句就组织阻抗表说出题会给，不用背数值；给ρ、c时Z=ρc仍可算。

ENKey points
  • Inverse piezoelectric effect: applied voltage produces deformation and sound (transmit).
  • Direct effect: returning pressure produces charge (receive).
  • Acoustic impedance Z=ρc;
  • a larger mismatch produces stronger reflection, so coupling gel reduces the air gap.
  • Higher ultrasound frequency usually improves spatial resolution but increases attenuation and reduces penetration.
  • Echo attenuation uses the outgoing and returning path.
中文必会知识点
  • Inverse piezoelectric effect逆压电效应：施加电压产生形变与声波（发射）；
  • direct正压电效应：返回声压产生电荷（接收）。
  • 声阻抗Z=ρc；
  • 失配越大、反射通常越强，耦合凝胶用于减少空气间隙。
  • 超声频率更高通常提高空间分辨率，但增加衰减、降低穿透。
  • 回波衰减应计入去程和回程。

ENStart from zero: A piezoelectric material links mechanical deformation and electricity. In ultrasound transmission, an applied voltage makes the material change shape rapidly, creating sound: this is the inverse piezoelectric effect. On reception, returning sound pressure deforms it and produces charge: this is the direct effect. It resembles one device acting as both speaker and microphone, although its physical conversion mechanism is specifically piezoelectric.

中文从零理解：Piezoelectric（压电）材料把机械形变与电联系起来。超声发射时，施加电压让材料快速形变，产生声波，这叫inverse piezoelectric effect（逆压电效应）。接收时，返回声压让材料变形并产生电荷，这叫direct piezoelectric effect（正压电效应）。可类比同一器件兼做扬声器和麦克风，但这里的具体换能机制是压电效应。

ENFollow the mechanism: Acoustic impedance Z=ρc combines density ρ and sound speed c. It describes a medium's relation between sound pressure and particle motion. When sound meets a boundary with different impedance, some energy reflects. A large mismatch can produce a strong echo and prevent much sound entering the next medium. Coupling gel removes an air gap that would otherwise cause strong reflection at the skin surface.

中文跟着机制走：Acoustic impedance（声阻抗）Z=ρc由密度ρ与声速c共同决定，描述介质中声压和质点运动的关系。声遇到声阻抗不同的界面时，部分能量被反射；失配很大时可产生强回波，同时阻止较多声进入下一介质。Coupling gel（耦合凝胶）用于消除空气间隙，否则皮肤表面处会出现很强反射。

ENTry an example: Higher frequency usually means shorter wavelength and finer spatial detail, but also stronger tissue attenuation and reduced penetration. Choose between small shallow features and deeper targets; no frequency is best for everything. An echo also weakens along both outgoing and returning paths. English clues: voltage to deformation is inverse piezoelectric; pressure to charge is direct; mismatch means boundary reflection; attenuation means weakening during travel.

中文用例子理解：频率更高通常意味着波长更短、能分开更细的空间细节，但组织衰减也通常更强，穿透更浅。可理解为在“看清浅处小结构”和“到达深处目标”之间取舍，没有一种频率适合全部情况。回波在去程和回程都会减弱。英文辨认：voltage to deformation为逆压电；pressure to charge为正压电；mismatch失配对应界面反射；attenuation衰减对应传播中的减弱。

Source / 来源：W5 p5–14; W5 p15–18; W5 p19–23; W5 p19–21; W5 p24–26; W5 p27–28; W5 p29 | T5-0004–0032, T5-0037–0040

ENRead the figure: Read the arrow directions. On the left, Electrical Signal In produces Sound Vibrations Out: voltage makes the crystal deform/vibrate, the inverse piezoelectric effect. On the right, Sound Vibrations In produces Electrical Signal Out: incoming pressure generates electrical charge, the direct piezoelectric effect. The outgoing and returning ultrasound are mechanical waves, not electromagnetic light.

中文读图：看箭头方向。左侧Electrical Signal In电信号输入，变成Sound Vibrations Out声振动输出：电压使晶体变形/振动，是逆压电效应。右侧声音输入产生电信号输出：入射声压产生电荷，是正压电效应。发出与返回的超声都是机械波，不是电磁光波。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p15; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S501 · [P1] Mechanical waves, pressure and reflection coefficients / 机械波、声压与反射系数

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Use Z mismatch to predict echo strength and transmission; pressure amplitude and intensity are different.学习抓手：按Z失配判断回波与透射，分清声压幅度与强度。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T5-0022; Week 5 PDF p22

“This is very, very important. This reflection is the key value that what ultrasound is measuring.”

正入射理想无损模型R=[(Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁)]²；平方给强度比例，不是带符号声压。

Slide / classroom worked example课件／课堂例题: Week 5 PDF p25; T5-0027–0032

衰减的课堂例子随频率和路程变化；不需要将组织数据表本身背下来。

ENUltrasound is a mechanical wave above roughly 20 kHz, not an electromagnetic wave. It needs a material medium and cannot travel through vacuum. In the taught tissue model it is longitudinal: local particles oscillate along the propagation direction, forming compression and rarefaction. The particles do not all travel from the probe to the organ. Wavelength follows λ=c/f; diagnostic frequencies are in the MHz range, distinct from the 20 kHz hearing boundary.

中文Ultrasound（超声）是频率约高于20 kHz的机械波，不是电磁波；它需要物质介质，不能在真空中传播。课程组织模型中它是longitudinal（纵波）：局部质点沿传播方向振动，形成compression（压缩）与rarefaction（稀疏），并不是所有质点从探头一路移动到器官。波长λ=c/f；诊断频率在MHz量级，要与20 kHz听觉边界区分。

ENSound pressure is the pressure variation; intensity is power per area. In the travelling-wave model, I(t)=p(t)²/Z, with acoustic impedance Z=ρc. For a sinusoid, mean intensity uses RMS pressure: ⟨I⟩=p_rms²/Z=p_peak²/(2Z). At fixed Z, doubling pressure amplitude gives four times the intensity, not twice. Do not substitute peak pressure into the RMS formula without the factor of two.

中文声压是压力的变化；intensity（强度）是单位面积上的功率。行波模型中I(t)=p(t)²/Z，声阻抗Z=ρc。正弦波的平均强度应使用RMS（均方根）声压：⟨I⟩=p_rms²/Z=p_peak²/(2Z)。Z固定时，声压幅度加倍，强度变为四倍，不是两倍。峰值声压不能不加系数地直接代入均方根公式。

ENAt a lossless boundary with normal incidence, the intensity reflection coefficient is R=[(Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁)]² and transmission coefficient T=1−R. Equal impedances give R=0 in this simple model; a strong mismatch gives a large return and poor onward transmission. These are intensity fractions, not signed pressure amplitudes. Attenuation is loss along the path, including absorption/scattering; an echo path has outgoing and returning distance. Keep pressure and intensity attenuation conventions distinct.

中文无损界面、垂直入射时，强度反射系数R=[(Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁)]²，透射系数T=1−R。简单模型中声阻抗相等时R=0；失配强时返回较多，继续透入较少。这里是强度比例，不是带正负号的声压幅度。Attenuation（衰减）是沿途减弱，含吸收/散射；回波要计去程与回程距离，并区分声压衰减和强度衰减的约定。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p9–25; T5-0008–0032

ENClarify the concept: At fixed acoustic impedance, intensity is proportional to pressure squared. If pressure amplitude decays as p=p₀e^(−α_p x), intensity decays as I=I₀e^(−2α_p x). If instead I=I₀e^(−α_I x), then α_I=2α_p. A dB loss is 10log₁₀(I₀/I)=20log₁₀(p₀/p); multiply a stated dB-per-length coefficient by path length. The same α cannot mean all three conventions. For a reflected echo, count both outward and return paths.

中文把概念讲清：声阻抗固定时，强度与声压平方成正比。若声压幅度p=p₀e^(−α_p x)，强度I=I₀e^(−2α_p x)；若定义强度式I=I₀e^(−α_I x)，则α_I=2α_p。dB损失为10log₁₀(I₀/I)=20log₁₀(p₀/p)，给定dB/长度系数应乘传播路径长度。同一个α不能同时代表这三种约定。反射回波应计去程加回程。

Source / 来源：README §5.1 Attenuation; Week 5 PDF p14, 23–25; T5-0027–0032 (especially total path); derived directly from I=p²/Z

C17 · [P2] Ultrasound versus photoacoustic imaging超声与光声成像

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Contrast ultrasound echoes with photoacoustic absorption→heat→expansion→sound, and round-trip versus one-way timing.学习抓手：分清超声回波与光声的吸收→热→膨胀→声，并区分往返／单程时间。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T5-0004–0017; T5-0044–0051; Week 5 PDF p6–18, 34–43

两种成像从输入与输出信号比较；没有在这组段落明确承诺某道Quiz题。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T5-0037; Week 5 PDF p27–28

“This part will not be on the exam our previous part will be on exam.”

this part是后续扫描成像技术；不能排除前面的超声基本原理，也未明确该exam专指Quiz。

ENKey points
  • Conventional ultrasound uses acoustic transmission and returning echoes.
  • Photoacoustic imaging starts with optical absorption, followed by heating, thermoelastic expansion and acoustic-wave generation;
  • an ultrasound transducer detects the sound.
  • Optical absorption supplies contrast, while acoustic detection supports depth.
中文必会知识点
  • 常规超声发射声波并接收回波。
  • 光声成像从光吸收开始，随后升温、热弹性膨胀并产生声波，由超声换能器检测。
  • 光学吸收提供对比，声学检测支持较深成像。

ENStart from zero: Ultrasound uses sound above the human hearing range to look inside tissue. A transducer sends a pulse and listens for returning echoes. Different boundaries return different amounts of sound, allowing an image to be formed. This is similar to listening for an echo in a room, but a medical instrument uses controlled pulses, sensitive detectors, and known sound-speed assumptions to estimate positions.

中文从零理解：Ultrasound（超声）使用超过人耳听觉范围的声波观察组织内部。Transducer（换能器）发出声脉冲，再接收返回的echo（回波）；不同界面返回声波的强弱不同，从而形成图像。这有点像听房间里的回声，但医学仪器使用受控脉冲、灵敏探测器及已知声速假设来估计位置。

ENFollow the mechanism: Photoacoustic imaging begins differently: a light pulse is absorbed, producing a small temperature rise and rapid thermoelastic expansion, which generates sound. The detector then listens to that sound. Think of converting an optical event into an acoustic message. The analogy does not mean ordinary thermal expansion always makes a useful imaging signal; pulse timing and detection conditions matter.

中文跟着机制走：Photoacoustic imaging（光声成像）的起点不同：光脉冲被吸收，造成微小升温和快速thermoelastic expansion（热弹性膨胀），从而产生声波，探测器再接收声波。可以把它理解为将光学事件转换成声学信息；但不是任何普通热膨胀都能产生有用成像信号，脉冲时间和探测条件也很重要。

ENTry an example: For an ultrasound echo, sound travels to the boundary and back, so depth z=vt/2. With speed v=1540 m/s and echo time t=40 μs, z=0.0308 m=3.08 cm. For a stated one-way photoacoustic travel time, use z=vt. English clues: transmission and echo indicate conventional ultrasound; optical absorption, heating, expansion, and acoustic detection indicate photoacoustics. The factor of two comes from the path, not the name alone.

中文用例子理解：超声回波中，声波先到界面再回来，所以深度z=vt/2。若声速v=1540 m/s、回波时间t=40 μs，则z=0.0308 m=3.08 cm。若题目明确给光声的单程传播时间，应使用z=vt。英文中transmission与echo提示常规超声；optical absorption、heating、expansion、acoustic detection提示光声。是否除以2取决于实际传播路径，不能只凭技术名称判断。

ENExam wording: Echo depth uses a round-trip time: z=vt/2. For a photoacoustic one-way propagation time, z=vt. The problem must state which timing it measures. Detailed ultrasound scan and resolution examples are lower priority under the local lecture exclusions.

中文英文读题抓手：回波深度按往返时间z=vt/2；若给光声单程传播时间，则z=vt。必须先看题目定义的时间。根据课堂局部排除，复杂超声扫描与分辨率例题降低优先级。

Source / 来源：W5 p5–14; W5 p15–18; W5 p27–28; W5 p29; W5 p34–43 | T5-0004–0017, T5-0037–0040, T5-0044–0051

ENRead the figure: The horizontal axis is Time and the vertical axis is detected Voltage. The early peak is the skin echo; later peaks come from the organ's front and back boundaries. Match the lower distance D to the marked 2D/v delay: sound goes to the boundary and returns, so D = vt/2. Peak height indicates echo strength and is also affected by attenuation; it is not directly the depth.

中文读图：横轴Time是时间，纵轴Voltage是检测到的电压。早到的峰来自皮肤，稍后的峰来自器官前、后边界。把下方距离D与上方标出的2D/v时延对应：声走到边界还要返回，所以D = vt/2。峰高表示回波强弱，也会受衰减影响；它不直接等于深度。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p21; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S502 · [P3] Read ultrasound displays: supporting vocabulary / 看懂超声显示：辅助词汇

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognise A/B/M display names and time gain compensation without technical scanning calculations.学习抓手：只辨认A/B/M显示与时间增益补偿，不练技术扫描计算。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T5-0037; Week 5 PDF p27–28

“This part will not be on the exam our previous part will be on exam.”

局部说的是形成扫描图像的技术段，前面的压电、声阻抗、反射、衰减仍保留。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T5-0040; Week 5 PDF p29

“It's just a reference for you because it's too technical.”

指超声分辨率计算，不是光学Rayleigh分辨率。

ENSupporting, lower-priority vocabulary: A-mode plots echo amplitude against arrival time/depth along one line. B-mode encodes echo strength as brightness and combines lines into a cross-section. M-mode repeatedly observes one line to show how structures move over time. A, B and M here mean amplitude, brightness and motion; they are not three different biological recognition molecules.

中文辅助、低优先级词汇：A-mode把一条线上的回波幅度画成随到达时间/深度变化的曲线；B-mode把回波强度编码为亮度，再合并多条线得到剖面；M-mode反复观察同一条线，显示结构随时间如何运动。这里A、B、M分别是amplitude（幅度）、brightness（亮度）、motion（运动），不是三种生物识别分子。

ENDeeper echoes are weakened by travel, so time gain compensation increases receiver gain for later returns to make the display more useful. This does not undo the physical attenuation or create missing echoes. The lecturer locally excluded the technical scanning/imaging section; keep its vocabulary as context, while the earlier piezoelectric, impedance, reflection and attenuation principles remain central.

中文更深回波沿途减弱，因此time gain compensation（时间增益补偿）对较晚返回的信号增加接收增益，帮助显示。这不会逆转实际衰减，也不会创造已经缺失的回波。老师局部排除了技术性的扫描/成像段；这里保留名词供理解，前面的压电、声阻抗、反射及衰减原理仍是重点。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p27–31; T5-0037–0041

B19 · [P2] Photoacoustic contrast and X-ray attenuation / 光声对比与X射线衰减

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know photoacoustic absorption contrast and X-ray photon transmission through one or multiple layers.学习抓手：会区分光声吸收对比与X射线光子透射，并计算单层／多层指数衰减。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T5-0044–0051; T5-0063–0072; T5-0073–0080; Week 5 PDF p34–51, 54–59

光声与X-ray连续讲解。T5-0063开头“两题Quiz再见”仍指前面的NA/光栅，不能误贴到光声。

Slide / classroom worked example课件／课堂例题: T5-0082–0085; Week 5 PDF p60–61

“Now we have one real example.”

课件三条骨／软组织路径练exp[−ΣμL]；第三条口述有系数错误，应按课件数据纠正。

ENKey points
  • Photoacoustic contrast depends on optical absorption, so excitation wavelength can emphasize different absorbers.
  • An X-ray tube accelerates electrons toward a target to generate X-ray photons;
  • the patient is imaged by photons, not the electron beam.
  • X-ray transmission follows exponential attenuation;
  • successive layers multiply transmissions.
  • Absorption contrast and acoustic reflection contrast are different mechanisms.
中文必会知识点
  • 光声对比依赖光吸收，因此激发波长可突出不同吸收物。
  • X射线管把电子加速到靶材以产生X射线光子；
  • 用于成像的是光子，不是射向患者的电子束。
  • X射线透射遵循指数衰减；
  • 连续多层的透过率相乘。
  • 吸收对比与声学反射对比属于不同机制。

ENStart from zero: Different contrast mechanisms tell us different properties. A conventional ultrasound echo reflects a sound-impedance boundary. Photoacoustic sound reports optical absorption that caused local heating and expansion. Changing the excitation wavelength can therefore emphasize different light absorbers. A strong photoacoustic signal does not necessarily mean the strongest acoustic reflector: the signal started from absorption, rather than from a reflected ultrasound pulse.

中文从零理解：不同对比机制显示不同性质。常规超声回波反映声阻抗界面；光声信号反映光吸收造成的局部升温和膨胀。因此改变激发波长，可以突出不同吸光物。光声很强的位置，不一定是声反射最强的位置：它的信号起点是吸收光，不是反射超声脉冲。

ENFollow the mechanism: An X-ray tube accelerates electrons toward a solid target. Their interactions with the target generate X-ray photons; these photons pass toward the patient and detector. Do not confuse electrons inside the source with photons used for imaging. Tissues weaken the transmitted beam by different amounts. X-rays are ionizing radiation, meaning individual photons can have enough energy to remove electrons from atoms.

中文跟着机制走：X射线管把电子加速撞向固体靶材；电子与靶材相互作用产生X射线光子，再由这些光子照向患者及探测器。不要把光源内部的电子与用于成像的光子混淆。不同组织使透射光束衰减的程度不同。X射线属于电离辐射，即单个光子能量可以足以把电子从原子中移走。

ENTry an example: For a uniform layer, transmission T=I/I₀ follows T=exp(−μL), where μ is an attenuation coefficient and L the layer thickness in matching units. Successive layers multiply their transmissions. In a simple illustration, two layers each passing 50% leave 0.5×0.5=25% overall, not zero. English questions may contrast absorption-based photoacoustics, reflection-based ultrasound, and transmission attenuation in X-rays. State which mechanism is measured before deciding what image brightness means.

中文用例子理解：均匀一层的透射率T=I/I₀满足T=exp(−μL)，μ是衰减系数，L是层厚，两者单位需匹配。连续多层的透射率相乘。简单举例：两层各通过50%，总透过率为0.5×0.5=25%，不是零。英文题可比较基于吸收的光声、基于反射的超声以及X射线透射衰减。判断图像亮度意义前，要先说明测的是哪种机制。

Source / 来源：W5 p34–43; W5 p44–51; W5 p53–58; W5 p59–61; W5 p62; W5 p63 | T5-0044–0051, T5-0063–0087

S503 · [P2] Photoacoustic spectra and reconstruction光声光谱与重建

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain wavelength-dependent absorption and oxygenation contrast; arrival times locate the sound source.学习抓手：解释波长依赖吸收与氧合对比；到达时间帮助定位声源。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T5-0063–0072; Week 5 PDF p42–51

课堂在双题Quiz承诺之后恢复光声讲解；不能把前一句承诺挪给光声光谱。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: Week 5 PDF p45–50

小／大吸光物波形和重建图用于理解；不背研究模型结构或“任何情况下光声更好”。

ENPhotoacoustic imaging records sound generated inside an absorber after light absorption; the received sound is not simply the incident ultrasound reflecting back. Multiple detectors receive a wave from the same source at different times. With known detector positions and an assumed sound speed, back-projection combines those arrival times to estimate the absorber’s location. Here the timing describes the source-to-detector acoustic route.

中文光声成像记录吸光物内部在吸收光后产生的声音，接收声波不是单纯入射超声反射回来。同一声源的波到达不同探测器的时间不同。已知探测器位置并假设声速后，back-projection（反投影）合并到达时间来估计吸光物位置。这里的时间描述声源到探测器的声学路径。

ENChanging laser wavelength changes how strongly a particular molecule absorbs. Oxygenated and deoxygenated hemoglobin have different spectra, so multiwavelength photoacoustic signals can help estimate oxygenation and visualize vessels. This is absorption-based molecular/functional contrast, not fluorescence emission. Signal also depends on local light delivery and detection, so a larger signal is not a universal direct concentration measurement without calibration.

中文改变激光波长，会改变某种分子的吸收强弱。氧合与脱氧血红蛋白光谱不同，因此多波长光声信号可帮助估计氧合状态、显示血管。这是基于吸收的分子/功能对比，不是荧光发射。信号还受局部光输送和检测条件影响，不能不经校准就普遍把“信号更大”等同于“浓度更高”。

ENIn the slide example, a smaller absorber generates a shorter acoustic time feature and a larger absorber a broader feature. The waveform therefore carries size information as well as arrival-time information. Photoacoustics combines optical absorption contrast with acoustic detection, but its resolution and depth still depend on the illumination, acoustic bandwidth and geometry; it is not automatically superior at every depth and scale.

中文课件示例中，较小吸光物产生较窄的声学时间特征，较大吸光物产生较宽特征，因此波形还携带尺寸信息，不只是到达时间。光声结合光吸收对比与声学检测，但分辨率和深度仍受照明、声学带宽及几何影响，并非在任何深度和尺度都一定更优。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p42–51; T5-0063–0073

ENRead the figure: Follow the arrows from laser pulse through absorption, expansion and acoustic waves to ultrasound detection. The incoming excitation is light; the outgoing detected signal is sound.

中文读图：按箭头跟随激光脉冲→吸收→膨胀→声波→超声检测。进入的激发是光，最终检测的信号是声音。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p41; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S504 · [P2] X-ray contrast, scattering and CT reconstruction / X射线对比、散射与CT重建

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Worked example例题练习Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish X-ray projection from CT reconstruction; practice multilayer attenuation before technical scattering details.学习抓手：分清X射线投影与CT重建；先练多层衰减，散射技术细节后看。

Slide / classroom worked example课件／课堂例题: Week 5 PDF p60–61; T5-0082–0085

“Now we have one real example.”

骨／软组织三路径是课件课堂例题，不是已确认课后作业。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T5-0088–0095; Week 5 PDF p64–68

CT要多角度投影及计算重建，不能说单幅X-ray直接生成三维。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T5-0087; Week 5 PDF p63

“You don't need to bother too much when you deal with exam and quiz.”

仅降级此处X-ray能量／散射技术细节；不排除前面衰减或后面CT基本概念。

ENThe photoelectric effect absorbs an X-ray photon and ejects a bound electron when enough energy is available. In the course comparison, higher atomic-number materials such as bone give stronger photoelectric attenuation; the approximate trend decreases as photon energy rises, with absorption-edge exceptions. Compton scattering changes the photon direction and energy. Scattered photons reaching the detector can produce fog and reduce useful projection contrast.

中文Photoelectric effect（光电效应）在能量足够时吸收X射线光子并击出束缚电子。课程比较中，骨等原子序数较高材料产生更强光电衰减；近似趋势随光子能量增加而减小，但有absorption edge（吸收边）的例外。Compton scattering（康普顿散射）改变光子的方向和能量；散射光子到达探测器可形成fog（雾状背景），降低有效投影对比。

ENA projection radiograph combines attenuation along each beam path; structures at different depths overlap. In the conventional display taught, more transmission looks darker and less transmission looks whiter, although display inversion is possible. For successive uniform layers, I/I₀=exp(−ΣμᵢLᵢ). A single projection does not separately locate every layer in depth.

中文Projection radiograph（投影X射线图）把每条光路沿途的衰减合在一起，不同深度结构会重叠。课程传统显示中，透过更多较暗、透过更少较白；实际也可反转显示。连续均匀多层满足I/I₀=exp(−ΣμᵢLᵢ)。单张投影不会单独定位每一层的深度。

ENContrast agents containing high-atomic-number elements such as iodine or barium can increase attenuation differences between otherwise similar tissues. Beam collimation and grids reduce the contribution of scatter. Lower X-ray energy can improve attenuation contrast but may penetrate poorly; higher energy can reach thicker regions. Attenuation, contrast and penetration are related choices, not interchangeable definitions.

中文含iodine（碘）或barium（钡）等高原子序数元素的contrast agents（对比剂）可增大原本相似组织的衰减差异。Collimation（限束）及栅格可减少散射贡献。较低X射线能量可改善衰减对比，却可能穿透不足；较高能量可到达更厚区域。衰减、对比、穿透是相关取舍，不是同一个定义。

ENCT collects projections at many angles and reconstructs a map of attenuation inside a slice. Simple back-projection spreads each projection back along its ray paths and adds the contributions; the slide shows that this can blur the result. Rotating tube/detector systems collect angular views; helical scanning combines rotation with patient translation. CT still uses X-rays and therefore still involves ionizing radiation.

中文CT采集许多角度的投影，重建切片内部的衰减分布。Simple back-projection（简单反投影）把各投影沿光线路径分摊回去，再把贡献相加；课件显示这种做法可产生模糊。旋转的射线管/探测器采集角度信息；helical scanning（螺旋扫描）把旋转与患者平移结合。CT仍使用X射线，仍涉及电离辐射。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p54–68; T5-0073–0095

B20 · [P2] Digital images and analysis vocabulary数字图像与分析术语

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Teacher emphasis课堂强调Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish sampling from quantization and know 2ᵇ levels; recognise segmentation and convolution.学习抓手：分清采样与量化、会算2ᵇ灰度级，并能认分割与卷积。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T5-0097–0103; Week 5 PDF p70–85

课堂解释数字化、位深、像素和处理任务；更多灰度级不自动带来更多空间细节。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T5-0102–0103; Week 5 PDF p82

“One important one is the convolution filter.”

重点认卷积用邻域权重，不要求背AI软件或论文模型。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T5-0105; Week 5 PDF p87–90

“This part I think it is not very important. You can t it just as reference.”

原字幕“t”保留；范围是混淆矩阵/ROC邻近内容，不是此前全部数字图像基础。

ENKey points
  • Sampling discretizes position;
  • quantization discretizes intensity (2ᵇ levels for b bits).
  • Preprocessing includes denoising/deblurring;
  • convolution combines neighbouring values with kernel weights.
  • Semantic segmentation labels classes;
  • instance segmentation separates objects.
  • Classification assigns a class using features such as shape/intensity.
  • TP/TN mean true positive/negative;
  • FP/FN mean false positive/negative.
  • Diagnostic sensitivity=TP/(TP+FN), specificity=TN/(TN+FP);
  • these differ from calibration slope.
中文必会知识点
  • Sampling采样离散化位置；
  • quantization量化离散化强度（b位对应2ᵇ级）。
  • Preprocessing预处理含去噪/去模糊；
  • convolution卷积用核权重组合邻域值。
  • Semantic segmentation语义分割标类别；
  • instance segmentation实例分割区分对象。
  • Classification分类依据形状/强度等特征给出类别。
  • TP/TN为真阳性/真阴性，FP/FN为假阳性/假阴性。
  • 诊断敏感度=TP/(TP+FN)，特异度=TN/(TN+FP)，不同于校准斜率。

ENStart from zero: A digital image divides space into pixels and brightness into numerical levels. Sampling chooses spatial positions; quantization assigns intensity levels. These are separate choices. With b bits, there are 2ᵇ possible levels: eight bits give 256. In a tiled picture, tile size resembles spatial sampling; available colors resemble quantization. Brightness levels do not create finer spatial resolution.

中文从零理解：数字图像把空间划分为像素，把亮度划分为数字等级。Sampling（采样）选择空间位置；quantization（量化）规定强度等级，这是两个独立选择。b位有2ᵇ个等级，8位为256级。可以类比用有限颜色的瓷砖拼图：砖块尺寸对应空间采样，颜色表对应量化；增加亮度等级不会创造更细的空间分辨率。

ENFollow the mechanism: Preprocessing cleans the input, for example by reducing noise or blur. Convolution forms an output using weighted neighboring values; the weights form a kernel. Segmentation marks regions: semantic segmentation says which class each pixel belongs to, while instance segmentation separates individual objects. Classification assigns a category to an image or object, often using shape, intensity, or learned features. Detecting three separate cells requires instance information, not merely a cell-class label.

中文跟着机制走：Preprocessing（预处理）整理输入，例如减小噪声或模糊。Convolution（卷积）把邻近数值加权组合，权重组成kernel（核）。Segmentation（分割）标出区域：semantic segmentation（语义分割）标每个像素属于哪类，instance segmentation（实例分割）区分一个个对象。Classification（分类）根据形状、强度或学得的特征，给图像或对象分配类别。要认出三个独立细胞，需要实例信息，仅有“细胞类”标签不够。

ENTry an example: For diagnostic decisions, positive means the method predicts the condition is present. TP is a correctly positive case; FN is a missed positive case. Sensitivity=TP/(TP+FN), so detecting eight of ten actual positives gives 80%. TN is correctly negative, and FP a false alarm; specificity=TN/(TN+FP). English sensitivity here means finding actual positive cases, unlike the calibration slope used for a sensor's response versus concentration.

中文用例子理解：诊断判断中，positive（阳性）表示方法预测目标情况存在。TP（真阳性）是正确报阳性，FN（假阴性）是漏掉真实阳性。Sensitivity=TP/(TP+FN)，所以10个真实阳性中检出8个，诊断敏感度是80%。TN（真阴性）是正确报阴性，FP（假阳性）是误报；specificity=TN/(TN+FP)。这里sensitivity表示找出真实阳性的能力，不是传感器响应随浓度变化的校准斜率。

Source / 来源：W5 p70–74; W5 p75–83; W5 p84–86 | T5-0096–0106

S505 · [P3] ROC, processing tasks and sampling rate / ROC、处理任务与采样频率

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Lower priority降低优先级Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know ROC axes and classification/regression vocabulary; do not memorise advanced model implementations.学习抓手：辨认ROC坐标及分类／回归词义即可，不背高级模型实现。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T5-0105; Week 5 PDF p87–90

“This part I think it is not very important. You can t it just as reference.”

局部为混淆矩阵／ROC；并未排除前面的采样、量化或卷积基础。

Explicit final-exam statement老师明确提到期末: T5-0106; Week 5 PDF p91–97

“which will not be on the final exam.”

该句针对末尾新技术/机器视觉应用，而且只说final；不据此声明所有图像处理在Quiz都不考。

ENA ROC curve plots true-positive rate, TP/(TP+FN), against false-positive rate, FP/(FP+TN)=1−specificity, while the decision threshold varies. Moving toward the upper-left corner means more true positives and fewer false alarms. AUC is the area under this curve: the slides show 1 for ideal discrimination and about 0.5 for random ranking. This diagnostic sensitivity differs from a sensor’s calibration slope.

中文ROC曲线在改变判断threshold（阈值）时，画true-positive rate（真阳性率）TP/(TP+FN)，对false-positive rate（假阳性率）FP/(FP+TN)=1−specificity（特异度）。越靠左上角，真阳性多、误报少。AUC是曲线下面积；课件把1画作理想区分、约0.5画作随机排序。这个诊断sensitivity不同于传感器校准斜率。

ENRead image-analysis questions by the output: object detection finds locations such as bounding boxes; segmentation assigns pixel regions; classification gives a category; regression predicts a numerical value; tracking follows an object over time.
