Feature extraction measures properties such as area, shape or intensity. Enhancement/denoising aims to improve the input image, whereas classification interprets it. ML-assisted processing still depends on suitable sensor and image data.

中文图像分析题先看输出：object detection（目标检测）找位置，例如边界框；segmentation（分割）分配像素区域；classification（分类）给类别；regression（回归）预测数值；tracking（跟踪）追踪对象随时间的变化。Feature extraction（特征提取）量出面积、形状或强度等性质。Enhancement/denoising（增强/去噪）改善输入图像，分类则解释图像。机器学习辅助处理仍依赖合适的传感器与图像数据。

ENSampling frequency is samples per unit time, f_s=1/Δt, not the number of times an image is averaged. Repeating and averaging suitably independent noisy measurements can reduce random noise, but this is a separate operation. Bit depth controls the number of intensity levels; spatial pixel spacing controls spatial sampling. Increasing any one of these does not automatically improve all definitions of resolution or eliminate systematic error.

中文Sampling frequency（采样频率）是单位时间的采样数，f_s=1/Δt，不是把图像平均了多少次。重复并平均合适的独立噪声测量，可减小随机噪声，但这是另一个操作。Bit depth（位深）控制强度等级数，空间像素间距控制空间采样。增加其中一项不会自动改善所有“分辨率”，也不会消除系统误差。

Source / 来源：Week 5 PDF p76–91; T5-0100–0106

ENClarify the concept: Use the denominator to distinguish diagnostic metrics: recall/sensitivity=TP/(TP+FN), among actual positives; precision=TP/(TP+FP), among predicted positives; specificity=TN/(TN+FP), among actual negatives; accuracy=(TP+TN)/all cases. A high value of one metric does not guarantee all others are high. The course directly emphasizes the confusion matrix and sensitivity/specificity; precision and accuracy here are supporting terminology.

中文把概念讲清：看分母辨认诊断指标：recall/sensitivity（召回率/敏感度）=TP/(TP+FN)，看真实阳性；precision（精确率）=TP/(TP+FP)，看预测阳性；specificity（特异度）=TN/(TN+FP)，看真实阴性；accuracy（准确率）=(TP+TN)/全部案例。一项高不保证其他项都高。课程直接介绍混淆矩阵与敏感度/特异度，precision与accuracy这里作为辅助词汇。

Source / 来源：README §5.4; Week 5 PDF p84–86; T5-0103–0105; precision is README supporting extension, formula checked by TP/FP definitions

Week 6 learning block: Electrochemical biosensors / 第6学习组：电化学生物传感器

Week 6 concept map / 第6周知识框架

ENChapter logic: Link chemical recognition or molecular charge to the electrical variable measured by the sensor.

中文本章主线：把化学识别或分子电荷，与传感器实际测得的电量连起来。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Redox and reference 氧化还原与参比 Oxidation loses electrons, reduction gains them; electrode potential is relative to a stated reference. 氧化失电子、还原得电子；电极电位相对给定参比。 Details / 详解
Potentiometric/ion-selective sensing 电位型/离子选择感测 Read potential at negligible current; an ideal Nernst response is logarithmic in ion activity. 在极小测量电流下读电位，理想Nernst响应与离子活度呈对数关系。 Details / 详解
Amperometry and glucose 安培型与葡萄糖 Controlled potential measures reaction current; distinguish enzyme recognition from electrode readout and GOx generations. 控制电位测反应电流，区分酶识别、电极读出与GOx各代路线。 Details / 详解
Charge and stoichiometry 电荷与反应计量 For constant current Q=It; with complete charge collection Q=z nₐF. 恒定电流Q=It；完全收集电荷时Q=z nₐF。 Details / 详解
Conductance and impedance 电导与阻抗 G=1/R; AC impedance adds magnitude, phase and frequency dependence. G=1/R；交流阻抗还包含幅值、相位及频率依赖。 Details / 详解
FET, nanopore and capacitance FET、纳米孔与电容 Gate charge changes a channel; pore passage changes ionic current; dielectric/geometry changes capacitance. 栅电荷改变沟道，穿孔改变离子电流，介电/几何变化改变电容。 Details / 详解
Molecular charge 分子电荷 DNA is typically negative; protein net charge varies with pH/pI, so bound charge is not universally positive or negative. DNA通常负电，蛋白净电荷随pH/pI变，因此结合电荷并非普遍同正或同负。 Details / 详解
Device fabrication 器件制造 Photolithography patterns resist; etching removes, deposition adds, and PDMS molding copies microstructures. 光刻形成胶图案，刻蚀去材料、沉积加材料，PDMS模制复制微结构。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX424 Cell potential and electrochemical Nernst equation, FX425 Ideal ion-selective response andpH, FX426 Reference-electrode conversion, FX427 Faraday charge, electron moles and counts, FX428 Analyte stoichiometry, mass and current efficiency, FX429 Glucose-strip background subtraction, FX430 Conductance, conductivity and geometry, FX431 Parallel-plate capacitance model, FX432 R,C,L complex impedances, FX433 Combining AC impedances, FX434 SeriesRC capacitor voltage divider, FX435 Pure parallelRC and Bode conventions, FX436 Series resistance with a parallelRC/Nyquist semicircle.

中文本章公式定位：FX424 电池电势与电化学能斯特式；FX425 理想离子选择响应与pH；FX426 参比电极换算；FX427 法拉第电荷、电子摩尔与个数；FX428 分析物计量、质量与电流效率；FX429 葡萄糖试纸背景扣除；FX430 电导、电导率与几何；FX431 平行板电容模型；FX432 电阻、电容、电感复阻抗；FX433 交流阻抗串并联；FX434 串联RC的电容分压；FX435 纯并联RC与Bode约定；FX436 串联电阻加并联RC／Nyquist半圆。

B21 · [P2] Redox and reference-relative potential氧化还原与相对电位

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know oxidation loses electrons, reduction gains them, and electrode potentials are relative to a reference.学习抓手：认出氧化失电子、还原得电子，电极电位相对参考测量。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0011–0018; T6-0034–0040; Week 6 PDF p13–18, 31–40

电极角色和相对电位是测量基础；正负极不能无条件代替阳极／阴极定义。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T6-0036–0038; Week 6 PDF p35–36

“Basically, this is just a reference for you to take a look.”

范围是电位表和W6的Nernst背景推导；不排除W7以后膜电位的概念。

ENKey points
  • Oxidation loses electrons;
  • reduction gains electrons.
  • Oxidation occurs at the anode and reduction at the cathode;
  • electrode polarity depends on cell type.
  • Electrode potential is measured relative to a reference.
  • Nernst-type equilibrium potentials depend logarithmically on ion activities, not linearly on concentration.
  • When using reduction-potential tables, Ecell=Ecathode−Eanode;
  • do not mix oxidation and reduction signs.
中文必会知识点
  • Oxidation氧化失电子；
  • reduction还原得电子。
  • Anode阳极发生氧化、cathode阴极发生还原，但正负极性取决于电池类型。
  • 电极电位相对参比测量。
  • Nernst型平衡电位与离子活度的对数有关，并非与浓度直接成正比。
  • 使用还原电位表时Ecell=Ecathode−Eanode，不要混用氧化与还原电位符号。

ENStart from zero: An oxidation–reduction reaction transfers electrons. Oxidation loses electrons; reduction gains them. The two occur together because electrons need an acceptor. Use the memory aid OIL RIG: Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain. The anode is where oxidation occurs, and the cathode where reduction occurs. Their positive or negative polarity depends on the cell type, so polarity alone is a poor universal definition.

中文从零理解：Oxidation–reduction（氧化还原）反应转移电子：oxidation氧化失去电子，reduction还原得到电子。两者同时发生，因为释放的电子必须被某处接受。可记OIL RIG：Oxidation Is Loss，Reduction Is Gain。Anode（阳极）发生氧化，cathode（阴极）发生还原；它们的正负极性取决于电池类型，因此不能只靠正负极性作普遍定义。

ENFollow the mechanism: An electrode potential tells us its electrical potential relative to a reference, just as a height needs a chosen ground level. Specify the reference before comparing readings. Ion-selective electrodes respond to particular ions, and their equilibrium potential follows a logarithmic activity relationship. Activity is an effective chemical amount; in suitable dilute approximations it relates to concentration. It is not a universally straight-line voltage-versus-concentration response.

中文跟着机制走：电极电位是相对于reference（参比）的电位，好比高度需要选一个地面基准。比较读数前必须知道参比。Ion-selective electrode（离子选择电极）响应特定离子，其平衡电位遵循与activity（活度）的对数关系。活度可理解为有效化学量，在合适稀溶液近似下与浓度关联，但电压对浓度并非普遍直线关系。

ENTry an example: If a question supplies both electrode values as reduction potentials, calculate Ecell=Ecathode−Eanode. For example, 0.8 V minus 0.2 V gives 0.6 V. Do not reverse another sign because oxidation occurs there; both values already use a reduction convention. Exam clues are loss of electrons for oxidation, gain for reduction, stable reference for potential measurement, and logarithmic rather than linear dependence for Nernst-type equilibrium sensing.

中文用例子理解：若题目提供的两电极数值都是reduction potentials（还原电位），计算Ecell=Ecathode−Eanode。例如0.8 V减0.2 V得到0.6 V。不能因为某电极实际发生氧化，就在相减之外再随意翻转一次符号；表格已使用统一的还原约定。英文辨认：loss of electrons是氧化，gain是还原；stable reference是电位测量基准；Nernst型平衡传感是对数而非线性依赖。

Source / 来源：W6 p13–18; W6 p31–35, p38; W6 p36; W6 p37–40; W6 p41–46 | T6-0011–0018, T6-0034–0043

S601 · [P2] Electron flow, ionic flow and wearable chemical sensing / 电子流、离子流与可穿戴化学检测

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate electron flow in wires from ionic flow in solution; repeated monitoring needs reversibility and stable readout.学习抓手：分清导线电子流与溶液离子流；连续监测需要可重复响应及稳定读出。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0011–0016; T6-0048–0049; Week 6 PDF p13–17, 44–46

课堂用化学电子转移及汗液离子反复解释；一次诊断也需要准确性／再现性，不能照录为不需要。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: T6-0102–0105; Week 6 PDF p87–89

柔性无线系统为应用项目背景，无需背通信模块和材料工艺。

ENIn an electrochemical cell, electrons travel through the metal/electrical circuit and ions carry charge in the solution. A salt bridge or porous junction permits ionic charge balance without requiring the two bulk solutions to mix freely. The bridge does not replace the external wire that carries electrons. Redox links the chemical reactions at the electrodes to the electrical measurement.

中文电化学电池中，电子通过金属/电路移动，溶液里由离子传递电荷。Salt bridge（盐桥）或porous junction（多孔接界）允许离子配平电荷，而不必让两份溶液自由混合。盐桥不能代替传递电子的外部导线。氧化还原把电极处化学反应与电测量联系起来。

ENWearable chemical sensors can analyze ions or metabolites in sweat, tears or saliva; they are different from electrodes recording ECG/EEG voltages. Continuous monitoring requires repeatable responses when the target rises and falls, not only a single irreversible detection. Printed flexible electrodes and wireless electronics make integration convenient, but a chemical signal measured in one body fluid is not automatically the same measurement as blood concentration.

中文可穿戴化学传感器可分析汗、泪液或唾液中的离子或代谢物；它们不同于记录ECG/EEG电位的电极。Continuous monitoring（连续监测）需要目标上升与下降时都可重复响应，不只是一次不可逆检测。印刷柔性电极与无线电路便于集成，但某一种体液的化学信号并不自动等同于血液浓度的测量。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p3, 6–17, 44–46, 87–89; T6-0002–0016, T6-0047–0049, T6-0102–0105

S602 · [P3] Standard potential, Nernst equation and reference conversion / 标准电位、Nernst式与参比换算

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know potentials require a reference and Nernst dependence is logarithmic; use supplied data without memorising tables.学习抓手：知道电位需参比、Nernst是对数依赖；按给定数据算，不背电位表。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T6-0036; Week 6 PDF p35

“Basically, this is just a reference for you to take a look.”

标准电位表在该处被称reference。

Locally deemphasised by teacher老师局部降低优先级: T6-0038; Week 6 PDF p36

“Here is another supporting information as a reference.”

仅降低W6温度／Nernst背景推导的优先级；不代表后续膜电位Nernst概念排除。

ENStandard reduction potential E° compares a half-reaction’s tendency to gain electrons under specified standard conditions. The standard hydrogen electrode, SHE, is assigned 0 V. In the course table, a more positive reduction potential indicates the oxidized form is a stronger electron acceptor/oxidizing agent. Do not confuse a stronger oxidizing agent with a species that itself loses electrons.

中文Standard reduction potential（标准还原电位）E°在规定标准条件下比较半反应接受电子的倾向。Standard hydrogen electrode（SHE，标准氢电极）被规定为0 V。课程表中，还原电位更正表示对应氧化态是更强的电子接受者/oxidizing agent（氧化剂）。强氧化剂是接受电子的物种，不是“它自己失电子”。

ENFor a specified redox reaction, E=E°−(RT/nF)lnQ; at 25 °C, E=E°−(0.05916 V/n)log₁₀Q. Here n is electrons transferred in the written reaction, and Q is the reaction quotient built from activities with their stoichiometric powers. It is not the Q used for resonator quality factor or electrical charge. With E° and n fixed, increasing Q by ten lowers E by 0.05916/n V under this convention.

中文给定氧化还原反应时，E=E°−(RT/nF)lnQ；25 °C时，E=E°−(0.05916 V/n)log₁₀Q。n是所写反应转移的电子数，Q是按计量指数用活度组成的reaction quotient（反应商），不是共振器品质因数Q，也不是电荷量Q。在此约定下，E°、n固定，Q增大十倍使E降低0.05916/n V。

ENChanging the reference changes the numerical reading, not the physical indicator electrode: E(indicator versus new reference)=E(indicator versus SHE)−E(new reference versus SHE). In the slide, 0.750 V versus SHE becomes 0.750−0.197=0.553 V versus Ag/AgCl, or 0.750−0.2444≈0.506 V versus saturated calomel. Use the reference values stated in the question, since they depend on reference conditions.

中文改变参比会改变数值读数，并没有改变指示电极本身：E（指示电极相对新参比）=E（指示电极相对SHE）−E（新参比相对SHE）。课件中，相对SHE的0.750 V换成Ag/AgCl为0.750−0.197=0.553 V；换成饱和甘汞为0.750−0.2444≈0.506 V。应使用题目给定参比值，因为它们依赖参比条件。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p35–38; T6-0036–0039

C18 · [P1] Electrochemical sensing modes电化学传感模式

P1 First passP1 先掌握Repeated explanation反复讲解Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Match potentiometric→potential, amperometric→current and conductometric→conductance; pH sensing is potentiometric.学习抓手：会配对电位型→电位、安培型→电流、电导型→电导；pH测量归电位型。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0019–0022; T6-0032–0033; Week 6 PDF p19–21

老师在章节总结和后面讲解中反复按测量变量分类。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T6-0042–0043; Week 6 PDF p41–43

“A PH sensor is a potential metric sensor because it measures the changes of the potential”

ASR potential metric对应potentiometric。只强调老师的开头解释，后面视频旁白不是额外考试承诺。

ENKey points
  • Potentiometric sensing reads potential, ideally with negligible measurement current.
  • Amperometric sensing measures current at a controlled potential.
  • Conductometric sensing reads conductance;
  • impedimetric sensing reads the response to an AC perturbation.
  • Identify the measured variable before doing arithmetic.
中文必会知识点
  • Potentiometric测电位，理想情况下测量电流极小；
  • amperometric在控制电位下测电流；
  • conductometric测电导；
  • impedimetric测交流扰动的响应。
  • 先识别被测量，再计算。

ENStart from zero: Electrical sensing can measure different things. Voltage, or potential difference, describes electrical energy per unit charge; current describes how much charge passes each second. A water analogy helps: pressure difference resembles voltage, while flow rate resembles current. Electricity is not literally flowing water, but the analogy explains why measuring a driving difference and measuring a flow are different tasks.

中文从零理解：电传感可以测不同物理量。Voltage（电压，即电位差）描述单位电荷对应的电能差；current（电流）描述每秒通过多少电荷。可用水流类比：压力差像电压，流量像电流。电并不真的等于流动的水，但这个比喻能帮助区分“测推动差异”和“测通过的量”是两种任务。

ENFollow the mechanism: Potentiometric sensing measures potential with very little measurement current, like checking pressure without drawing much water. Amperometric sensing controls electrode potential and measures reaction current. Conductometric sensing measures ease of electrical flow. Impedimetric sensing applies a small alternating signal and measures both response size and timing. Match the method to its readout before thinking about the biological target.

中文跟着机制走：Potentiometric（电位型）在测量电流极小时测电位，好比测压力而尽量不抽走水。Amperometric（安培型）控制电极电位，测反应电流；conductometric（电导型）测电流通过的容易程度；impedimetric（阻抗型）施加小交流信号，同时看响应大小及时间相位。先对应测量量，再考虑它测哪一种生物目标。

ENTry an example: In a three-electrode system, the working electrode is the sensing reaction site. The reference electrode provides a stable potential baseline and ideally carries negligible current. The counter electrode carries the balancing current. A reference is like a reliable zero mark on a ruler, not the main reaction electrode. Exam clues are potential for potentiometry, current at controlled potential for amperometry, and AC response for impedance.

中文用例子理解：三电极系统中，working electrode（工作电极）是感测反应位置；reference electrode（参比电极）提供稳定电位基准，理想情况下几乎不承载电流；counter electrode（对电极）承担配平电流。参比像尺子上的可靠零点，不是主要反应电极。英文辨认：potential对应电位型；current at controlled potential对应安培型；AC response（交流响应）对应阻抗型。

ENExam wording: Working, reference and counter electrodes have different roles. A reference electrode provides a stable potential reference. In a three-electrode arrangement, the counter electrode carries the balancing current while the reference ideally carries negligible current.

中文英文读题抓手：Working、reference和counter electrode作用不同。参比电极提供稳定电位基准。在三电极结构中，对电极承担配平电流，参比电极理想情况下电流极小。

Source / 来源：W6 p13–18; W6 p19–21; W6 p37–40 | T6-0011–0022, T6-0038–0040

ENRead the figure: The potentiostat controls WE potential relative to RE while measuring the reaction current through the WE–CE path. RE provides a stable potential reference and its sensing input draws approximately no current. This standard WE/RE/CE arrangement differs from the pictured glucose strip with two working contacts and one reference contact.

中文读图：Potentiostat（恒电位仪）控制WE相对RE的电位，并测量WE–CE回路中的反应电流。RE提供稳定电位参考，其测量输入近似不取电流。这个标准WE/RE/CE结构，与后面血糖试纸图中的“两根工作接点＋一根参比接点”要区分。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p37–40; original teaching schematic / 自绘教学示意，非实验数据

S603 · [P1] Ion-selective membranes, pH and ISFET / 离子选择膜、pH与ISFET

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Identify the ion-selective membrane and pH→H⁺ activity→potential; ISFET is an additional implementation.学习抓手：会认离子选择膜及pH→H⁺活度→电位；ISFET为补充实现。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T6-0042–0043; Week 6 PDF p41–43

“A PH sensor is a potential metric sensor because it measures the changes of the potential”

老师开头强调pH的potentiometric分类；后面视频旁白的历史／ISFET不能当额外考试承诺。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0040–0042; Week 6 PDF p39–43

连续说明膜赋予选择性；并不是只靠普通电极就自动识别单一离子。

ENAn ion-selective electrode, ISE, combines a selective membrane response with an approximately open-circuit potential measurement relative to a stable reference. The sensing membrane favors a target ion; it is not simply a perfectly selective size sieve for every molecule. Activity means effective concentration after considering interactions, expressed relative to a standard state as a dimensionless quantity for the logarithm; in a suitable dilute approximation it corresponds to concentration. A bare metal electrode alone does not automatically identify which of many dissolved species caused the signal.

中文Ion-selective electrode（ISE，离子选择电极）把选择膜响应与近似开路电位测量结合，并相对稳定参比读数。感测膜优先响应目标离子，并不只是对所有分子都完美按大小筛选。Activity（活度）可理解为考虑相互作用后的有效浓度，再以标准态归一化为对数中使用的无量纲量；合适的稀溶液近似下与浓度对应。裸金属电极本身也不会自动认出许多溶解物中究竟哪种引起信号。

ENA potentiometric pH sensor responds to hydrogen-ion activity, with pH=−log₁₀a_H⁺. Ten times greater H⁺ activity lowers pH by one. A glass membrane and a fixed internal reference create a potential related to the outside solution. For an ideal monovalent ion at 25 °C, the potential change has magnitude about 59 mV per tenfold activity change; the sign depends on the defined electrode/potential convention.

中文电位型pH传感器响应氢离子活度，pH=−log₁₀a_H⁺。H⁺活度增大十倍，pH降低1。玻璃膜与固定内部参比形成与外部溶液有关的电位。理想单价离子在25 °C时，每十倍活度变化对应约59 mV的电位变化大小；正负方向取决于电极/电位定义约定。

ENIn an ion-sensitive FET, ISFET, the sensing layer’s ion-dependent potential acts as a gate influence, and the transistor converts it to channel-current change. Reading channel current does not mean that the analyte must undergo amperometric redox at the electrode. Distinguish the chemical sensing mechanism at the gate from the electrical readout of the transistor.

中文Ion-sensitive FET（ISFET，离子敏感场效应管）中，感测层随离子变化的电位形成栅极作用，晶体管把它转成沟道电流变化。读出沟道电流不表示分析物必须在电极上发生安培型氧化还原。要区分栅极处的化学感测机制与晶体管的电读出方式。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p39–46; T6-0040–0049

ENRead the figure: Find Reference electrode in the solution, the Capture/sensor layer on the transistor, and Source/Drain at the channel ends. Ions or bound analytes change the surface/gate potential; the transistor converts that change into a change in channel current. The reference electrode establishes the solution potential. The arrow is current along the transistor channel, not a stream of target ions entering the electronic circuit.

中文读图：找溶液中的Reference electrode参比电极、晶体管表面的Capture/sensor layer捕获/传感层，以及沟道两端Source/Drain源漏。离子或结合的目标改变表面/栅电位，晶体管把它变成沟道电流变化。参比电极提供溶液电位基准。箭头是沿晶体管沟道的电流，不是目标离子流进电子电路。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p45; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B22 · [P3] Microfabrication and PDMS微加工与PDMS

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognise lithography, etching, deposition and PDMS moulding by what each step does.学习抓手：按每一步作用认光刻、刻蚀、沉积与PDMS模塑。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: T6-0023–0033; Week 6 PDF p22–30

讲述器件怎么造的背景；没有观察到独立Quiz承诺或必做课后例题。

ENKey points
  • Photolithography patterns photoresist using exposure and development;
  • etching removes selected material, whereas deposition adds material.
  • PDMS (polydimethylsiloxane) soft lithography casts and cures a polymer on a master, then peels and bonds it to form structures such as microchannels.
  • Know each step’s function and the integration advantage;
  • detailed recipes and equipment settings are secondary.
中文必会知识点
  • Photolithography光刻通过曝光、显影形成光刻胶图案；
  • etching刻蚀去除选定材料，deposition沉积添加材料。
  • PDMS聚二甲基硅氧烷软光刻在母模上浇注、固化聚合物，再剥离、键合，可形成微通道。
  • 认识各步骤功能与集成优势即可，详细配方和设备参数次要。

ENStart from zero: Microfabrication makes small, patterned structures such as electrodes and fluid channels. The challenge is processing selected places rather than covering everything uniformly. Photolithography solves a patterning task using light-sensitive photoresist. A mask determines where exposure reaches it, and development creates the pattern. Which exposed or unexposed parts remain depends on the resist type; there is no single rule for every process.

中文从零理解：Microfabrication（微加工）制作微小且有图案的结构，例如电极和流体通道。困难在于只在指定位置处理材料，而不是全部均匀覆盖。Photolithography（光刻）用对光敏感的photoresist（光刻胶）形成图案；mask（掩模）决定哪些位置被曝光，development（显影）形成所需图案。曝光或未曝光部分哪种留下取决于光刻胶类型，不存在适用于所有工艺的单一规则。

ENFollow the mechanism: Etching removes selected material; deposition adds material. PDMS is a flexible polymer used in soft lithography. Liquid polymer is placed over a patterned master, cured to become solid, peeled away, and bonded to another surface to make enclosed channels. Think of making a molded stamp and sealing it onto a floor. The analogy explains shape copying; actual bonding and material compatibility still matter.

中文跟着机制走：Etching（刻蚀）移除指定材料，deposition（沉积）添加材料。PDMS是一种柔性聚合物，常用于soft lithography（软光刻）。把液态聚合物放在有图案的master（母模）上，cure（固化）成为固体，再剥离并与另一表面bond（键合），形成封闭通道。可类比制作模压印章再把它封到地板上；比喻解释复制形状，但实际键合及材料兼容仍很重要。

ENTry an example: A microfluidic channel guides a small fluid volume past a sensing surface, supporting controlled handling and integration. It does not itself guarantee perfect biological recognition or a lower detection limit. For English matching questions, exposure and development point to photolithography; material removal to etching; material addition to deposition; master, casting, curing, and peeling to PDMS molding. Understand each action before memorizing fabrication recipes or equipment settings.

中文用例子理解：Microfluidic channel（微流控通道）让少量液体沿指定路径流过感测表面，有利于受控处理和集成；但它本身不保证完美生物识别或更低检测限。英文配对题中，exposure与development对应光刻；material removal对应刻蚀；material addition对应沉积；master、casting、curing、peeling对应PDMS模制。先理解各步骤做成什么，再考虑长的工艺配方和设备参数。

Source / 来源：W6 p22–30 | T6-0023–0033

S604 · [P3] Positive/negative resist, etching and lift-off / 正负光刻胶、刻蚀与剥离

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know which resist region remains after development and distinguish etching from lift-off.学习抓手：辨认显影后正／负胶哪部分留下，并分清刻蚀与剥离。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: T6-0027–0033; Week 6 PDF p24–30

制造流程背景，未发现独立本Quiz承诺；不要把曝光本身当立即去除全部胶。

ENPhotoresist is a light-sensitive material that makes a temporary pattern. After exposure and development, positive resist removes the exposed regions, whereas negative resist retains/crosslinks the exposed regions. A mask therefore produces opposite resist patterns with the two types. Exposure patterns the resist; it does not by itself mean that the underlying silicon has already been etched.

中文Photoresist（光刻胶）是用来制作临时图案的光敏材料。曝光、显影后，positive resist（正胶）去掉曝光区域；negative resist（负胶）使曝光区域保留/交联。同一个掩模因此可产生相反胶图案。曝光先形成胶图案，不等于下面的硅已经被刻掉。

ENEtching removes exposed substrate/material through the patterned mask. Wet etching uses liquid chemical reagents; dry etching uses processes such as plasma. Deposition adds material. In lift-off, material is deposited over a resist pattern, then removing the resist also removes the material on top of it, leaving the material deposited in the intended openings. Lift-off is not simply another word for etching the substrate.

中文Etching（刻蚀）通过图案掩模去除露出的基底/材料。Wet etching（湿法刻蚀）使用液体化学试剂，dry etching（干法刻蚀）可用等离子体等过程。Deposition（沉积）添加材料。Lift-off（剥离）先在胶图案上沉积，再去掉胶及胶上材料，留下预定开口中的沉积物；它不是“刻蚀基底”的同义词。

ENIn PDMS soft lithography, a patterned master is the mold; liquid polymer precursor is poured, cured and peeled off to reproduce microstructures. The cured structure can then be assembled/bonded into a microfluidic device. PDMS is a polymer, not silicon; soft lithography copies a master’s pattern rather than exposing every final polymer device as if it were silicon photolithography. Biocompatibility means compatibility with the intended biological sample/tissue use. Visible transparency supports optical readout; chemical modification adds recognition layers. Material choice also balances flexibility and manufacturability.

中文PDMS soft lithography（软光刻）用图案母模作模具，倒入液态聚合物前体、固化、剥离，复制微结构；再装配/键合成微流控器件。PDMS是聚合物，不是硅；软光刻复制母模图案，并非把每个最终聚合物器件都当作硅光刻来曝光。 Biocompatibility（生物相容性）指与预定生物样品或组织用途兼容；可见光透明便于光学读出，chemical modification（化学修饰）便于添加识别层。材料选择还要兼顾柔性与可制造性。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p24–30; T6-0026–0033, T6-0083

C19 · [P1] Glucose biosensor: recognition and electrical readout / 葡萄糖传感器：识别与电读出

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Trace glucose→GOx reaction→H₂O₂-related electrode reaction→current, and understand matched background subtraction.学习抓手：能讲清葡萄糖→GOx反应→H₂O₂相关电极反应→电流，并理解匹配背景扣除。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T6-0070–0071; Week 6 PDF p55, 57–59

“These two equations are quite important.”

重点是识别与间接电读出的两步机制；不能推广成所有安培传感器都必须测H₂O₂。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0051–0053; T6-0064–0073; Week 6 PDF p49, 55–59

多次用glucose说明酶、电极、电流的关系；具体施加电压和所有反应式不作为统一常数背。

ENKey points
  • In the taught glucose-oxidase example, an enzymatic reaction links glucose to an electroactive product.
  • An amperometric electrode converts the product-related reaction into current.
  • A paired background channel can help subtract non-target electroactive interference under matched conditions.
中文必会知识点
  • 课程的glucose oxidase示例中，酶反应把葡萄糖与电活性产物联系起来。
  • 安培型电极把产物相关反应转为电流。
  • 条件匹配时，配对背景通道可帮助扣除非目标电活性干扰。

ENStart from zero: An enzyme is a biological catalyst: it speeds a suitable chemical reaction rather than being the target we want to count. Glucose oxidase, GOx, helps react glucose. This recognition step makes the response linked to glucose, but a reaction alone is not yet a number on a meter. An electrode and electronics are needed to convert chemical activity into a measurable electrical signal.

中文从零理解：Enzyme（酶）是生物催化剂：它加快适合的化学反应，并不是我们要计数的被测目标。Glucose oxidase（GOx，葡萄糖氧化酶）帮助葡萄糖发生反应；这个识别环节让响应与葡萄糖关联，但单有反应还不是仪表上的数字，还需要电极和电路把化学活动转换为可测电信号。

ENFollow the mechanism: In the taught first-generation example, the enzyme reaction generates hydrogen peroxide, H₂O₂. Its electrode reaction transfers electrons, and moving charge produces current. Within a calibrated working range, more glucose can produce a larger current. Think of the enzyme as a selective chemical worker and the electrode as a counter for transferred charge. Neither role alone explains the complete biosensor.

中文跟着机制走：课程第一代例子中，酶反应生成hydrogen peroxide（H₂O₂，过氧化氢）；它在电极上的反应转移电子，电荷移动形成电流。在已校准的有效范围内，更多葡萄糖可对应更大电流。可以把酶比作有选择性的化学工作人员，把电极比作记录转移电荷的计数器；任何一个角色都不能单独解释完整传感器。

ENTry an example: Other electroactive substances also contribute current. A matched channel without GOx can estimate background for subtraction. For illustration, a sensing channel reading 12 μA and a background channel reading 3 μA gives a corrected signal of 9 μA, assuming matched backgrounds. This does not automatically give glucose concentration without calibration. English clues: enzymatic recognition identifies the target; amperometric readout measures current. Other generations can use different electron-transfer pathways.

中文用例子理解：其他electroactive（电活性）物质也可能贡献电流。一个条件匹配、但没有GOx的通道可以估计背景，供相减使用。举例：感测通道12 μA、背景通道3 μA，在背景匹配假设下，校正信号是9 μA；没有校准关系，仍不能直接换算葡萄糖浓度。英文辨认：enzymatic recognition指酶识别目标，amperometric readout指测电流；其他代传感器可使用不同电子传递途径。

ENExam wording: The enzyme recognition step and electrode transduction step are different. The lactate example is called exam-style without a clear Quiz/final distinction. This edition lowers the multi-step mass-to-moles-to-electrons calculation because of the Quiz’s short-calculation guidance; keep the simple reaction–charge–current chain as supporting knowledge.

中文英文读题抓手：酶识别与电极换能是不同步骤。乳酸例题被称为考试类型，但没有明确区分Quiz与期末。本版依据Quiz短计算指导降低质量→摩尔→电子多步计量的优先级，保留反应、电荷与电流的简单关系作为辅助知识。

Source / 来源：W6 p55, p57–59; W6 p58–59; W6 p60 | T6-0060–0073

ENRead the figure: Follow the labels, not just the three contact pads. This example contains an Ag/AgCl reference plus two working electrodes: the first has GOx, the second has no GOx. The first measures glucose-related H₂O₂ current plus interference; the second estimates interference. Subtracting the second current helps isolate the glucose contribution when backgrounds match. These are not the usual working/reference/counter three-electrode roles, and subtraction cannot remove every interference automatically.

中文读图：按标签辨认，别只数三个接触点。本例是Ag/AgCl参比电极加两个工作电极：第一个有GOx，第二个没有GOx。第一个测到葡萄糖相关H₂O₂电流加干扰，第二个估计干扰；背景匹配时两电流相减有助于分离葡萄糖贡献。它不是通常的工作/参比/对电极三种角色组合，也不能自动消除所有干扰。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p58; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B23 · [P2] Three glucose-sensor generations葡萄糖传感器三代原理

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognise oxygen/peroxide, mediator and direct electron-transfer generations; keep the first-generation core clear.学习抓手：认出氧／过氧化氢、介体、直接电子传递三代；先掌握第一代核心。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T6-0071; Week 6 PDF p57

“These two equations are quite important.”

明确重要的两式是GOx/H₂O₂基本路线，已在C19；不能给所有代际化学细节套同一重要性。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: T6-0070; Week 6 PDF p58–59

“This is more on the chemistry side.”

三代比较是简要背景，没有与电子计量例题同等的考试提示。

ENKey points
  • First generation uses the natural oxygen/peroxide pathway;
  • second generation uses an electron-transfer mediator;
  • third generation aims at direct enzyme–electrode electron transfer.
  • In the taught peroxide-oxidation example: H₂O₂ → O₂+2H⁺+2e⁻.
  • A matched electrode without GOx measures background for subtraction.
  • Do not generalize this example into “all amperometric sensors must measure peroxide”.
中文必会知识点
  • 第一代使用天然氧气/过氧化氢途径；
  • 第二代使用electron-transfer mediator电子传递介体；
  • 第三代追求酶—电极直接电子传递。
  • 课程的过氧化氢氧化例子为H₂O₂→O₂+2H⁺+2e⁻。
  • 匹配的无GOx电极测背景以便相减。
  • 不能推广为“所有安培型传感器都必须测过氧化氢”。

ENStart from zero: A glucose enzyme reacts with glucose, but the sensor also needs a route for the reaction's electrons to communicate with an electrode. The three generations describe different routes, not three release dates. First-generation GOx sensing uses the natural oxygen pathway and can monitor oxygen consumption or hydrogen peroxide. In the taught peroxide example, peroxide oxidation produces electrons that are measured as current.

中文从零理解：葡萄糖酶与葡萄糖反应，但传感器还需要把反应中的电子信息传到电极。三代描述不同传递路线，不只是三次产品发布日期。第一代GOx传感使用天然氧气途径，可测耗氧或过氧化氢；课程的过氧化氢例子中，过氧化氢氧化释放电子，形成可测电流。

ENFollow the mechanism: Second-generation sensing uses a mediator, a chemical electron carrier, to shuttle electrons between the enzyme and electrode. Think of a delivery worker connecting two sites. Third-generation sensing aims at direct enzyme–electrode electron transfer, without that shuttle. The analogy concerns electron transport, not physical movement of the enzyme. Direct transfer is a design goal whose practical success depends on the enzyme and electrode arrangement.

中文跟着机制走：第二代使用mediator（介体），即化学电子载体，在酶和电极之间传递电子，可类比连接两处的送货员。第三代追求direct enzyme–electrode electron transfer（酶—电极直接电子传递），不再用这个中间载体。比喻说的是电子传递，不是酶实际被搬运；直接传递是设计目标，能否实际实现取决于酶及电极的布置。

ENTry an example: For the taught reaction H₂O₂→O₂+2H⁺+2e⁻, each peroxide molecule releases two electrons. A background electrode without GOx helps estimate non-target current when conditions are matched. English clues: oxygen or peroxide for first generation, mediator for second, direct electron transfer for third. Amperometric only tells you current is measured at controlled potential; it does not imply that every amperometric biosensor measures peroxide or uses a glucose enzyme.

中文用例子理解：课程反应H₂O₂→O₂+2H⁺+2e⁻中，每个过氧化氢分子释放两个电子。无GOx背景电极在条件匹配时帮助估计非目标电流。英文辨认：oxygen或peroxide提示第一代，mediator提示第二代，direct electron transfer提示第三代。Amperometric只说明在受控电位下测电流，并不代表所有安培型生物传感器都测过氧化氢或使用葡萄糖酶。

Source / 来源：W6 p55, p57–59; W6 p58–59 | T6-0064–0073

ENRead the figure: Read top to bottom and follow the e⁻ arrows to the electrode on the right. First generation uses oxygen/H₂O₂ chemistry; second generation uses a mediator cycling between reduced and oxidized forms (Medred/Medox); third generation seeks direct electron transfer between enzyme and electrode. The changing feature is the electron-transfer route, not three different targets. Direct transfer is a design objective that requires a suitable enzyme–electrode interface.

中文读图：从上往下读，跟着e⁻箭头看到右侧电极。第一代利用氧气/H₂O₂化学；第二代用在还原态与氧化态间循环的介体Medred/Medox传递；第三代追求酶与电极直接电子转移。变的是电子传递路线，不是三种不同目标。直接转移是设计目标，需要合适的酶—电极界面。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p59; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B24 · [P2] Charge, current and reaction stoichiometry / 电荷、电流与反应计量

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Worked example例题练习Teacher emphasis课堂强调Quiz statedQuiz明确提及
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Understand electron stoichiometry and q=It; practise the multi-step mole/mass examples after the first-pass concepts.学习抓手：理解电子计量与q=It；多步浓度/质量/摩尔例题放在第一轮概念之后练。

Slide / classroom worked example课件／课堂例题: Week 6 PDF p51–52, 60; T6-0054–0063

银沉积例1/2及乳酸例3在课堂逐步讲；个数要乘阿伏伽德罗常数，mol不能当个数。 本次作为P2练习；反应式按题给，重点理解电子计量，不必把原多步题当成Quiz保证。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T6-0060; T6-0062–0063; Week 6 PDF p60

“Every year in the exam, you'll at least see one question that is very similar to this.”

老师说往年exam有类似乳酸例，没有在这句专指本次Quiz；旧“5分”不能沿用到用户25题格式。

Explicit Quiz statement老师明确提到Quiz: T6-0058–0059; Week 6 PDF p50–52, 60

“the equation will always be provided on your final exam or your quiz.”

这里声明提供反应式，不承诺这次一定考原乳酸题；练从给定系数读电子比例。

ENKey points
  • For constant current, Q=It.
  • Faraday’s relation is Q=nₑF=z nₐF, where nₑ is moles of electrons, nₐ moles of analyte, z electrons per analyte molecule and F≈96485 C/mol.
  • Obtain z from the stated reaction.
  • Mass-to-moles requires molar mass;
  • counting molecules requires Avogadro’s constant.
  • Keep the short relations;
  • lengthy multi-step examples are lower priority.
中文必会知识点
  • 恒定电流时Q=It。
  • 法拉第关系Q=nₑF=z nₐF，其中nₑ为电子摩尔数，nₐ为分析物摩尔数，z为每分子转移电子数，F≈96485 C/mol。
  • z应由给定反应式获得。
  • 质量换摩尔需摩尔质量，分子数换算需阿伏伽德罗常数。
  • 保留短关系，长的多步例题降低优先级。

ENStart from zero: Charge Q is the amount of electrical charge transferred; current I is its transfer rate. One ampere means one coulomb each second. If current stays constant, Q=It, where t is time. For example, 1 mA for 10 s transfers 0.001 A×10 s=0.010 C. A large current for a short time can transfer the same charge as a small current for a long time.

中文从零理解：Charge Q（电荷量）表示转移多少电荷；current I（电流）表示转移速度。1 ampere（安培）是每秒1 coulomb（库仑）。恒定电流时Q=It，t为时间。例如1 mA持续10 s，转移0.001 A×10 s=0.010 C。大电流持续短时间，与小电流持续长时间，可能转移同样电荷量。

ENFollow the mechanism: Chemical reactions count particles, while electrical instruments measure charge. A mole is a counting unit for many particles. Faraday's constant F≈96485 C/mol connects these descriptions: one mole of electrons carries that charge magnitude. If each analyte molecule transfers z electrons, nₐ moles of analyte transfer z nₐ moles of electrons. Under complete conversion and collection, Q=z nₐF.

中文跟着机制走：化学反应按粒子数量计量，电仪器则测电荷。Mole（摩尔）是表示极大量粒子的计数单位。Faraday's constant（法拉第常数）F≈96485 C/mol把两种描述连起来：一摩尔电子对应这么多电荷量的大小。若每个分析物分子转移z个电子，nₐ摩尔分析物就转移z nₐ摩尔电子；在完全反应且全部电荷被收集的假设下，Q=z nₐF。

ENTry an example: Read z from the stated reaction, not from the analyte's name. If 1 μmol of analyte transfers two electrons per molecule completely, Q=2×10⁻⁶×96485≈0.193 C. To start from mass, first divide by molar mass; do not insert grams directly into the mole formula. English clues: stoichiometry determines electron count, current is charge per time, and integrated charge measures total transfer. These are illustration calculations, not claimed actual Quiz questions.

中文用例子理解：z应从题目给定反应读出，不能只靠分析物名字猜。如果1 μmol分析物完全反应，每个分子转移两个电子，则Q=2×10⁻⁶×96485≈0.193 C。若起点是质量，先除以molar mass（摩尔质量），不能把克直接代入摩尔公式。英文辨认：stoichiometry（反应计量）决定电子数；current是电荷/时间；integrated charge（积分电荷）测总转移量。这些是讲解例子，不声称实际Quiz会出现。

Source / 来源：W6 p50–52; W6 p50–52, p60; W6 p60; W7 p9–13 | T6-0054–0063, T7-0006–0008

B25 · [P2] FET, nanopore and capacitive readout / 场效应管、纳米孔与电容读出

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain how binding changes FET current and how nanopores modulate ionic current; changes can have either sign.学习抓手：解释结合怎样改变FET电流、纳米孔怎样调制离子电流；变化方向可正可负。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0074–0091; Week 6 PDF p64–81

课堂以分子、细胞、FET、DNA序列和人体动作反复说明读出；变化方向依电荷、沟道及条件。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T6-0074; Week 6 PDF p64–65

“Because molecules are charged, this sentence is important.”

正文按实际条件限定为分子净电荷与pH有关，不把“任何分子都非零电荷”作普适事实。

ENKey points
  • In a field-effect transistor (FET) sensor, binding near the gate changes the channel’s electrical response.
  • A nanopore reads ionic-current changes/blockades as molecules interact with the pore.
  • A capacitive sensor reads changes in capacitance, which depends on geometry and dielectric properties (ideal plates: C=εA/d).
  • Conductance G=1/R;
  • conductance and material conductivity are related but different quantities.
中文必会知识点
  • Field-effect transistor（FET，场效应晶体管）传感器中，栅极附近结合改变沟道电响应。
  • Nanopore纳米孔测分子与孔相互作用引起的离子电流变化/阻塞。
  • Capacitive电容型传感测电容变化，电容依赖几何与介电性质（理想平板C=εA/d）。
  • 电导G=1/R；
  • conductance电导与conductivity材料电导率相关，但并非同一物理量。

ENStart from zero: Different electrical sensors turn binding into different circuit changes. In a field-effect transistor, FET, the gate's electrical influence controls current through a channel, like a handle controlling flow. Binding near the sensing gate can alter that influence. The analogy does not mean molecules physically block the channel in every FET sensor; the important idea is electrical control of channel response.

中文从零理解：不同电传感器把结合转成不同电路变化。Field-effect transistor（FET，场效应晶体管）中，gate（栅极）的电作用控制channel（沟道）电流，可类比控制把手影响流动路径。感测栅极附近的结合可改变这种电作用；但不是所有FET中分子都实际堵住沟道，重点是栅极对沟道响应的电控制。

ENFollow the mechanism: A nanopore is a very small opening carrying ionic current through liquid. An interacting molecule changes current, often causing a blockade. Capacitance instead describes charge stored per voltage. For ideal parallel plates, C=εA/d: ε describes dielectric properties, A plate area, and d spacing. Binding can alter the effective dielectric environment or geometry, changing capacitance without being a nanopore blockade.

中文跟着机制走：Nanopore（纳米孔）是允许液体中离子电流通过的极小孔。分子进入或与孔相互作用时会改变电流，常表现为blockade（阻塞）。Capacitance（电容）则描述每单位电压能储存多少电荷。理想平板C=εA/d，ε描述介电性质、A是板面积、d是间距；结合可改变有效介电环境或几何，导致电容变化，不等于纳米孔堵塞。

ENTry an example: Conductance G=1/R measures how easily a particular device conducts, in siemens; resistance R is measured in ohms. Conductivity is a material property; a device’s conductance also depends on its geometry. English matching: gate and channel point to FET; ionic-current blockade to nanopore; stored charge and dielectric changes to capacitive sensing. For ideal plates with ε and A fixed, doubling d halves C. Apply that example only when the stated geometry supports it.

中文用例子理解：Conductance（电导）G=1/R表示一个具体器件导电有多容易，单位siemens（西门子）；电阻R用ohm（欧姆）。Conductivity（电导率）是材料性质，具体器件测量还受几何影响。英文配对：gate和channel对应FET；ionic-current blockade对应纳米孔；stored charge和dielectric changes对应电容传感。理想平板中，ε、A固定，d加倍时C减半；只有题目几何支持该模型时才这样计算。

Source / 来源：W6 p64–74; W6 p75–77; W6 p78–81, p87–90 | T6-0074–0091, T6-0102–0105

S605 · [P2] DNA charge, protein pH response and isoelectric point / DNA电荷、蛋白质pH响应与等电点

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know DNA is typically negative and protein net charge depends on pH relative to pI.学习抓手：认出DNA通常负电；蛋白净电荷要看pH相对pI。

Teacher emphasis老师强调: T6-0074; Week 6 PDF p64–65

“Because molecules are charged, this sentence is important.”

老师强调电荷会影响读出；正文补充pI边界，避免所有蛋白永远同符号的误解。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0074–0076; Week 6 PDF p64–65

正负电荷是电导/FET判断的基础；不需要背每一种蛋白具体pI。

ENDNA is normally negatively charged in the taught aqueous setting because of its phosphate backbone. A protein is not always positive or always negative: its net charge depends on ionizable amino-acid groups and the solution pH. Binding can therefore change an electrical sensor in different directions; “all biomolecules have the same charge” is a poor general rule.

中文课程水溶液背景下，DNA通常因phosphate backbone（磷酸骨架）带负电。蛋白质不是总正电或总负电：净电荷取决于可电离氨基酸基团与溶液pH。因此结合可让电传感信号向不同方向变化，“所有生物分子电荷相同”不是可靠通则。

ENFor a simple ionizable group, pKa is the pH where protonated and deprotonated forms are equally populated. Below pKa, the protonated form is favored; above it, the deprotonated form is favored. Deprotonation of an acidic group changes neutral to negative, while deprotonation of a basic group can change positive to neutral. Losing H⁺ does not always produce the same final charge for every group.

中文简单可电离基团的pKa，是protonated（带质子）与deprotonated（失去质子）形式各占一半的pH。pH低于pKa时带质子形式较多，高于时失去质子形式较多。酸性基团失去质子可从中性变负电；碱性基团可从正电变中性。失去H⁺并不让所有基团都得到同一种最终电荷。

ENThe isoelectric point, pI, is the pH at which a protein has zero net charge. It can still contain both positive and negative groups. In the usual acid–base trend, pH below pI gives a more positive net charge and pH above pI gives a more negative net charge. pI is a whole-protein net-charge condition; it is not the pKa of every side chain.

中文Isoelectric point（pI，等电点）是蛋白质净电荷为零时的pH；它内部仍可同时存在正、负基团。通常酸碱趋势中，pH低于pI时净电荷更正，高于pI时更负。pI描述整个蛋白质的净电荷条件，不是每个侧链的pKa。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p64–65; T6-0074–0075

S607 · [P2] FET polarity, nanopore sequences and motion capacitance / FET方向、纳米孔序列与运动电容

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognise conditional n/p-channel charge response and nanopore ionic-current blockade; motion changes capacitance geometry.学习抓手：会按条件认n/p沟道电荷方向、纳米孔离子电流阻塞；动作可改变电容几何。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0081; T6-0086–0091; Week 6 PDF p71–81

“Your current dropped after you detect it.”

T6-0081紧邻也说依目标可能上升／下降，因此仅作图示案例，不无条件记“结合一定降电流”。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: Week 6 PDF p71–81

具体n/p方向按固定偏置、理想静电门控条件；纳米孔读离子电流，非DNA自行释放电子。

ENIn a FET, source and drain are connected by a conducting channel and the gate controls its carrier population. The same bound charge can affect an n-type electron channel differently from a p-type hole channel. The slides illustrate opposite conductance changes. Therefore, identify carrier type, charge and bias before assigning an increase or decrease; detecting a target does not universally make FET current rise. Under the illustrated ideal electrostatic-gating model at fixed bias, positive bound charge attracts electrons and increases n-type channel conductance, but depletes holes and decreases p-type conductance; negative charge gives the opposite tendency. Screening, bias and device design can modify the actual response.

中文FET中，source（源极）与drain（漏极）之间由导电channel（沟道）连接，gate（栅极）控制载流子数量。同一结合电荷对n-type电子沟道与p-type空穴沟道的影响可不同，课件画出相反电导变化。因此判断增减前要看载流子类型、电荷与偏置；检测到目标不会普遍使FET电流上升。 在图示固定偏置、理想静电门控模型下，结合正电荷吸引电子，使n型沟道电导增大；同时减少空穴，使p型电导减小。负电荷的趋势相反。实际响应还受屏蔽、偏置及器件设计影响。

ENIn nanopore sequencing, a voltage drives ionic current through a small opening. A DNA/RNA strand changes that current as it translocates; the time sequence of current levels is interpreted to infer sequence. The measured current is carried by ions through the pore, not by electrons travelling along the DNA as a metal wire. Read blockade amplitude and duration as electrical features, not as fluorescence colors.

中文纳米孔测序中，电压驱动离子电流通过小孔，DNA/RNA链移过孔时改变该电流；分析随时间的电流水平来推断序列。被测电流由穿孔离子携带，不是电子把DNA当金属线沿链移动。Blockade amplitude（阻塞幅度）与duration（持续时间）是电特征，不是荧光颜色。

ENCapacitive sensing can measure either molecular changes near an interface or mechanical deformation. In the wearable examples, bending or pressure changes effective separation/geometry and therefore capacitance. Such a motion sensor need not use an enzyme or redox reaction. Ask whether the cause is charge/dielectric binding or physical geometry before assigning the sensing principle.

中文电容传感既可测界面附近分子变化，也可测机械形变。可穿戴示例中，弯曲或压力改变有效间距/几何，从而改变电容；这种运动传感器不一定使用酶或氧化还原。判别原理前，先问变化来自电荷/介电结合，还是来自物理几何。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p45, 71–81; T6-0081–0091

B26 · [P2] Impedance, reactance and Bode plots阻抗、电抗与Bode图

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Worked example例题练习Sample Q10样卷Q10Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: First practise capacitive impedance magnitude and frequency trend; keep full Bode plotting for later.学习抓手：先练电容阻抗幅值与频率趋势；完整Bode绘图放后。

Slide / classroom worked example课件／课堂例题: Week 6 PDF p86; T6-0097–0101

例4给500pF、1MHz，|ZC|≈318Ω；这是课件课堂例，不是被指定的课后作业。

Sample Quiz coverageSample Quiz涉及: Sample Quiz p2 Q10; T7-0057–0060

相关背景：样卷器件为电容，但题问线性斜率／LOD，优先见C02/C03；它并未直接考本节阻抗或Bode。

Explicit final-exam statement老师明确提到期末: T6-0096; Week 6 PDF p84–86

“You'll also see it in this year's final exam.”

明确对象是完整阻抗+Bode绘图，不能改写成这次Quiz一定画图。

ENKey points
  • Impedance includes magnitude and phase in AC response.
  • Ideal R is frequency-independent;
  • |XC|=1/(2πfC) decreases with frequency, while XL=2πfL increases.
  • A Bode plot shows magnitude and phase versus logarithmic frequency.
  • A capacitor’s imaginary impedance is not its positive magnitude.
  • Long complex-number combinations and full Bode plotting remain secondary for this Quiz.
中文必会知识点
  • Impedance阻抗包含交流响应的幅值与相位。
  • 理想R不随频率变；
  • |XC|=1/(2πfC)随频率升高减小，XL=2πfL随频率升高增大。
  • Bode图画幅值和相位随对数频率的变化。
  • 电容的虚数阻抗不能等同于其正值幅度。
  • 复杂阻抗组合与完整Bode作图仍为本次Quiz次要内容。

ENStart from zero: An alternating signal repeatedly changes direction. Its response can differ not only in size but also in timing. Impedance describes both: magnitude is the voltage-amplitude to current-amplitude ratio, and phase describes their relative position within a cycle. Imagine two people swinging with the same rhythm but reaching the front at different times. That timing difference resembles phase; it is not merely another amount of resistance.

中文从零理解：交流信号反复改变方向，响应不仅大小可能变化，时间关系也可能变化。Impedance（阻抗）同时描述两者：magnitude（幅值）是电压幅度与电流幅度之比，phase（相位）描述两者在一个周期中的相对位置。可以想象两人荡秋千节奏相同，但到最前方的时刻不同；这个时间差像相位，不只是又多了一个电阻数值。

ENFollow the mechanism: An ideal resistor has frequency-independent resistance. A capacitor stores charge; its reactance magnitude |XC|=1/(2πfC) decreases when frequency f increases. An inductor opposes changing current; XL=2πfL increases with frequency. C and L are capacitance and inductance. In complex-number notation, capacitive impedance has a negative imaginary part, not simply a positive resistance. Doubling f halves capacitive reactance magnitude when C stays fixed.

中文跟着机制走：理想电阻的阻值不随频率变化。电容储存电荷，其电抗幅值|XC|=1/(2πfC)随频率f提高而减小；电感阻碍电流变化，XL=2πfL随频率提高而增加。C和L分别是电容与电感量。在复数表示中，电容阻抗有负虚部，不是一个单纯的正电阻。C固定时，f加倍，电容电抗幅值减半。

ENTry an example: A Bode plot shows magnitude and phase against logarithmic frequency, revealing behavior across a wide frequency range. Do not add resistance and reactance magnitudes as ordinary numbers. For an ideal series 3 Ω resistor and capacitor impedance −j4 Ω, total magnitude is √(3²+4²)=5 Ω, not 7 Ω. Here j marks the imaginary direction. For this Quiz, understand trends and phase before lengthy complex-number algebra.

中文用例子理解：Bode plot（波特图）画响应幅值及相位随对数频率的变化，方便观察很宽频率范围内的行为。不要把电阻和电抗的幅值当普通数字相加。理想串联中，电阻3 Ω、电容阻抗−j4 Ω，总幅值为√(3²+4²)=5 Ω，不是7 Ω；j标记虚数方向。本次Quiz先理解趋势和相位，再考虑长的复数代数。

Source / 来源：W6 p82–85; W6 p84–86; W6 p86; W7 p70–78 | T6-0092–0101, T7-0073–0081

S606 · [P2] Interface impedance, Nyquist plots and cell coverage / 界面阻抗、Nyquist图与细胞覆盖

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Read Nyquist real/negative-imaginary axes and identify Rₛ, Rct and Cdl before detailed circuits.学习抓手：先会读Nyquist实部／负虚部轴，并认出Rₛ、Rct、Cdl，再看详细电路。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0075–0080; Week 6 PDF p66–70

课堂反复用细胞／分子覆盖改变电流和阻抗；本节Nyquist坐标不是Bode横轴频率。

Supporting lecture content课件辅助内容: Week 6 PDF p66–70, 84–86

半圆与界面参数帮助读原图；完整多频点Bode期末声明在B26，不把它套到所有Nyquist细节。

ENAn impedance biosensor can change because of the liquid’s bulk conduction or the electrode–liquid interface. In the slide’s equivalent circuit, R_s represents solution resistance. C_dl is double-layer capacitance: opposite charges accumulate on the two sides of the interface, storing charge like a capacitor. R_ct describes difficulty of charge transfer across the interface; a larger value means harder transfer. W denotes a diffusion contribution, associated with chemical species moving toward or away from the surface. Binding can impede a redox probe’s access and increase R_ct in this example; not every sensor must change by the same component or in the same direction.

中文阻抗生物传感器可因液体内部导电改变，也可因电极—液体界面改变。课件等效电路中，R_s是溶液电阻。C_dl是double-layer capacitance（双电层电容）：界面两侧聚集相反电荷，像电容一样储存电荷。R_ct描述跨界面电荷转移的困难程度，越大表示越难转移。W表示diffusion（扩散）贡献，与化学物种移向或离开表面有关。示例中结合可妨碍氧化还原探针接近并提高R_ct；但不是每个传感器都必然改变同一元件或同一方向。

ENA Nyquist impedance plot places real impedance Z′ on the horizontal axis and commonly −Z″ on the vertical axis. Each point corresponds to a different measurement frequency; frequency is not the horizontal coordinate. In the simple semicircle example, its width relates to R_ct, and the real-axis offset relates to R_s. A Bode plot instead shows magnitude and phase versus frequency. The name Nyquist here is distinct from the optical sampling theorem.

中文Nyquist impedance plot（Nyquist阻抗图）横轴是阻抗实部Z′，纵轴常为−Z″，即负虚部。各点对应不同测量频率，但横坐标本身不是频率。简单半圆示例中，半圆宽度与R_ct有关，实轴起始偏移与R_s有关。Bode图则把幅值和相位画成随频率变化。这里的Nyquist图要与光学采样定理区分。

ENThe cell-coverage examples use a resistive barrier: more surface coverage obstructs ionic current and lowers conductance under the shown conditions. The measured change can follow cell adhesion, spreading or growth. This is an electrical observation of the interface, not proof that every covered surface has the same biological identity. For a particular sensor, interpret the calibrated direction and background rather than assuming “more analyte always means more current.”

中文细胞覆盖示例利用电阻性屏障：图示条件下，覆盖更多会阻碍离子电流、降低电导。测量可追踪细胞黏附、铺展或生长。这是在电学上观察界面，不自动证明所有覆盖表面都具有同一生物身份。具体传感器要按已校准的方向及背景解释，不能假设“目标越多，电流一定越大”。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p66–70, 72, 84–89; T6-0075–0080, T6-0092–0101

ENRead the figure: Find R_s, R_ct and C_dl and the real/negative-imaginary axes. Increasing analyte widens the semicircle in this illustrated mechanism. Frequency labels indicate which point was measured; they are not the horizontal axis.

中文读图：找出R_s、R_ct、C_dl及实部/负虚部坐标。图示机制中目标增多使半圆变宽；频率标签表示各点的测量频率，不是横坐标。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p66; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S608 · [P2] Peak, RMS and voltage–current phase / 峰值、均方根与电压电流相位

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Worked example例题练习Repeated explanation反复讲解Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Match peak/RMS conventions and recognise capacitor current lead; add impedances as complex quantities.学习抓手：匹配峰值／RMS约定，认出电容电流超前；阻抗按复数相加。

Slide / classroom worked example课件／课堂例题: Week 6 PDF p86; T6-0099–0101

例4输出4.77V为peak，与输入5V peak一致；R+ZC的幅值不是R+|ZC|。

Repeated classroom explanation课堂反复讲解: T6-0092–0101; Week 6 PDF p82–86

交流幅值与频率是课堂基础；原电感式XL误写成2πL/f已更正为2πfL。

Explicit final-exam statement老师明确提到期末: T6-0096; Week 6 PDF p84–86

“You'll also see it in this year's final exam.”

只指完整Bode多频点绘图，不代表本Quiz要完整推导相位。

ENFor a sinusoidal voltage, V_rms=V_peak/√2, and similarly I_rms=I_peak/√2. RMS describes the effective magnitude for power in a resistor; it is neither peak-to-peak magnitude nor the signed cycle average, which is zero for a symmetric sinusoid. Apply this factor only to the stated sinusoidal waveform, not to every possible signal.

中文正弦电压V_rms=V_peak/√2，电流同样I_rms=I_peak/√2。RMS（均方根）描述电阻上功率对应的有效大小，不是peak-to-peak（峰峰值），也不是带正负的周期平均值；对称正弦的后者为零。这个系数只用于给定正弦波，不适用于任何波形。

ENFor ideal components using the voltage phase relative to current, a resistor has zero phase difference, a capacitor has negative impedance phase (current leads voltage), and an inductor has positive impedance phase (current lags voltage). At DC steady state an ideal capacitor blocks continuous conduction; as frequency rises its reactance magnitude falls. An ideal inductor has the opposite frequency trend. Phase sign depends on the stated convention, so check which signal is the reference.

中文理想元件以“电压相对电流的相位”为约定时，电阻相位差为零；电容阻抗相位为负（电流领先电压）；电感为正（电流落后电压）。直流稳态下理想电容不持续导通；频率提高时它的电抗幅值减小。理想电感的频率趋势相反。相位正负依赖约定，要先看用哪个信号作参考。

Source / 来源：Week 6 PDF p82–86; T6-0092–0101

Week 7 learning block: Bioelectricity, ECG and EEG / 第7学习组：生物电、心电与脑电

Week 7 concept map / 第7周知识框架

ENChapter logic: Ionic gradients and selective channels create cell voltages; tissue activity reaches electrodes as potential differences, which are interpreted as EMG, ECG or EEG patterns.

中文本章主线：离子梯度与选择性通道形成细胞电压；组织活动以电位差到达电极，再根据来源与时间模式解释为EMG、ECG或EEG。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Bioelectricity / biopotential 生物电 / 生物电位 Recording measures potential differences; stimulation deliberately applies an electrical input. ECG, EMG and EEG identify heart, muscle and brain-related recordings. 记录测电位差；刺激主动施加电输入。ECG、EMG、EEG分别对应心脏、肌肉及脑相关记录。 Details / 详解
Membrane potential and AP phases 膜电位与动作电位阶段 Vm=inside−outside. Na⁺ entry raises the taught neuronal voltage; later K⁺ exit lowers it, with a possible dip below rest. Vm=胞内−胞外。课程神经元中Na⁺内流使电压升高，随后K⁺外流使其降低，可短暂低于静息。 Details / 详解
Threshold / all-or-none / firing rate 阈值 / 全或无 / 发放频率 Threshold triggers a spike; stronger input commonly produces more similar spikes per second, not proportionally taller spikes. 阈值决定是否触发；更强输入通常增加每秒相似尖峰数量，不是让单个尖峰成比例变高。 Details / 详解
Nernst versus GHK Nernst与GHK Nernst balances one ion; GHK combines ions with different permeabilities. Zero summed current does not require every ionic current to vanish. Nernst平衡一种离子，GHK综合不同通透性的多种离子。电流总和为零不要求每项都为零。 Details / 详解
Electrode–electrolyte interface 电极—电解质界面 Ionic tissue current meets electronic metal conduction; the interface adds voltage offsets and frequency-dependent impedance. 组织离子载流与金属电子载流在界面交接；界面加入电压偏移及随频率变化的阻抗。 Details / 详解
P / QRS / T P波 / QRS波群 / T波 P: atrial depolarization; QRS: ventricular depolarization; T: ventricular repolarization. These are waveform events, not separate leads. P：心房去极化；QRS：心室去极化；T：心室复极化。这是曲线事件，不是三个导联。 Details / 详解
ECG leads and RR interval 心电导联与RR间期 A lead defines a voltage-difference view; II=I+III for the given limb definitions. With RR in seconds, heart rate=60/RR. 导联定义一种电位差视角；所给肢体定义满足II=I+III。RR用秒时，心率=60/RR。 Details / 详解
Scalp EEG and wave frequency 头皮脑电与脑波频率 EEG reflects combined neuronal activity at standardized sites. Frequency comes from complete cycles/elapsed seconds; amplitude is a different quantity. EEG在标准位置记录神经元共同活动。频率=完整周期数/实际秒数；幅度是另一个量。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX701 Cell Nernst potential: valence, sign and temperature, FX702 GHK: permeability weights and reversed chloride placement, FX703 Ionic branch: conductance and driving force, FX704 Einthoven limb leads: write the polarity first, FX705 Frequency, peak intervals and heart rate, FX708 Loading and contact mismatch: voltage-divider model, FX709 Electrode-interface RC impedance and limits, FX713 Sampling Nyquist frequency is not an impedance-plot axis.

中文本章公式定位：FX701 细胞 Nernst 电位：价态、符号与温度；FX702 GHK：通透性权重与 Cl⁻ 的反向位置；FX703 离子支路：电导与驱动力；FX704 Einthoven 肢体导联：先写清极性；FX705 频率、峰间隔与心率；FX708 加载与接触不匹配：分压模型；FX709 电极界面 RC 阻抗与频率极限；FX713 采样 Nyquist 频率不是阻抗图的横轴。

C20 · [P1] ECG, EMG and EEG: match the organ and signal / ECG、EMG与EEG：组织来源对应

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q4样卷Q4Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Match ECG, EMG and EEG to their tissue and distinguish direct recording from smartwatch sleep estimation.学习抓手：会对应ECG心脏、EMG肌肉、EEG脑活动；区分手表睡眠估计与直接脑电记录。

Sample Q4: smartwatch sleep estimation样卷Q4：手表睡眠估计: Sample quiz PDF p1 Q4

Lecturer previewed this sample question老师再次提示这道样题: T7-0053

“You'll see it very soon again.”

这是题型信号，不能保证原题复现；原题机制补充见S706。

Three major biopotential recordings反复介绍三类生物电记录: W7 PDF p5–8; T7-0002–0006; T7-0096

ENKey points
  • ECG records cardiac electrical activity;
  • EMG records muscle electrical activity;
  • EEG records scalp potential differences associated with brain activity.
  • These are biopotentials measured relative to a reference.
  • A smartwatch can estimate sleep from motion and heart-related signals without directly recording scalp EEG.
中文必会知识点
  • ECG记录心脏电活动，EMG记录肌肉电活动，EEG记录与脑活动有关的头皮电位差。
  • 它们都是相对于参照测得的生物电位。
  • 智能手表可以用运动与心脏相关信号估计睡眠，而不直接记录头皮EEG。

ENStart from zero: Start with biopotential: a voltage difference produced by biological activity. Voltage compares two locations; it is not the amount of electricity stored in an organ. Electrodes are conductive contacts that let an instrument measure that difference. ECG means electrocardiogram, recording heart activity; EMG means electromyogram, recording muscle activity; EEG means electroencephalogram, recording brain-related activity at the scalp.

中文从零理解：先理解biopotential生物电位：生物活动产生的电压差。电压比较两个位置，并不是一个器官里储存了多少“电”。Electrode电极是导电的接触部件，让仪器测出这个差值。ECG是electrocardiogram心电图，记录心脏活动；EMG是electromyogram肌电图，记录肌肉活动；EEG是electroencephalogram脑电图，在头皮记录与脑活动有关的信号。

ENFollow the mechanism: Cells move charged particles called ions across their membranes. Many cells acting together create small voltage changes that can reach recording electrodes. The instrument compares a recording location with another location or reference, then amplifies the difference. Think of listening to a crowd rather than one person: a surface recording combines nearby activity. This analogy explains summation, not literal sound transmission.

中文跟着机制走：细胞让带电的粒子——ion离子——跨过细胞膜移动。许多细胞一起活动，就会产生能被记录电极检测到的微小电压变化。仪器把记录位置与另一个位置或reference参照比较，再放大差值。可以想成“听一群人，而不是只听一个人”：体表记录包含附近活动的组合。这个类比用于理解信号叠加，并不是说电信号真的通过声音传播。

ENTry an example: In an English question, match cardiac with ECG, muscular with EMG, and scalp or brain with EEG. A watch using an accelerometer measures motion; its heart sensor provides heart-rate information. Combining these signals can estimate sleep patterns. That does not mean the watch directly records EEG or measures brain-wave frequency. First identify what is physically measured, then identify what the software estimates.

中文用例子理解：遇到英文题，先把cardiac心脏对应ECG、muscular肌肉对应EMG、scalp头皮或brain脑对应EEG。手表的accelerometer加速度计测运动，心脏传感器提供心率信息。把这些信号结合，可以估计睡眠模式，但不代表手表直接记录EEG或测出了脑波频率。先认清“传感器实际测什么”，再认清“软件根据这些数据推测什么”。

ENExam wording: Do not infer that every wearable measures EEG. The sample smartwatch combination is accelerometer plus heart-rate/heart-rate-variability information. EMG numerical ranges labelled “for reference” do not remove basic EMG recognition from the review.

中文英文读题抓手：不能认为所有可穿戴设备都测EEG。样题手表对应accelerometer加heart rate/heart rate variability。EMG某些数值范围被标为“供参考”，并不等于基础EMG识别全部不用复习。

Source / 来源：W7 p5–8; Sample quiz p1 Q4; W1 p16, p48, p69–75 | T7-0002–0006, T7-0053

S706 · [P1] Watch sensors: PPG, HRV and oxygen saturation / 手表传感器：PPG、HRV与血氧

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q4样卷Q4Quiz statedQuiz明确提及
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish accelerometer plus optical PPG/HRV sleep estimation from EEG, EMG and SpO₂.学习抓手：分清运动＋PPG/HRV睡眠估计与EEG、EMG、SpO₂；能判断样题每项机制。

Sample Q4: compare all four proposed mechanisms样卷Q4：比较四项机制: Sample quiz PDF p1 Q4

Sample sleep question explicitly previewed again课堂再次提示睡眠样题: T7-0053

“Again, this one, I leave it to you. You'll see it very soon again.”

老师也说明该睡眠机制课堂没有充分覆盖；本节补足理解，不声称原题必复现或所有手表规格相同。

ENIn an optical pulse sensor, an LED illuminates tissue and a photodetector records changes in received light as blood volume changes with each pulse: photoplethysmography, PPG. Pulse timing can provide heart rate and pulse-interval variability, used as a proxy for HRV in suitable conditions. An accelerometer separately measures movement. Software combines such clues to estimate sleep.

中文光学脉搏传感器用LED照组织，photodetector光探测器记录每次脉搏引起血容量变化时的收光变化，这叫photoplethysmography（PPG，光电容积描记）。脉搏时间可提供心率及脉搏间隔变化，适当条件下用作HRV心率变异性的代理指标。Accelerometer加速度计另行测运动，软件把这些线索结合来估计睡眠。

ENPPG pulse sensing, SpO₂ oxygen-saturation estimation and EEG are different measurements. Oxygen saturation estimates blood oxygenation using wavelength-dependent absorption; it does not directly count brain-wave cycles. EEG electrodes record scalp electrical potentials; EMG electrodes record muscle electrical activity. For sample Q4, motion plus optical pulse/variability supports A. The fact that LEDs can also be used for SpO₂ does not establish D’s proposed brain-activity mechanism.

中文PPG脉搏检测、SpO₂血氧饱和度估计与EEG是不同测量。血氧根据与波长有关的吸收来估计血液含氧，不直接数脑波周期。EEG电极记录头皮电位，EMG电极记录肌肉电活动。样题Q4中，“运动＋光学脉搏/间隔变化”支持A；LED也能用于SpO₂，不等于D提出的脑活动预测机制就成立。

Source / 来源：Sample quiz PDF p1 Q4; Week 7 PDF p7, p43–44, p79–85; Week 1 PDF p16, p48, p69–75; Week 2 pulse-oximetry section; T7-0053

S707 · [P1] Elementary charge and electrical units / 元电荷与基础电学单位

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recall elementary charge and the units A=C/s, V=J/C, Ω=V/A; separate electron motion from conventional current.学习抓手：记元电荷及A=C/s、V=J/C、Ω=V/A，分清电子运动与约定电流方向。

Basic charge/current/voltage facts may not be supplied基础电荷/电流/电压事实需自行记忆: W7 PDF p9–13; T7-0007–0008

“These are some parameters that will not be provided on the exam or the quiz.”

字幕数值有ASR误识，e和库仑换算以原课件正确数值为准；不能把历史期末可带纸套到闭卷Quiz。

ENElectrical charge is quantized: the charge of an electron is −e and that of a proton is +e, where e≈1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C. One coulomb corresponds to about 6.24×10¹⁸ elementary charge magnitudes. e is a charge magnitude; eV is an energy unit. The same numerical factor appears in converting 1 eV to joules, but coulombs and joules are different units.

中文电荷具有quantized量子化特性：电子带−e，质子带+e，其中e≈1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C。1库仑约对应6.24×10¹⁸个元电荷的大小。e是电荷量的大小，eV是能量单位；把1 eV换为焦耳时也出现同样的数值因子，但coulomb库仑与joule焦耳是不同单位。

ENCurrent is the rate of charge transfer: I=ΔQ/Δt for an average, or dQ/dt instantaneously; 1 A=1 C/s. Voltage is energy per unit charge: 1 V=1 J/C. Resistance has units Ω=V/A. For example, transferring 2 μC in 1 ms gives an average current of 2 mA, not 2 μA.

中文Current电流是电荷转移速率：平均电流I=ΔQ/Δt，瞬时电流为dQ/dt；1 A=1 C/s。Voltage电压是单位电荷对应的能量，1 V=1 J/C。电阻单位Ω=V/A。例如1 ms内转移2 μC，平均电流为2 mA，不是2 μA。

ENConventional current follows positive-charge motion. Thus an electron moving in one direction contributes current in the opposite direction. Positive charges tend toward lower electrical potential under an electric field; negative charges respond oppositely. Biological fluids carry charge mainly through ions, while metal wires carry it through electrons. The lecturer explicitly identified these basic charge/unit facts as items that may need recall rather than being supplied.

中文Conventional current约定电流方向沿正电荷运动方向，因此电子向一个方向移动，对应的电流方向相反。在电场下，正电荷倾向移向较低电位，负电荷的响应相反。生物体液主要靠离子载流，金属导线主要靠电子载流。老师明确提到这些基础电荷与单位事实可能需要自行记住，不一定在题中提供。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p9–13; T7-0007–0008

B27 · [P1] Neurons, threshold and all-or-none firing / 神经元、阈值与全或无发放

P1 First passP1 先掌握Repeated explanation反复讲解Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain threshold and all-or-none firing: stronger input often changes firing rate rather than spike size.学习抓手：理解阈值与全或无；更强刺激通常增加发放频率，不让单峰成比例变高。

Threshold explained before the action-potential phases进入五阶段前多次解释阈值: W7 PDF p19–21; T7-0011–0013; T7-0023–0025

Core mechanism supporting the emphasized phases支撑老师强调的动作电位阶段: T7-0028–0030

“These five stages are very important.”

重点是阈值/全或无与阶段的联系；不将这句推广为S701内辅助不应期也被点名。

ENKey points
  • Dendrites receive input;
  • the axon conducts action potentials.
  • Beyond threshold, a neuronal action potential is approximately all-or-none;
  • stronger stimulation commonly increases firing rate, not single-spike amplitude proportionally.
  • Below threshold does not mean zero voltage: a typical neuronal resting value is about −70 mV, varying by cell.
  • Passive recording measures activity;
  • active stimulation applies an external electrical input.
中文必会知识点
  • Dendrite树突接收输入，axon轴突传导动作电位。
  • 达到threshold阈值后，神经元动作电位近似all-or-none全或无；
  • 更强刺激通常提高firing rate发放频率，而非成比例增大单个尖峰幅度。
  • 未达阈值不等于零电压：典型神经元静息约−70 mV，不同细胞可不同。
  • Passive recording被动记录测活动；
  • active stimulation主动刺激施加外部电输入。

ENStart from zero: A neuron is a signalling cell. Dendrites receive many inputs; the cell body integrates them; the axon carries action potentials toward other cells. Threshold is the level of excitation needed to trigger a spike. Below threshold, a neuron can still have a resting voltage and small voltage changes. For example, moving from −70 to −65 mV is electrical change even if it does not trigger an action potential.

中文从零理解：Neuron神经元是传递信号的细胞。Dendrites树突接收许多输入，cell body细胞体整合输入，axon轴突把动作电位传向其他细胞。Threshold阈值是触发尖峰所需的兴奋水平。未达到阈值时，神经元仍有静息电压，也可以有小幅电压变化。例如−70变成−65 mV，虽然未触发动作电位，却仍是电变化。

ENFollow the mechanism: Beyond threshold, the taught neuronal spike is approximately all-or-none: it fires rather than being proportionally smaller. Stronger stimulation commonly produces more spikes per second, a higher firing rate. Think of sending more similar pulses to communicate stronger input. This describes the course model, not a promise of identical numerical spike heights in every cell and recording.

中文跟着机制走：达到阈值后，课程中的神经元尖峰近似all-or-none全或无：触发一个尖峰，而不是产生一个成比例缩小的版本。更强的刺激通常让每秒尖峰更多，这叫更高的firing rate发放频率。可以理解为“发送更多相似的脉冲”来表达更强输入。这针对课程模型，不保证每个细胞、每次记录的尖峰数值高度都完全相同。

ENTry an example: Compare two teaching traces: both have similar spike heights, but one contains 5 spikes and the other 10 in one second. Their firing rates are 5 and 10 Hz; the second is more frequent, not necessarily larger in amplitude. Passive recording observes activity already occurring. Active stimulation deliberately applies an input to influence activity. In English questions, do not read “no spike” as “zero membrane voltage”.

中文用例子理解：比较两条教学记录：尖峰高度相似，一条在1秒有5个尖峰，另一条有10个。发放频率分别为5和10 Hz，后者更频繁，并不一定幅度更大。Passive recording被动记录观察已发生的活动；active stimulation主动刺激是人为施加输入来影响活动。英文题中的no spike“没有尖峰”，不能理解成“膜电压为零”。

Source / 来源：W7 p5–8; W7 p19–21; W7 p32–39 | T7-0002–0006, T7-0011–0012, T7-0023–0025, T7-0028–0030

ENRead the figure: Start at the branched dendrites, which receive inputs, then locate the soma and the long axon leading to the terminal buttons. The yellow sleeves are myelin around the axon; they are not extra electrodes. This is a single-cell structure diagram: an action potential propagates along its axon, whereas scalp EEG records activity contributed by many cells through tissue.

中文读图：先找分叉的dendrites树突，它们接收输入；再找到soma胞体，以及通往terminal buttons末梢的长axon轴突。轴突外黄色的一节节套层是myelin髓鞘，不是另加的电极。这是单细胞结构图：动作电位沿轴突传播，而头皮EEG是许多细胞的活动经组织共同形成的记录。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p19; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S701 · [P2] Ion channels, pumps and propagation / 离子通道、离子泵与动作电位传导

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate pumps from channels and ligand gating from voltage gating; understand trigger-zone propagation.学习抓手：分清泵/通道及配体/电压门控，懂触发区与沿轴突传导。

Mechanism in the classroom action-potential video课堂动作电位影片解释机制: W7 PDF p19–21, p34–38; T7-0023–0025

Refractory period is explanatory support不应期是辅助解释: S701 supporting paragraph; OpenStax A&P 2e §12.4

不应期术语未在本组原课件/老师提示中单独强调；该段按P3辅助阅读，不因C21重要而一起升级。

ENThe sodium–potassium pump maintains the concentration gradients: it moves Na⁺ outward and K⁺ inward using metabolic energy. Ion channels instead allow selected ions to flow when their gates open. The rapid rising and falling phases of the taught neuronal action potential are mainly channel events. Repolarization is not simply the pump suddenly switching on.

中文Sodium–potassium pump钠钾泵用代谢能维持浓度梯度：把Na⁺向外运、K⁺向内运。Ion channel离子通道则在门打开时让特定离子流动。课程神经元动作电位快速上升、下降，主要由通道的变化造成。Repolarization复极化不是“钠钾泵突然启动”的简单结果。

ENLigand-gated means that a chemical messenger opens a channel; voltage-gated means that membrane voltage controls the gate. Dendritic inputs can produce small graded changes. At the axon hillock or trigger zone, a sufficiently strong combined input reaches threshold and activates a spike. Threshold is the trigger level, not the height of the completed spike.

中文Ligand-gated配体门控表示化学信使使通道打开；voltage-gated电压门控表示膜电压控制通道。树突输入可产生小幅graded change渐变电位。输入在axon hillock轴丘或trigger zone触发区综合，足够强、达到threshold阈值时触发尖峰。阈值是“启动所需的水平”，不是最终尖峰的高度。

ENPropagation means that excitation triggers the next section of axon membrane, so the action potential is regenerated along the axon rather than merely fading like a passive voltage disturbance. In the course model, stronger stimulation produces more similar spikes, not a proportionally larger spike at every position. A spike travelling along an axon and a surface EEG trace are different recording scales.

中文Propagation传导是指兴奋触发下一段轴突膜，因此动作电位沿轴突不断再生，而不只是像被动电压扰动那样逐渐变弱。课程模型中，更强刺激通常产生更多相似尖峰，不是让每个位点的单个尖峰成比例变大。沿轴突传播的尖峰与体表EEG记录，属于不同测量尺度。

ENSupporting explanation: after a spike, channel inactivation and recovery produce a refractory period during which the membrane briefly cannot fire again normally, helping explain why spikes remain separate events. This term was not separately emphasized as a Quiz memorization requirement in the supplied slides.

中文辅助理解：尖峰后，通道失活与恢复带来refractory period不应期，使膜短暂不能正常再次发放，帮助解释尖峰为什么是分开的事件。本组课件未把此术语单独强调为Quiz必背要求。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p19–21, p34–38; T7-0023–0025; 不应期辅助核实：OpenStax §12.4

C21 · [P1] Membrane potential and action-potential phases / 膜电位与动作电位阶段

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize resting, depolarizing, peak, repolarizing and hyperpolarizing phases and the Na⁺/K⁺ sequence.学习抓手：看懂动作电位五阶段与Na⁺内流、K⁺外流；未达阈值仍有膜电位。

Five phases explicitly called very important老师明确说五阶段很重要: W7 PDF p33–38; T7-0028–0030

“These five stages are very important.”

Ion gradients and membrane voltage反复讲解离子梯度与膜电位: W7 PDF p19–27; T7-0011–0018; T7-0023–0025

约−70 mV是典型静息示例，不能推为所有细胞恒负；小于阈值不等于电压为零。

ENKey points
  • Use Vₘ=Vinside−Voutside.
  • A resting membrane is usually negative inside.
  • Depolarization means becoming less negative and may include a positive overshoot;
  • repolarization returns toward rest;
  • hyperpolarization becomes more negative than rest.
  • The taught sequence emphasizes Na⁺ influx and subsequent K⁺ efflux.
中文必会知识点
  • 使用Vₘ=Vinside−Voutside。
  • 静息时细胞内通常为负。
  • Depolarization表示变得不那么负，并可能出现正向超射；
  • repolarization返回静息；
  • hyperpolarization比静息更负。
  • 课程重点顺序为Na⁺内流，随后K⁺外流。

ENStart from zero: A cell membrane separates intracellular fluid, inside the cell, from extracellular fluid, outside. Ions are charged atoms or molecules: Na⁺ is a positive sodium ion and K⁺ a positive potassium ion. Membrane potential is Vₘ=Vinside−Voutside. If the outside is our zero reference and the inside is −70 mV, Vₘ is −70 mV. Negative means lower electrical potential, not absence of electrical activity.

中文从零理解：Cell membrane细胞膜把intracellular细胞内液与extracellular细胞外液分开。Ion离子是带电的原子或分子：Na⁺是带正电的钠离子，K⁺是带正电的钾离子。Membrane potential膜电位定义为Vₘ=Vinside−Voutside。把细胞外作为零参考，细胞内为−70 mV时，Vₘ就是−70 mV。负值表示电位更低，不表示没有电活动。

ENFollow the mechanism: In the taught neuronal action potential, sodium channels open and positive Na⁺ enters. The inside becomes less negative: depolarization. Voltage can briefly become positive. Later sodium entry declines and K⁺ leaves, bringing voltage downward: repolarization. Continued potassium movement can briefly make voltage more negative than rest: hyperpolarization. Channels are selective gates, but the analogy does not mean every ion can use every gate.

中文跟着机制走：课程的神经元action potential动作电位中，钠通道打开，正电Na⁺进入，细胞内变得不那么负，这叫depolarization去极化；电压甚至会短暂变成正值。随后钠内流减弱，K⁺向外移动，使电压下降，这叫repolarization复极化。钾继续外流可让电位暂时比静息更负，这叫hyperpolarization超极化。通道像有选择性的门，但不是每种离子都能通过每扇门。

ENTry an example: Follow the numbers: −70→−40 mV is depolarization, even though both values remain negative. +30→−70 mV is repolarization; −70→−80 mV is hyperpolarization relative to a −70 mV resting level. Thus becoming less negative is the key phrase. The statement “inside is always negative” fails during a positive overshoot. Remember 1 mV=0.001 V when calculating or reading axes.

中文用例子理解：沿数值判断：−70→−40 mV是去极化，虽然两个数都仍为负；+30→−70 mV是复极化；以−70 mV为静息基准，−70→−80 mV是超极化。因此becoming less negative“变得不那么负”是关键表达。“细胞内始终为负”遇到动作电位的正向超射就不成立。计算或读坐标时，记住1 mV=0.001 V。

ENExam wording: “The inside is always negative” is false during an action potential. Keep mV separate from V. Long multi-ion membrane equations and derivations are secondary to the phase names, ion directions and sign convention.

中文英文读题抓手：“细胞内始终为负”在动作电位中是错误的。mV与V不能混。长的多离子膜方程及推导，优先级低于阶段名称、离子流向和符号约定。

Source / 来源：W7 p22–27; W7 p19–21; W7 p32–39 | T7-0011–0012, T7-0014–0018, T7-0023–0025, T7-0028–0030

ENRead the figure: Start near the resting negative voltage; rising is depolarization, falling is repolarization, and the dip below rest is hyperpolarization. The dashed threshold is a trigger level, not peak height. The drawn numerical values illustrate this model rather than every cell.

中文读图：从负的静息值开始，上升是去极化、下降是复极化、降到静息以下是超极化。虚线threshold是启动阈值，不是峰高。图中数值示范该模型，不代表所有细胞都相同。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p35; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B28 · [P2] Ionic gradients: Nernst versus GHK离子梯度：Nernst与GHK

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know how ion gradients and selective permeability create membrane voltage; distinguish single-ion Nernst from multi-ion GHK.学习抓手：懂离子梯度、选择性通透与膜电位；认Nernst单离子、GHK多离子，不主攻长式。

Take away the ion-concentration concept老师要求抓住离子浓度核心概念: W7 PDF p22–30; T7-0014–0020

“This is the most important concept that you should take away from this equation.”

Long cellular equations presented for reference长细胞方程仅供参考: T7-0017–0021

“This is more like a mathematic expression. You don't need to memorize this.”

不把局部长式降优先扩大为整个膜电位概念不考；具体this无同步翻页，不能逐式宣称全部排除。

ENKey points
  • Membrane voltage arises from ion gradients and selective permeability: typically more K⁺ inside and Na⁺ outside.
  • Nernst describes the equilibrium potential for one ion;
  • Goldman–Hodgkin–Katz (GHK) includes several ions weighted by permeability.
  • Zero net membrane current does not require each ionic current to be zero.
  • Learn the meaning of the equations without prioritizing their long derivations.
中文必会知识点
  • 膜电压来自离子梯度与选择性通透：通常K⁺胞内更多、Na⁺胞外更多。
  • Nernst能斯特描述单种离子的平衡电位；
  • Goldman–Hodgkin–Katz（GHK）按通透性考虑多种离子。
  • 跨膜净电流为零不要求每种离子电流都为零。
  • 记住方程含义，长推导不作为优先任务。

ENStart from zero: An ion concentration gradient means unequal amounts per unit volume on two sides. Typically K⁺ is more concentrated inside a neuron and Na⁺ outside. An open channel permits selected ions to cross: this is permeability. For K⁺, concentration favours outward movement, while a negative interior attracts positive K⁺ inward. The combination of concentration and electrical effects determines movement, not concentration alone.

中文从零理解：Ion concentration gradient离子浓度梯度，表示两侧单位体积内的离子数量不同。神经元通常K⁺在细胞内更多，Na⁺在细胞外更多。打开的通道允许特定离子通过，这涉及permeability通透性。对K⁺而言，浓度差推动其向外，而负的细胞内部会吸引正K⁺向内。运动方向由浓度与电效应共同决定，不能只看浓度。

ENFollow the mechanism: Nernst asks a single-ion question: what voltage balances the concentration drive for this ion, giving zero net flow of that ion under its equilibrium assumptions? GHK considers several ions and their different permeabilities. Imagine several selective doors: how open each door is affects the combined outcome. This is a guide to weighting; GHK voltage is not simply an ordinary arithmetic average of the individual Nernst voltages.

中文跟着机制走：Nernst能斯特回答单离子问题：什么电压能平衡这一种离子的浓度驱动力，让它在相应平衡假设下的净流为零？GHK同时考虑多种离子及其不同通透性。可以想成多扇有选择性的门：每扇门开得多大，会影响综合结果。这用于理解“权重”，但GHK膜电压不是把各离子的Nernst电压直接做普通算术平均。

ENTry an example: For conceptual questions, “one ion’s equilibrium potential” points to Nernst; “multiple ions weighted by permeability” points to GHK. Zero total current does not require every ionic current to be zero. In a simple teaching example, +2 units from one contribution and −2 from another sum to zero while both remain nonzero. You should understand this balance before trying a long equation or memorizing a particular resting voltage.

中文用例子理解：概念题看到one ion’s equilibrium potential“单种离子的平衡电位”，对应Nernst；看到multiple ions weighted by permeability“按通透性考虑多种离子”，对应GHK。总电流为零，不要求每种离子的电流都为零。一个简单例子是：某项贡献+2单位，另一项−2单位，合计为零，但两项各自都不为零。先理解这种平衡，再去看长公式或背某个静息电压数值。

ENClarify the concept: In the slide’s equivalent-circuit branch, Iion=gion(Vm−Eion), with conductance gion=1/Rion. Vm−Eion expresses the electrochemical driving force as a voltage relative to that ion’s equilibrium potential. If Vm=Eion, this branch’s net current is zero in the model, even with an open channel. That is different from GHK’s zero sum of several nonzero ionic currents. Treat this as supporting interpretation, not a required long derivation.

中文把概念讲清：课件等效电路单支路满足Iion=gion(Vm−Eion)，gion=1/Rion为电导。Vm−Eion把相对该离子平衡电位的电化学驱动力表示成电压。模型中Vm=Eion时，该支路净电流为零，即使通道打开；这不同于GHK中多个非零离子电流相加为零。作为辅助读式即可，不增加长推导要求。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p25, p30; T7-0017–0021明确reference；当前B28未出现该短式；README行578

Source / 来源：W7 p15–16; W7 p22–27; W7 p25–30 | T7-0008–0010, T7-0014–0021, T7-0030

ENRead the figure: The enlarged membrane separates extracellular fluid on the left from the intracellular region on the right. Read the colored wedges below: Na+ and Cl− are more concentrated outside in this model, while K+ is more concentrated inside. The black arrow illustrates K+ movement through a selective channel; actual net ionic flow depends on both concentration and electrical driving forces. The +/− signs show charge separation near the membrane, not that the whole intracellular fluid contains only negative ions.

中文读图：放大的细胞膜把左侧extracellular细胞外与右侧intracellular细胞内分开。看下面彩色楔形：此模型中Na+和Cl−在外面较多，K+在里面较多。黑箭头示意K+通过选择性通道；实际净流动由浓度驱动力和电驱动力共同决定。膜两侧“+”“−”表示膜附近的电荷分离，不表示整个细胞内液只有负离子。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p22; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B29 · [P2] Electrode–electrolyte interface电极—电解质界面

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize electrode–electrolyte contact, half-cell offset and frequency-dependent interface impedance.学习抓手：认电极—电解质界面、半电池电位偏移、接触阻抗随频率变化。

Gel and electrode–skin circuit explained讲解凝胶导电接触与界面电路: W7 PDF p41–42; T7-0035–0038

Long interface circuit and Bode plotting are final-exam examples长界面电路与Bode作图为期末例题: W7 PDF p77–78; T7-0077–0081

“This question is a very typical final exam question.”

保留元件含义与高低频趋势；不因期末例题提升为Quiz长计算重点。

ENKey points
  • Tissue carries ionic current;
  • metal leads carry electronic current.
  • The interface introduces a half-cell potential and frequency-dependent polarization/contact impedance.
  • The course equivalent circuit contains a half-cell source, an interfacial resistance/capacitance branch and solution resistance.
  • Poor or unequal contact can distort recorded signals;
  • a pure series-resistor exercise is only a simplified model.
中文必会知识点
  • 组织中为离子电流，金属导线中为电子电流。
  • 界面引入half-cell potential半电池电位及随频率变化的极化/接触阻抗。
  • 课程等效电路含半电池电源、界面电阻/电容支路及溶液电阻。
  • 接触差或两侧不匹配可能使记录失真；
  • 纯串联电阻练习只是简化模型。

ENStart from zero: An electrolyte is a fluid containing mobile ions, such as dissolved salts. Ions carry electrical charge in tissue fluids; electrons carry charge in metal wires. At the electrode–electrolyte interface, these two conducting systems meet. The electrode is therefore more than a perfect wire touching skin: its surface interacts with the fluid and adds its own electrical behaviour to the measurement.

中文从零理解：Electrolyte电解质是含有可移动离子的流体，例如溶有盐的液体。组织液里由离子携带电荷，金属导线里由电子携带电荷。Electrode–electrolyte interface电极—电解质界面，就是这两种导电系统的交界。因此，电极不只是“贴着皮肤的一根完美导线”：它的表面会与流体相互作用，把自身的电学特性也加入测量。

ENFollow the mechanism: The course represents this interface with an equivalent circuit, a simplified electrical model. Ehc is the half-cell potential, a surface-related voltage offset. Rs represents resistance in the fluid. Rd and Cd represent interfacial resistance and capacitance associated with charge transfer and polarization.
