Capacitance allows charge separation at the surface, so response depends on changing frequency. These components explain behaviour; they are not literal separate parts hidden under the electrode.

中文跟着机制走：课程用equivalent circuit等效电路表示界面，即用简化的电学模型描述它。Ehc是half-cell potential半电池电位，代表与表面相关的电压偏移；Rs代表液体电阻。Rd、Cd代表与电荷转移及极化有关的界面电阻、电容。表面可以形成电荷分离，因此响应会随变化频率而变。这些元件用于解释行为，不是说电极下面真的藏着几个独立电路零件。

ENTry an example: Suppose the biological voltage stays unchanged but electrode contact shifts. The recorded voltage can change because contact impedance or surface potential changed: this is an artifact. Two unequal contacts can also introduce unequal errors that differential subtraction cannot fully cancel. Thus a pure series-resistor problem is useful for practising V=IR, but it omits the full interface. In English, look for contact impedance, polarization and half-cell potential as interface terms.

中文用例子理解：假设生物电压没变，但电极接触发生改变。记录仍可能变化，因为contact impedance接触阻抗或表面电位变了，这叫artifact伪迹。两侧接触不同，还会引入不同误差，差分相减不能完全抵消。因此，纯串联电阻题适合练V=IR，却没有包括完整界面。英文中，contact impedance、polarization极化、half-cell potential都是与界面有关的词。

Source / 来源：W7 p41–42; W7 p52–54; W7 p70–78 | T7-0035–0038, T7-0043–0046, T7-0073–0081

S702 · [P2] Skin contact and interface impedance皮肤接触与界面阻抗

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Final emphasis仅期末强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Explain gel contact, volume conduction and low/high-frequency interface trends; unequal contacts leave residual noise.学习抓手：懂凝胶接触、容积传导和界面高低频趋势；知道接触不匹配会残留噪声。

Contact and small-signal measurement discussed课堂讲接触与微弱信号记录: W7 PDF p41–42, p49–54; T7-0035–0046

“离子游到皮肤”的课堂类比按容积传导解释，不作逐字生理机制。

Long mains-interference and interface calculations长工频干扰/界面计算属期末例题: W7 PDF p74–78; T7-0074–0081

“This question is a very typical final exam question.”

Quiz先理解趋势与匹配；完整电阻网络、复数化简与全Bode作图降优先。

ENSurface electrodes do not have to touch the muscle itself. Ionic currents in conductive tissue fluids produce extracellular voltage differences that can be detected at the skin: this is volume conduction. Conductive gel improves electrode–skin contact. Changing contact pressure, drying gel or motion can change contact impedance and add an artifact even if muscle activity stays the same.

中文表面电极不必直接碰到肌肉。导电组织液中的离子电流产生细胞外电压差，可在皮肤检测，这涉及volume conduction容积传导。Conductive gel导电凝胶改善电极—皮肤接触。接触压力变化、凝胶变干或运动，都可能改变接触阻抗，加入artifact伪迹，即使肌肉活动没有改变。

ENFor the slide model Rs+(Rd in parallel with Cd), low frequency makes the capacitor branch difficult to pass, so the impedance approaches Rs+Rd. At high frequency the capacitor branch becomes easier to pass and bypasses Rd, so the impedance approaches Rs. Thus a single fixed resistor cannot describe this interface at every frequency. Ehc is a voltage offset and is not the same quantity as impedance.

中文课件模型为Rs与“Rd、Cd并联支路”串联。低频时，电容支路不易通过，阻抗趋近Rs+Rd；高频时，电容支路更易通过、旁路Rd，阻抗趋近Rs。因此，不能用一个固定电阻描述所有频率下的界面。Ehc是电压偏移，与impedance阻抗不是同一个量。

ENDifferential measurement cancels interference only to the extent that it reaches both inputs equally. Unequal electrode contact impedances can turn shared mains interference into unequal input voltages, leaving a residual after subtraction. This explains the ECG interference example conceptually; its long resistor-network calculation is secondary to good contact, matched inputs and common-mode rejection.

中文差分测量能消除干扰，前提是干扰到达两输入端时足够相同。两侧电极接触阻抗不匹配，可把共有工频干扰变成不同的输入电压，相减后仍有残留。这解释了ECG干扰例题的基本原理；长的电阻网络计算，优先级低于良好接触、输入匹配与common-mode rejection共模抑制。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p41–42, p49–54, p74–78; T7-0035–0046, T7-0073–0081

C22 · [P1] ECG morphology and reading frequency from a trace / ECG波形与从时轴读频率

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q5样卷Q5Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Match P/QRS/T to cardiac events and calculate frequency from complete cycles over elapsed time.学习抓手：会认P/QRS/T；按完整周期数÷实际时间算频率，先看横轴单位。

Sample Q5: EEG frequency from a trace样卷Q5：脑电时轴读频率: Sample quiz PDF p1 Q5

低清、不规则样图仅暂估C≈45 Hz；老师未确认最终字母。

Read the actual time span, not the ending tick老师反复纠正时间窗口误读: W7 PDF p84–87; T7-0092–0095

“You need to pay attention to the x axis.”

ECG waveform and beat interval讲解心电波形与峰间时间: W7 PDF p65–69; T7-0068–0071

P/QRS/T的定义保留；更详细生理与诊断留后续课程，不背图上所有近似时长。

ENKey points
  • The P wave relates to atrial depolarization, the QRS complex to ventricular depolarization, and the T wave to ventricular repolarization.
  • For a reasonably periodic trace, frequency f=N/Δt or f=1/T.
  • Always read the horizontal-axis unit first.
中文必会知识点
  • P wave对应心房去极化，QRS complex对应心室去极化，T wave对应心室复极化。
  • 近似周期波形的频率f=N/Δt或f=1/T。
  • 必须先读横轴单位。

ENStart from zero: An ECG is a voltage-versus-time trace. The atria are the heart’s upper chambers; the ventricles are its lower pumping chambers. P marks atrial depolarization, QRS ventricular depolarization, and T ventricular repolarization. These labels describe electrical stages, which are related to contraction but are not identical to mechanical movement. P, QRS and T are parts of a waveform, not three separate ECG leads.

中文从零理解：ECG心电图是“电压随时间变化”的曲线。Atria心房是心脏上方的腔室，ventricles心室是下方负责泵血的腔室。P表示心房去极化，QRS表示心室去极化，T表示心室复极化。这些标记描述电活动阶段，虽然与收缩有关，却不直接等同于机械运动。P、QRS、T是波形中的部分，不是三个独立的心电导联。

ENFollow the mechanism: Frequency asks how many complete repetitions occur each second; its unit is hertz, Hz. Period T asks how long one repetition takes. Therefore f=1/T, or f=N/Δt for N complete cycles in a time window Δt. Picture repeatedly walking the same loop: count completed loops, not every step. For a waveform, do not count both its upward and downward portions as separate cycles.

中文跟着机制走：Frequency频率问的是“每秒完整重复几次”，单位hertz赫兹，记作Hz。Period周期T问的是“一次完整重复要多久”。所以f=1/T；若时间窗口Δt里有N个完整周期，则f=N/Δt。可以想成反复走同一圈：数走完的圈数，不数每一步。对应波形时，不能把向上和向下两段各算成一个周期。

ENTry an example: Suppose a teaching trace shows 10 complete cycles in 200 ms. Convert 200 ms to 0.200 s, then calculate f=10/0.200=50 Hz. Eleven successive matching peaks contain ten peak-to-peak intervals. An irregular EEG trace may support only a rough estimate: choose a representative window and state its uncertainty. A taller wave means larger voltage amplitude; it does not automatically mean higher frequency.

中文用例子理解：假设教学波形在200 ms中有10个完整周期。先把200 ms换成0.200 s，再算f=10/0.200=50 Hz。连续11个同类波峰之间，只有10个峰到峰的间隔。实际EEG不规则时，可能只能估计频率：选代表性的时间窗口，并承认估读误差。波形更高表示电压幅度更大，并不自动表示频率更高。

ENExam wording: Sample Q5 is a rough estimate from a low-resolution, irregular EEG trace, around 45 Hz with C (40–48 Hz) only a provisional reference, not a confirmed answer. Treat it as graph-reading practice rather than an exact numerical standard.

中文英文读题抓手：样题Q5来自低分辨率且不规则的EEG波形，仅能估读约45 Hz，C（40–48 Hz）仅为暂定参考，不是已确认答案。应把它作为读图训练，而非精确数值标准。

Source / 来源：W7 p62–69; W7 p79–87; Sample quiz p1 Q5 | T7-0068–0073, T7-0084–0087, T7-0091–0095

S703 · [P2] Heart pumping and the electrical sequence / 心脏泵血与电活动顺序

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Understand systole versus diastole and why electrical activation differs from mechanical pumping.学习抓手：懂收缩期/舒张期及电激活与机械泵血的区别；先认SA/AV名称。

Heart pumping cycle explained讲解泵血循环与收缩: W7 PDF p57–65; T7-0062–0068

Detailed cardiac physiology deferred更细心脏生理留后续教学: T7-0068–0069

“Here I will not go too deep.”

四腔、瓣膜、SA/AV可作词汇认识；影片的funny-current、特定电压与离子通道细节不主攻。

ENAtria are receiving chambers and ventricles are pumping chambers. The right side sends oxygen-poor blood from the body to the lungs; the left side sends oxygen-rich blood from the lungs to the body. Heart valves promote one-way flow. Left and right describe the person’s anatomy, not necessarily the left and right of a drawing.

中文Atria心房主要接收血液，ventricles心室负责泵血。右侧把身体返回的低氧血送往肺，左侧把肺返回的富氧血送往全身。Heart valve心脏瓣膜帮助维持单向血流。Left/right指人体解剖学左右，未必等于图纸的左右。

ENSystole is the contraction or pumping phase; diastole is the relaxation and filling phase. An ECG records the electrical activation associated with this cycle, not blood flow itself. Electrical depolarization helps initiate contraction, but the voltage trace and the mechanical contraction are different quantities.

中文Systole收缩期是收缩、泵血阶段；diastole舒张期是放松、充盈阶段。ECG记录与这个周期有关的电激活，并不直接测血流。电去极化帮助启动收缩，但电压曲线与机械收缩是不同的量。

ENThe SA node, sinoatrial node, is the usual pacemaker that starts the normal heartbeat. Activation spreads through the atria and then through the AV node, atrioventricular node, before ventricular activation. The ordered timing helps the atria and ventricles work in sequence. Pacemaker cells set the timing; the larger muscle tissue performs most of the pumping.

中文SA node是sinoatrial node窦房结，通常作为pacemaker起搏点启动正常心搏。电激活经过心房，再经过AV node（atrioventricular node房室结），随后激活心室。这个有顺序的时间安排让心房、心室依次工作。起搏细胞提供节律，较大的肌肉组织完成主要泵血。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p57–65; T7-0058–0069

S704 · [P2] ECG waves, segments and intervals心电的波、段与间期

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Supporting concept辅助理解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish wave, segment and interval; locate PR/ST/QT/RR and the cardiac events they span.学习抓手：分清波、段、间期；图上找PR/ST/QT/RR与对应事件，不背全部时长。

Labels on the ECG lecture figure原课件心电图的标签: W7 PDF p65–67; T7-0068–0071

More detailed ECG interpretation deferred复杂心电解释留后续课程: T7-0068–0069

“Here I will not go too deep.”

P/QRS/T归C22先掌握；本小节补图轴词，诊断规则与近似持续时间不是普适常数。

ENA wave is a visible deflection; a segment is the portion between waves; an interval includes a specified time span containing one or more waves. Do not confuse a flat-looking segment with a zero membrane potential in every heart cell. The ECG is a difference recorded at the body surface, and different cell activities can cancel in that difference.

中文Wave波是曲线可见的偏转；segment段是波与波之间的部分；interval间期是包含一个或多个波的指定时间跨度。看起来平的心电段，不表示每个心肌细胞的膜电位都为零。ECG是体表记录的电位差，不同细胞活动在这个差值中可以相互抵消。

ENPR interval runs from the start of P to the start of QRS: from the start of atrial depolarization to the start of ventricular depolarization. ST segment lies after QRS and before T. QT interval runs from the start of QRS to the end of T, covering ventricular depolarization through repolarization. RR is instead the spacing between successive R peaks, used for heart-rate calculation.

中文PR interval从P波开始到QRS开始，对应心房开始去极化到心室开始去极化。ST segment在QRS之后、T波之前。QT interval从QRS开始到T波结束，包含心室去极化至复极化。RR则是连续R峰的间隔，用来计算心率。

ENAtrial repolarization is usually hidden by the larger QRS complex; the T wave is ventricular repolarization. The slide shows approximate P, PR, QRS and T durations for orientation. Understanding which event and time span each label represents is more useful here than treating those approximate durations as universal constants or as a diagnosis.

中文心房复极化通常被较大的QRS波群遮住；T波表示心室复极化。课件给出的P、PR、QRS、T持续时间是帮助认识时间尺度的近似值。这里更应理解每个标签表示什么事件、覆盖哪段时间，而非把近似时长当成普适常数或诊断结论。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p65–67; T7-0068–0070; 图示定义核实：OpenStax §19.2

ENRead the figure: Locate P, QRS and T first, then follow the horizontal spans of PR, ST and QT. These are features within a trace, not limb lead I/II/III. Durations on this slide are approximate reference values.

中文读图：先找到P、QRS、T，再沿横向看PR、ST、QT覆盖的时间。它们是同一曲线内的特征，不是肢体导联I/II/III。页上时长属于近似参考值。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p66; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B30 · [P2] ECG leads, heart rate and EMG心电导联、心率与肌电

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Distinguish electrodes from ECG leads; use II=I+III and heart rate=60/RR with RR in seconds.学习抓手：分清电极、导联和P/QRS/T；会II=I+III与心率=60/RR（RR用秒）。

Three contacts and potential-difference views讲解三个接触点与多个电位差: W7 PDF p68–69; T7-0071–0073

课堂将三导联与三波峰联系的口语不够准确，资料按原导联电位差定义纠正。

ECG trace explains beat timing心电曲线说明峰间时间与心率: W7 PDF p66–69; T7-0070–0071

这是曲线解释，未发现该处有单独命名的课后习题；不贴“课后例题”标签。

EMG amplitude/bandwidth numbers are reference valuesEMG幅度/带宽数值仅供参考: W7 PDF p47–48; T7-0039

“When I say it's just for reference, I really means that it will not be on the quiz. It will also not be on the exam.”

近邻页为EMG数值范围，不能据此排除EMG定义、电极位置和后续差分原理。

ENKey points
  • An ECG lead is a potential-difference view;
  • P, QRS and T are features within a waveform, not three different leads.
  • For standard limb leads, II=I+III.
  • Heart rate=60/RR when RR is in seconds;
  • RR=0.8 s gives 75 beats/min.
  • EMG measures muscle electrical activity, with electrode placement and reference affecting the recorded signal.
中文必会知识点
  • ECG lead心电导联是一种电位差观察视角；
  • P、QRS、T是同一波形内的特征，不是三个不同导联。
  • 标准肢体导联满足II=I+III。
  • RR用秒时，heart rate心率=60/RR；
  • RR=0.8 s对应75次/分。
  • EMG肌电测肌肉电活动，电极位置与参考位置影响记录。

ENStart from zero: An electrode is a physical contact; an ECG lead is a defined voltage difference between contacts or references. Think of viewing the same event from different camera angles: different leads view the same heart activity differently. P, QRS and T are stages visible within a trace. They are not lead I, lead II and lead III, and changing the lead can change waveform appearance.

中文从零理解：Electrode电极是实际接触部件；ECG lead心电导联是按定义取得的电极或参考之间的电压差。可以类比不同相机角度拍同一事件：不同导联从不同电位差视角观察同一心脏活动。P、QRS、T是曲线里的阶段，不是lead I、lead II、lead III三个导联；换导联后，波形外观可能改变。

ENFollow the mechanism: For the three limb contacts in the slide, I=V₂−V₁, II=V₃−V₁ and III=V₃−V₂. Adding I and III cancels V₂, leaving II. Example: V₁=1.0, V₂=1.2 and V₃=1.5 mV give I=0.2, III=0.3 and II=0.5 mV. This is a voltage identity for the stated lead definitions, not a claim that three different heart stages are being added together.

中文跟着机制走：课件三个肢体接触点的定义为I=V₂−V₁、II=V₃−V₁、III=V₃−V₂。把I与III相加，V₂抵消，得到II。例如V₁=1.0、V₂=1.2、V₃=1.5 mV时，I=0.2、III=0.3、II=0.5 mV。这是按所给导联定义成立的电压关系，并不是把三个不同心脏阶段相加。

ENTry an example: The RR interval is the time from one R peak to the next. If RR=0.8 s, one beat takes 0.8 s: 1/0.8=1.25 beats per second, then ×60 gives 75 beats per minute. This is a teaching calculation, not a diagnosis. EMG instead records muscle electrical activity; which muscle and where the recording and reference electrodes sit affect the signal. Heart-rate arithmetic does not automatically apply to arbitrary EMG spikes.

中文用例子理解：RR interval是一个R峰到下一个R峰的时间。如果RR=0.8 s，一次心搏用0.8秒，那么1/0.8=1.25次/秒，再乘60，得到75次/分。这是教学计算，不是诊断。EMG记录的是肌肉电活动，测哪块肌肉、记录电极与参照电极放哪里，都会影响信号。不能把心率算法自动套到任意肌电尖峰上。

Source / 来源：W7 p47–48; W7 p52–54; W7 p62–69 | T7-0038–0039, T7-0043–0046, T7-0068–0073

ENRead the figure: Find the two black electrode points above the skin; they measure local potentials V1 and V2 arising from muscle electrical activity conducted through tissue. The red voltage arrow and formula indicate subtraction, not two separate kinds of muscle. Noise that reaches both inputs with the same value cancels ideally; unequal interference remains. Surface EMG generally contains contributions from multiple muscle fibers, rather than the intracellular voltage of one fiber.

中文读图：找皮肤上方两个电极的黑点：它们测V1与V2两个局部电位，来自肌肉电活动经导电组织的传播。红色电压箭头与公式表示相减，不是两种不同肌肉。相同数值同时进入两输入的噪声在理想相减中抵消；不相同的干扰仍可留下。表面EMG通常包含多条肌纤维的贡献，不是一条肌纤维的细胞内电压。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p53; original slide figure / 原课件截图

B31 · [P2] EEG placement and brain-wave vocabulary脑电位置与脑波词汇

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Know scalp EEG is population activity, why electrode placement matters, and the slow-to-fast band order.学习抓手：懂头皮EEG测群体活动、位置的重要性，认δ→θ→α→β→γ由慢到快。

EEG spatial placement emphasized强调脑电电极空间位置: W7 PDF p79–84; T7-0085–0087

“The spatial location of each electrode is very, very important.”

不能照课堂宽泛说法推成EMG任意两点都等效；不背电极数为所有系统固定值。

Brain-wave frequency and state associations讲脑波频率与状态关联: W7 PDF p84–87; T7-0091–0096

详细频带边界随约定而变；原p84的gamma<25有误。频率读图高优先另见C22/S705。

ENKey points
  • Scalp EEG reflects population activity;
  • the 10–20 system standardizes electrode positions.
  • Slow-to-fast order: delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma.
  • W7 p84 lists delta 1–3, theta 4–7, alpha 8–12, beta 13–25 Hz;
  • exact boundaries vary by convention, and its gamma <25 label is erroneous.
  • Alpha often accompanies relaxed wakefulness, delta slow-wave sleep;
  • these are associations, not diagnoses.
中文必会知识点
  • 头皮EEG反映群体活动，10–20 system规范电极位置。
  • 由慢到快为delta δ、theta θ、alpha α、beta β、gamma γ。
  • W7 p84列出δ 1–3、θ 4–7、α 8–12、β 13–25 Hz；
  • 具体边界随约定变化，其中γ<25为错误标注。
  • Alpha常伴随放松清醒，delta常见于慢波睡眠；
  • 这是相关表现，不是诊断规则。

ENStart from zero: Scalp EEG records small voltage differences associated with the combined activity of many neurons, especially coordinated synaptic activity. It is not simply a direct recording of one neuron’s action potential. The international 10–20 system gives standard scalp positions, so recordings can use comparable locations. Imagine microphones placed consistently around a crowd; placement matters. This analogy describes collective measurement, not actual sound or precise identification of every individual neuron.

中文从零理解：头皮EEG记录与许多神经元共同活动有关的微小电压差，尤其与协调的突触活动有关，并不只是直接记录单个神经元的动作电位。国际10–20 system给出标准头皮位置，方便在可比较的位置记录。可以类比把麦克风按固定位置放在人群周围：位置很重要。但这个类比只用于理解群体测量，不是实际声音，也不表示能准确辨认每一个神经元。

ENFollow the mechanism: Brain-wave bands group oscillations by frequency: delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma run from slower to faster. Read time on the horizontal axis and count complete cycles to estimate frequency; vertical height describes voltage amplitude. The slide lists delta 1–3, theta 4–7, alpha 8–12 and beta 13–25 Hz. These are course conventions, not universal boundaries. Its gamma “<25 Hz” label is inconsistent and should not be memorized.

中文跟着机制走：脑波频带按频率分组，从慢到快是delta δ、theta θ、alpha α、beta β、gamma γ。读横轴时间、数完整周期来估频率；纵向高度表示电压幅度。课件列δ 1–3、θ 4–7、α 8–12、β 13–25 Hz。这些是课程采用的约定，并非唯一通用边界。其gamma“<25 Hz”标注有矛盾，不要背这个错误标签。

ENTry an example: A teaching trace with ten cycles in one second is 10 Hz, fitting the slide’s alpha range. Four cycles in one second would be slower despite taller peaks. Alpha often accompanies relaxed wakefulness and delta slow-wave sleep, but these are associations rather than individual diagnostic rules. For English multiple-choice questions, distinguish “higher amplitude” from “higher frequency” and retain the slow-to-fast band order before memorizing numerical limits.

中文用例子理解：教学曲线若1秒有10个周期，就是10 Hz，落在课件的alpha范围内。另一条曲线1秒只有4个周期，即使峰更高，频率仍更慢。Alpha常伴随放松清醒，delta常见于慢波睡眠，但这只是相关表现，不是个人诊断规则。英文选择题要分清higher amplitude幅度更大与higher frequency频率更高；先记由慢到快的顺序，再记数值边界。

ENClarify the concept: In the conventional 10–20 labels shown, odd numbers identify left-hemisphere sites and even numbers right-hemisphere sites; z marks the midline. F/T/C/P/O label regions. These are spatial recording-site labels, not frequency bands, and the left/right convention refers to the subject.

中文把概念讲清：图示常规10–20编号中，奇数对应左侧、偶数对应右侧，z表示中线；F/T/C/P/O标区域。这些是空间记录位置标签，不是频率带，左右以被测者为准。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p82原位置图可核对；T7-0085–0087强调位置；当前FIGV704图解；README行654

Source / 来源：W7 p79–87; Sample quiz p1 Q5 | T7-0084–0087, T7-0091–0095

ENRead the figure: The left picture links a scalp electrode cap to several recorded traces. The right top view shows named recording sites: F, T, C, P and O refer to frontal, temporal, central, parietal and occipital regions; z marks the midline. These labels identify electrode positions, not the names of brain-wave frequency bands. Multiple electrodes sample different spatial combinations of brain activity; a recording site is not an isolated single neuron.

中文读图：左图把头皮电极帽与多条记录曲线连在一起；右图俯视头部，标出各记录位置。F、T、C、P、O分别对应额、颞、中央、顶、枕区域；z表示中线。这些标签是电极位置，不是脑波频段名称。多个电极采样脑活动在不同位置的组合，不是每个位置只对应一颗神经元。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p82; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S705 · [P1] Brain-wave states and timing脑波状态与时间窗口

P1 First passP1 先掌握Sample Q5样卷Q5Teacher emphasis课堂强调
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: For an EEG trace, use end time minus start time before dividing complete cycles by the duration.学习抓手：读EEG先用结束时间−开始时间，再以完整周期数除以这段时长。

Sample Q5 uses a nonzero start time样卷Q5横轴起点不是零: Sample quiz PDF p1 Q5

约45 Hz/C是低清图暂估，非教师最终确认答案。

Lecturer corrected the sample time-window trap老师专门纠正样题窗口陷阱: W7 PDF p84–87; T7-0092–0095

“If I have 30 peaks, you need to divide it by 0.6 second.”

此句30峰/0.6 s是课堂说明例子，不是原样题的确认计数。脑波状态关联按P2掌握，不能作单频诊断。

ENThe slide associates beta with awake, alert activity; alpha with relaxed wakefulness; theta with deeper relaxation or drowsier states; and delta with deep sleep. Gamma is a faster band. These associations overlap and depend on recording context. A single frequency label does not uniquely prove a sleep stage, a thought or a disease.

中文课件把beta β与清醒、警觉联系，把alpha α与放松清醒联系，把theta θ与更深放松或较困倦状态联系，把delta δ与深睡联系；gamma γ是更快的频带。这些关联有重叠，也依赖记录情境。单个频率标签不能唯一证明某个睡眠阶段、想法或疾病。

ENWhen the visible window starts at 0.2 s and ends at 0.8 s, its duration is 0.6 s, not 0.8 s and not one second. Count complete repetitions within that duration, then divide by 0.6 s. Real EEG often contains multiple frequencies; a rough cycle count estimates a representative oscillation, not the complete frequency spectrum. Vertical height and horizontal repetition rate must be read separately.

中文如果窗口从0.2 s开始、0.8 s结束，持续时间是0.6 s，不是0.8 s，也不是1秒。数这个窗口中的完整重复，再除以0.6 s。真实EEG常含多种频率，粗略数周期估计的是代表性振荡，不是完整frequency spectrum频谱。纵向高度与横向重复快慢要分开读。

Source / 来源：Week 7 PDF p84–87; T7-0091–0096; Sample quiz PDF p1 Q5

Week 8 learning block: Cell recording, amplification and filters / 第8学习组：细胞记录、放大与滤波

Week 8 concept map / 第8周知识框架

ENChapter logic: Choose a cell-recording method, preserve and amplify the weak signal, then select its useful frequency band; this chapter stops at Parts One and Two through PDF p29.

中文本章主线：先选择细胞记录方法，再保住并放大弱信号，最后选择有用频段；本组只到原PDF p29的第一、二章。

English term 中文名词 Meaning and connection 含义与知识联系
Patch clamp 膜片钳 A pipette forms a tight membrane seal. Voltage clamp holds voltage/read current; current clamp applies current/read voltage. 吸管与膜紧密封接。电压钳保持电压、读电流；电流钳施加电流、读电压。 Details / 详解
MEA / raster plot 多电极阵列 / 栅格图 MEA records extracellular activity from many sites in parallel. A raster plot shows when each channel detects spikes. MEA并行记录多个位点的细胞外活动；栅格图显示各通道何时检测到尖峰。 Details / 详解
Differential / common-mode 差分 / 共模 Vout=G(V1−V2). Equal shared interference cancels ideally; unequal interference remains. Vout=G(V1−V2)。相同共有干扰理想抵消，不同干扰仍可留下。 Details / 详解
Input impedance / output impedance / gain 输入阻抗 / 输出阻抗 / 增益 High input impedance reduces loading; low output impedance drives a load; gain specifies amplification. They are independent roles. 高输入阻抗减少加载，低输出阻抗驱动负载，增益决定放大倍数；三者分工不同。 Details / 详解
Preamplifier / isolation 前置放大 / 隔离 The preamplifier handles a weak input; isolation limits unwanted electrical paths and supports patient protection. 前置放大处理弱输入；隔离限制不希望出现的电连接路径，帮助保护被测者。 Details / 详解
Inverting / non-inverting 反相 / 同相 In the shown ideal circuits, gains are −Rf/Ri and 1+Rf/Ri. The minus sign reverses polarity, not amplification itself. 所示理想电路增益为−Rf/Ri与1+Rf/Ri。负号表示极性翻转，不表示没有放大。 Details / 详解
Low-pass / high-pass / band-pass / notch 低通 / 高通 / 带通 / 陷波 Filters attenuate unwanted frequency components: low-pass keeps slower components, high-pass faster, band-pass an interval, notch a narrow rejected band. 滤波器削弱不需要的频率成分：低通保留较慢、高通较快、带通保留区间、陷波抑制窄频带。 Details / 详解
Frequency-response graph 频率响应图 Horizontal frequency and vertical gain reveal the retained region. The local RC worked example is excluded; basic filter-role recognition remains. 横轴频率、纵轴增益显示保留区域。局部RC例题被排除，基本滤波功能辨认仍保留。 Details / 详解

ENFormula links for this chapter: FX706 Differential voltage and shared-noise cancellation, FX707 CMRR: a rejection ratio, not voltage gain, FX710 Ideal inverting and non-inverting op-amp gains, FX711 First-order RC cutoff and low-/high-pass response, FX712 Optional active analog-filter equations.

中文本章公式定位：FX706 差分电压与共有噪声抵消；FX707 CMRR：共模抑制比，不是电压增益；FX710 理想反相与同相运放增益；FX711 一阶 RC 截止与低通/高通响应；FX712 可选：有源模拟滤波器完整式。

C23 · [P1] Patch clamp versus multielectrode array (MEA) / 膜片钳与多电极阵列

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Repeated explanation反复讲解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Recognize patch-clamp and MEA structures, recording location and manual versus parallel throughput.学习抓手：辨识膜片钳与MEA的结构、胞内外记录及逐次/并行通量差别。

Two methods explicitly named for quiz/exam老师明确点名Quiz/exam的两个方法: W8 PDF p9–13; T8-0014–0016; T8-0018

“So if on a quiz or exam, if you happen to see any question asking you, please write down the two main method.”

原话还要求能画图简述；当前单选重点为图识别与比较，不要求模拟卷手写图。

Pipette and array recording explained in detail细讲微吸管与阵列记录: T8-0005–0016

不背吸管尺寸、平台96孔、历史年代等示例数字。

ENKey points
  • Patch clamp forms a tight seal between a micropipette and a membrane patch and can record controlled membrane currents or potentials depending on the mode.
  • A MEA records extracellular signals at many electrode sites in parallel.
  • The lecturer explicitly names these two methods for Quiz/exam recognition.
中文必会知识点
  • Patch clamp用微吸管与膜片形成紧密封接，根据模式记录受控的膜电流或电位。
  • MEA通过多个电极位点并行记录细胞外信号。
  • 老师明确点名这两种方法可作为Quiz或考试的辨识内容。

ENStart from zero: Patch clamp and MEA answer different measurement questions. A micropipette is a very small glass tube containing conducting liquid and an electrode. In patch clamp, its opening contacts a tiny patch of cell membrane and forms a tight seal. This close electrical connection allows detailed measurements from that cell or membrane patch. “Clamp” means controlling an electrical variable, not mechanically squeezing the whole cell.

中文从零理解：Patch clamp膜片钳与MEA解决的测量问题不同。Micropipette微吸管是非常细的玻璃管，内部装有导电液体及电极。膜片钳让管口接触一小块细胞膜，并形成紧密封接。这样的电连接让研究者能细致测量这个细胞或膜片。“Clamp钳制”指控制某个电学变量，不是用机械夹子把整个细胞夹住。

ENFollow the mechanism: In voltage-clamp mode, the instrument holds a chosen membrane voltage and measures the current needed; in current-clamp mode, it applies a chosen current and records voltage. A multielectrode array, MEA, instead places many electrodes near cells and records extracellular signals in parallel. Think of one close inspection point versus many listening stations. This analogy captures measurement coverage; it does not imply that the electrical signals are sounds.

中文跟着机制走：Voltage clamp电压钳模式下，仪器把膜电压保持在选定值，测为此所需的电流；current clamp电流钳模式下，仪器施加选定电流，记录电压。Multielectrode array多电极阵列，简称MEA，则把多个电极放在细胞附近，并行记录extracellular细胞外信号。可以类比“一个近距离检查点”与“许多监听站”，用于理解覆盖范围，而不是把电信号当成声音。

ENTry an example: If an English question describes a glass pipette, membrane patch and tight seal, identify patch clamp. If it describes patterned electrodes, many recording sites and simultaneous extracellular recording, identify MEA. A standard MEA does not directly report the intracellular membrane voltage at every site. Conversely, a single patch-clamp recording does not automatically provide parallel recordings from an entire network. Match the geometry and measured quantity together.

中文用例子理解：英文题出现glass pipette玻璃微吸管、membrane patch膜片、tight seal紧密封接，就认膜片钳。出现patterned electrodes图案化电极、many recording sites多个记录位点、simultaneous extracellular recording同时记录细胞外信号，就认MEA。普通MEA并不直接给出每个位点的细胞内膜电压；单个膜片钳也不自动提供整个网络的并行记录。把装置外形与测量量一起判断。

ENClarify the concept: Whole-cell patch clamp: a glass micropipette first forms a tight seal with a small membrane patch; the patch beneath the opening is then disrupted to provide electrical access to the cell interior. It is not simply a hollow needle puncturing anywhere through a cell. Configuration and clamp mode are different: voltage clamp holds voltage and reads current; current clamp applies current and reads voltage.

中文把概念讲清：Whole-cell patch clamp全细胞膜片钳：玻璃微吸管先与一小块膜形成紧密封接，再打开管口下方这块膜，获得细胞内电接入；不只是用中空针随便刺穿细胞。“构型”与“钳制模式”不同：电压钳保持电压、读电流；电流钳施加电流、读电压。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p9–10; T8-0006–0008, T8-0014–0018; Molecular Devices: whole-cell patch clamp

ENExam wording: Recognize the pipette–membrane seal versus the patterned electrode array. Do not replace a standard electrode array with the excluded detailed conformal-electrode material/design requirements.

中文英文读题抓手：图中要分清微吸管—细胞膜封接与阵列化电极。基础MEA辨识不能被替换成已排除的贴合电极材料或技术设计细节。

Source / 来源：W8 p9–13; W8 p9–10; W8 p11–13 | T8-0005–0016, T8-0018

ENRead the figure: The patch electrode accesses the cell interior; the external electrode stays outside. Compare the two illustrated waveforms: their shapes and amplitudes need not be the same. Position and recording method determine what voltage is measured.

中文读图：Patch electrode膜片电极接触细胞内；external electrode外部电极留在细胞外。比较图中两条波形：形状与幅值不必相同。位置和记录方式决定测到哪一种电压。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p9; original slide figure / 原课件截图

ENRead the figure: Find the patch pipette touching the membrane, the electrode inside its solution, and the operating amplifier with a feedback resistor. The pipette seal selects the membrane region for electrical recording; this is different from a flat MEA electrode beneath cells.

中文读图：找到接触细胞膜的patch pipette膜片吸管、吸管液中的电极，以及带反馈电阻的运算放大器。吸管与膜的封接选择电记录区域，与细胞下方平面MEA电极不同。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p9; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S801 · [P1] Recording-method trade-offs and raster plots / 记录方法的优缺点与栅格图

P1 First passP1 先掌握Quiz statedQuiz明确提及Repeated explanation反复讲解Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Compare patch-clamp and MEA throughput and read a raster plot as spike timing rather than voltage height.学习抓手：比较膜片钳/MEA通量，认栅格图的时间、通道与尖峰；刻痕不表示电压高度。

Patch clamp and MEA explicitly remain the key methods老师重申膜片钳和MEA是关键方法: W8 PDF p9–13; T8-0014–0018

“The answer will be these two.”

明确题型信号只指两个主方法；栅格图是MEA影片讲解中的理解工具，不是单独点名必考。

MEA parallel-recording advantages and video explained讲阵列并行记录优势及影片: T8-0009–0016

Impedance and optical comparison columns are secondary阻抗/光学对照列次要: W8 PDF p13; T8-0016–0018

“If you're interested, you can search for it.”

该两列及细优缺点按P3浏览；不要把主方法的明确考试信号平均分给所有方法。

ENPatch clamp allows detailed controlled-current or controlled-voltage measurements in a selected cell or membrane patch, but precise pipette positioning and skilled operation limit manual throughput. A standard MEA can record many extracellular sites in parallel without inserting a pipette into each cell; it is convenient for repeated network recordings. Its signal also depends on electrode contact and cell density or maturity. Many sites do not automatically mean a complete intracellular voltage map.

中文膜片钳可在选定细胞或膜片做细致的受控电流/电压测量，但微吸管需要精确定位与熟练操作，人工测量throughput通量较低。普通MEA可并行记录许多细胞外位点，不必把吸管逐个插入细胞，方便重复记录网络活动。其信号也受电极接触、细胞密度或成熟度影响。位点多不自动等于完整的细胞内电压地图。

ENA raster plot summarizes spike timing: the horizontal axis is time, each row represents one recording electrode, and each short mark denotes a detected spike. Marks aligned across rows suggest coordinated firing; dense bursts differ from isolated spikes. The marks primarily show when spikes occur, not their voltage amplitudes. This is how a MEA’s many channels become a readable picture of network activity.

中文Raster plot栅格图概括尖峰发生时间：横轴是时间，每行代表一个记录电极，每个短刻痕代表检测到一次尖峰。多行刻痕在同一时间对齐，提示协调发放；密集burst爆发与零散尖峰不同。刻痕主要表示“何时发生”，不直接表示电压幅值。这让MEA多通道记录变成可读的网络活动图。

ENThe comparison slide also shows impedance and optical methods. Bulk impedance reflects an electrical response of the measured sample or culture, rather than automatically identifying each individual cell. Optical reporters can change fluorescence with cellular activity and provide many imaging sites. However, fluorescence intensity is not itself an absolute voltage in millivolts; interpreting it as electrical activity may require calibration. Patch clamp and MEA remain the two methods the lecturer explicitly asked students to recognize.

中文对比页还列出impedance阻抗与optical光学方法。整体阻抗反映被测样品或培养体系的电响应，并不自动识别每个单细胞。光学报告分子可随细胞活动改变荧光，提供许多成像位点；但荧光强度本身不是以mV表示的绝对电压，解释为电活动可能需要校准。老师明确要求辨识的两个方法仍是膜片钳与MEA。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p9–13; T8-0008–0018

ENRead the figure: Read left to right: an MEA uses several electrode sites near cells; patch clamp uses a glass pipette sealed against a membrane region; impedance measurements apply electrical probing and measure the voltage–current relationship; optical techniques detect a light-based reporter response. The cartoons show different measurement interfaces, not interchangeable ways to obtain exactly the same waveform. The illustrated MEA arrangement is extracellular. For a voltage-sensitive optical reporter, quantitative voltage estimates need calibration; generic fluorescence intensity is not an absolute voltage.

中文读图：从左向右看：MEA在细胞附近设置多个电极点；patch clamp膜片钳用玻璃吸管与一块膜封接；impedance阻抗测量施加电探测并测电压—电流关系；optical techniques光学方法检测光学报告信号。图示的是不同测量界面，不表示四者能直接得到完全相同的波形。图中MEA是胞外记录；若使用电压敏感的光学报告探针，还需校准才能定量估计电压；普通荧光强度不是绝对电压。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p13; original slide figure / 原课件截图

ENRead the figure: Each row here is one electrode/channel; each tick is a detected spike event at a time. Ticks near 0.48 s across several channels illustrate roughly coordinated timing. Tick height is only a plotting symbol, not voltage amplitude. The array measures extracellular signals; interpretation depends on detection and electrode placement.

中文读图：这里每一行表示一个电极／通道，每条短竖线表示该时刻检测到一次Spike（脉冲事件）。多个通道在0.48 s附近出现短线，示意时间大致同步。短线高度只是画图符号，不是电压幅度。阵列记录的是细胞外信号；解释还取决于事件检测方法和电极位置。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p11–13; original teaching schematic / 自绘教学示意，非实验数据

C24 · [P1] Differential amplification and common-mode noise / 差分放大与共模噪声

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Use Vout=G(V₁−V₂), identify common-mode interference and understand why matched inputs matter.学习抓手：会用Vout=G(V₁−V₂)，理解共模抑制及电极不匹配为什么留下噪声。

Differential recording explicitly emphasized老师明确强调小信号差分消噪: W7 PDF p52–54; T7-0043–0046

“This is very important question that you need to keep in mind about why EMG can work very well, how to ignore the noise, given that the signal is very small.”

只能抑制两端相似的干扰，不能把口语说明扩成所有噪声/运动都完全消失。

Weak signals and amplification emphasized again再次强调微弱信号需放大: W8 PDF p19–20; T8-0021–0023

“you should expect that these bioelectrical signals or biopotential signals are all very weak.”

Classroom quiz: third reference electrode课堂quiz：第三参考电极: T7-0047–0049; W7 PDF p52–55

“These two questions are very typical quiz type of question.”

A接3只对课堂原图有效；要学参考/接地的作用，不背无图编号。

ENKey points
  • A differential amplifier amplifies the difference between two inputs: Vout=G(V₁−V₂).
  • A signal appearing similarly at both inputs is common-mode and is ideally rejected.
  • High input impedance reduces loading of a weak biological signal.
中文必会知识点
  • 差分放大器放大两输入之差：Vout=G(V₁−V₂)。
  • 两端相似的信号是common-mode，理想情况下被抑制。
  • 较高输入阻抗减少对微弱生物信号的负载影响。

ENStart from zero: A differential amplifier receives two voltages and enlarges their difference: Vout=G(V₁−V₂). G is voltage gain, a multiplication factor. A voltage added equally to both inputs is common-mode. If V₁=S₁+n and V₂=S₂+n, subtraction removes the identical n, leaving S₁−S₂. Imagine two thermometers both shifted by the same calibration error: their difference still cancels that shared error.

中文从零理解：Differential amplifier差分放大器接收两个电压，放大它们的差：Vout=G(V₁−V₂)。G是voltage gain电压增益，即乘上多少倍。两端同样增加的电压叫common-mode共模。如果V₁=S₁+n、V₂=S₂+n，相减后相同的n消失，只剩S₁−S₂。可类比两个温度计都有同样的校准偏移：相减时，这个共有误差会抵消。

ENFollow the mechanism: If the noises differ, n₁−n₂ remains; real amplifiers also reject common-mode imperfectly. High input impedance means the measuring input draws very little current from the biological source. That reduces loading, which would otherwise alter the voltage being measured. It preserves the input signal; it does not itself set gain. Think of measuring gently without draining the source, rather than automatically making its signal bigger.

中文跟着机制走：若两端噪声不同，n₁−n₂仍会留下；实际放大器的共模抑制也并非完美。High input impedance高输入阻抗，表示测量端从生物信号源取走的电流很少，从而减少loading加载，否则被测电压会因测量而改变。它帮助保住输入信号，并不直接决定增益。可以理解为“轻轻测，尽量不取走源的电流”，而不是自动把源信号变大。

ENTry an example: Example: V₁=1.4 mV, V₂=1.1 mV and G=1000. First subtract: 0.3 mV. Then multiply: 300 mV=0.300 V. Adding the same 5 mV interference to both inputs leaves the difference unchanged ideally. Adding 5 mV to only one input changes it greatly. Therefore “large gain removes any noise” is false: gain also enlarges noise that survives the subtraction.

中文用例子理解：例：V₁=1.4 mV、V₂=1.1 mV、G=1000。先相减得到0.3 mV，再放大得到300 mV=0.300 V。理想情况下，两端同时加同样的5 mV干扰，差值不变；只在一端加5 mV，差值就会明显改变。所以“增益大就能消除所有噪声”是错的：相减后剩下的噪声，也会被增益放大。

ENExam wording: Subtract before multiplying, and convert mV to V correctly. The reference and recording locations matter. Gain alone does not guarantee removal of noise that appears differently at the two inputs.

中文英文读题抓手：先相减再乘增益，并正确换算mV与V。记录位置和参考位置很重要。若噪声在两输入端不同，仅有增益并不保证它被消除。

Source / 来源：W7 p52–54; W8 p19–20; W8 p20; W8 p22 | T7-0043–0046, T8-0021–0026

B32 · [P2] Amplifier chain, isolation and polarity放大链、隔离与极性

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Separate amplification, filtering and isolation; explain high input/low output impedance and polarity.学习抓手：分清放大、滤波、隔离；懂高输入/低输出阻抗，认反相与同相极性。

Biopotential amplifier chain explained讲解生物电放大链各级: W8 PDF p19–24; T8-0021–0026

Other amplifier diagrams are locally described as reference其他放大器结构局部说供参考: W8 PDF p23–24; T8-0026

“You don't need to memorize these. These are just for your reference.”

these所指页面无同步证据，不能声称逐式排除反相/同相短增益；结构与长式降优先。

ENKey points
  • A preamplifier handles weak input;
  • high-pass filtering reduces slow drift and low-pass filtering reduces fast interference.
  • Isolation supports patient protection.
  • High input impedance reduces loading;
  • low output impedance helps drive a load.
  • Neither specifies voltage gain.
  • Inverting amplification reverses polarity;
  • non-inverting preserves it.
  • Recognize the ideal gains −Rf/Rin and 1+Rf/Rin as supporting relations, not an explicit memorization promise.
中文必会知识点
  • Preamplifier前置放大器处理弱输入；
  • 高通减小慢漂移，低通减小快速干扰。
  • Isolation隔离用于患者保护。
  • 高输入阻抗减少加载，低输出阻抗便于驱动负载，二者都不直接决定电压增益。
  • Inverting反相放大翻转极性；
  • non-inverting同相放大保持极性。
  • 理想增益−Rf/Rin和1+Rf/Rin可作辅助辨识，并非老师明确保证必背。

ENStart from zero: A weak biological signal usually needs several processing stages. A preamplifier enlarges the initial small signal. High-pass filtering reduces slow drift; low-pass filtering reduces fast components outside the useful range. An isolation stage separates electrical connections to help protect the subject and limit unwanted current paths. Amplification, filtering and isolation perform different jobs: none should be described as automatically doing everything the other stages do.

中文从零理解：微弱生物信号通常需要多级处理。Preamplifier前置放大器先放大初始小信号；高通减少慢漂移，低通削弱有用频段之外的快速成分；isolation stage隔离级隔开电连接，帮助保护被测者并限制不希望出现的电流路径。放大、滤波、隔离分工不同，不能把某一级说成自动完成其他所有级的任务。

ENFollow the mechanism: Input impedance describes how strongly the amplifier loads its source. A high value draws little input current and helps preserve the source voltage. Output impedance concerns driving the next device: a low value reduces voltage loss into that load. Gain is separately the ratio of output signal to input signal. Think of a gentle receiver connected to a strong sender; this illustrates loading, not a rule that high impedance creates large gain.

中文跟着机制走：Input impedance输入阻抗描述放大器对信号源施加多大负载。输入阻抗高，取走的输入电流少，有助于保住源电压。Output impedance输出阻抗涉及驱动下一级设备：输出阻抗低，可减少负载造成的电压损失。Gain增益则另行定义为输出与输入信号之比。可以理解为“轻轻接收，同时有力输出”，用来理解加载；不能据此推出阻抗高就增益大。

ENTry an example: Inverting means polarity reversal: a positive input produces a negative output in the ideal circuit. Non-inverting keeps polarity. With Rf=20 kΩ and Rin=10 kΩ, the ideal inverting gain is −Rf/Rin=−2; the non-inverting gain is 1+Rf/Rin=3. Thus a +1 mV input gives −2 mV or +3 mV respectively. The minus sign describes polarity, not an absence of amplification. These simple examples explain the circuits rather than promise a specific Quiz question.

中文用例子理解：Inverting反相表示极性翻转：理想电路里，正输入产生负输出；non-inverting同相保留极性。若Rf=20 kΩ、Rin=10 kΩ，理想反相增益为−Rf/Rin=−2，同相增益为1+Rf/Rin=3。因此+1 mV输入分别得到−2 mV或+3 mV。负号描述极性，并不表示“没有放大”。这些简单例子用于理解电路，不是保证Quiz一定考这道题。

Source / 来源：W8 p13; W8 p19–20; W8 p20; W8 p21; W8 p19–29 context; W8 p22; W8 p23–24; W8 p25–26; W8 p27–28; W8 p29 | T8-0016–0018, T8-0021–0029, T8-0062–0064

ENRead the figure: Follow the arrows from the patient on the left to Vout on the right. The preamplifier raises a weak signal; the high-pass stage reduces DC and slow drift; the isolation stage provides electrical separation for safety and helps prevent ground loops; the low-pass stage attenuates excessively fast components. Each tiny filter graph has frequency on its horizontal axis. Gain, filtering and isolation serve different functions: amplification alone does not remove all noise or provide patient isolation.

中文读图：沿箭头从左侧患者读到右侧Vout输出。Preamplifier前置放大器把弱信号放大；high-pass高通减少直流与缓慢漂移；isolation隔离级提供电隔离以保护被测者，也有助于避免地环路；low-pass低通衰减过快成分。两个小滤波图的横轴都是频率。增益、滤波、隔离各司其职：单靠放大既不能消除所有噪声，也不能实现患者电隔离。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p22; original slide figure / 原课件截图

S802 · [P2] Amplifier requirements, bandwidth and safety / 放大器要求、带宽与安全

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Understand amplifier impedance, gain, useful bandwidth and isolation; use the chart for orientation rather than memorizing boundaries.学习抓手：懂放大器阻抗、增益、有效带宽与隔离；图表认大致关系，不背所有边界数值。

Amplifier requirements and stages discussed讲解放大器要求与处理链: W8 PDF p19–22; T8-0021–0026

高输入阻抗减小加载，不直接保证高增益；>10 MΩ来自课件，不是字幕逐字数值。

Detailed amplitude/frequency chart data need not be memorized幅度/频率图详细数据不用死记: W8 PDF p21; T8-0023–0024; T8-0064

“You don't need to memorize these things.”

EOG/ERG和ground loop用于词汇理解；不将论文图边界、全部商业指标当考试重点。

ENThe requirement slide gives high input impedance (>10 MΩ), low output impedance and large gain (often >1000) for weak biopotential signals. These numbers describe the stated application, not every amplifier: the preceding slide lists gains from ×10 to ×10000. Input impedance preserves the source voltage, output impedance helps drive the load, and gain sets amplification. None of these three quantities substitutes for the others.

中文要求页给出高输入阻抗（>10 MΩ）、低输出阻抗，以及微弱生物信号常需较大增益（常见>1000）。这些数值针对所述应用，不是所有放大器的统一定义：前一页也列出×10至×10000的增益。输入阻抗帮助保住源电压，输出阻抗帮助驱动负载，gain决定放大倍数，三者不能相互替代。

ENFrequency response must cover the useful signal band. More gain does not restore signal removed by an unsuitable filter, and a wider bandwidth can admit more unwanted components. The amplitude-versus-frequency chart shows that ECG, EEG and EMG occupy different approximate regions; its detailed numerical boundaries were presented for reference. EOG means electrooculogram, associated with eye-related potentials; ERG means electroretinogram, recording retinal electrical responses, rather than EEG brain recordings.

中文Frequency response频率响应要覆盖有用信号频段。更多增益不能恢复已被不合适滤波器削掉的信号，较宽bandwidth带宽也可放进更多不需要的成分。幅度—频率图显示ECG、EEG、EMG的大致区域不同；详细数值边界是供参考。图中EOG是electrooculogram眼电图，与眼相关电位有关；ERG是electroretinogram视网膜电图，记录视网膜电响应，不是EEG脑电。

ENAn isolation stage protects the subject by limiting unwanted electrical connections and current paths; it also helps prevent ground loops. A ground loop is an unintended closed path through connected grounds that can introduce interference. Safety is therefore about patient-connected current paths and protection, not merely choosing a small voltage gain. Amplification, isolation and filtering remain distinct functions.

中文Isolation stage隔离级通过限制不希望出现的电连接和电流路径保护被测者，也有助于防止ground loop地环路。地环路是互连接地之间意外形成的闭合路径，可引入干扰。因此，安全涉及患者连接的电流路径与保护措施，并不只是选择较小电压增益。放大、隔离与滤波仍是不同功能。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p19–22; T8-0021–0026

S803 · [P3] Read an operational-amplifier diagram看懂运算放大器图

P3 Supporting readingP3 辅助阅读Lower priority降低优先级Supporting concept辅助理解
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Use the op-amp picture to recognize signal inputs, supply terminals, output and feedback; keep gain relations as support.学习抓手：辅助看懂运放输入、供电、输出与反馈；短增益关系备查，不主攻长推导。

Other amplifier diagrams locally called reference其他放大器图局部说仅供参考: W8 PDF p23–24; T8-0025–0026

“You don't need to memorize these. These are just for your reference.”

these没有同步页切换，不能说老师逐式明确排除了反相/同相短增益；本节仅作为理解结构的辅助。

Diagram reading supports the main amplifier concept读图支撑放大器主概念: W8 PDF p23–24

优先C24和B32；只有满足理想线性负反馈条件才用相关闭环公式。

ENThe op-amp triangle has a non-inverting (+) signal input, an inverting (−) signal input and an output. The supply terminals power the circuit; they are not the two measured biological signal inputs. The +/− input labels specify which input contribution increases or decreases output polarity, not that one electrode must always have a positive measured voltage and the other a negative one.

中文Op-amp运算放大器三角形有non-inverting（+，同相）信号输入、inverting（−，反相）信号输入与输出。Supply terminals供电端给电路供能，不是两个被测生物信号输入。“+”“−”表示输入对输出极性的作用，不是说一个电极测得的电压必须始终为正、另一个必须始终为负。

ENIn the shown circuits, a feedback resistor connects output back to the inverting input. Under the ideal linear-operation assumptions, the resistor ratios set the closed-loop gains: −Rf/Ri for inverting and 1+Rf/Ri for non-inverting. A minus sign reverses polarity. These relations should not be applied as if output could grow without limit; the amplifier must remain within its available output range.

中文图中feedback resistor反馈电阻把输出接回反相输入。满足理想线性工作假设时，电阻比决定closed-loop gain闭环增益：反相为−Rf/Ri，同相为1+Rf/Ri。负号表示极性翻转。不能把公式理解成输出能无限增大；放大器必须在可用输出范围内工作。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p23–24; T8-0025–0026

ENRead the figure: On the left, Vi reaches the − input through Ri; on the right, Vi reaches the + input. In both circuits, trace Rf from the output back to the − input. Under ideal linear-operation assumptions, the gains are −Rf/Ri and 1+Rf/Ri respectively. The minus sign means output polarity is reversed; it does not mean negative signal size or negative input impedance. These relations apply while the amplifier remains within its operating and output limits.

中文读图：左图Vi经Ri到“−”输入，右图Vi直接到“+”输入。两图都可沿Rf追踪输出返回“−”输入的反馈路径。理想线性工作时，增益分别为−Rf/Ri与1+Rf/Ri。负号表示输出极性翻转，不表示信号大小为负，也不是输入阻抗为负。公式成立还要求放大器在允许的工作与输出范围内。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p24; original slide figure / 原课件截图

C25 · [P1] High-pass, low-pass, band-pass and notch filters / 高通、低通、带通与陷波滤波器

P1 First passP1 先掌握Teacher emphasis课堂强调Repeated explanation反复讲解Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Identify low-pass, high-pass, band-pass and band-reject/notch roles and response curves.学习抓手：从名字和响应曲线认高通、低通、带通、带阻/陷波；区分通过与衰减。

Low-pass versus high-pass must not be confused老师明确要求不混淆高通、低通: W8 PDF p25–26; T8-0026–0027

“The meaning of low pass and high pass you should not get confused.”

Filter roles in the signal chain放大链中反复说明滤波作用: W8 PDF p22; T8-0024–0027

Specific RC cutoff example is secondary具体RC截止例题降优先: W8 PDF p27–29; T8-0028

“But I can tell you it will it will not be in this year's exam, okay?”

原话仅就该往年例题说今年exam不出，未逐字排除Quiz；不扩大为所有滤波概念不考。长传递式不主攻。

ENKey points
  • A high-pass filter attenuates low-frequency components;
  • a low-pass filter attenuates high-frequency components.
  • A band-pass filter preserves a frequency interval.
  • A band-reject or notch filter suppresses an interval or narrow interference band, such as mains interference when appropriately selected.
中文必会知识点
  • High-pass抑制低频，low-pass抑制高频；
  • band-pass保留一个频率区间；
  • band-reject或notch抑制一个区间或窄干扰带，例如适当选择时可抑制工频干扰。

ENStart from zero: A recorded signal can contain slow baseline drift, useful biological changes, and fast interference together. Frequency describes how rapidly each repeating component changes, not how tall it is. A filter treats these components differently. Pass means retain relatively well; attenuate means reduce amplitude. A low-pass filter does not turn every fast oscillation into a slower one: it mainly weakens the unwanted fast components.

中文从零理解：一条记录中，可能同时含有很慢的baseline drift基线漂移、有用的生物变化和很快的干扰。Frequency频率描述每个重复成分变化有多快，不描述它有多高。Filter滤波器区别处理这些成分。Pass通过表示较好保留；attenuate衰减表示减小幅度。低通不是把所有快速振荡“变慢”，而是主要削弱不需要的快速成分。

ENFollow the mechanism: High-pass keeps higher frequencies and reduces slower ones; low-pass does the reverse. Band-pass keeps an interval between lower and upper limits. Band-reject suppresses an interval; a notch is a narrow rejection band. Think of frequency gates accepting certain repetition rates. Actual transitions are gradual, so near a cutoff the amount of attenuation matters.

中文跟着机制走：High-pass高通保留较高频率、削弱较慢成分；low-pass低通的作用相反。Band-pass带通保留上下限之间的一段频率；band-reject带阻抑制一个区间；notch陷波是窄的抑制区间。可以想成按“重复快慢”筛选的门。实际边界渐变，所以接近cutoff截止频率时，衰减多少也重要。

ENTry an example: For an idealized 10–100 Hz band-pass teaching example, a 5 Hz component is reduced, a 40 Hz component is retained, and a 200 Hz component is reduced. A suitably chosen notch can reduce 50 Hz mains interference. However, useful signal at 50 Hz is also affected: the filter cannot recognize whether a component is biological or interference merely from its origin. Match the requested frequency range to the filter type.

中文用例子理解：教学例中，若采用理想化10–100 Hz带通，5 Hz成分被削弱，40 Hz被保留，200 Hz被削弱。合适的陷波可削弱50 Hz工频干扰，但有用信号若也位于50 Hz，同样会受影响：滤波器不会仅凭成分的来源，就自动区分“生物信号”与“干扰”。做题时，把要求保留或抑制的频率范围对应到滤波类型。

ENExam wording: Keep filter-role recognition in the main review. The particular RC cutoff example was excluded from this year’s exam in its local context; this does not justify excluding every filter concept from the Quiz.

中文英文读题抓手：主复习保留滤波功能辨识。某个RC截止频率例题在局部语境中被说成今年考试不考，这不能推导为所有滤波概念都不在Quiz范围。

Source / 来源：W8 p25–26; W8 p27–28; W8 p29 | T8-0026–0029, T8-0062–0063

S804 · [P2] Read filter responses and simple circuit trends / 读滤波响应图与简单电路趋势

P2 Important foundationsP2 重要基础Teacher emphasis课堂强调Worked example例题练习Lower priority降低优先级
Evidence and review target依据与学习抓手

Review target: Read pass/stop regions of response graphs first; understand RC cutoff trends without prioritizing the old worked calculation.学习抓手：先读响应图的通过/衰减区；RC仅懂R/C增大时截止频率降低，旧例题后看。

Graph recognition supports the emphasized four filter roles读图支撑老师强调的四种滤波作用: W8 PDF p25–26; T8-0026–0027

“The meaning of low pass and high pass you should not get confused.”

四曲线辨认属C25的P1内容；本小节中的RC公式和电路细节另外降优先。

Slide worked RC cutoff calculation课件RC截止计算例题: W8 PDF p27–29; T8-0027–0029

The particular past-exam cutoff example was locally excluded那道往年截止例题被局部排除: T8-0028

“But I can tell you it will it will not be in this year's exam, okay?”

只逐字明确今年exam不出该例题，未明确提Quiz；RC代入、长传递式按P3辅助，不排除四种滤波概念。

ENOn a frequency-response plot, the horizontal axis is frequency and the vertical axis is gain or response magnitude. A low-pass curve is relatively large at low frequency and falls at high frequency; a high-pass does the reverse. A band-pass retains a middle region and falls at both ends; a band-reject has a suppressed middle region. On a time trace, removing fast components often makes the waveform smoother; removing slow components can remove baseline drift.

中文频率响应图横轴是频率，纵轴是gain增益或响应幅度。低通在低频较大、高频下降，高通相反；带通保留中间区间、两端下降；带阻则让中间区间降低。时间曲线上，去掉快速成分往往让波形更平滑；去掉慢成分可减少基线漂移。

ENThe analog-filter diagrams implement these same roles using resistors, capacitors and op-amps. A high-pass stage followed by a low-pass stage can form a band-pass when the lower cutoff is below the upper cutoff. For a simple first-order RC stage, the supporting relation is fc=1/(2πRC): increasing R or C lowers fc. The lecturer excluded the particular worked RC cutoff example; retain the role and graph recognition, with this formula as supporting understanding rather than a promised Quiz calculation.

中文Analog filter模拟滤波器图用电阻、电容与运放实现同样的功能。高通后接低通，在下截止频率低于上截止频率时，可组成带通。简单一阶RC级的辅助关系是fc=1/(2πRC)：增大R或C会降低fc。老师排除了那道具体RC截止频率例题；保留功能与读图辨认，公式作为辅助理解，不把它宣传成Quiz保证计算题。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p25–29; T8-0026–0029

ENRead the figure: Read the frequency axis from left to right. A high part of a curve means relatively strong transmission, and a low part means attenuation. Blue idealized boundaries and the smooth practical curves express the same pass/stop roles.

中文读图：频率轴从左向右增大。曲线较高表示相对更好通过，较低表示衰减。蓝色理想边界与平滑的实际曲线，表达的是同样的通过/抑制功能。

Source / 来源：Week 8 PDF p25; original slide figure / 原课件截图

Formulas explained with small examples公式符号与短例题（完整补全）

ENUpdated 2026-10-14: the original ten worked relations are expanded here by checking the classmate’s formula sheet against the lecture sources. P1/P2/P3 set revision order, not certainty of appearing on the quiz. Long formulas remain available for recognition and substitution when quantities are supplied.

中文2026-10-14更新：原先集中讲解的10项关系式已按同学公式表及原课件扩充。P1/P2/P3决定复习先后，不代表真题保证；较长的关系式也保留，用于辨认与给定数据下的代入。

ENSymbols are reused between topics: n can mean refractive index, charge-carrier density or electron count; R can mean resistance, reflectivity or resolving power. Read the definition beside each formula. Δ denotes a change or a spectral separation, j² = −1, and log₁₀ is distinct from ln. Always match units before calculating.

中文不同章节会复用符号：n可能是折射率、载流子密度或电子数；R可能是电阻、反射率或分辨本领。每次按该公式旁的定义读。Δ表示变化量或谱线间隔，j²=−1，log₁₀与ln不同；代入前先统一单位。

ENQuick route: follow a chapter’s formula links, read the equation and symbols, then check its conditions and tiny example. The cards below retain every topic in the classmate’s 37-row appendix and add supported short relations from the covered lectures.

中文使用顺序：从本章公式链接进入，先看式子和符号，再看适用条件与短例。下方覆盖同学附录A的全部37类主题，并补入考试范围课件中的重要短关系。

FX101 · [P1] Calibration sensitivity and concentration LODFX101 · [P1] 校准灵敏度与浓度检出限

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Worked in class and represented in Sample Q10/Q12; know the calculation and units.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。课堂讲解并对应 Sample Q10/Q12，须会算且会核对单位。

Formula: 公式： y = mC + b; m = Δy / ΔC; LOD_C = 3σ_y / |m|

ENSymbols and units: C: concentration; y: response; m: calibration slope; b: intercept; σ_y: blank/low-level response SD. m has response/concentration units.

中文符号与单位：C：浓度；y：响应；m：校准斜率；b：截距；σ_y：空白/低水平响应标准差。m 单位为响应/浓度。

ENWhen to use: Convert a measurable response change into target amount and compare the threshold with output noise.

中文何时使用：将响应变化换算为目标量，比较检测阈值与输出噪声。

ENConditions and traps: Use a valid local linear calibration, with σ_y and m in matching response units. The 3σ rule is the course approximation. Apply an integer ceiling only when the problem requires discrete counts at or above LOD. Sensitivity is a slope; LOD is a concentration. Do not use the saturated part or mistake m for σ. W1 p62 mixes current and current-density units.

中文条件与易错点：使用有效局部线性校准，σ_y 与 m 响应单位一致。3σ 是本课程采用的近似；只有要求不低于阈值的整数计数时才向上取整。 灵敏度是斜率，检出限是浓度；不用饱和段，不把 m 当 σ。W1 p62 电流和电流密度单位混写。

ENTiny example: σ_y=2 and m=10.911 in matching units give LOD≈0.55 mM.

中文短例理解：响应单位一致时，σ_y=2、m=10.911，LOD≈0.55 mM。

Source / 来源：W1 PDF p60–62 | W2 PDF p9–10 | T1-0054 | T1-0055 | T1-0056 | T1-0057 | T1-0058 | T1-0059 | T2-0007 | T2-0008 | Sample Quiz PDF p2 Q10/Q12

FX102 · [P3] Hall voltageFX102 · [P3] 霍尔电压

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Printed as a background sensor example; no class-worked Hall calculation or direct Quiz question was found. Recognize the proportionality first.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。课件作为传感器背景例子出现，未定位课堂霍尔计算或直接样题；先会辨认正比关系。

Formula: 公式： V_H = I B_perp / (n_c q t); |V_H| = |I B_perp| / (n_c |q| t)

ENSymbols and units: I: current (A); B_perp: magnetic field perpendicular to the current/sensing plate (T); n_c: carrier number density (m⁻³); q: signed carrier charge (C); t: plate thickness (m).

中文符号与单位：I：电流 A；B_perp：相应垂直磁场分量 T；n_c：载流子数密度 m⁻³；q：带正负号的载流子电荷 C；t：薄片厚度 m。

ENWhen to use: Relate transverse Hall voltage to magnetic field; at fixed I, n_c, q and t, V_H is proportional to B_perp.

中文何时使用：把横向霍尔电压与磁场联系起来，其他参数固定时 V_H 与 B_perp 成正比。

ENConditions and traps: Simple uniform slab with a dominant carrier type and the stated field geometry. The sign depends on carrier type and measurement polarity. n_c here is a number density, not optical refractive index; t is thickness, not time. A voltage sign needs a defined polarity.

中文条件与易错点：均匀薄片、单一主导载流子及指定磁场几何的简化模型，符号取决于载流子与测量极性。 这里 n_c 是数密度，不是折射率；t 是厚度，不是时间。电压正负必须先定义极性。

ENTiny example: With all other factors fixed, doubling B_perp doubles |V_H|; doubling thickness halves it.

中文短例理解：其他不变时，B_perp 加倍使 |V_H| 加倍；厚度加倍使电压减半。

Source / 来源：W1 PDF p21 | T1-0022

FX103 · [P2] Optical wave, frequency, wavelength and phaseFX103 · [P2] 光波、频率、波长与相位

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. W2 explicitly defines these symbols; learn the relationships and meanings, not a new wave-equation derivation.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。W2 明确定义这些符号，要懂关系与含义，不增加波动方程推导要求。

Formula: 公式： E_field(z,t) = E0 cos(ωt − kz); ω = 2πf; k = 2π/λ; v_phase = fλ; in vacuum: c = fλ0

ENSymbols and units: E_field: electric field, not photon energy; E0: field amplitude; f: Hz; ω: rad/s; k: rad/m; λ: wavelength in the propagation medium; λ0: vacuum wavelength; c≈3×10⁸ m/s.

中文符号与单位：E_field：电场，不是光子能量；E0：场幅；f：Hz；ω：rad/s；k：rad/m；λ：传播介质中的波长；λ0：真空波长；c≈3×10⁸ m/s。

ENWhen to use: Recognize frequency, phase and propagation direction; shorter vacuum wavelength means higher frequency.

中文何时使用：辨认频率、相位、传播方向；真空波长越短，频率越高。

ENConditions and traps: The cosine expression is an ideal monochromatic plane wave. Use c=fλ only with vacuum wavelength; in a medium use its phase speed. The course writes frequency as ν. ω is not f: they differ by 2π. The electric-field symbol E and photon-energy E are different quantities.

中文条件与易错点：余弦式为理想单色平面波；c=fλ 必须使用真空波长，介质中用其相速度。课件频率符号为 ν。 ω 不是 f，两者差 2π；电场 E 与光子能量 E 是不同量。

ENTiny example: λ0=600 nm gives f≈5×10¹⁴ Hz and ω≈3.14×10¹⁵ rad/s.

中文短例理解：λ0=600 nm 时 f≈5×10¹⁴ Hz，ω≈3.14×10¹⁵ rad/s。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p17 | T2-0011 | T2-0012

FX104 · [P1] Photon energy, total energy and photon rateFX104 · [P1] 单光子能量、总能量与光子率

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. The lecturer uses this in the 500 nm photon example and W2 p80 bacterium calculation.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。老师用于 500 nm 光子例子及 W2 p80 细菌光子计算。

Formula: 公式： E_ph = hf = hc/λ0; E_ph(eV) ≈ 1240/λ0(nm); E_total = N E_ph; N_dot = P/E_ph = Pλ0/(hc)

ENSymbols and units: h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s; c=2.99792458×10⁸ m/s; λ0: vacuum wavelength; N: photon count; P: optical power (W=J/s); N_dot: photons/s; 1 eV=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ J.

中文符号与单位：h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s；c=2.99792458×10⁸ m/s；λ0：真空波长；N：光子数；P：光功率 W=J/s；N_dot：光子/秒；1 eV=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ J。

ENWhen to use: Move between wavelength, energy per photon, total energy and photons per second.

中文何时使用：在波长、单光子能量、总能量及每秒光子数之间换算。

ENConditions and traps: Use one photon wavelength or sum over wavelengths for a broadband beam. The 1240 shortcut requires nm and eV. For photons reaching a sample, use power actually incident on that sample. P is energy per second, not photon energy. Do not multiply by the number of dye molecules, and do not confuse incident and detected photon rate.

中文条件与易错点：单色光用一个波长，宽带光需按各波长求和；1240 快捷式要求 nm 与 eV。求照到样品的光子率时用实际到达样品的功率。 P 是每秒能量，不是光子能量；不额外乘染料分子数，不混淆入射与探测光子率。

ENTiny example: 410 nm and 10 nW give E_ph≈4.845×10⁻¹⁹ J and N_dot≈2.064×10¹⁰ s⁻¹.

中文短例理解：410 nm、10 nW 时 E_ph≈4.845×10⁻¹⁹ J，N_dot≈2.064×10¹⁰ s⁻¹。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p19–20 | W2 PDF p80 | T2-0014 | T2-0015 | T2-0016 | T2-0101 | T2-0102 | T2-0103 | T2-0104

FX105 · [P3] Photon momentumFX105 · [P3] 光子动量

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Shown in the particle-model slide; no dedicated momentum arithmetic was located. Recognize the concept and inverse-wavelength trend.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。粒子模型页出现，未定位专门动量计算；会辨认概念与波长反比趋势。

Formula: 公式： p_ph = h/λ0 = E_ph/c (vacuum)

ENSymbols and units: p_ph: photon momentum (kg·m/s); h: Planck constant; λ0: vacuum wavelength; E_ph: photon energy.

中文符号与单位：p_ph：光子动量 kg·m/s；h：普朗克常数；λ0：真空波长；E_ph：光子能量。

ENWhen to use: Explain why absorption/reflection can transfer momentum and why light can exert pressure.

中文何时使用：解释吸收/反射为何能传递动量，以及光为何能施加压力。

ENConditions and traps: This is the vacuum photon relation. It is not an unqualified formula for momentum inside a material. Momentum, energy and photon rate have different units; P/E_ph is not a momentum.

中文条件与易错点：这是光子在真空中的关系，不可无条件拿来表示介质内动量。 动量、能量与光子率单位不同，P/E_ph 不是动量。

ENTiny example: Doubling vacuum wavelength halves each photon’s momentum.

中文短例理解：真空波长加倍，单光子动量减半。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p19

FX106 · [P2] Energy fractions: reflection, absorption and transmissionFX106 · [P2] 反射、吸收与透射能量比例

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. A useful foundation for distinguishing optical interactions and absorbance notation.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。用于区分光学作用及吸光度记号的重要基础。

Formula: 公式： R + A_frac + T = 1

ENSymbols and units: R: reflected fraction; A_frac: absorbed fraction; T: transmitted fraction. All are dimensionless fractions of the same incident energy.

中文符号与单位：R：反射比例；A_frac：吸收比例；T：透射比例；均为同一入射能量的无量纲比例。

ENWhen to use: Check a simple optical energy budget and determine a missing fraction.

中文何时使用：核对简单光能量收支，并求缺失的比例。

ENConditions and traps: The measured/accounted channels must include all outgoing reflection/transmission; in a scattering sample, any separately excluded scattered light needs its own budget term. A_frac is an absorbed fraction, whereas Beer–Lambert absorbance A is −log10(T); the two A meanings are not interchangeable.

中文条件与易错点：被计入的反射/透射必须覆盖全部对应出射能量；散射样品中若有另外排除的散射光，应单独加入收支。 A_frac 是吸收比例；Beer–Lambert 的吸光度 A 是 −log10(T)，两个 A 不能混用。

ENTiny example: R=0.10 and T=0.70 imply A_frac=0.20, not an absorbance of 0.20.

中文短例理解：R=0.10、T=0.70 时 A_frac=0.20，但不能称吸光度就是 0.20。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p30 | T2-0029 | T2-0030

FX107 · [P2] Direct-beam attenuation and characteristic distancesFX107 · [P2] 直达光衰减与特征距离

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. W2 explains length and absorption/scattering coefficients; coefficients can be supplied, so do not memorize material tables.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。W2 解释光程及吸收/散射系数；材料系数可题中给，不背材料数值表。

Formula: 公式： I(L) = I0 exp(−μ_t L); μ_t = μ_a + μ_s; ℓ_a = 1/μ_a; ℓ_s = 1/μ_s; ℓ_t = 1/μ_t

ENSymbols and units: I0, I: incident/direct-beam intensity; L: path length; μ_a, μ_s, μ_t: absorption, scattering and total attenuation coefficients (inverse length); ℓ: corresponding characteristic distances.

中文符号与单位：I0、I：入射/直达光强；L：光程；μ_a、μ_s、μ_t：吸收、散射和总衰减系数，单位长度倒数；ℓ：相应特征距离。

ENWhen to use: Explain why a longer path or larger loss coefficient reduces direct transmitted light.

中文何时使用：解释光程更长或损耗系数更大时，直达透射光为何减少。

ENConditions and traps: Uniform medium and direct/ballistic-beam attenuation with approximately constant coefficients. Scattering removes photons from the direct beam but does not necessarily absorb them; total diffuse light is a different quantity. μL must be dimensionless. A 1/e distance is not a sharp boundary at which all light disappears.

中文条件与易错点：均匀介质、近似常系数的直达/弹道光衰减模型；散射使光离开直达束，不必然把光吸收，漫射总光是另一量。 μL 必须无量纲；1/e 距离不是光到此全部消失的硬边界。

ENTiny example: If μ_t=2 cm⁻¹ and L=0.5 cm, I/I0=e⁻¹≈0.368 and ℓ_t=0.5 cm.

中文短例理解：μ_t=2 cm⁻¹、L=0.5 cm 时，I/I0=e⁻¹≈0.368，ℓ_t=0.5 cm。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p32–33 | T2-0034 | T2-0035 | T2-0036

FX108 · [P1] Beer–Lambert: transmission and two logarithm conventionsFX108 · [P1] Beer–Lambert：透过率与两种对数约定

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. W2 Examples 3/4 are worked in class; know percent conversion, units and coefficient conventions.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。W2 Example 3/4 有课堂讲解，须会百分比、单位及系数约定。

Formula: 公式： T = I/I0; A = −log10(T) = εCL; T = 10^(−εCL); I = I0 exp(−ε′CL); ε′ = ln(10) ε ≈ 2.303ε

ENSymbols and units: A: dimensionless absorbance; T: transmitted fraction; C: molar concentration (M); L: cm; ε: base-10 molar absorptivity (M⁻¹cm⁻¹); ε′: natural-exponential coefficient in the same concentration/length units.

中文符号与单位：A：无量纲吸光度；T：透过比例；C：摩尔浓度 M；L：cm；ε：常用对数摩尔吸光系数 M⁻¹cm⁻¹；ε′：自然指数形式的相应系数。

ENWhen to use: Convert transmitted fraction to absorbance and solve for concentration, path length or absorptivity.

中文何时使用：把透过比例换成吸光度，并求浓度、光程或吸光系数。

ENConditions and traps: Use a specified wavelength and a valid linear Beer–Lambert regime, after an appropriate blank/reference correction. Do not assume a buffer never absorbs at every wavelength. 15% means T=0.15; absorbance is not 1−T. Do not mix ε with ε′ or round ε before completing the calculation.

中文条件与易错点：使用指定波长、有效线性 Beer–Lambert 区间，作合适的空白/参比扣除；不能假设缓冲液在所有波长都不吸收。 15% 要写 T=0.15；吸光度不是 1−T，不混用 ε 与 ε′，计算结束前不先把 ε 粗略取整。

ENTiny example: At unchanged C and wavelength, changing L from 2 cm to 4.5 cm changes A=0.35 to 0.35×4.5/2=0.7875.

中文短例理解：C、波长不变时，L 从 2 cm 到 4.5 cm，使 A=0.35 变为 0.35×4.5/2=0.7875。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p37–43 | T2-0041 | T2-0049 | T2-0050 | T2-0051

FX109 · [P3] Two-wavelength hemoglobin mixtureFX109 · [P3] 双波长血红蛋白混合关系

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. The lecturer says the detailed coefficients/derivation need not be memorized. Use this to recognize the two-wavelength principle or substitute supplied data.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。老师说明详细系数/推导不需背；用于辨认双波长原理或题给数据代入。

Formula: 公式： μ_a(λ_i) = ln(10) [ε_ox(λ_i) C_ox + ε_de(λ_i) C_de], i=1,2

ENSymbols and units: C_ox, C_de: molar oxy-/deoxyhemoglobin concentrations; ε_ox, ε_de: base-10 molar absorptivities at λ_i; μ_a: natural-exponential absorption coefficient (e.g. cm⁻¹).

中文符号与单位：C_ox、C_de：含氧/脱氧血红蛋白摩尔浓度；ε_ox、ε_de：波长 λ_i 下的常用对数摩尔吸光系数；μ_a：自然指数吸收系数，如 cm⁻¹。

ENWhen to use: Use two absorption measurements to separate two hemoglobin concentrations.

中文何时使用：用两个吸收测量分开两种血红蛋白浓度。

ENConditions and traps: Two-species additive absorption approximation with supplied coefficients and independent wavelength responses; backgrounds must be accounted for. If the two equations are proportional, two concentrations cannot be separated uniquely. ln(10) converts a base-10 ε to a natural-exponential μ_a; it is not a new concentration unit. An isosbestic wavelength alone measures a shared absorption contribution.

中文条件与易错点：两组分吸收可相加的近似，系数由题给，两个波长响应需独立，背景需处理；若两式成比例，不能唯一分出两浓度。 ln(10) 用于常用对数 ε 到自然指数 μ_a 的转换，不是新浓度单位；单独等吸收波长只有共同吸收贡献。

ENTiny example: At an isosbestic wavelength where ε_ox=ε_de=ε, μ_a=ln(10)ε(C_ox+C_de).

中文短例理解：等吸收波长 ε_ox=ε_de=ε 时，μ_a=ln(10)ε(C_ox+C_de)。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p49 | T2-0063 | T2-0064

FX110 · [P2] Oxygen saturation and total hemoglobinFX110 · [P2] 血氧饱和度与总血红蛋白

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Short conceptual relation from W2; understand the denominator and do simple ratios.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。W2 简短概念关系，懂分母含义并能做简单比值。

Formula: 公式： SO2 = C_ox / (C_ox + C_de); CHb = C_ox + C_de; saturation(%) = 100 × SO2

ENSymbols and units: C_ox: oxyhemoglobin concentration; C_de: deoxyhemoglobin concentration; CHb: their total; SO2: dimensionless oxygenated fraction.

中文符号与单位：C_ox：含氧血红蛋白浓度；C_de：脱氧血红蛋白浓度；CHb：两者总浓度；SO2：无量纲含氧比例。

ENWhen to use: Distinguish fraction oxygenated from the total amount of hemoglobin.

中文何时使用：分清含氧比例与血红蛋白总量。

ENConditions and traps: Both concentrations must use the same units and refer to the same sample/compartment. The denominator must be nonzero; device SpO2 is a calibrated estimate, not every abstract mixture fraction. The denominator is total hemoglobin, not deoxyhemoglobin alone; 0.8 corresponds to 80%, not 0.8%.

中文条件与易错点：两浓度单位一致、属于同一样品/区室，分母非零；仪器 SpO2 是校准估计，并非每个抽象混合比例都等同临床读数。 分母是总血红蛋白，不是只用脱氧血红蛋白；0.8 对应 80%，不是 0.8%。

ENTiny example: C_ox=8 and C_de=2 in the same units give SO2=80% and CHb=10.

中文短例理解：同单位 C_ox=8、C_de=2 时，SO2=80%，CHb=10。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p50 | T2-0063 | T2-0064

FX111 · [P3] Pulse-oximeter example: ratio of ratiosFX111 · [P3] 血氧仪例题：比值之比

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Worked for graph interpretation; the teacher explicitly says not to memorize the long calculation. Keep it available for supplied-formula questions.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。课堂用于读图，老师明确长计算不必背；保留用于题给公式后的代入。

Formula: 公式： R_os = ln(Ip_R/Ib_R) / ln(Ip_IR/Ib_IR); SaO2 = [ε_Hb,R − ε_Hb,IR R_os] / [(ε_Hb,R − ε_HbO2,R) + (ε_HbO2,IR − ε_Hb,IR) R_os]

ENSymbols and units: Ip, Ib: trace peak and baseline intensities; R, IR subscripts: red and infrared channels; ε: the four supplied hemoglobin coefficients; R_os and SaO2 are dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：Ip、Ib：波形峰与基线光强；R、IR 下标：红光、红外通道；ε：题给四个血红蛋白系数；R_os、SaO2 都无量纲。

ENWhen to use: Read each channel’s peak/baseline, form the specified ratio, and substitute the provided calibration relation.

中文何时使用：读取两个通道峰/基线，按指定定义求比值，再代入给定校准关系。

ENConditions and traps: This is the relation supplied for the course example with its specified wavelengths and coefficients, not a universal uncalibrated saturation law. Intensities are positive and the IR log denominator is nonzero. Do not multiply intensities by wavelength or attach nm to the ratios. This example uses 630/940 nm, while the general device slide uses 660/940 nm.

中文条件与易错点：这是该例题指定波长/系数下给出的关系，不是无需校准的通用血氧定律；光强须为正，红外对数分母不能为零。 不要把光强再乘波长，不给比值加 nm。此例用 630/940 nm，设备概述页用 660/940 nm。

ENTiny example: 18/12 and 8/5 give R_os=0.86269. With ε_Hb,R=1.1, ε_HbO2,R=0.17, ε_Hb,IR=0.16 and ε_HbO2,IR=0.23, SaO2≈97.13%.

中文短例理解：18/12、8/5 得 R_os=0.86269。按 ε_Hb,R=1.1、ε_HbO2,R=0.17、ε_Hb,IR=0.16、ε_HbO2,IR=0.23 的明确对应关系代入，得 SaO2≈97.13%。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p53–54 | T2-0065 | T2-0066 | T2-0067 | T2-0068

FX112 · [P1] Raman shift and absolute wavenumberFX112 · [P1] 拉曼位移与绝对波数

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. The lecturer works W2 p67 and stresses the forward/reverse conversion. Also supports Sample Q2 scattering concepts.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。老师讲 W2 p67 并强调正向/反向换算，也支撑 Sample Q2 散射概念。

Formula: 公式： ν_tilde = 1/λ(cm) = 10^7/λ(nm); f = c_cm ν_tilde; Δν_tilde = 10^7 [1/λ0(nm) − 1/λs(nm)]; λs(nm) = 1 / [1/λ0(nm) − Δν_tilde/10^7]

ENSymbols and units: ν_tilde: absolute wavenumber (cm⁻¹); Δν_tilde: signed Raman shift (cm⁻¹); λ0, λs: excitation/scattered vacuum wavelengths; c_cm≈2.998×10¹⁰ cm/s.

中文符号与单位：ν_tilde：绝对波数 cm⁻¹；Δν_tilde：带符号的拉曼位移 cm⁻¹；λ0、λs：入射/散射真空波长；c_cm≈2.998×10¹⁰ cm/s。

ENWhen to use: Convert spectral coordinates and reverse a given Raman shift to find scattered wavelength.

中文何时使用：换算光谱坐标，并由给定拉曼位移反求散射波长。

ENConditions and traps: Use the same wavelength unit in both reciprocals. With the stated signed convention, Stokes has positive shift and anti-Stokes negative shift; some plots instead use absolute magnitudes. Raman shift is a difference of reciprocal wavelengths, not λs−λ0, nor the absolute scattered wavenumber.

中文条件与易错点：两个倒数采用同一波长单位；本带符号约定下 Stokes 正、anti-Stokes 负，有些图则用绝对值。 拉曼位移是倒数波长之差，不是 λs−λ0，也不是散射光的绝对波数。

ENTiny example: 1000→1080 nm gives 740.74 cm⁻¹ (Stokes); a given +800 cm⁻¹ shift at 1000 nm gives λs≈1086.96 nm.

中文短例理解：1000→1080 nm 得 740.74 cm⁻¹（Stokes）；1000 nm 入射、+800 cm⁻¹ 位移时 λs≈1086.96 nm。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p64–68 | T2-0084 | T2-0085 | T2-0086 | Sample Quiz PDF p1 Q2

FX113 · [P1] Fluorescence lifetime and exponential decayFX113 · [P1] 荧光寿命与指数衰减

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Know lifetime, units and the 1/e meaning. The differential notation is for recognition, not a new calculus exercise.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。会寿命、单位及 1/e 含义；微分记号用于辨认，不额外要求微积分解题。

Formula: 公式： k_tot = kr + knr; knr = k1 + k2; τ = 1/k_tot; dN_exc/dt = −k_tot N_exc; N_exc(t) = N_exc(0) exp(−t/τ); I_fl(t) ∝ exp(−t/τ); t_half = τ ln(2)

ENSymbols and units: N_exc: excited S1 population; kr, knr, k_tot: radiative, nonradiative and total exit rates (s⁻¹); τ: lifetime (s); I_fl: background-corrected fluorescence intensity. In the p82 diagram, k1 is nonradiative S1→S0 relaxation and k2 is S1→T1 intersystem crossing.

中文符号与单位：N_exc：S1 激发态粒子数；kr、knr、k_tot：辐射、非辐射与总离开速率，单位 s⁻¹；τ：寿命 s；I_fl：扣背景后的荧光强度。 原p82图中，k1为S1→S0非辐射弛豫，k2为S1→T1系间窜越。

ENWhen to use: Connect decay rate, the 1/e lifetime and the distinct half-life.

中文何时使用：联系衰减速率、1/e 寿命及不同的半衰期。

ENConditions and traps: Single-exponential, constant first-order rates after a short excitation pulse, without continued pumping. Multi-exponential samples need a more detailed model. I_fl follows population only with unchanged detection and kr. knr=k1+k2 follows this two-channel nonradiative model; other samples can have additional nonradiative channels. At t=τ, 36.8% remains, not 50%. A lifetime is not the time until the signal becomes exactly zero; kr alone is not 1/τ unless knr=0.

中文条件与易错点：短激发脉冲后、无持续泵浦、常数一级速率的单指数模型；多指数样品需更复杂模型。检测条件与 kr 不变时 I_fl 才随粒子数衰减。 knr=k1+k2限于此图的两类非辐射通道模型；其他样品可能还有别的非辐射通道。 t=τ 时剩 36.8%，不是 50%；寿命不是恰好变零所需时间，除非 knr=0，否则 kr 不等于 1/τ。

ENTiny example: τ=10 ns gives k_tot=10⁸ s⁻¹ and t_half≈6.93 ns; at 20 ns the remaining fraction is e⁻²≈13.5%.

中文短例理解：τ=10 ns 时 k_tot=10⁸ s⁻¹、t_half≈6.93 ns；20 ns 后剩 e⁻²≈13.5%。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p82 | T2-0105 | T2-0106 | Sample Quiz PDF p1 Q1

FX114 · [P1] Quantum yield, radiative and nonradiative ratesFX114 · [P1] 量子产率、辐射与非辐射速率

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. W2 Examples 6/7 are explained in class; these also support the full fluorescence concepts behind Sample Q1.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。W2 Example 6/7 课堂有讲，亦支撑 Sample Q1 全部荧光概念。

Formula: 公式： Φ = N_emitted/N_absorbed = kr/(kr+knr) = krτ; kr = Φ/τ; knr = (1−Φ)/τ; N_emitted = Φ N_absorbed

ENSymbols and units: Φ: dimensionless yield (0–1); N: emitted/absorbed photon counts; kr, knr: s⁻¹ if τ is in s. Use photon numbers, not unequal-wavelength optical energies.

中文符号与单位：Φ：无量纲产率 0–1；N：发射/吸收光子数；τ 用 s 时 kr、knr 为 s⁻¹。按光子数算，不能把不同波长的光能比直接当产率。

ENWhen to use: Find yield or either decay rate and predict emitted photon number from absorbed photons.

中文何时使用：求产率或两种衰减速率，并由吸收光子数预测发射数量。

ENConditions and traps: The rate equality uses the single-excited-state first-order model; count-based yield needs corrected photon measurements. Incident photons equal absorbed photons only if the beam is fully absorbed. Do not use arbitrary spectral peak heights as general quantum-yield measurements. 1 ns⁻¹=10⁹ s⁻¹; the p88 25-hour unit is unusual but must be preserved if solving that source question.

中文条件与易错点：速率等式采用单激发态一级模型；计数产率须用校正光子测量。只有完全吸收时，入射光子才等于吸收光子。 不能把任意光谱峰高比当通用量子产率。1 ns⁻¹=10⁹ s⁻¹；p88 的 25 小时虽异常，做原题仍需保留。

ENTiny example: Φ=0.46, τ=8.4 ns give kr≈0.05476 ns⁻¹=5.476×10⁷ s⁻¹ and knr≈6.429×10⁷ s⁻¹.

中文短例理解：Φ=0.46、τ=8.4 ns 时，kr≈0.05476 ns⁻¹=5.476×10⁷ s⁻¹，knr≈6.429×10⁷ s⁻¹。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p83–88 | T2-0106 | T2-0107 | Sample Quiz PDF p1 Q1

FX115 · [P2] Molecular fluorescence brightnessFX115 · [P2] 分子荧光亮度指标

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Printed on p85 and supports the yield/brightness explanation; retain the matched-conditions qualification.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。p85 明列，支撑产率/亮度解释，须保留比较条件。

Formula: 公式： B_mol = ε(λ_exc) Φ; at equal low concentration, excitation and collection: fluorescence signal ∝ C ε(λ_exc) Φ

ENSymbols and units: ε(λ_exc): molar absorptivity at the chosen excitation wavelength; Φ: quantum yield; B_mol: relative molecular brightness indicator, not a lumen/W instrument reading.

中文符号与单位：ε(λ_exc)：所选激发波长下摩尔吸光系数；Φ：量子产率；B_mol：相对分子亮度指标，不是仪器的流明/瓦读数。

ENWhen to use: Compare a fluorophore’s absorption strength and emission efficiency together.

中文何时使用：同时比较荧光分子的吸收能力和发射效率。

ENConditions and traps: Matched excitation/detection and dilute, unsaturated response, without major reabsorption, self-quenching or bleaching. Signal also depends on amount and instrument settings. Higher Φ alone does not always make a dye brighter if ε differs. Intensity is not necessarily linear in concentration at high concentration or saturation.

中文条件与易错点：激发/检测条件匹配，稀溶液、未饱和，重吸收、自猝灭和漂白影响不大；实际信号还取决于数量和仪器设置。 若 ε 不同，Φ 更高不一定更亮；高浓度或饱和时强度不必与浓度线性。

ENTiny example: ε=100000, Φ=0.25 give εΦ=25000; ε=20000, Φ=0.75 give 15000, so the first indicator is larger.

中文短例理解：ε=100000、Φ=0.25 得 εΦ=25000；ε=20000、Φ=0.75 得 15000，前者亮度指标更大。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p84–86 | T2-0106 | T2-0107

FX116 · [P1] Grating resolving power and illuminated groovesFX116 · [P1] 光栅分辨本领与受照刻线数

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Explicit Sample Q7 topic; the standard ideal-grating relation is added for solving that source question, not falsely attributed as printed on W2 p35.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。Sample Q7 明确涉及；补入标准理想光栅关系帮助做题，不声称 W2 p35 印了该等式。

Formula: 公式： R_grating = λ/Δλ_min = |m| N; N = groove_density × illuminated_width; Δλ_min = λ/(|m|N)

ENSymbols and units: R_grating: dimensionless resolving power; m: nonzero diffraction order; N: illuminated groove count; Δλ_min: smallest separable wavelength gap. Density and illuminated width must use reciprocal length units.

中文符号与单位：R_grating：无量纲分辨本领；m：非零衍射级次；N：受照刻线数；Δλ_min：最小可分辨波长间隔。刻线密度与照亮宽度长度单位须匹配。

ENWhen to use: Find spectral resolution or compare groove density at fixed illuminated width and order.

中文何时使用：求光谱分辨率，或在固定受照宽度/级次下比较刻线密度。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal grating limit for coherently illuminated grooves; real spectrometer resolution may also be limited by slit width, optics and detector sampling. Compare at matched wavelength, order and illuminated width. Density is not N; a larger density gives more illuminated grooves only at fixed width. Resolving power R is larger-better, whereas Δλ_min is smaller-better.

中文条件与易错点：理想相干照亮光栅的极限；实际分辨率还可受狭缝、光学系统和探测器采样限制。比较时固定波长、级次和受照宽度。 密度不是 N；只有受照宽度固定时密度越大才照亮更多刻线。R 越大越好，Δλ_min 越小越好。

ENTiny example: At λ=600 nm, |m|=1 and N=50, R=50 and Δλ_min=12 nm.

中文短例理解：λ=600 nm、|m|=1、N=50 时，R=50、Δλ_min=12 nm。

Source / 来源：W2 PDF p35 | W1 PDF p86 | Sample Quiz PDF p1 Q7

FX117 · [P2] Label-free spectral sensitivity and index LODFX117 · [P2] 无标记光谱灵敏度与折射率检出限

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. The lecturer repeatedly reads these plots and explicitly mentions sensitivity/LOD calculations for the final; this is supporting Quiz preparation, not a guaranteed Quiz item.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。老师反复读图并明确提到期末灵敏度/LOD 计算；用于 Quiz 辅助复习，不夸大为必出。

Formula: 公式： S_λ = Δλ_res/Δn = (λ2−λ1)/(n2−n1); Δλ_res ≈ S_λ Δn; LOD_n = 3σ_λ/|S_λ|

ENSymbols and units: λ_res: resonance wavelength; Δn: index change in RIU; S_λ: nm/RIU; σ_λ: wavelength-noise SD in nm; LOD_n: RIU.

中文符号与单位：λ_res：共振波长；Δn：折射率变化 RIU；S_λ：nm/RIU；σ_λ：波长噪声标准差 nm；LOD_n：RIU。

ENWhen to use: Read a peak/dip position shift, predict the response to index change, or translate wavelength noise into an index threshold.

中文何时使用：读峰/谷位置移动，预测折射率响应，或将波长噪声换成折射率阈值。

ENConditions and traps: Use the local calibrated index range, matched temperature/geometry and same resonance mode. A concentration LOD additionally needs an index–concentration calibration. Peak height and peak position are different signals. nm/RIU sensitivity is not automatically nm/mM; σ must have the same spectral unit as S.

中文条件与易错点：采用局部校准折射率范围、匹配温度/几何及同一共振模式；浓度检出限还需折射率—浓度校准。 峰高与峰位是不同信号；nm/RIU 不自动等于 nm/mM，σ 和 S 的光谱单位要一致。

ENTiny example: S_λ=30 nm/RIU and Δn=10⁻⁴ RIU give a 3 pm shift. If σ_λ=1 pm, LOD_n=10⁻⁴ RIU.

中文短例理解：S_λ=30 nm/RIU、Δn=10⁻⁴ RIU 时位移 3 pm；若 σ_λ=1 pm，则 LOD_n=10⁻⁴ RIU。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p15 | W3 PDF p47 | W3 PDF p79 | T3-0024 | T3-0025 | T3-0026 | T3-0077 | T3-0078 | T3-0108

FX118 · [P1] Snell refraction and critical angleFX118 · [P1] 斯涅尔折射与临界角

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. The two TIR requirements are central to fibre questions; the numerical critical-angle calculation is a supporting basic application.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。全反射的两条件是光纤题核心；临界角数字计算属基础应用。

Formula: 公式： n1 sinθ1 = n2 sinθ2; θc = arcsin(n2/n1) for n1>n2; TIR requires θ1>θc

ENSymbols and units: n1,n2: refractive indices; θ1,θ2: angles from the interface normal; θc: critical angle.

中文符号与单位：n1、n2：折射率；θ1、θ2：相对界面法线的角；θc：临界角。

ENWhen to use: Decide whether a ray refracts or satisfies total internal reflection and calculate the threshold.

中文何时使用：判断折射或全反射，并求临界阈值。

ENConditions and traps: Ordinary isotropic lossless media in the course ray model. TIR needs high-index to low-index travel and incidence above the critical boundary; at θc the refracted ray is grazing. Angles are from the normal, not the surface. The p22 shorthand ≥ includes the boundary; distinguish it from strict above-critical TIR. n1<n2 has no real TIR critical angle.

中文条件与易错点：本课程射线模型中的普通各向同性无损介质。全反射需从高到低折射率且超过临界角；θc 时折射光沿界面。 角度相对法线，不是表面；p22 简写 ≥ 包括边界，应与严格超过临界值区分。n1<n2 没有实数全反射临界角。

ENTiny example: Glass n1=1.45 to water n2=1.33 gives θc≈66.53°; 70° incidence satisfies TIR.

中文短例理解：玻璃 n1=1.45 到水 n2=1.33 时 θc≈66.53°，70° 入射满足全反射。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p21–22 | W3 PDF p25 | T3-0032 | T3-0033 | T3-0034 | T3-0035 | T3-0036

FX119 · [P2] Fibre numerical aperture and acceptance half-angleFX119 · [P2] 光纤数值孔径与接受半角

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Explicit W3 formula explained in class; retain the n0 assumption rather than copying an air-only shortcut everywhere.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。W3 明列且课堂讲解，须保留 n0 假设，不把空气简式套到所有介质。

Formula: 公式： NA_fibre = n0 sinθ_accept,max = sqrt(n_core² − n_clad²); θ_accept,max = arcsin(NA_fibre/n0)

ENSymbols and units: n0: outside launch-medium index; n_core,n_clad: core/cladding indices; θ_accept,max: maximum launch angle from the fibre axis (acceptance cone half-angle); NA is dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：n0：光纤外入射介质折射率；n_core、n_clad：纤芯/包层折射率；θ_accept,max：相对纤轴最大入射角，即接受锥半角；NA 无量纲。

ENWhen to use: Connect core–cladding index contrast to the external light-acceptance cone.

中文何时使用：把纤芯/包层折射率差与外部接受光锥联系起来。

ENConditions and traps: The course meridional-ray model of a step-index fibre, n_core>n_clad; arcsin requires NA/n0≤1. The slide omits n0 by assuming air.
