The external acceptance angle is measured from the fibre axis; the internal TIR angle is measured from an interface normal. They are different angles.

中文条件与易错点：课件阶跃折射率光纤的子午射线模型，n_core>n_clad；反正弦需 NA/n0≤1。课件省略 n0，默认空气。 外部接受角相对纤轴，内部全反射角相对界面法线，两角不同。

ENTiny example: n_core=1.50,n_clad=1.48 give NA≈0.2441; in air θmax≈14.13°. In water n0=1.33 the same NA gives θmax≈10.58°.

中文短例理解：n_core=1.50、n_clad=1.48 得 NA≈0.2441；空气中 θmax≈14.13°，水 n0=1.33 中同 NA 得 θmax≈10.58°。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p23 | T3-0036 | T3-0037 | T3-0038

FX120 · [P2] Evanescent intensity and field-amplitude decayFX120 · [P2] 倏逝强度与场幅衰减

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. The surface-confinement concept is P1; the exponential expression is useful supporting algebra. Amplitude conversion is explained, not treated as an extra exam claim.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。近表面局限概念为 P1；指数式属辅助代数。解释场幅转换，不额外宣称是考试要求。

Formula: 公式： I(d)/I0 = exp(−d/L_I); |E_field(d)|/|E0| = exp(−d/L_E); I ∝ |E_field|²; L_E = 2 L_I

ENSymbols and units: d: distance normal to the interface; L_I: 1/e intensity decay depth; L_E: 1/e field-amplitude decay depth. Intensity and electric field are different quantities.

中文符号与单位：d：垂直界面的距离；L_I：强度降至 1/e 的深度；L_E：场幅降至 1/e 的深度。光强与电场是不同量。

ENWhen to use: Explain surface-confined sensing and avoid a factor-of-two error when switching amplitude/intensity conventions.

中文何时使用：解释近表面传感，并避免把场幅与强度深度混用导致二倍误差。

ENConditions and traps: A single exponential evanescent tail in a uniform lossless low-index region; keep the same depth definition. The p27 plotted normalized intensity corresponds to L_I. p27 writes I(d)=exp(−d/L0) but plots I/I0: the expression is normalized. Goos–Hänchen lateral shift is along the interface, not this normal penetration depth.

中文条件与易错点：均匀无损低折射率区的单指数倏逝尾部，需保持深度定义一致；p27 的归一化强度图对应 L_I。 p27 写 I(d)=exp(−d/L0) 而图画 I/I0，因此式子实为归一化。Goos–Hänchen 横移沿界面，不是此处垂直穿透深度。

ENTiny example: If L_I=100 nm, then at d=100 nm intensity is 36.8% and field amplitude is 60.7%; L_E=200 nm.

中文短例理解：若 L_I=100 nm，d=100 nm 时强度剩 36.8%、场幅剩 60.7%，L_E=200 nm。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p25–27 | T3-0042 | T3-0043 | T3-0044 | T3-0045 | T3-0046

FX121 · [P3] Evanescent penetration-depth convention (support)FX121 · [P3] 倏逝穿透深度约定（辅助）

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. README labels this as supplementary; retain it for understanding definitions, without announcing a new required calculation.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。README 明确标作补充；保留帮助理解约定，不增加必做计算要求。

Formula: 公式： κ = (2π/λ0) sqrt(n1² sin²θ − n2²); L_E = 1/κ = λ0 / [2π sqrt(n1² sin²θ − n2²)]; L_I = 1/(2κ) = λ0 / [4π sqrt(n1² sin²θ − n2²)]

ENSymbols and units: λ0: vacuum wavelength; θ: incidence from the normal on the n1 side; n1>n2. κ is the normal field-amplitude decay constant in inverse length (m⁻¹ for λ0 in m); L_E and L_I are amplitude/intensity 1/e depths in the same length unit as λ0.

中文符号与单位：λ0为真空波长；θ为n1侧相对法线的入射角；n1>n2。κ为场幅垂直衰减常数，单位长度的倒数（λ0用m时κ用m⁻¹）；L_E、L_I为场幅／强度1/e深度，与λ0采用同一长度单位。

ENWhen to use: Make the README supplemental depth formula unambiguous and connect it to the three factors listed on the slide.

中文何时使用：明确 README 补充深度式的约定，并联系课件列出的三个因素。

ENConditions and traps: Derived flat-interface TIR expression for isotropic lossless media with θ>θc. It is supplementary to p26’s qualitative factors, not an original numeric worked formula. Very near θc the idealized model is sensitive to conditions. The README’s 4π formula is an intensity depth. Texts using 2π may be giving field-amplitude depth; do not call either wrong without checking its definition.

中文条件与易错点：由各向同性无损平界面、θ>θc 的全反射模型推得；是对 p26 定性因素的辅助，不是原课件数字例题公式。接近 θc 时理想模型对条件很敏感。 README 的 4π 式为强度深度；资料中 2π 式可能定义场幅深度，不能不看定义就判错。

ENTiny example: At fixed n1,n2,θ, doubling λ0 doubles both depths; at fixed wavelength, approaching θc from above increases them.

中文短例理解：n1、n2、θ 固定时 λ0 加倍使两深度加倍；固定波长、从上方接近 θc 时，两深度增大。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p26–27 | README §3.2 倏逝场（补充公式）

FX122 · [P2] WGM resonance and small fractional changesFX122 · [P2] WGM 共振与小幅相对变化

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. W3 shows the formula and explains index/geometry shifts; the lecturer’s main emphasis is the reference peak and its shift.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。W3 明列并解释折射率/几何位移；课堂主要强调基准峰与移动。

Formula: 公式： λ_res = (2π R n_eff)/m; Δλ_res/λ_res ≈ ΔR/R + Δn_eff/n_eff

ENSymbols and units: R: ring/sphere mode radius; n_eff: effective modal index; m: positive integer longitudinal/azimuthal mode order; λ_res: vacuum resonance wavelength.

中文符号与单位：R：环/球模式的半径；n_eff：模式有效折射率；m：正整数纵向/方位模式级次；λ_res：真空共振波长。

ENWhen to use: Predict resonance shifts due to changes in geometry or effective index.

中文何时使用：预测几何或有效折射率变化引起的共振位移。

ENConditions and traps: Same mode m, small perturbations and negligible/localized dispersion in the course optical-path model. The fractional expression is first order; it neglects the product ΔRΔn and does not automatically use bulk index in place of n_eff. The slide uses r/R and n for the same role; use one consistent notation. m is not generally 1 just because a lecture gives that verbal simplification. A radius change and an index change may both shift the peak.

中文条件与易错点：同一模式 m、小扰动及课件光程模型中的可忽略/局部色散。相对变化式为一阶近似，略去 ΔRΔn 乘积，不能自动用体相折射率替换 n_eff。 课件 r/R、n 记号混用，要统一含义。不能因课堂口头简化就总令 m=1；半径与折射率变化都可使峰移动。

ENTiny example: If ΔR/R=2×10⁻⁵ and Δn_eff/n_eff=4×10⁻⁵, a 1550 nm resonance shifts by ≈0.093 nm.

中文短例理解：ΔR/R=2×10⁻⁵、Δn_eff/n_eff=4×10⁻⁵ 时，1550 nm 共振约移动 0.093 nm。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p46–47 | T3-0073 | T3-0074 | T3-0075 | T3-0076

FX123 · [P3] Two-mirror cavity resonance (support)FX123 · [P3] 双镜腔共振（辅助）

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. The Quiz-relevant lesson is cavity recognition; this supporting equation is not added as a teacher-confirmed Quiz calculation.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。Quiz 相关核心为腔结构辨识，此辅助等式不标成老师确认的 Quiz 计算。

Formula: 公式： 2 n_cav L = m λ0; λ0 = 2 n_cav L/m

ENSymbols and units: L: physical mirror separation; n_cav: cavity medium index; m: positive integer mode order; λ0: vacuum resonance wavelength. The wavelength in the cavity is λ0/n_cav.

中文符号与单位：L：两镜物理间距；n_cav：腔介质折射率；m：正整数模式级次；λ0：真空共振波长，腔内波长为 λ0/n_cav。

ENWhen to use: Explain the standing-wave optical-path condition for a simple Fabry–Pérot cavity.

中文何时使用：解释简单 Fabry–Pérot 腔的驻波光程条件。

ENConditions and traps: Normal incidence, a simple two-mirror path and negligible additional reflection phase. This is the generalized interpretation of the slide’s half-wavelength illustration; real coatings and angled paths modify it. The integer mode label in a standing-wave drawing is not the same as the refractive-index symbol n. Do not confuse physical length L with optical path n_cav L.

中文条件与易错点：正入射、简单双镜光程且额外反射相位可忽略；是课件半波长示意的规范一般化解释。真实镀膜与倾斜光路会修改条件。 驻波图中的整数模式编号不是折射率 n；物理长度 L 与光程 n_cav L 不同。

ENTiny example: In air, L=1 μm and m=4 give λ0=500 nm.

中文短例理解：空气中 L=1 μm、m=4 时 λ0=500 nm。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p44 | W3 PDF p48

FX124 · [P2] FWHM, Q and unit-consistent FOMFX124 · [P2] 半高宽、Q 与单位一致的 FOM

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. The teacher explicitly mentions these for the final; retain them as important support for broad Quiz concepts, without a guarantee.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。老师明确提到期末，此处作为宽泛 Quiz 概念的重要辅助，不保证必出。

Formula: 公式： I_half,peak = I_base + (I_max−I_base)/2; I_half,dip = I_base − (I_base−I_min)/2 = (I_base+I_min)/2; width_x = x_right−x_left at the appropriate half level; Q = f0/Δf_FWHM ≈ λ0/Δλ_FWHM (narrow line); FOM_λ = |S_λ|/Δλ_FWHM; FOM_f = |S_f|/Δf_FWHM

ENSymbols and units: x: chosen spectral coordinate; Δf: linewidth in Hz; Δλ: linewidth in nm; S_λ: nm/RIU; S_f: Hz/RIU; Q: dimensionless; both consistent FOMs: RIU⁻¹.

中文符号与单位：x：所选光谱坐标；Δf：Hz 线宽；Δλ：nm 线宽；S_λ：nm/RIU；S_f：Hz/RIU；Q 无量纲，两种一致 FOM 都为 RIU⁻¹。

ENWhen to use: Read the full half-height width of an upward peak or the full half-depth width of a downward dip, then compare sharpness and index-shift performance.

中文何时使用：上凸峰读半高全宽，向下谷读半深全宽，再比较共振尖锐程度与折射率位移表现。

ENConditions and traps: Account for baseline and distinguish a peak from a dip; SPR reflectance often has a dip. Subtract baseline before identifying half-height. Q≈λ0/Δλ assumes a narrow resonance; FOM must use the same spectral coordinate for sensitivity and width. Neither alone proves concentration LOD without noise/calibration. The README calls wavelength Q exactly equivalent and tells readers to follow Δf in a mixed-unit FOM; correct this: wavelength Q is a narrow-line approximation, and nm/RIU cannot be divided directly by Hz. Δf is width, not a before/after shift.

中文条件与易错点：先看基线并区分上凸峰与向下谷；SPR反射谱常是向下谷。先扣基线再找半高；Q≈λ0/Δλ 要求窄共振。FOM 的灵敏度和宽度须用同一光谱坐标；若缺噪声/浓度校准，均不能单独证明浓度检出限。 README 把波长 Q 说成完全等价、混单位 FOM 说应照 Δf，须修正：波长式是窄线近似，nm/RIU 不能直接除 Hz。Δf 是宽度，不是前后峰位移。

ENTiny example: λ0=600 nm, Δλ=10 nm and S_λ=200 nm/RIU give Q≈60 and FOM_λ=20 RIU⁻¹. Halving Δλ doubles both if the other quantities stay fixed.

中文短例理解：λ0=600 nm、Δλ=10 nm、S_λ=200 nm/RIU 时，Q≈60、FOM_λ=20 RIU⁻¹；其他不变、线宽减半，两者加倍。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p80 | T3-0109 | T3-0110

FX125 · [P3] Weak Raman signals and reported SERS enhancementFX125 · [P3] 微弱拉曼信号与所报 SERS 增强量级

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Keep the weakness/enhancement concept; no need to memorize every reported exponent as a guaranteed Quiz number.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。保留弱信号/增强概念，不把所报每个指数标成必背 Quiz 数字。

Formula: 公式： I_Rayleigh/I0 ~ 10⁻³; I_Raman/I0 ~ 10⁻⁶–10⁻⁹; reported SERS enhancement can be ~10⁹–10¹²

ENSymbols and units: I0: incident intensity; I_Rayleigh and I_Raman: illustrative scattered intensities; enhancement: a stated comparison under defined measurement conditions.

中文符号与单位：I0：入射强度；I_Rayleigh、I_Raman：示例散射强度；增强：在指定测量条件下的比较。

ENWhen to use: Recognize why ordinary Raman is weak and why local-field enhancement is useful.

中文何时使用：理解普通拉曼为何微弱，以及局域场增强为何有用。

ENConditions and traps: These are rough reported orders from the slides, not universal conversion fractions or guaranteed enhancement for every substrate/sample. Comparisons depend on geometry, molecules and normalization. Do not multiply arbitrary input power by 10¹² and treat it as physically emitted power; enhancement is relative to a reference Raman measurement.

中文条件与易错点：这些是课件所报粗略量级，不是统一转换比例，也不保证每个基底/样品都达到；比较取决于几何、分子及归一化方式。 不能把任意入射功率乘 10¹² 当实际出射功率；增强是相对参照拉曼测量的比值。

ENTiny example: Qualitative example: a weak molecular fingerprint can become easier to measure at a metal nanoparticle hot spot; the amount still needs calibration.

中文短例理解：趋势例：金属纳米颗粒热点可让弱分子指纹更容易测到，定量仍需校准。

Source / 来源：W3 PDF p89–91

FX401 · [P2] Thin lens and magnificationFX401 · [P2] 薄透镜与放大率

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Slide relation and basic image-formation reasoning; no explicit quiz promise for lens algebra.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。课件短关系和成像基础，未找到薄透镜代数的明确Quiz承诺。

Formula: 公式： 1/S₁ + 1/S₂ = 1/f; |M| = |S₂/S₁|; signed M = −S₂/S₁

ENSymbols and units: S₁: object distance; S₂: image distance; f: focal length, all in the same length unit; M: dimensionless magnification.

中文符号与单位：S₁物距、S₂像距、f焦距，统一长度单位；M为无量纲放大率。

ENWhen to use: Find where the image forms and how large it is.

中文何时使用：求像的位置与图像大小。

ENConditions and traps: Paraxial thin-lens model. The slide uses positive real-object/real-image distance magnitudes; other sign conventions must be stated. The minus sign describes inversion. More magnification alone does not improve diffraction resolution.

中文条件与易错点：近轴薄透镜模型；课件图用实物、实像距离的正值大小，其他符号约定需另说明。 负号表示倒像；放大率增大本身不提高衍射分辨率。

ENTiny example: S₁=20 cm, f=10 cm → S₂=20 cm, |M|=1; the real image is inverted.

中文短例理解：S₁=20 cm、f=10 cm，得S₂=20 cm、|M|=1，实像倒立。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p23–26 | T4-0026–0029

FX402 · [P1] Objective numerical apertureFX402 · [P1] 物镜数值孔径

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Repeated explanation; the W5 classroom objective-comparison question was explicitly linked to quiz.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。反复讲解；W5课堂物镜比较题明确与Quiz联系。

Formula: 公式： NA = n sinθ

ENSymbols and units: n: refractive index between specimen and objective; θ: acceptance-cone half-angle; NA: dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：n为样品与物镜之间介质折射率，θ为接收光锥半角，NA无量纲。

ENWhen to use: Compare light collection and calculate the NA used in resolution formulas.

中文何时使用：比较收光能力，并为分辨率公式计算NA。

ENConditions and traps: Use the surrounding-medium index, not the lens-glass index; in air n≈1 and NA≤1. The full cone angle is 2θ. An immersion objective can have NA>1.

中文条件与易错点：用周围介质折射率，不用镜片玻璃折射率；空气n≈1时NA≤1。 完整光锥角是2θ；浸没物镜的NA可大于1。

ENTiny example: n=1.00, θ=30° → NA=0.50.

中文短例理解：n=1.00、θ=30°，NA=0.50。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p28–31 | T4-0031–0038 | T5-0059–0063

FX403 · [P1] Rayleigh separation and Airy radius/diameterFX403 · [P1] 瑞利间距与艾里斑半径／直径

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Core classroom comparison; distinguish physical quantities rather than memorize an unlabeled coefficient.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。课堂核心比较，重点区分物理量，不只背一个无标签系数。

Formula: 公式： Δd = 0.61λ/NA; r_Airy ≈ 0.61λ/NA; D_Airy ≈ 1.22λ/NA (slide p29 prints 1.21λ/NA)

ENSymbols and units: λ: vacuum/free-space wavelength in the model; Δd: minimum lateral separation; r_Airy: first-zero radius; D_Airy: diameter, all lengths.

中文符号与单位：λ为该模型使用的真空／空气波长；Δd最小横向间距，r_Airy第一零点半径，D_Airy直径，均为长度。

ENWhen to use: Resolve two points and distinguish radius/diameter from the Rayleigh separation.

中文何时使用：判断两点能否分开，区分斑半径、直径与瑞利间距。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal circular pupil, incoherent point-object Rayleigh criterion and diffraction-limited scalar model; comparable wavelength and optics when ranking NA. High resolution means smaller Δd. Do not double Δd merely because two points are present. The 1.21/1.22 difference is a source coefficient discrepancy. If a question supplies the source diameter coefficient1.21, use that stated coefficient.

中文条件与易错点：理想圆形孔径、非相干点物的瑞利判据及衍射限制标量模型；比较NA须有可比波长及光学条件。 高分辨率指更小Δd；不能因有两点就把Δd翻倍。1.21/1.22是源材料系数差异。若题目给课件直径系数1.21，计算按题给值。

ENTiny example: λ=550 nm, NA=0.80 → Δd≈0.419 μm; conventional D_Airy≈0.839 μm.

中文短例理解：λ=550 nm、NA=0.80，Δd≈0.419 μm；通常艾里斑直径约0.839 μm。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p27–31, p81 | T4-0034–0044 | T5-0059–0061

FX404 · [P2] Detector sampling and magnificationFX404 · [P2] 探测器采样与倍率

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Teacher explained the bright–dark–bright sampling example; useful short calculation.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。老师讲过亮—暗—亮的采样例子，适合短计算。

Formula: 公式： Δx_object = Δx_detector/|M|; |M|Δd/Δx_detector ≈ 2.3–3; |M| ≥ qΔx_detector/Δd

ENSymbols and units: Δx_detector: detector pixel pitch; Δx_object: object-plane equivalent pitch; q: chosen samples per resolved separation; lengths must match units.

中文符号与单位：Δx_detector相机像素间距；Δx_object物面等效间距；q为选定的每分辨距离采样数；长度单位一致。

ENWhen to use: Check whether pixels sample an optically resolvable feature finely enough.

中文何时使用：检查像素是否足够细地采到光学上可分辨的细节。

ENConditions and traps: The slide recommends q≈2.3–3 for its two-peak illustration; this is a practical sampling criterion, not a universal three-pixel law. Do not compare detector pitch with object-plane Δd without M; finer pixels do not remove the optical diffraction limit.

中文条件与易错点：课件双峰示例建议q≈2.3–3；这是实用采样准则，不是所有信号统一三像素定律。 不要漏掉M直接比较像面像素与物面Δd；细像素不能消除光学衍射限制。

ENTiny example: Δd=0.50 μm, detector pitch=6 μm, q=3 → |M|≥36.

中文短例理解：Δd=0.50 μm、像素6 μm、q=3，需|M|≥36。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p32–34 | T4-0045–0047

FX405 · [P1] Two-photon intensity lawFX405 · [P1] 双光子强度关系

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Sample Q1 and classroom single/two-photon demonstration; remember conditions for the square law.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。Sample Q1及课堂单双光子演示；平方规律须带条件。

Formula: 公式： F ∝ I_exc²; F₂/F₁ = (I₂/I₁)²; 2hc/λ₂ph ≈ hc/λ₁ph ⇒ λ₂ph ≈ 2λ₁ph

ENSymbols and units: F: fluorescence signal/rate; I_exc: local excitation intensity; λ₂ph: wavelength of each equal-energy two-photon excitation photon.

中文符号与单位：F为荧光信号／速率，I_exc局部激发强度，λ₂ph为每个等能双光子激发光子的波长。

ENWhen to use: Predict signal ratios and understand low-energy photons exciting the same state.

中文何时使用：求信号比，并理解两个低能光子激发同一能态。

ENConditions and traps: Unsaturated two-photon absorption, fixed dye, pulse shape and collection conditions; the wavelength relation matches the same excitation energy gap. Longer wavelength means lower energy per photon; λ_em can be shorter than each two-photon excitation wavelength.

中文条件与易错点：未饱和双光子吸收，染料、脉冲形状及收集条件固定；波长关系针对同一激发能隙。 每个光子的长波长对应低能量；发射波长可短于每个双光子激发波长。

ENTiny example: Excitation intensity doubles → F grows fourfold under these assumptions.

中文短例理解：上述条件下激发强度翻倍，F变四倍。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p55–61 | T4-0067–0069 | T4-0077–0079 | Sample Q1

FX406 · [P2] Michelson path, phase and intensityFX406 · [P2] 迈克尔逊光程、相位与强度

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Explicit OCT working-principle relation; phase/intensity algebra is supporting rather than a quiz promise.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。课件OCT原理关系；相位／强度代数为辅助，不标Quiz承诺。

Formula: 公式： OPD = 2nΔL; Δφ = 2π·OPD/λ₀; I = I₁ + I₂ + 2√(I₁I₂) cosΔφ; in air OPD=2ΔL, Δφ=4πΔL/λ₀

ENSymbols and units: ΔL: geometric one-way arm-length difference; OPD: optical-path difference; n: uniform index; λ₀: vacuum wavelength; phase in radians.

中文符号与单位：ΔL为几何单程臂长差，OPD光程差，n均匀折射率，λ₀真空波长；相位用弧度。

ENWhen to use: Explain why mirror motion changes the interference pattern and why reflection gives a factor two.

中文何时使用：解释移镜如何改干涉条纹，以及反射光路为何乘二。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal coherent, matching-polarization beams at the detector; broadband OCT adds a coherence envelope and phase depends on spectral component. L is an arm difference in this equation, not automatically the whole arm length; do not treat OCT as ordinary electronic light-echo timing.

中文条件与易错点：探测处为理想相干、偏振匹配光束；宽带OCT另有相干包络，相位随光谱分量而变。 此式L是臂长差，不是随便取整条臂长度；不能把OCT当普通电子直接计光回波时间。

ENTiny example: In air a mirror displacement ΔL=λ₀/4 changes phase byπ and swaps bright/dark for equal beams.

中文短例理解：空气中移镜λ₀/4，相位变π；等强束由亮变暗。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p75–79 | T4-0091–0098

FX407 · [P2] OCT coherence-limited axial resolutionFX407 · [P2] OCT相干长度限制的轴向分辨率

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Teacher emphasized which parameter controls axial versus lateral resolution; full constants are secondary to the bandwidth trend.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。老师强调轴向与横向控制参数不同；先掌握带宽趋势，再掌握系数。

Formula: 公式： Δz_air ≈ (2 ln2/π)λ₀²/Δλ ≈ 0.441λ₀²/Δλ; Δz_medium ≈ Δz_air/n_g

ENSymbols and units: λ₀: center wavelength; Δλ: source spectral FWHM; n_g: group refractive index converting optical delay to geometric depth; Δz: axial length.

中文符号与单位：λ₀中心波长；Δλ光源光谱半高全宽；n_g用于将光学延迟换算几何深度的群折射率；Δz轴向长度。

ENWhen to use: Calculate layer separation and compare source bandwidths.

中文何时使用：计算能分开的层间距，并比较光源带宽。

ENConditions and traps: Gaussian source spectrum, the stated FWHM convention and narrow fractional bandwidth approximation; weak dispersion can use supplied n≈n_g. Use consistent units for λ₀ and Δλ. Axial coherence resolution is not lateral Rayleigh resolution or the focused depth range.

中文条件与易错点：高斯光源光谱、给定FWHM定义及相对窄带近似；弱色散时可用题给n≈n_g。 λ₀与Δλ统一单位；相干轴向分辨率不等于横向瑞利分辨率，也不等于景深。

ENTiny example: 900 nm/40 nm → Δz_air≈8.94 μm; in a medium with n_g=1.4 → ≈6.38 μm.

中文短例理解：900 nm／40 nm得空气Δz≈8.94 μm；n_g=1.4时组织中约6.38 μm。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p81–84 | T4-0099–0104

FX408 · [P3] Object-side depth of field with detector termFX408 · [P3] 含探测器项的物方景深

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Keep the distinction and source correction; detailed detector-term arithmetic was not explicitly promised for quiz.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。保留概念区分与原式补正；复杂探测器项计算未明确点名Quiz。

Formula: 公式： d_tot ≈ λ₀n/NA² + n·e/(|M|·NA)

ENSymbols and units: d_tot: object-side in-focus depth range; e: smallest image-plane spacing resolved by detector; λ₀, e, d_tot in matching length units; M, NA, n dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：d_tot物方清晰深度范围；e探测器在像面可分辨的最小间距；λ₀、e、d_tot长度单位一致；M、NA、n无量纲。

ENWhen to use: Recognize the NA trade-off and use the corrected geometric detector term when all data are supplied.

中文何时使用：辨认NA与景深的权衡；给全参数时使用补正的探测器几何项。

ENConditions and traps: A stated microscopy focus criterion combining diffraction and detector/geometric limits; not a universal OCT axial-resolution formula. p83 omits e, leaving a dimensionless term that cannot be added to a length. Its object-side “Depth of Focus” should be called depth of field; standard depth of focus is image-side.

中文条件与易错点：该显微焦清晰判据合并衍射与探测器／几何限制，并非通用OCT轴向分辨率公式。 p83漏e，使第二项无量纲而不能与长度相加；原页物方“Depth of Focus”应称景深depth of field，标准depth of focus指像方焦深。

ENTiny example: λ₀=0.55 μm, n=1, NA=0.5, M=20, e=6 μm → 2.20+0.60=2.80 μm.

中文短例理解：λ₀=0.55 μm、n=1、NA=0.5、M=20、e=6 μm，得2.20+0.60=2.80 μm。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p83 | T4-0101–0104 | Nikon MicroscopyU: https://www.microscopyu.com/microscopy-basics/depth-of-field-and-depth-of-focus

FX409 · [P3] Hyperspectral cube data countsFX409 · [P3] 高光谱立方的数据数目

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Short counting aid to the teacher’s 5×5/25-spectrum illustration, not an added exam requirement.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。辅助老师5×5／25条谱的解释，不新增考试要求。

Formula: 公式： N_spectra = N_xN_y; N_values = N_xN_yN_λ

ENSymbols and units: N_x, N_y: spatial sample counts; N_λ: spectral-band count; counts are dimensionless integers.

中文符号与单位：N_x、N_y为空间采样数；N_λ为光谱波段数；均为无量纲整数。

ENWhen to use: Distinguish spectra per spatial pixel from all scalar intensity samples.

中文何时使用：区分每像素光谱条数与全部强度标量数。

ENConditions and traps: A complete x, y,λ cube with one intensity per spatial pixel and band; not every scanning step acquires the whole cube. The λ axis is spectral, not anatomical depth z; spatial sampling per mm is not a frequency in Hz.

中文条件与易错点：完整x,y,λ立方，每个空间像素每个波段一个强度；不能说每次扫描步骤都取得整块立方。 λ轴是光谱，不是解剖深度z；每毫米空间采样数不是Hz。

ENTiny example: 5×5 pixels, 120 bands →25 spectra and3000 intensity samples.

中文短例理解：5×5像素、120波段，得25条谱、3000个强度值。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p99–103 | T4-0111–0113

FX410 · [P2] Acoustic wave, wavelength and frequencyFX410 · [P2] 声波、波长与频率

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Foundational source-wave relations; not part of the locally excluded scanning details.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。基本声源关系，不属于老师局部列参考的扫描细节。

Formula: 公式： p(x,t)=p₀ cos(ωt−kx); v=λf; ω=2πf; k=2π/λ; T=1/f

ENSymbols and units: p₀: peak acoustic pressure Pa; v: m/s; λ: m; f: Hz; ω: rad/s; k: rad/m; T: s.

中文符号与单位：p₀为压力峰值Pa；v用m/s，λ用m，f用Hz，ω用rad/s，k用rad/m，T用s。

ENWhen to use: Convert frequency, period and wavelength and read a traveling pressure wave.

中文何时使用：换算频率、周期、波长并辨认传播压力波。

ENConditions and traps: Harmonic longitudinal plane-wave model with the stated sound speed; tissue speed is not the speed of light. Frequency f and angular frequency ω differ by2π; a full pressure cycle contains compression and rarefaction.

中文条件与易错点：给定声速的简谐纵向平面波模型；组织声速不是光速。 f与ω相差2π；一个完整压力周期含压缩和稀疏。

ENTiny example: v=1540 m/s, f=2 MHz → λ=0.770 mm, T=0.50 μs.

中文短例理解：v=1540 m/s、f=2 MHz，λ=0.770 mm、T=0.50 μs。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p9–14 | T5-0008–0010

FX411 · [P1] Echo depth versus one-way photoacoustic pathFX411 · [P1] 回波深度与光声单程声路

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Teacher directly explained divide-by-two echo timing; core short calculation.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。老师直接解释回波除二，属于基础短计算。

Formula: 公式： d_echo = vt_echo/2; d_oneway = vt_oneway

ENSymbols and units: d: geometric path/depth m; v: sound speed m/s; t: propagation time s.

中文符号与单位：d为几何路径／深度m；v声速m/s；t传播时间s。

ENWhen to use: Choose the correct time-of-flight factor from the actual path.

中文何时使用：根据实际路径选择飞行时间公式中的因子。

ENConditions and traps: Echo uses the same source/receiver path out and back; one-way PA assumes sound starts at the absorber and optical/system delay is negligible or removed. The names alone do not determine the factor: read the stated geometry and time reference.

中文条件与易错点：回波沿同路径去返；单程光声假设声源在吸收体，光／系统延迟可忽略或已扣。 不能只看成像名字就定因子，须看几何与计时起点。

ENTiny example: t=40 μs, v=1540 m/s → echo depth3.08 cm; the same one-way time gives6.16 cm.

中文短例理解：t=40 μs、v=1540 m/s，回波深度3.08 cm；同时间单程为6.16 cm。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p10–11,p21,p45–46 | T5-0007–0008 | T5-0066–0070

FX412 · [P2] Acoustic impedance and pressure/intensityFX412 · [P2] 声阻抗与压力／强度

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Teacher introduced acoustic material properties; essential for interpreting reflection and attenuation.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。老师介绍声学材料性质，是反射与衰减的理解基础。

Formula: 公式： Z_a=ρv; I(t)=p(t)²/Z_a; for p(t)=p₀ cosωt: Ī=p₀²/(2Z_a)=p_rms²/Z_a

ENSymbols and units: ρ: density kg/m³; Z_a: acoustic impedance rayl=kg/(m²·s); p: acoustic excess pressure Pa; I: W/m².

中文符号与单位：ρ密度kg/m³；Z_a声阻抗rayl=kg/(m²·s)；p声学过压Pa；I强度W/m²。

ENWhen to use: Relate pressure, material properties and carried acoustic intensity.

中文何时使用：联系压力、材料性质与声强。

ENConditions and traps: Progressive plane wave in a uniform lossless medium; distinguish instantaneous p(t), peak p₀ and RMS pressure. The factor1/2 applies when using peak pressure to compute time-average intensity; it is not inserted into the slide’s instantaneous formula.

中文条件与易错点：均匀无损介质中的行进平面波；区分瞬时p(t)、峰值p₀与有效值压力。 用压力峰值求时间平均强度才出现1/2，不能硬加进课件瞬时公式。

ENTiny example: p₀=2000 Pa, Z_a=1.5×10⁶ rayl → Ī≈1.33 W/m².

中文短例理解：p₀=2000 Pa、Z_a=1.5×10⁶ rayl，平均声强约1.33 W/m²。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p13–14,p19–22 | T5-0010–0012

FX413 · [P1] Acoustic reflection and normal-incidence optical analogueFX413 · [P1] 声反射与正入射光学类比

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Repeated classroom emphasis on impedance mismatch and echo contrast; Fresnel is a secondary comparison.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。声阻抗失配与回波对比课堂反复强调；Fresnel仅辅助类比。

Formula: 公式： R_I = [(Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁)]²; T_I=1−R_I; optical R=[(n₂−n₁)/(n₂+n₁)]²

ENSymbols and units: Z₁, Z₂: acoustic impedances in identical units; n₁, n₂: refractive indices; R_I, T_I: dimensionless intensity fractions.

中文符号与单位：Z₁、Z₂为同单位声阻抗；n₁、n₂折射率；R_I、T_I为无量纲强度比例。

ENWhen to use: Calculate reflected/transmitted energy fractions and understand coupling gel.

中文何时使用：求反射／透射能量比例并理解耦合凝胶。

ENConditions and traps: Normal incidence at an ideal lossless interface; optical expression additionally assumes nonmagnetic, transparent media and no interface absorption. These are intensity coefficients, not signed pressure-amplitude reflection coefficients; no universal T=1−R in a lossy whole tissue path.

中文条件与易错点：理想无损界面正入射；光学式另要求非磁性透明介质且界面不吸收。 这是强度系数，不是带正负号的压力反射系数；有损整条组织路径不通用T=1−R。

ENTiny example: Z₂=2Z₁ → R=1/9, T=8/9; air/glass n=1/1.5 → optical R≈4%.

中文短例理解：Z₂=2Z₁时R=1/9、T=8/9；空气／玻璃n=1／1.5时光反射约4%。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p19–22,p30 | T5-0019–0026

FX414 · [P1] Exponential pressure and intensity attenuationFX414 · [P1] 压力与强度的指数衰减

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Core attenuation concept; teacher highlighted total path and frequency dependence.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。衰减基础，老师强调总路径及频率依赖。

Formula: 公式： p_amp(L)=p_amp,0 e^(−α_pL); I(L)=I₀ e^(−α_IL); α_I=2α_p (same medium)

ENSymbols and units: L: actual traveled length; α_p: pressure-amplitude coefficient in inverse length; α_I: intensity coefficient in inverse length.

中文符号与单位：L为实际传播长度；α_p压力幅度衰减系数、α_I强度衰减系数，均用长度倒数。

ENWhen to use: Apply exponential attenuation without mixing pressure and intensity definitions.

中文何时使用：应用指数衰减，同时区分压力和强度定义。

ENConditions and traps: Uniform medium with unchanged acoustic impedance and stated constant coefficients; α values can depend on frequency. p23 uses an intensity α and p24 uses a pressure α. Equal symbols do not mean equal numerical definitions. For echoes L can be2d.

中文条件与易错点：介质均匀、声阻抗不变、系数给定且恒定；α可随频率改变。 p23强度α与p24压力α不是同一定义；同符号不代表同数值。回波L可为2d。

ENTiny example: If α_pL=1, pressure ratio=e⁻¹≈0.368 while intensity ratio=e⁻²≈0.135.

中文短例理解：α_pL=1时压力比e⁻¹≈0.368，强度比e⁻²≈0.135。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p23–25 | T5-0027–0032

FX415 · [P2] dB loss and exponential-coefficient conversionFX415 · [P2] dB损耗与指数系数换算

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Supports the classroom attenuation calculation and prevents unit-definition mistakes.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。支持课堂衰减计算，避免单位与定义错误。

Formula: 公式： A_dB=10 log₁₀(I₀/I)=20 log₁₀(p₀/p); I/I₀=10^(−A_dB/10); p/p₀=10^(−A_dB/20); a_dB=4.343α_I=8.686α_p

ENSymbols and units: A_dB: positive attenuation loss dB; a_dB: loss per unit length dB/length; α_I,α_p: inverse-length coefficients. p0 and p are positive pressure amplitudes or RMS values; I0 and I are corresponding time-averaged intensities.

中文符号与单位：A_dB为正的衰减损耗dB；a_dB每单位长度损耗；α_I、α_p自然指数系数，单位长度倒数。 p0、p为正的声压幅度或均方根值；I0、I为对应时间平均声强。

ENWhen to use: Convert the p24–25 dB data and distinguish intensity from amplitude ratios.

中文何时使用：换算p24–25的dB数据，区分强度比和幅度比。

ENConditions and traps: Pressure and intensity conversions assume the same medium/impedance. Positive loss uses input/output; gain convention uses output/input instead. 8.686 converts the pressure exponential coefficient, not an intensity α. Never put a dB/cm value directly into e^(−αL). Do not take the logarithm of signed instantaneous p(t).

中文条件与易错点：压力与强度换算需同介质／声阻抗；正损耗用输入／输出，增益定义则相反。 8.686对应压力指数系数，不是强度α；不能直接把dB/cm放进e^(−αL)。 不对带正负号的瞬时p(t)直接取对数。

ENTiny example: A_dB=20 dB → intensity1%, pressure10%; α_I=1 cm⁻¹ → a_dB≈4.343 dB/cm.

中文短例理解：20 dB损耗对应强度1%、压力10%；α_I=1 cm⁻¹对应约4.343 dB/cm。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p23–25 | T5-0030–0032

FX416 · [P1] Frequency-dependent ultrasound path lossFX416 · [P1] 频率相关的超声路径损耗

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. p25 worked example and explicit teacher correction of the two-way route.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。p25例题及老师对双程路径的明确纠正。

Formula: 公式： A_dB = a·f·L_total; uniform pulse-echo L_total=2d; layered path A_dB=Σ aᵢfLᵢ

ENSymbols and units: a: dB/(MHz·cm) if f uses MHz and L uses cm; d: reflector depth; L_total: full travel length.

中文符号与单位：若f用MHz、L用cm，a须用dB/(MHz·cm)；d反射点深度；L_total全路径长度。

ENWhen to use: Use the muscle example and include outward and return losses.

中文何时使用：使用肌肉例子，并计入去返程衰减。

ENConditions and traps: Approximately linear frequency dependence over the stated range; ignores interface reflection loss unless separately included. Depth and traveled length differ in echo measurements; do not use MHz values as Hz in this empirical-unit formula.

中文条件与易错点：给定范围内近似随频率线性变化；除非另计，忽略界面反射损失。 回波深度不等于传播总长度；这条经验单位式不能把MHz数值当Hz。

ENTiny example: a=1.3 dB/(MHz·cm), f=5 MHz, d=3 cm → A=1.3×5×6=39 dB.

中文短例理解：a=1.3 dB/(MHz·cm)、f=5 MHz、d=3 cm，A=1.3×5×6=39 dB。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p24–25 | T5-0030–0032

FX417 · [P3] Ultrasound pulse length and slide half-depth heuristicFX417 · [P3] 超声脉冲长度与课件半深度经验式

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Recognition/reference only: T5-0040 lowers detailed resolution calculation priority; it does not exclude basic echo/attenuation formulas.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。仅辨认／参考：T5-0040降低详细分辨率计算优先级，不排除基础测距和衰减式。

Formula: 公式： SPL=N_cyclesλ; axial separation≈SPL/2; for I=I₀e^(−α_IL), L_half,I=ln2/α_I; p31 also prints L_half≈6/f_ν

ENSymbols and units: N_cycles: cycles in pulse; SPL: spatial pulse length. The README assumes f_ν in MHz and 6/f_ν in cm, but source p31 does not print these units.

中文符号与单位：N_cycles为脉冲周期数，SPL空间脉冲长度。README假设f_ν用MHz、6/f_ν得cm，但p31原页未印出该单位约定。

ENWhen to use: Recognize why shorter pulses and higher frequency can improve axial separation; identify the half-depth definition.

中文何时使用：辨认短脉冲／高频如何改善轴向间距，并认清半深度定义。

ENConditions and traps: SPL/2 is pulse-echo axial geometry. The6/f expression is a tissue/frequency heuristic with unstated coefficient assumptions, not a universal law. Half intensity and half pressure require different depths. The teacher called detailed ultrasound resolution calculation reference material.

中文条件与易错点：SPL/2是脉冲回波轴向几何；6/f是未充分说明组织／系数条件的经验式，不是普遍定律。 强度减半与压力减半深度不同；老师把详细超声分辨率计算列为参考。

ENTiny example: At v=1540 m/s, f=2 MHz, N=2: λ=0.77 mm, SPL/2=0.77 mm.

中文短例理解：v=1540 m/s、f=2 MHz、N=2时，λ=0.77 mm，SPL/2=0.77 mm。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p27–31 | T5-0037–0041

FX418 · [P1] X-ray single- and multilayer attenuationFX418 · [P1] X射线单层与分层衰减

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. p60–61 worked in class; important exponential layering and unit check.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。p60–61上课讲解，重点是分层指数与单位。

Formula: 公式： I/I₀=e^(−μx); I/I₀=e^(−Σμᵢxᵢ); x_1/e=1/μ; x_half=ln2/μ

ENSymbols and units: μ: linear attenuation coefficient cm⁻¹ or m⁻¹; x: matching path length; I/I₀: dimensionless transmitted intensity.

中文符号与单位：μ线性衰减系数cm⁻¹或m⁻¹；x使用对应长度单位；I/I₀为无量纲透射强度。

ENWhen to use: Calculate a film/detector intensity and accumulate different tissue layers.

中文何时使用：计算胶片／探测器收到的强度，并累加不同组织层。

ENConditions and traps: Monoenergetic beam, stated fixed layer coefficients, primary transmitted beam; neglect scatter and beam hardening. Add μᵢxᵢ in the exponent, not intensities; projection X-ray is one-way in the source problem.

中文条件与易错点：单能光束、各层系数给定且固定、直接透射束；忽略散射与束硬化。 累加指数中的μᵢxᵢ，不累加强度；原题X射线为单程透射。

ENTiny example: 1 cm bone μ=10 cm⁻¹ plus3 cm tissue μ=1 cm⁻¹ → I/I₀=e⁻¹³≈2.26×10⁻⁶.

中文短例理解：1 cm骨μ=10 cm⁻¹加3 cm组织μ=1 cm⁻¹，I/I₀=e⁻¹³≈2.26×10⁻⁶。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p58–61 | T5-0082–0085

FX419 · [P2] Signed transmission-image contrastFX419 · [P2] 透射图像的带符号对比度

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Source formula and imaging concept; no specific quiz promise for this numerical ratio.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。原课件公式及成像概念，未找到此比值的明确Quiz承诺。

Formula: 公式： C_local=(I_B−I_O)/I_B = 1−I_O/I_B

ENSymbols and units: I_B: background transmitted intensity; I_O: object-path transmitted intensity; C_local: dimensionless, often expressed as%.

中文符号与单位：I_B背景透射强度，I_O目标路径透射强度；C_local无量纲，可表示百分比。

ENWhen to use: Quantify the relative intensity difference between object and background.

中文何时使用：量化目标与背景的相对强度差。

ENConditions and traps: Use the p62 sign convention and the same acquisition/reference exposure. Other contrast definitions may use absolute values or reversed signs. Greater attenuation gives smaller detector intensity and positive C here. Displayed black/white can be inverted; do not infer sign from screen color alone.

中文条件与易错点：用p62的符号定义，且两强度采集参照相同；其他定义可能取绝对值或反号。 衰减更强使探测强度更小，在本定义下C为正；显示灰度可反相，不能只看黑白判断符号。

ENTiny example: I_B=100, I_O=80 → C=0.20; I_O=120 → C=−0.20.

中文短例理解：I_B=100、I_O=80时C=0.20；I_O=120时C=−0.20。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p62 | T5-0085–0087

FX420 · [P3] Photoelectric threshold and absorption trendFX420 · [P3] 光电阈值与吸收趋势

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Supporting mechanism/trend recognition; source technical details were not promised for quiz.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。辅助机制／趋势辨认；源技术细节未明确点名Quiz。

Formula: 公式： K_max=E_photon−W (if E_photon≥W); photoelectric probability ∝ ρZ_atom³/E_photon³ (source approximation)

ENSymbols and units: W: work function/binding threshold energy; K_max: electron kinetic energy; Z_atom: atomic number, not acoustic impedance; ρ: density.

中文符号与单位：W逸出功／束缚阈值；K_max电子最大动能；Z_atom为原子序数，不是声阻抗；ρ密度。

ENWhen to use: Recognize threshold emission and why high-Z contrast agents can absorb strongly.

中文何时使用：辨认阈值发射及高原子序数造影剂强吸收趋势。

ENConditions and traps: K_max is the simple one-photon photoelectric illustration. The absorption power law is a rough energy/material trend away from absorption edges. The p57 sodium example uses visible photons, not X-ray wavelengths. Shell absorption edges break a smooth E⁻³ extrapolation.

中文条件与易错点：K_max用于简单单光子光电示例；吸收幂律是在吸收边之外的粗略能量／材料趋势。 p57钠例使用可见光子，不是X射线波长；壳层吸收边使平滑E⁻³外推失效。

ENTiny example: p57: E_photon=2.48 eV, W=2.28 eV → K_max=0.20 eV.

中文短例理解：p57示例2.48 eV光子、阈值2.28 eV，K_max=0.20 eV。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p57–58 | T5-0077–0081

FX421 · [P3] Bit depth, storage and spatial samplingFX421 · [P3] 位深、存储与空间采样

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Useful image-data interpretation; storage counting is an auxiliary derived relation.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。辅助图像数据理解；存储计数为派生短关系。

Formula: 公式： N_gray=2ᵇ; highest unsigned code=2ᵇ−1; N_bits=N_pixels·b; raw bytes=N_bits/8; f_spatial=1/Δx

ENSymbols and units: b: bits/pixel for grayscale; N_pixels: pixel count; Δx: spatial pitch in mm or m; f_spatial: samples/mm or samples/m, not Hz.

中文符号与单位：b为灰度每像素位数，N_pixels像素数；Δx空间间距mm或m，f_spatial为空间采样数/mm或/m，不是Hz。

ENWhen to use: Read quantization tables and distinguish gray levels from spatial resolution.

中文何时使用：读量化表，区分灰度等级与空间分辨率。

ENConditions and traps: Storage formula assumes packed raw grayscale without header/compression; implementation can store12-bit values in16-bit containers. 256 levels means codes0–255. More gray levels do not create new optically resolved spatial detail.

中文条件与易错点：存储式假设紧凑原始灰度且无文件头／压缩；12bit可实际装入16bit容器。 256级编码是0–255；增加灰度级不会生成新的光学空间细节。

ENTiny example: 8 bits→256 levels; 256×256×12 bits/8=98, 304 bytes when packed.

中文短例理解：8bit→256级；256×256×12bit紧凑存储为98,304字节。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p73–76 | T5-0098–0101

FX422 · [P3] Convolution and averaging kernelsFX422 · [P3] 卷积与均值核

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Teacher described convolution; full indexing algebra is recognition/reference rather than first-pass quiz memorization.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。老师讲卷积作用；完整下标代数仅辨认／参考，不列第一轮Quiz背诵。

Formula: 公式： g(i,j)=ΣₐΣ_b h(a,b)f(i−a,j−b); uniform K×K mean: h=1/K², Σh=1

ENSymbols and units: f: input pixel intensity; g: filtered intensity; h: dimensionless kernel weights; K: integer kernel side length.

中文符号与单位：f输入像素强度，g滤波后强度，h无量纲核权重，K核边长整数。

ENWhen to use: Predict smoothing and calculate one explicitly defined neighborhood output.

中文何时使用：判断平滑作用，计算明确定义邻域的输出。

ENConditions and traps: Use the specified convolution/correlation convention and border handling; a symmetric mean kernel gives the same local mean in either convention. p82 mixes a5×5 label with a3×3 red-center illustration. Follow the stated kernel, not a copied output.

中文条件与易错点：须说明卷积／相关约定与边界处理；对称均值核在两种约定下局部均值相同。 p82混用5×5标题与3×3红中心示例；按题给核，不盲背输出。

ENTiny example: A5×5 mean gives weight1/25 per sample; the illustrated3×3 red-center mean is489/9≈54.33.

中文短例理解：5×5均值每权重1/25；图示3×3红中心均值为489/9≈54.33。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p82 | T5-0102–0103

FX423 · [P3] Diagnostic sensitivity, specificity and ROCFX423 · [P3] 诊断敏感度、特异度与ROC

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Teacher discussed the definitions but called the extension reference/not very important; formulas support understanding.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。老师讲定义但把扩展列为参考、不很重要；此式辅助理解。

Formula: 公式： TPR=TP/(TP+FN); specificity=TN/(TN+FP); FPR=FP/(FP+TN)=1−specificity; accuracy=(TP+TN)/N; precision=TP/(TP+FP)

ENSymbols and units: TP, TN: correct positive/negative counts; FP, FN: false positive/negative counts; N=TP+TN+FP+FN; all ratios dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：TP、TN为正确阳／阴计数；FP、FN为假阳／阴；N为四格总和；比例无量纲。

ENWhen to use: Interpret the confusion matrix and ROC axes (FPR horizontal, TPR vertical).

中文何时使用：读混淆矩阵与ROC轴：横FPR，纵TPR。

ENConditions and traps: Binary classifier at a given threshold; denominators must be nonzero. Threshold changes generate ROC points. Diagnostic sensitivity is not calibration slope. Precision uses predicted positives, while TPR uses actual positives.

中文条件与易错点：给定阈值下的二分类器，分母需非零；改变阈值形成ROC点。 诊断敏感度不是校准斜率；precision分母是预测阳性，TPR分母是真实阳性。

ENTiny example: TP=80, FN=20, TN=90, FP=10 → TPR=80%, specificity=90%, accuracy=85%.

中文短例理解：TP=80、FN=20、TN=90、FP=10时，敏感度80%、特异度90%、准确率85%。

Source / 来源：W5 PDF p84–86 | T5-0103–0105

FX424 · [P2] Cell potential and electrochemical Nernst equationFX424 · [P2] 电池电势与电化学能斯特式

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Source equation and relative-potential concept; teacher called chemistry tables supporting, so long reaction bookkeeping is not a quiz promise.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。原课件式与相对电势概念；老师把化学表列支持资料，不把长反应配平宣传Quiz必考。

Formula: 公式： E_cell=E_cathode−E_anode (both reduction potentials); E=E°−RT/(nF)·lnQ_rxn; at 25°C (298.15 K): E=E°−(0.05916 V/n)log₁₀Q_rxn

ENSymbols and units: R=8.314 J/(mol·K); T: K; n: integer stoichiometric electron number per balanced reaction; F≈96485 C/mol; Q_rxn: dimensionless activity quotient; E: V.

中文符号与单位：R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，T开尔文，n为配平反应中转移电子数（整数，不是电子摩尔数），F≈96485 C/mol，Q_rxn无量纲活度反应商，E用V。

ENWhen to use: Relate concentration/activity and temperature to equilibrium electrochemical potential.

中文何时使用：联系活度／浓度、温度与平衡电化学电势。

ENConditions and traps: Equilibrium/reversible electrode response; 0.05916 applies at 25°C (298.15 K) and base10 log. Pure solids/liquids usually have unit activity in Q. Q_rxn is not electric charge Q; do not flip anode reduction potential twice or mix ln with the0.05916 coefficient.

中文条件与易错点：平衡／可逆电极响应；0.05916针对25°C (298.15 K)及常用对数；反应商中纯固液活度通常取1。 Q_rxn不是电荷Q；不要对阳极还原电势反号两次，也不要把ln和0.05916混用。

ENTiny example: n=1, Q_rxn=10 at 25°C (298.15 K) → E is59.16 mV below E°.

中文短例理解：25°C (298.15 K)、n=1、Q_rxn=10时，E比E°低59.16 mV。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p34–36 | T6-0035–0038

FX425 · [P2] Ideal ion-selective response andpHFX425 · [P2] 理想离子选择响应与pH

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. pH is explicitly explained; the ideal Nernst slope is a useful conditioned supporting formula.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。pH课堂明确解释；理想Nernst斜率是带条件的辅助短公式。

Formula: 公式： E=K+[2.303RT/(zF)]log₁₀a_ion; pH=−log₁₀a_H⁺; ideal H⁺ response at 25°C (298.15 K): E=K−0.05916 V·pH

ENSymbols and units: a_ion: dimensionless ion activity; z: signed ion valence; K: reference/constant terms V; pH: dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：a_ion离子活度无量纲，z带符号价数，K为参比／常数电势项V，pH无量纲。

ENWhen to use: Recognize logarithmic sensing and a59 mV-per-pH-unit ideal slope.

中文何时使用：认清对数感测及理想每pH单位约59 mV斜率。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal selective equilibrium response at stated temperature and voltage polarity; dilute solutions can approximate activity with normalized concentration. The source phrase “proportional to concentration” must not become E∝c. Reversing measured electrode polarity reverses the slope sign.

中文条件与易错点：给定温度与电压极性的理想选择性平衡响应；稀溶液可用归一浓度近似活度。 源文“与浓度成比例”不能解读成E∝c；反转测量电极极性，斜率符号也反转。

ENTiny example: For E=K−59.16 mV·pH, pH6→8 gives ΔE=−118.32 mV.

中文短例理解：按E=K−59.16 mV·pH，pH6→8得ΔE=−118.32 mV。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p36,p40–43 | T6-0042–0045

FX426 · [P2] Reference-electrode conversionFX426 · [P2] 参比电极换算

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Explicit slide worked question; short reference subtraction, not chemical table memorization.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。原课件明确例题；会短参比减法，不背化学表。

Formula: 公式： E(vsRef)=E_ind(vsSHE)−E_Ref(vsSHE); E(vsRefB)=E(vsRefA)+E_RefA−E_RefB

ENSymbols and units: E_ind: indicator half-cell potential; E_Ref: specified reference potential; all V relative to a commonSHE zero.

中文符号与单位：E_ind指示半电池电势，E_Ref指定参比电势；均用V并相对共同SHE零点。

ENWhen to use: Change the reference zero without changing the underlying indicator electrode.

中文何时使用：变换参照零点而不改变指示电极本身。

ENConditions and traps: Same polarity and reference conditions; ignore or separately include liquid-junction potential, which the source diagram labels E_j. Subtract the new reference. The p38 source actually prints SCE+0.2444 V, not+0.2440 V.

中文条件与易错点：极性、参照条件相同；液接电势需忽略或另计，源图标为E_j。 减去新参照；p38原图实际印SCE+0.2444 V，不是+0.2440 V。

ENTiny example: Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺+0.750 V vsSHE → +0.5056 V vsSCE; +0.553 V vsAg/AgCl(+0.197 V).

中文短例理解：Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺相对SHE+0.750 V，换成SCE为+0.5056 V，换Ag/AgCl(+0.197 V)为+0.553 V。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p32,p37–38 | T6-0034–0039

FX427 · [P1] Faraday charge, electron moles and countsFX427 · [P1] 法拉第电荷、电子摩尔与个数

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Three classroom worked examples and repeated unit/stoichiometry emphasis.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。三个课堂例题及反复单位／计量强调。

Formula: 公式： Q=∫i(t)dt; constant current Q=It; n_e=|Q|/F; N_e=n_eN_A=|Q|/e_charge

ENSymbols and units: I: A; t: s; Q: C; F≈96500 C/mol electrons; N_A≈6.022×10²³ mol⁻¹; e_charge≈1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C; N_e: electron count.

中文符号与单位：I用A，t用s，Q用C；F≈96500 C/mol电子，N_A≈6.022×10²³ mol⁻¹，e_charge≈1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C，N_e电子个数。

ENWhen to use: Convert measured current/time into electron moles or electron count.

中文何时使用：把电流与时间换成电子摩尔数或个数。

ENConditions and traps: Use integrated faradaic reaction charge; the requested count uses magnitude, whereas signed Q follows the current convention. 1 faraday of charge is not1 farad of capacitance. Electron moles and individual electrons are different answers.

中文条件与易错点：使用反应的法拉第电荷积分；电子数量用大小，带符号Q遵循电流方向约定。 一法拉第电荷不是一法拉电容；电子摩尔数与单个电子数量不同。

ENTiny example: 0.10 A×600 s=60 C →6.22×10⁻⁴ mol electrons.

中文短例理解：0.10 A×600 s=60 C，对应6.22×10⁻⁴ mol电子。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p50–52,p60 | T6-0054–0063

FX428 · [P1] Analyte stoichiometry, mass and current efficiencyFX428 · [P1] 分析物计量、质量与电流效率

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Teacher said the lactate question resembles past exam questions; it supports this method, not a guaranteed quiz replica.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。老师说乳酸题类似历年题，支持这一方法，不代表本次Quiz原样必出。

Formula: 公式： n_analyte=m/M_molar; n_e=z_e·n_analyte; |Q_reaction|=z_eFm/M_molar; m=η|It|M_molar/(z_eF)

ENSymbols and units: M_molar: g/mol with m: g; z_e: electron coefficient per analyte; η: current efficiency0–1; I: A and t: s.

中文符号与单位：M_molar用g/mol时m用g；z_e每份待测物电子系数；η电流效率0–1；I用A、t用s。

ENWhen to use: Convert a given reaction coefficient to charge, analyte mass or average current.

中文何时使用：用给定电子系数求电荷、分析物质量或平均电流。

ENConditions and traps: The stated reaction model, complete/known reaction yield and collected charge. η includes the specified useful-current fraction. Convert mg to g before dividing by g/mol. Do not import the real lactate molar mass or reaction into p60 without noting its simplified100 g/mol, 1: 12 assumptions.

中文条件与易错点：按给定反应模型、已知／完全反应产率与收集电荷；η是指定有效电流比例。 除以g/mol前把mg换g；不能静默替换p60简化100 g/mol、1:12假设。

ENTiny example: 10 mL×1 mg/mL=0.010 g; M=100 g/mol, z_e=12 → n_e=1.2×10⁻³ mol.

中文短例理解：10 mL×1 mg/mL=0.010 g；M=100 g/mol、z_e=12，得n_e=1.2×10⁻³ mol。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p51–52,p60 | T6-0055–0063

FX429 · [P2] Glucose-strip background subtractionFX429 · [P2] 葡萄糖试纸背景扣除

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Explicit source arithmetic relationship and practical glucose readout.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。原图明确的减法关系与葡萄糖实际读出。

Formula: 公式： I_glucose≈I_WE1−I_WE2; if I_corr=S c+b, c=(I_corr−b)/S

ENSymbols and units: WE1: GOx-containing working electrode signal+background; WE2: matched enzyme-free background; S: calibration current/concentration.

中文符号与单位：WE1含GOx，测目标加背景；WE2不含酶，测匹配背景；S校准斜率，单位电流/浓度。

ENWhen to use: Subtract matched interference and use the calibration for the corrected signal.

中文何时使用：扣除匹配干扰，再用扣背景信号的校准线。

ENConditions and traps: Background currents are suitably matched and calibration is valid for the corrected channel. p58 is two working electrodes plusAg/AgCl reference; do not rename the secondWE as a counter electrode.

中文条件与易错点：两路背景电流适当匹配，且校准线对扣背景通道有效。 p58是双WE加Ag/AgCl参比，不能把第二WE改叫对电极。

ENTiny example: 18−5=13 μA; S=2 μA/mM, b=0 →c=6.5 mM.

中文短例理解：18−5=13 μA；S=2 μA/mM、b=0，c=6.5 mM。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p58 | T6-0066–0069

FX430 · [P3] Conductance, conductivity and geometryFX430 · [P3] 电导、电导率与几何

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Supporting uniform-path relation derived for interpreting conductometric diagrams; not an explicit new quiz formula.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。用于理解电导图的均匀路径辅助关系，不新增明确Quiz公式。

Formula: 公式： G=1/R; I=GV; R=ρ_eL/A; G=κA/L; κ=1/ρ_e

ENSymbols and units: G: siemens S; R:Ω; κ: conductivity S/m; ρ_e: resistivity Ω·m; L: m; A: m².

中文符号与单位：G电导用S，R电阻Ω，κ电导率S/m，ρ_e电阻率Ω·m，L用m，A用m²。

ENWhen to use: Distinguish a measured conductance from material conductivity and account for geometry.

中文何时使用：区分测得的电导与材料电导率，并考虑几何形状。

ENConditions and traps: Uniform ohmic path with specified length/cross-section; electrode interfaces and complex geometries need a fuller model. G depends on geometry as well as material. Acoustic densityρ is unrelated to electrical resistivityρ_e.

中文条件与易错点：指定长度、截面的均匀欧姆导体；电极界面与复杂几何需更完整模型。 G随几何与材料共同变；声学密度ρ与电阻率ρ_e不是同一量。

ENTiny example: κ=1 S/m, A=1 mm², L=1 mm →G=1 mS, R=1 kΩ.

中文短例理解：κ=1 S/m、A=1 mm²、L=1 mm，G=1 mS、R=1 kΩ。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p19,p67–69 | T6-0020 | T6-0077–0079

FX431 · [P2] Parallel-plate capacitance modelFX431 · [P2] 平行板电容模型

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. README core formula supports the course capacitance mechanism; treat it as a stated model, not every electrode’s universal law.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。README核心式支持课程电容机制，但须声明模型，不当成所有电极通用定律。

Formula: 公式： C=εA/d=ε₀ε_rA/d; for fixedA: C₂/C₁=(ε₂/ε₁)(d₁/d₂)

ENSymbols and units: C: F; ε₀≈8.854×10⁻¹² F/m; ε_r: relative permittivity; A: m²; d: m; ε: absolute permittivityF/m.

中文符号与单位：C用F；ε₀≈8.854×10⁻¹² F/m，ε_r相对介电常数，A用m²、d用m；ε为绝对介电率F/m。

ENWhen to use: Predict capacitance change with dielectric, area and separation.

中文何时使用：判断介电、面积及间距变化怎样改变电容。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal parallel plates, uniform dielectric, negligible fringing and fixed measurement frequency; biosensor interfaces need an appropriate equivalent model. C=εA/d already uses absoluteε; do not multiply ε₀ twice. Binding does not universally make C rise—thickness and dielectric can change together.

中文条件与易错点：理想平行板、均匀介电、忽略边缘效应且测量频率固定；真实传感界面需适当等效模型。 C=εA/d中的ε已是绝对介电率，不乘两次ε₀；结合可同时改厚度与介电，不保证C一定上升。

ENTiny example: Fixedε, A and doubledd →C halves.

中文短例理解：ε、A固定，d翻倍，C减半。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p80–81,p86 | T6-0088–0092 | T6-0097–0099 | Sample Q10

FX432 · [P2] R,C,L complex impedancesFX432 · [P2] 电阻、电容、电感复阻抗

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Basic impedance recognition is covered; full multi-element algebra/Bode drawing is secondary/final emphasis.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。基础阻抗辨认在课程内；完整多元件代数／Bode作图为次要／期末强调。

Formula: 公式： ω=2πf; Z_R=R; Z_C=1/(jωC)=−j/(ωC); Z_L=jωL; |X_C|=1/(2πfC); |X_L|=2πfL

ENSymbols and units: j²=−1; f: Hz; ω: rad/s; C: F; L: H; allZ andX:Ω; phases R0°, C−90°, L+90° for the stated convention.

中文符号与单位：j²=−1；f用Hz、ω用rad/s、C用F、L用H；Z、X均用Ω；按此约定相位R0°、C−90°、L+90°。

ENWhen to use: Read frequency trends and calculate reactive impedance.

中文何时使用：辨认频率趋势并计算电抗阻抗。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal linear lumped elements and e^(jωt) phasor convention; actual components can have parasitic losses. p83’s graphic/ASR incorrectly puts f in the denominator of inductive reactance: correct X_L=2πfL. Capacitive magnitude falls as f rises.

中文条件与易错点：理想线性集中参数元件，采用e^(jωt)相量约定；真实器件有寄生损耗。 p83图／字幕把电感电抗的f放分母有误；正确X_L=2πfL。电容幅值随频率升高而降低。

ENTiny example: f=1 MHz, C=500 pF →Z_C=−j318.3 Ω.

中文短例理解：f=1 MHz、C=500 pF，Z_C=−j318.3 Ω。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p82–86 | T6-0093–0101

FX433 · [P3] Combining AC impedancesFX433 · [P3] 交流阻抗串并联

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Necessary support for source Example4; lengthy network calculations are not a quiz guarantee.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。支持原例4所需关系；长网络计算不宣传Quiz保证。

Formula: 公式： Z_series=ΣZᵢ; 1/Z_parallel=Σ(1/Zᵢ); two branches Z_parallel=Z₁Z₂/(Z₁+Z₂); |a+jb|=√(a²+b²)

ENSymbols and units: Zᵢ: complex impedancesΩ; a, b: real and imaginary partsΩ; |Z|: magnitudeΩ.

中文符号与单位：Zᵢ复阻抗Ω；a、b为实部、虚部Ω；|Z|幅值Ω。

ENWhen to use: Simplify equivalent circuits before computing current or voltage division.

中文何时使用：先化简等效电路，再算电流或分压。

ENConditions and traps: Linear sinusoidal steady state at a common frequency; use the actual connection diagram. Add complexZ first, then take magnitude. In general |Z₁+Z₂|≠|Z₁|+|Z₂|.

中文条件与易错点：同一频率下的线性正弦稳态；连接关系按实际电路图。 先加复数Z，再求模；一般|Z₁+Z₂|不等于|Z₁|+|Z₂|。

ENTiny example: 100 Ω in series with−j318.3 Ω →|Z|≈333.65 Ω, not418.3 Ω.

中文短例理解：100 Ω串联−j318.3 Ω，|Z|≈333.65 Ω，不是418.3 Ω。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p85–86 | T6-0096–0101

FX434 · [P3] SeriesRC capacitor voltage dividerFX434 · [P3] 串联RC的电容分压

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Worked in class; teacher explicitly emphasized final impedance/Bode questions, not an assured quiz complex calculation.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。课堂讲过；老师明确强调期末阻抗／Bode，不等于保证Quiz复数计算。

Formula: 公式： V_C/V_s=Z_C/(R+Z_C)=1/(1+jωRC); |V_C|=|V_s|/√[1+(ωRC)²]; φ_C=−atan(ωRC)

ENSymbols and units: R:Ω; C: F; ω: rad/s; ωRC dimensionless; V_s, V_C use the same peak/RMS convention.

中文符号与单位：R用Ω、C用F、ω用rad/s；ωRC无量纲；V_s与V_C统一峰值／有效值约定。

ENWhen to use: Solve the p86 voltage across the series sensor capacitor.

中文何时使用：求p86串联传感电容两端电压。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal seriesR–C driven by a voltage source, output acrossC, no loading; not the same as a parallelRC total impedance. Do not divide by R+|Z_C| as scalars. Phase is relative to the source; peak5 V gives a peak answer.

中文条件与易错点：理想电压源驱动串联R–C，输出取电容、无负载；不同于并联RC总阻抗。 分母不能用R+|Z_C|的标量和；相位相对源，5 V峰值得到峰值结果。

ENTiny example: R=100 Ω, C=500 pF, f=1 MHz, V_s=5 V peak →V_C≈4.77∠−17.44° V peak.

中文短例理解：R=100 Ω、C=500 pF、f=1 MHz、源5 V峰值，V_C≈4.77∠−17.44° V峰值。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p86 | T6-0097–0101

FX435 · [P3] Pure parallelRC and Bode conventionsFX435 · [P3] 纯并联RC与Bode约定

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Reference/final-algebra support; included chiefly to correct the copied phase-peak claim.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。参考／期末代数辅助，主要用于纠正照抄相位峰的说法。

Formula: 公式： Z_(R∥C)=R/(1+jωRC); |Z|=R/√[1+(ωRC)²]; φ=−atan(ωRC); f_c=1/(2πRC); normalized magnitude_dB=20log₁₀(|Z|/Z_ref)

ENSymbols and units: Z_ref: stated positive reference impedance; R:Ω, C: F, f_c: Hz; magnitude ratio for dB must be dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：Z_ref为声明的正参考阻抗；R用Ω、C用F、f_c用Hz；dB的幅值比必须无量纲。

ENWhen to use: Recognize a corner frequency, limiting impedance and phase behavior.

中文何时使用：辨认转折频率、阻抗极限与相位变化。

ENConditions and traps: Pure parallelR∥C. The source may plotlog|Z| rather than normalizeddB: read the axis label; atf_c,|Z|=R/√2 andφ=−45°. A pure parallelRC phase changes monotonically0→−90° and has no interior phase peak. The p85 generic peak requires additional circuit structure.

中文条件与易错点：纯并联R∥C；课件可画log|Z|而非归一dB，须读轴；f_c处|Z|=R/√2、φ=−45°。 纯并联RC相位从0到−90°单调变化，无内部相位峰；p85一般峰形需额外电路结构。

ENTiny example: R=1 kΩ, C=1 μF →f_c≈159 Hz; atf_c,|Z|≈707 Ω.

中文短例理解：R=1 kΩ、C=1 μF，f_c≈159 Hz，此处|Z|≈707 Ω。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p85–86 | T6-0095–0101

FX436 · [P3] Series resistance with a parallelRC/Nyquist semicircleFX436 · [P3] 串联电阻加并联RC／Nyquist半圆

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Auxiliary equivalent-circuit recognition; longer derivation belongs to final/advanced practice, not quiz first-pass memory.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。等效电路辅助辨认；长推导放期末／进阶，不列Quiz第一轮背诵。

Formula: 公式： Z=R_s+R_p/(1+jωR_pC); Z′=R_s+R_p/(1+x²); Z″=−R_px/(1+x²), x=ωR_pC; (Z′−R_s−R_p/2)²+(Z″)²=(R_p/2)²

ENSymbols and units: R_s: series resistanceΩ; R_p: parallel resistanceΩ; C: F; x: dimensionless; Nyquist convention plots−Z″ againstZ′.

中文符号与单位：R_s串联电阻Ω，R_p并联电阻Ω，C用F，x无量纲；Nyquist常画−Z″对Z′。

ENWhen to use: Recognize the semicircle and why addingR_s changes Bode phase behavior.

中文何时使用：辨认半圆，并理解加R_s如何改变Bode相位。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal R_s+(R_p∥C) with positive parameters; no diffusion/constant-phase elements. Different electrode models give other shapes. The circuit, not every biosensor, predicts a semicircle. This network can have a phase feature; do not apply it to pureR∥C indiscriminately.

中文条件与易错点：理想正参数R_s+(R_p∥C)，不含扩散／常相位元件；不同电极模型可有其他曲线。 是该电路预测半圆，并非所有传感器都半圆；本网络可有相位特征，不能无条件套纯R∥C。

ENTiny example: Nyquist real-axis intercepts areR_s andR_s+R_p; withR_s=300 Ω, R_p=20 kΩ they are300 Ω and20.3 kΩ.

中文短例理解：实轴截距为R_s和R_s+R_p；R_s=300 Ω、R_p=20 kΩ时为300 Ω和20.3 kΩ。

Source / 来源：W6 PDF p66,p70,p84–85 | T6-0095–0101

FX701 · [P2] Cell Nernst potential: valence, sign and temperatureFX701 · [P2] 细胞 Nernst 电位：价态、符号与温度

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Understand the one-ion meaning and signs; the teacher did not require memorizing long cellular expressions. Numerical use is supporting practice.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。理解单离子含义与符号；老师说细胞长表达式不需死记。完整数值代入作辅助练习。

Formula: 公式： Eion = (RT/(zF)) ln(aout/ain) = (2.303RT/(zF)) log₁₀(aout/ain); 25°C: Eion = (59.16 mV/z) log₁₀(aout/ain); 37°C: Eion = (61.54 mV/z) log₁₀(aout/ain)

ENSymbols and units: Eion: inside-minus-outside equilibrium voltage; z: signed ionic charge (+1 for K⁺, −1 for Cl⁻); a: activity, approximated by concentration when appropriate. R=8.314 J/(mol·K), T in K, F≈96485 C/mol.

中文符号与单位：Eion：胞内减胞外的单离子平衡电位；z 是带符号价态（K⁺为 +1，Cl⁻为 −1）；a 为活度，适当条件下用浓度近似。R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，T 用 K，F≈96485 C/mol。

ENWhen to use: Find the voltage balancing one ion’s concentration drive; compare how a gradient or temperature changes that voltage.

中文何时使用：求使某一种离子的浓度驱动与电作用平衡的电压；判断梯度或温度变化的影响。

ENConditions and traps: One specified ion at electrochemical equilibrium; inside and outside use the same concentration units. 25°C=298.15 K; 37°C=310.15 K. The slide’s −61 coefficient is a rounded 37°C coefficient for z=+1 with the ratio reversed. Do not put ln into a base-10 coefficient, omit the sign of z, or use −61 for every ion. This single-ion voltage is not automatically the multi-ion resting potential.

中文条件与易错点：针对一种特定离子的电化学平衡；内外浓度单位一致。25°C=298.15 K；37°C=310.15 K。课件 −61 是 z=+1、浓度比倒置后使用的 37°C 粗略系数。 不能把 ln 配上常用对数系数、漏掉 z 的正负号，或所有离子都套 −61。单离子平衡电位不自动等于多离子细胞的实际静息电位。

ENTiny example: K⁺: aout/ain≈4/140 at 37°C gives −95.0 mV using 61.54; the source’s rounded 61 gives −94.2 mV. For z=−1, the coefficient changes sign.

中文短例理解：K⁺在 37°C，aout/ain≈4/140：用 61.54 得 −95.0 mV，课件用粗略 61 得 −94.2 mV。z=−1 时系数反号。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p27 | T7-0017–0018

FX702 · [P2] GHK: permeability weights and reversed chloride placementFX702 · [P2] GHK：通透性权重与 Cl⁻ 的反向位置

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. Learn what is weighted and the Cl⁻ placement; retain the full expression for reference rather than treating it as a promised Quiz derivation.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。先会权重与 Cl⁻ 位置的概念辨认；完整式保留供查阅，不宣传为 Quiz 保证推导题。

Formula: 公式： Vm = (RT/F) ln[(PK[K⁺]out + PNa[Na⁺]out + PCl[Cl⁻]in)/(PK[K⁺]in + PNa[Na⁺]in + PCl[Cl⁻]out)]; At a steady zero-net-current state: I_Na + I_K + I_Cl = 0

ENSymbols and units: Vm: inside−outside voltage (V); P: relative permeability for each ion; brackets: ion concentration, in consistent units; R,T,F as in Nernst.

中文符号与单位：Vm：胞内减胞外电位（V）；P：各离子的相对通透性；方括号表示统一单位的离子浓度；R、T、F 同 Nernst。

ENWhen to use: Recognize how several monovalent ions contribute to membrane voltage; identify why changing a permeability can change Vm without changing the concentrations.

中文何时使用：识别多个单价离子如何共同决定膜电位；理解浓度不变时通透性改变也能改变 Vm。

ENConditions and traps: The shown form is the constant-field, monovalent K⁺/Na⁺/Cl⁻ model. Use equal concentration units and a consistent permeability convention. Zero summed ionic current does not require zero current in every branch. Cl⁻ has “in” in the numerator and “out” in the denominator, opposite to the cations. GHK is not an arithmetic average of Nernst voltages, and −85 mV is the source’s example, not a universal constant.

中文条件与易错点：此式针对恒电场、单价 K⁺/Na⁺/Cl⁻ 模型。浓度单位与通透性约定要一致。总离子电流为零，不要求每个支路电流都为零。 Cl⁻ 的胞内项在分子、胞外项在分母，与阳离子相反。GHK 不是各 Nernst 电位的算术平均；−85 mV 是课件示例，不是普适常数。

ENTiny example: If PNa and PCl are negligible, the ratio reduces to [K⁺]out/[K⁺]in and the K⁺ Nernst result. Currents +2, −1.5 and −0.5 nA can sum to zero while each is nonzero.

中文短例理解：若 PNa、PCl 可忽略，式子退化为 K⁺ 的胞外/胞内浓度比，即 K⁺ Nernst 结果。+2、−1.5、−0.5 nA 总和为零，但各项仍不为零。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p28–31 | T7-0017–0018

FX703 · [P3] Ionic branch: conductance and driving forceFX703 · [P3] 离子支路：电导与驱动力

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Supporting circuit vocabulary from a slide the teacher described as reference; not a teacher-confirmed Quiz formula to memorize.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。课堂称相关细胞数学式供参考；这是支路模型补充，不是老师明确要求 Quiz 必背的公式。

Formula: 公式： Iion = gion(Vm − Eion) = (Vm − Eion)/Rion; gion = 1/Rion

ENSymbols and units: Iion: branch current (A), positive outward under the chosen convention; gion: conductance (S); Rion: resistance (Ω); Vm and Eion: voltages in the same unit.

中文符号与单位：Iion：支路电流（A），按所选约定取向外为正；gion：电导（S）；Rion：电阻（Ω）；Vm、Eion 用同一电压单位。

ENWhen to use: Separate ion concentration equilibrium voltage from the current at the actual membrane voltage. The difference Vm−Eion is the electrical driving force in this model.

中文何时使用：把该离子的平衡电位与实际膜电位下的电流分开；这个模型的驱动力是 Vm−Eion。

ENConditions and traps: A passive, locally ohmic ion-channel branch with specified conductance and sign convention. Channel conductance can change with time or voltage; the formula is not a complete cell model. Zero current in this branch occurs at Vm=Eion, but zero total membrane current can arise from nonzero cancelling branches. Do not equate conductance with permeability.

中文条件与易错点：针对给定电导与符号约定的被动、局部欧姆性离子通道支路。通道电导可随时间/电压改变；此式不是完整细胞模型。 此支路在 Vm=Eion 时电流为零；总膜电流也可由多个非零支路相抵而为零。电导不应直接等同通透性。

ENTiny example: g=10 nS, Vm=−70 mV and Eion=−90 mV give I=10 nS×20 mV=200 pA outward.

中文短例理解：g=10 nS、Vm=−70 mV、Eion=−90 mV，得到 I=10 nS×20 mV=200 pA，按约定向外。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p30 | T7-0017

FX704 · [P2] Einthoven limb leads: write the polarity firstFX704 · [P2] Einthoven 肢体导联：先写清极性

ENRevision priority: Important supporting relations. A short polarity identity printed in the ECG slide; understand it without elevating deep cardiac physiology.

中文复习优先级：重要基础关系。原 ECG 课件的短极性关系，应能理解；不因此提高深层心脏生理的复习权重。

Formula: 公式： Lead I = V_LA − V_RA; Lead II = V_LL − V_RA; Lead III = V_LL − V_LA; Lead II = Lead I + Lead III

ENSymbols and units: RA: right arm, LA: left arm, LL: left leg of the person; each V is an electrode potential referred to the same reference, usually in mV.

中文符号与单位：RA 是人体右臂，LA 是左臂，LL 是左腿；每个 V 是相对同一参考点的电极电位，通常用 mV。

ENWhen to use: Recover the third standard limb-lead voltage from two leads and avoid confusing electrode locations with P/QRS/T waveform features.

中文何时使用：由两个标准肢体导联求第三个电压；区分电极位置与 P/QRS/T 波形特征。

ENConditions and traps: The standard simultaneous limb-lead definitions must be used consistently. On W7 p69, electrode 1=RA, 2=LA and 3=LL; left/right is the subject’s anatomy, not the viewer’s image side. Reversing a subtraction reverses the sign. Lead II is not the QRS complex, and the identity does not add three different stages of the cardiac cycle.

中文条件与易错点：必须统一采用同时测量的标准肢体导联定义。W7 p69 的 1=RA、2=LA、3=LL；左右指人体解剖学左右，不是观看图纸的左右。 颠倒相减顺序就会反号。Lead II 不是 QRS 波群，此关系不是把三个不同心动阶段相加。

ENTiny example: Lead I=+0.2 mV and Lead III=+0.3 mV imply Lead II=+0.5 mV. If the lead-I terminals are swapped, that measured trace changes sign.

中文短例理解：Lead I=+0.2 mV、Lead III=+0.3 mV，则 Lead II=+0.5 mV。若交换 I 导联的测量端，这条记录反号。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p68–69 | T7-0072–0073

FX705 · [P1] Frequency, peak intervals and heart rateFX705 · [P1] 频率、峰间隔与心率

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. Time-window frequency reading is a repeated classroom and Sample Q5 priority. RR calculation is an additional short ECG application; the source’s blurry Q5 letter remains provisional.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。时间窗读频率为课堂反复强调且 Sample Q5 涉及的重点；RR 心率是短应用。模糊 Q5 的参考字母仍不能当已确认精确答案。

Formula: 公式： f = N/(t₂ − t₁) = 1/T; For n successive matching peaks: f = (n−1)/(tlast − tfirst); Heart rate (beats/min) = 60/RR(s)

ENSymbols and units: N: complete cycles in the selected time window; n: number of successive matching peaks; T: one period (s); RR: time between successive ECG R peaks (s); f in Hz.

中文符号与单位：N：时间窗内的完整周期数；n：连续同相位峰的个数；T：单周期（s）；RR：连续心电 R 峰的间隔（s）；f 单位 Hz。

ENWhen to use: Read a time-axis waveform rather than guessing frequency from amplitude. Use RR specifically when estimating heart rate.

中文何时使用：根据时间轴读频率，不用幅度猜频率；计算心率时要选 RR 间隔。

ENConditions and traps: A reasonably periodic signal with a defined cycle. Convert ms to s; use the actual difference between the time endpoints. Irregular EEG permits only a representative-window estimate. n peak positions delimit n−1 intervals. A window starting at 0.2 s does not have duration equal to its final timestamp. HR arithmetic must not be applied to arbitrary EMG spikes.

中文条件与易错点：信号近似周期性，且已定义一个周期。ms 要换成 s；时长是两端相减。对不规则 EEG，只能用代表性时间窗估读。 n 个峰位置划出 n−1 个间隔。时间从 0.2 s 开始时，不能把末时刻当总时长。不能把心率算法随便套到任意 EMG 尖峰。

ENTiny example: Eight complete cycles in 0.20 s give 40 Hz. Nine successive peak positions spanning 0.20 s also give 40 Hz. RR=0.8 s gives 75 beats/min.

中文短例理解：0.20 s 内 8 个完整周期得 40 Hz；9 个连续峰从首到末跨 0.20 s 也得 40 Hz。RR=0.8 s 得 75 次/分。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p64–67, p83–85 | T7-0070–0071 | T7-0092–0095 | Sample Quiz Q5

FX708 · [P3] Loading and contact mismatch: voltage-divider modelFX708 · [P3] 加载与接触不匹配：分压模型

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Supporting model from a worked historical final-exam example; the Quiz priority is loading/matched-contact understanding, not the long network calculation.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。来自课堂讲过的往年期末模型，作为辅助；Quiz 应先理解加载与接触匹配，不必把长网络计算提为重点。

Formula: 公式： Vinput = Vsource·Zin/(Zsource+Zin); VA−VB = Vcm[Zin/(Z₁+Zin) − Zin/(Z₂+Zin)]

ENSymbols and units: Zin: amplifier input impedance; Zsource: source impedance; Z₁,Z₂: the two electrode-contact impedances; Vcm: shared body voltage; A is on the Z₁ branch and B on Z₂ here.

中文符号与单位：Zin：放大器输入阻抗；Zsource：信号源阻抗；Z₁、Z₂：两端电极接触阻抗；Vcm：身体共有电压；这里 A 接 Z₁ 支路、B 接 Z₂。

ENWhen to use: Explain reduced loading when Zin is large and why unequal electrode impedances can convert common-mode interference into a differential input.

中文何时使用：说明大 Zin 如何减少加载，以及两电极阻抗不等如何把共模干扰转成差分输入。

ENConditions and traps: The second relation is the simplified equal-input-impedance circuit on W7 p74–75. For AC, use complex impedances and phasors consistently; the slide’s supplied real values are one special case. Do not divide using impedance magnitudes alone when phase matters. In p74 A has Z₁=20 kΩ and B has Z₂=10 kΩ; the source’s positive 137 μV is an interference amplitude, not signed VA−VB.

中文条件与易错点：第二式对应 W7 p74–75 的等输入阻抗简化电路。交流要统一用复阻抗与相量；原题给的实数阻抗是一个特例。 相位重要时，不能只用阻抗的模来分压。p74 中 A 对 Z₁=20 kΩ、B 对 Z₂=10 kΩ；源解 +137 μV 是干扰幅值，不是严格的有符号 VA−VB。

ENTiny example: Zsource=100 kΩ gives Vinput/Vsource=0.50 for Zin=100 kΩ, but ≈0.990 for Zin=10 MΩ. If Z₁=Z₂, the ideal common-mode differential term is zero.

中文短例理解：Zsource=100 kΩ：Zin=100 kΩ 时保留 0.50 倍电压，Zin=10 MΩ 时保留约 0.990 倍。Z₁=Z₂ 时，理想共模转差分项为零。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p74–75 | W8 PDF p20 | T7-0074–0077 | T8-0023

FX709 · [P3] Electrode-interface RC impedance and limitsFX709 · [P3] 电极界面 RC 阻抗与频率极限

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Full impedance algebra is retained for source completeness and final-exam support. Matching-contact and frequency trends are more important for the current concept-heavy Quiz.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。完整阻抗式供源式查阅与期末辅助；当前概念型 Quiz 更应先会接触匹配与频率趋势。

Formula: 公式： Z(ω) = Rs + Rd/(1+jωRdCd); |Z| = √[(Rs+Rd)²+(ωRsRdCd)²]/√[1+(ωRdCd)²]; Low f: Z→Rs+Rd; high f: Z→Rs; ω=2πf

ENSymbols and units: Rs: solution/series resistance; Rd: interfacial resistance; Cd: interfacial capacitance; Z in Ω, C in F, ω in rad/s, f in Hz; j²=−1. The p76 example uses Rs=R₁, Rd=R₂, Cd=C.

中文符号与单位：Rs：溶液/串联电阻；Rd：界面电阻；Cd：界面电容；Z 用 Ω、C 用 F、ω 用 rad/s、f 用 Hz；j²=−1。p76 例题中 Rs=R₁、Rd=R₂、Cd=C。

ENWhen to use: Turn the illustrated Rs+(Rd∥Cd) interface into a usable formula and predict low-/high-frequency behavior.

中文何时使用：把 Rs 串联 Rd∥Cd 的界面示意转为可使用的式子，并判断低频/高频行为。

ENConditions and traps: The simple linear lumped interface model omits diffusion and additional skin layers. A dc half-cell voltage offset is separate from this small-signal impedance. Substitute ω=2πf before calculation. W7 p78’s table is not consistent with its stated components when read as Hz. An EIS Nyquist plot has Z′ and usually −Z″ axes; frequency labels belong to points, not its horizontal axis.

中文条件与易错点：此线性集中参数简化模型未包含扩散与额外皮肤层。直流半电池电位偏移与这里的小信号阻抗不同。 计算前代入 ω=2πf。W7 p78 的原表按 Hz 读时与给定元件值不一致。EIS Nyquist 图横轴为 Z′、纵轴常为 −Z″；频率属于各测量点的标签，不是横坐标。

ENTiny example: Rs=300 Ω, Rd=20 kΩ and Cd=100 nF give limits 20.3 kΩ and 300 Ω; at f=100 Hz, |Z|≈12.64 kΩ.

中文短例理解：Rs=300 Ω、Rd=20 kΩ、Cd=100 nF，低/高频极限为 20.3 kΩ 与 300 Ω；f=100 Hz 时 |Z|≈12.64 kΩ。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p41–42, p76–78 | W6 PDF p66, p84–85 (Nyquist/Bode comparison) | T7-0035–0038 | T7-0077–0081

FX713 · [P3] Sampling Nyquist frequency is not an impedance-plot axisFX713 · [P3] 采样 Nyquist 频率不是阻抗图的横轴

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. The temporal sampling formula was not found as a required W7–8 formula. It is a bridge to W4 spatial sampling and the guide’s S505; do not label it teacher-confirmed Quiz material.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。没有在 W7–8 找到该时间采样式的必考要求。它用于联系 W4 空间采样及原讲义 S505，不标成老师确认的 Quiz 考点。

Formula: 公式： fs = 1/Δts; fNyquist = fs/2; For a baseband band-limited signal: fs > 2fmax

ENSymbols and units: fs: samples per second (Hz); Δts: sample interval (s); fNyquist: half the sample rate; fmax: highest retained signal frequency after suitable anti-alias filtering.

中文符号与单位：fs：每秒采样数（Hz）；Δts：采样间隔（s）；fNyquist：采样率的一半；fmax：经过适当抗混叠滤波后需保留的最高信号频率。

ENWhen to use: Separate a waveform’s oscillation frequency from its digital sampling rate, and separate the sampling theorem from an EIS Nyquist impedance plot.

中文何时使用：区分波形振荡频率与数字采样率，并区分采样定理和 EIS Nyquist 阻抗图。

ENConditions and traps: This is a supplementary baseband sampling relation. The signal must be band-limited and the acquisition path appropriate; exactly two samples per cycle can lose information at unfavorable phase, so allow margin. Neither a taller EEG wave nor more spatial electrodes determines fs. An EIS Nyquist plot uses Z′ versus −Z″ and its points have frequency labels; fNyquist=fs/2 is a different concept.

中文条件与易错点：这是补充的基带采样关系。信号需限带且采集通路合适；恰好每周期两次在不利相位下可能丢失信息，应留余量。 EEG 更高的波幅或更多空间电极都不直接决定 fs。EIS Nyquist 图画 Z′ 与 −Z″，每点带有测量频率；fNyquist=fs/2 是另一概念。

ENTiny example: fs=2000 samples/s gives fNyquist=1000 Hz. A retained 400 Hz baseband component is below that limit, provided higher-frequency contamination is adequately filtered.

中文短例理解：fs=2000 次/秒，则 fNyquist=1000 Hz。要保留的 400 Hz 基带成分低于此限，但还需适当滤掉更高频干扰。

Source / 来源：W4 PDF p33–34 (spatial-sampling context) | W7 PDF p83–85 (time-axis context) | W6 PDF p66, p84–85 (impedance-plot comparison) | T7-0092–0095 | NI primary digitization guide (fNyquist=fs/2): https://download.ni.com/evaluation/daq/NI_Engineers_Guide_to_Digitization.pdf

FX706 · [P1] Differential voltage and shared-noise cancellationFX706 · [P1] 差分电压与共有噪声抵消

ENRevision priority: First: know and calculate. The source repeatedly explains differential recording and gain; this consolidates the existing short formula with its cancellation conditions.

中文复习优先级：优先掌握与短算。课堂反复讲差分与增益；此卡把已有短式与抵消条件合在一起，不只是孤立背公式。

Formula: 公式： Vd = V₁ − V₂; Vout = G·Vd; If V₁=s₁+n and V₂=s₂+n: Vd=s₁−s₂; If noises differ: Vd=(s₁−s₂)+(n₁−n₂)

ENSymbols and units: Vd: differential input voltage; V₁,V₂: input electrode voltages; s: wanted components; n: interference; G: dimensionless voltage gain. All voltage terms use matching units.

中文符号与单位：Vd：差分输入电压；V₁、V₂：两输入电极电位；s 为有用成分，n 为干扰；G 是无单位电压增益。所有电压项用一致单位。

ENWhen to use: Explain why a large shared background can cancel while a small biological difference remains; then calculate the output voltage.

中文何时使用：解释为什么大共同背景可以抵消，小的生物电位差仍可保留，再计算输出。

ENConditions and traps: Linear amplifier operation within input/output limits. Ideal cancellation requires equal interference at both inputs; real finite common-mode rejection and unequal contact cause residual error. High input impedance reduces loading; it does not set G. Gain amplifies remaining differential noise as well as signal. It is not a filter or a guarantee of better SNR.

中文条件与易错点：要求放大器在输入/输出限制内线性工作。理想抵消要求两端干扰相同；有限共模抑制与接触差异仍会留下误差。 高输入阻抗减少加载，不决定 G。增益也会放大残留差分噪声；放大不是滤波，也不保证信噪比提高。

ENTiny example: V₁=2.02 mV, V₂=2.00 mV and G=1000 give Vd=20 μV and Vout=20 mV.

中文短例理解：V₁=2.02 mV、V₂=2.00 mV、G=1000，得 Vd=20 μV、Vout=20 mV。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p52–54 | W8 PDF p19–22 | T7-0043–0046 | T8-0021–0025

FX707 · [P3] CMRR: a rejection ratio, not voltage gainFX707 · [P3] CMRR：共模抑制比，不是电压增益

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Definition-level support for common-mode rejection, verified against TI primary documentation. CMRR was not found as a printed formula or required term in the supplied W7–8 slides/transcripts.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。这是共模抑制的定义型补充，已据 TI 原厂资料核验；提供的 W7–8 课件/字幕中未找到 CMRR 印刷公式或必背要求。

Formula: 公式： Vcm = (V₁+V₂)/2; Vout = Ad·Vd + Acm·Vcm; CMRRlinear = |Ad/Acm|; CMRRdB = 20 log₁₀(CMRRlinear); CMRRlinear = 10^(CMRRdB/20); Voltage-gain dB = 20 log₁₀|Ad|

ENSymbols and units: Vcm: common-mode input; Ad: differential voltage gain; Acm: gain from common-mode input to output; both gains are dimensionless and taken at the same frequency.

中文符号与单位：Vcm：共模输入；Ad：差模电压增益；Acm：共模输入到输出的增益。两个增益均无单位，必须在同一频率比较。

ENWhen to use: Quantify how strongly an amplifier rejects a shared input compared with amplifying a difference; distinguish a linear ratio from its dB representation.

中文何时使用：量化放大器在放大差值的同时抑制共有输入的能力，区分线性比值与 dB 表示。

ENConditions and traps: A linear small-signal model with the stated Vd/Vcm definitions. CMRR can depend on frequency and operating conditions. Ideal Acm=0 gives infinite CMRR; a real device is finite. Ad alone is not CMRR. Use 20 log for a voltage-gain ratio, not 10 log, and do not insert a dB number directly as G in Vout=G Vin.

中文条件与易错点：采用给定 Vd/Vcm 定义的线性小信号模型。CMRR 可随频率和工作条件改变。理想 Acm=0 时 CMRR 无穷大，真实器件为有限值。 只知道 Ad 不等于知道 CMRR。电压增益比用 20 log，不是 10 log；不能把 dB 数直接当 G 代入 Vout=G Vin。

ENTiny example: Ad=1000 and Acm=0.1 give CMRRlinear=10000 and CMRRdB=80 dB. The differential voltage gain alone is 60 dB, a different quantity.

中文短例理解：Ad=1000、Acm=0.1 时，CMRR线性比=10000，CMRR=80 dB；差模电压增益本身为 60 dB，是不同的量。

Source / 来源：W7 PDF p53–54 (underlying subtraction concept, not a printed CMRR formula) | W8 PDF p20–22 (amplifier context) | T7-0044–0045 | TI Precision Labs instrumentation-amplifier introduction: https://www.ti.com/video/series/precision-labs/ti-precision-labs-instrumentation-amplifiers.html

FX710 · [P3] Ideal inverting and non-inverting op-amp gainsFX710 · [P3] 理想反相与同相运放增益

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. The circuits are printed on p24, but the lecturer’s nearby “reference” wording does not make their memorization a confirmed Quiz requirement.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。p24 印有这两式；附近“仅供参考”的课堂措辞不足以确认它们属于 Quiz 必背公式，保留作辅助。

Formula: 公式： Inverting: G = −Rf/Ri; Vout = −(Rf/Ri)Vin; Non-inverting: G = 1+Rf/Ri; Vout = (1+Rf/Ri)Vin; Ideal negative-feedback approximation: V₊≈V₋; I₊≈I₋≈0

ENSymbols and units: Rf: feedback resistance from output to the − input; Ri: input resistance in the inverting circuit or lower feedback-divider resistance in the non-inverting circuit; G is dimensionless.

中文符号与单位：Rf：输出返回“−”端的反馈电阻；Ri：反相连接的输入电阻，或同相连接反馈分压网络的下臂电阻；G 无单位。

ENWhen to use: Identify polarity and compute a short output-voltage example from the resistor ratio.

中文何时使用：根据电阻比判断极性，并作简短输出电压计算。

ENConditions and traps: Ideal op-amp, stable negative feedback and linear unsaturated operation, with sufficient bandwidth and input common-mode range. Virtual equality of inputs is an approximation, not a physical short circuit. The non-inverting gain includes +1. A negative gain reverses polarity; it does not mean zero amplification or a negative resistance. Do not apply the formulas after clipping.

中文条件与易错点：理想运放、稳定负反馈、未饱和线性工作，还需合适带宽与输入共模范围。两输入虚短是近似，不是实体导线短接。 同相增益不能漏掉 +1。负增益表示反号，不是没有放大或电阻为负；削顶后不能继续套线性式。

ENTiny example: Rf=20 kΩ, Ri=10 kΩ and Vin=+1 mV give −2 mV (inverting) or +3 mV (non-inverting).

中文短例理解：Rf=20 kΩ、Ri=10 kΩ、Vin=+1 mV，反相输出 −2 mV，同相输出 +3 mV。

Source / 来源：W8 PDF p23–24 | T8-0025–0026

FX711 · [P3] First-order RC cutoff and low-/high-pass responseFX711 · [P3] 一阶 RC 截止与低通/高通响应

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Filter-role recognition is P1 elsewhere. These equations are supporting reference; the source’s old RC example was locally excluded from this year’s exam.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。滤波功能辨认在正文仍为 P1；这些关系式作辅助查阅。原旧 RC 例题在局部语境中被说成今年 exam 不出。

Formula: 公式： τ = RC; ωc = 1/(RC); fc = 1/(2πRC); x = ωRC = f/fc; HLP = 1/(1+jx); HHP = jx/(1+jx); |HLP| = 1/√(1+x²); |HHP| = x/√(1+x²); At fc: |H| = 1/√2 ≈0.707 (−3.01 dB relative to the passband)

ENSymbols and units: R in Ω, C in F, τ in s, fc in Hz, ωc in rad/s; H=Vout/Vin is dimensionless; LP/HP mean low-/high-pass; j²=−1.

中文符号与单位：R 用 Ω、C 用 F、τ 用 s、fc 用 Hz、ωc 用 rad/s；H=Vout/Vin 无单位；LP/HP 为低通/高通；j²=−1。

ENWhen to use: Locate the transition and connect a formula to the filter graph: low-pass keeps the low-frequency side; high-pass keeps the high-frequency side. Increasing R or C lowers the cutoff.

中文何时使用：定位过渡区并把公式和曲线联系起来：低通保留低频侧，高通保留高频侧；R 或 C 增大都会降低截止频率。

ENConditions and traps: These are standard passive, first-order RC stages with negligible source/loading effects. Output is across C for LP and across R for HP. Active-filter passband gain need not be unity. Convert pF=10⁻¹² F and kΩ=10³ Ω. ωc and fc differ by 2π. The teacher excluded the particular repeated 82 pF/240 kΩ exam example, not every filter formula or every simple Quiz calculation.

中文条件与易错点：针对信号源/负载影响可忽略的标准无源一阶 RC 级。低通输出取 C 两端，高通输出取 R 两端。有源滤波器的通带增益不必为 1。 先换 pF=10⁻¹² F、kΩ=10³ Ω。ωc 与 fc 相差 2π。老师局部排除的是重复的 82 pF/240 kΩ exam 例题，不是所有滤波公式或所有 Quiz 短计算。

ENTiny example: R=10 kΩ and C=100 nF give τ=1 ms, ωc=1000 rad/s and fc≈159 Hz. At 10fc, LP magnitude≈0.100 and HP≈0.995.

中文短例理解：R=10 kΩ、C=100 nF，得 τ=1 ms、ωc=1000 rad/s、fc≈159 Hz。10fc 时，低通幅度约 0.100，高通约 0.995。

Source / 来源：W8 PDF p25–29 | T8-0026–0029

FX712 · [P3] Optional active analog-filter equationsFX712 · [P3] 可选：有源模拟滤波器完整式

ENRevision priority: Recognise; optional calculations. Source completeness only. The teacher prioritized meanings and short relations, and did not ask students to memorize long filter algebra.

中文复习优先级：辅助辨认；计算后看。仅为源式完整性保留。老师强调含义与短式，没有要求把长滤波代数式当必背题。

Formula: 公式： Define H(s)=Vout/Vin; s=jω for a sinusoidal steady state; High-pass: H(s) = −sCR₂/(1+sCR₁); f₀ = 1/(2πR₁C); Band-pass: H(s) = −sC₁R₂/[(1+sC₁R₁)(1+sC₂R₂)]; f₁ = 1/(2πR₁C₁); f₂ = 1/(2πR₂C₂)

ENSymbols and units: R₁: input-path resistance; R₂: feedback resistance; C or C₁: input-path capacitance; C₂: feedback capacitance in the p29 circuit; s in s⁻¹, f in Hz.

中文符号与单位：R₁：输入通路电阻；R₂：反馈电阻；C 或 C₁：输入通路电容；C₂：p29 电路的反馈电容；s 单位 s⁻¹，f 单位 Hz。

ENWhen to use: Keep the actual p27/p29 source equations available, while understanding that a high-pass stage and a low-pass factor can make a band-pass response.

中文何时使用：保留 p27/p29 的实际源式供查看，同时理解高通项配合低通项可形成带通响应。

ENConditions and traps: The illustrated ideal inverting op-amp circuits must remain linear. The two characteristic stage frequencies are not automatically the overall −3 dB boundaries; a clear passband requires suitably separated f₁<f₂. p27 prints an extra minus sign before Vout/Vin that conflicts with its inverting diagram and negative transfer function. Here H is consistently Vout/Vin. Do not memorize the long transfer function as a teacher-confirmed Quiz requirement.

中文条件与易错点：针对图示理想反相运放，须保持线性。两个级的特征频率不自动等于总响应的精确 −3 dB 边界；清楚的通带要求 f₁<f₂ 且有适当间隔。 p27 把 Vout/Vin 前多印了一个负号，与反相图和后面的负传递函数不一致；此处统一定义 H=Vout/Vin。长传递函数不能宣传成老师确认的 Quiz 必背式。

ENTiny example: For the high-pass stage with R₂/R₁=10, low-frequency gain tends to zero; at sufficiently high frequency its ideal gain tends to −10, so the magnitude tends to 10.

中文短例理解：有源高通若 R₂/R₁=10，低频增益趋于零；足够高频的理想增益趋于 −10，幅度趋于 10。

Source / 来源：W8 PDF p27, p29 | T8-0026–0029 | T8-0062–0064

中文哪项陈述错误？优先找错误方向或条件。

中文哪项不属于……？不要漏看NOT。

中文线性区／校准斜率；排除饱和点。

中文假设其他条件相同；才能只比较一个因素。

中文更高分辨本领／更小可分辨间距：都表示分辨更好。

中文入射／吸收／发射光子：量子产率分母用吸收光子。

中文参比电极／参考光臂：一个用于电位基准，一个用于干涉比较。

中文细胞内／细胞外：膜电位定义的相减方向不能反。

Source corrections and sample cautions源材料纠错与样题注意点

ENPMT correction: the lecture description at T4-0049–0050 wrongly describes tiny mirrors and optical reflection. The actual diagram (W4 p35) labels dynodes: multiplication is by secondary electron emission. Amplification does not remove all noise. See Hamamatsu’s PMT explanation.

中文PMT纠错：T4-0049–0050把结构说成小镜子与光反射，讲解不准确。原图W4 p35标有dynodes倍增极，实际为二次电子发射倍增；放大不等于消除全部噪声。已核对 Hamamatsu官方PMT说明。

ENThe X-ray “non-ionizing” error also occurs in the original W4 p7, not only a student sheet. Correct it to ionizing; see FDA medical X-ray imaging. W7 p84 also misprints gamma as <25 Hz; learn the band ordering here rather than memorizing this inconsistent boundary.

中文X射线“non-ionizing”的错误也出现在原课件W4 p7，不只是学生一页纸；应改为电离性，见 FDA医学X射线说明。W7 p84还把gamma误写为<25 Hz；这里保留频带顺序，不让你死背不一致的边界。

ENFurther wording safeguards: the glucose/peroxide example is not universal to amperometry; high input impedance is not voltage gain; below-threshold neurons still have a resting potential; ECG leads are not the P/QRS/T waves. These conceptual corrections take precedence over loose oral wording.

中文另已防止四种过度概括：葡萄糖/过氧化氢例子不代表全部安培传感；高输入阻抗不等于高电压增益；未达阈值仍有静息电位；心电导联不等于P/QRS/T波。复习采用纠正后的概念，不照抄宽泛口头表述。

ENSample Q10 follows the lecturer’s integer-threshold answer B=5. Q5 remains a provisional waveform estimate; Q9 is a detector-principle reference answer rather than an unambiguous spoken final letter; Q12 retains a current/current-density unit inconsistency. Use the review report for details.

中文样题Q10采用老师整数阈值解释，答案B=5。Q5仍为暂定波形估读；Q9是按探测器原理推导的参考答案，课堂没有明确最后字母；Q12保留电流/电流密度单位冲突说明。细节见复核报告。

中文第一遍读F01–F08及各项中文讲解，包括相邻S补充与读图说明；进入下一项前，自己说出测什么、为什么输出会变。第二遍对应英文术语，并解释每个选项。旧32页速记版可回顾原主线，但未含本次补漏；新增区别应以这份更新后的讲解版为准。
